Audacy is seeking a high-energy Sales Project Manager to serve as operational support of our sales team. This is a role for a bright, proactive self-starter who thrives in the pace of media and entertainment and takes genuine satisfaction in keeping complex, fast-moving work on track.

Acting as the team's Sales Project Manager you will partner closely with Sales Managers and Account Executives to coordinate priorities, streamline workflow, and serve as a key liaison between internal teams and, when appropriate, clients. The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, detail-driven, and comfortable navigating a variety of personalities and priorities without losing momentum.

If you love the energy of a dynamic media workplace, take pride in flawless execution, and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves when things get busy, you'll thrive here.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

  • Serve as the central point of coordination for the sales team, managing projects, building proposals, and keeping campaigns moving forward on schedule.
  • Support Sales Managers and Account Executives with day-to-day project management, deadline tracking, and follow-through across competing priorities.
  • Build, maintain, and update sales materials, presentations, proposals, and recap decks with a high standard of accuracy and polish.
  • Manage CRM system information and pipeline reporting in Salesforce, ensuring data integrity, timely updates, and clean handoffs between teams.
  • Coordinate order entry, traffic, and campaign execution in partnership with traffic, production, and operations teams using Wide Orbit and related platforms.
  • Act as a liaison between sales, marketing, programming, digital, and finance teams to keep cross-functional initiatives aligned.
  • Track key sales metrics, prepare reports, and surface insights that help leadership make faster, sharper decisions.
  • Coordinate client-facing logistics where appropriate, including meetings, events, follow-ups, and post-campaign reporting.
  • Anticipate roadblocks and proactively solve problems before they become issues.

 

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales support, project coordination, account management, or a comparable operational role — media, entertainment, or advertising experience is a strong plus.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously without dropping detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the polish and judgment to interact with senior leaders, sales talent, and clients.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce (or comparable CRM); familiarity with Wide Orbit or other broadcast traffic systems strongly preferred.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook) and/or Google Workspace.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset where you are comfortable taking initiative, asking the right questions, and operating with minimal supervision.
  • Composure under pressure and a sense of humor when the pace picks up.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

 

Preferred:

job.title: Search Engine Marketing (SEM) Account Manager
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Search Engine Marketing Account Manager

 

Department: Digital

 

Reporting To: SEM Product Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Any of Audacy's 48 markets

 

Work Arrangement: Remote

 

Pay Transparency:

 

The anticipated starting salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $55,000.00/Yr. - $65,000/Yr. 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

 

The Search Engine Marketing (SEM) Account Manager, reporting to the SEM Product Manager, is an integral member of Audacy’s centralized Revenue Operations Search team. This individual is responsible for building, managing, monitoring and analyzing client Google Ads campaigns while serving as the primary SEM contact for sales teams and external vendors.

 

The Account Manager will proactively optimize campaigns in accordance with Audacy SEM best practices and provide strategic recommendations to support campaign performance and client success. This individual must be comfortable adapting to evolving platforms, processes and priorities while remaining receptive to direction and established team standards. Day-to-day guidance and support will be provided by the SEM Product Manager.

 

This position is eligible for remote work in any of Audacy’s 48 markets.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Use forecasting and research tools to provide sales teams with accurate estimates of campaign potential for prospective clients
  • Build and launch Google Ads campaigns, including campaign structures, keyword strategies, ad copy, targeting, budgets and supporting assets
  • Complete required pre-launch and post-launch quality checks to ensure campaigns are accurate and aligned with approved strategies
  • Proactively monitor and optimize campaigns using performance data, industry standards and established Audacy SEM best practices
  • Regularly review search terms, keywords, ads, bidding strategies and conversion data to identify opportunities to improve performance
  • Manage campaign budgets and pacing to support accurate monthly spending and full delivery over the life of each campaign
  • Review conversion tracking and reporting for accuracy, troubleshoot concerns and coordinate with internal teams or vendors when additional support is needed
  • Analyze campaign performance and clearly communicate results, recommendations, required actions and potential growth opportunities to sales teams
  • Manage multiple accounts, requests and deadlines while maintaining accurate documentation and proactively communicating priorities, concerns or potential delays
  • Identify and escalate performance, tracking, policy, billing or fulfillment concerns before they negatively affect a campaign or client
  • Stay current with evolving advertising platforms, SEM products and internal processes, applying new team guidance and Audacy SEM best practices as directed
  • Collaborate with sales teams, internal partners and external vendors to support accurate campaign execution and a positive client experience

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • BS/BA degree or relevant experience
  • Paid search or digital media advertising experience preferred
  • Experience with keyword research tools and ability to use these tools to setup/expand SEM campaigns
  • Working knowledge of Google Ads, Bing Ads, or other PPC platforms 
  • Proficient in Microsoft office suite and Google Workspace

With an emphasis on supporting and amplifying Audacy’s programming and talent, the Social Content Strategy Manager will focus on working closely with our local markets to translate the energy and immediacy of our content (sports broadcasts, show analysis, personalities, podcasts, pop culture and fan moments) into compelling, social-first storytelling that drives engagement and builds community. Tired of the LA hustle? Thinking about moving to Las Vegas? You'll be in good company—plenty of Californians have already made the move. If you're looking for a fresh start and a great career opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!  

We are seeking a creative, high-energy, and multi-talented Social Media Producer & Graphic Designer to join our media team. This dual-focused role is perfect for a digital storyteller who can seamlessly blend community management with striking visual design.

In this role, you will be the creative force behind five of our distinct radio station brands, driving audience engagement through dynamic social content (video, graphics and written content). Additionally, you will serve as the go-to visual designer for our digital sales team, crafting high-impact marketing collateral, client pitch decks, and digital advertisements that drive revenue.

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Regional Staff Engineer

Department: Technical

Reporting To: Regional Director, Technical Operations 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a talented Regional Staff Engineer to join our Houston-based engineering team. This hands-on role is ideal for a proactive professional with robust radio broadcast engineering skills and the flexibility to provide support and travel to multiple markets.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain, inspect, and repair all broadcast radio station equipment, including high power FM + HD, AM, digital audio & audio streaming, studio equipment, automation systems, remote control equipment, remote broadcast equipment, satellite downlinks, network infrastructure, generators, backup power systems, and related equipment in keeping with good engineering practices.
  • Support studio operations by managing AOIP networks, studio hardware, UPS systems, remote control equipment, and VOIP/telephone systems.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance by reviewing weekly transmitter and studio logs, EAS tests, and tower lighting requirements per F.C.C. regulations.
  • Install and troubleshoot broadcast IT systems, including WideOrbit and Axia, at both studio and transmitter sites.
  • Oversee critical infrastructure maintenance, including generator testing, fueling, and UPS system supervision.
  • Collaborate with the Corporate Networking Team and vendors to manage ISP/Networking circuits and service calls.
  • Assist in the technical planning and development of facilities, including data networks and backup power systems.
  • Develop instructional materials and provide training for operators on technical equipment and systems.
  • Provide 24/7 emergency support for equipment failures, including availability for weekends and holidays as required.
  • Maintain broadcast IT systems at studios and transmitter sites, such as WideOrbit and Axia 
  • Assist in planning and development of all aspects of technical facilities including studios, transmitters, AOIP, VOIP, satellite, STL, computers and data networks
  • Create instructional materials and teach operators to use technical equipment and systems
  • Handle ISP/Networking problems and service calls. Work with Corp Networking Team, Vendor Technicians to install and troubleshoot circuits.  
  • Generator testing, fueling and supervision of Generator maintenance.
  • UPS testing and supervision of maintenance.
  • Effectively communicate and partner with programming staff as well as outside partners.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required:

  • Minimum 5 years broadcast engineering experience.
  • Associate’s degree in electronics preferred.
  • IT networking skills preferred.
  • Knowledge of FCC rules and regulations.
  • Ability to provide support 24/7 in case of equipment failure; available to work various hours/days, including weekends and holidays.
  • FCC General Class License or SBE Certifications are a plus.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Role Overview:

Audacy is seeking a high-performing Manager, Strategic Finance & FP&A to drive the financial planning and operational analysis for our Podcasting division while providing corporate finance support at the total-company level.

This role partners closely with the SVP of Strategic Finance, providing hands-on execution support across both podcasting business partnering and corporate finance deliverables. You will bridge the gap between financial analysis and business strategy—translating operational metrics into actionable insights for podcast leadership while supporting enterprise-level executive reporting.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Podcasting Business Partnering & Operational FP&A:

  • Executive Business Partnering: Act as a trusted financial partner to Podcasting leadership, Content Development, and Sales Ops, translating operational drivers into financial strategies to maximize division profitability.
  • Business Unit Reporting: Lead the monthly reporting package for the Podcasting division, delivering variance analysis, KPI performance tracking, and operational commentary to podcast leadership. 
  • P&L & Forecast Ownership: Lead monthly rolling forecasting, annual budgeting, and financial performance tracking for the podcasting business unit.
  • Deal Strategy & Commercial Support: Model investment ROI and commercial deal structures for new talent acquisitions, show renewals, and strategic content partnerships.
  • Monetization & Yield Optimization: Partner with ad sales and operations to track yield, inventory utilization, CPM trends, and cost-to-serve dynamics.
  • Financial Operations Oversight: Oversee high-level show financial workflows, ensuring seamless alignment between content operations, vendor invoice processing, and creator payout compliance.

 

Total-Company Strategic Finance:

  • Senior Leadership, Executive & Board Packages: Support preparation of monthly executive reporting packs and quarterly operating reviews; assist in building Board of Directors (BOD) presentation materials.
  • Enterprise Long-Range Planning: Support multi-year 3-statement modeling and the company's long-range planning process.
  • Ad-Hoc Strategic Analysis: Support ad-hoc financial analysis for executive decision-making, including partnership evaluations and cost-efficiency initiatives (with occasional exposure to M&A or strategic transaction analysis as needed).
  • Process & Tool Modernization: Partner across departments to simplify financial consolidation, automate reporting workflows, and enhance business intelligence tools.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

  • Experience: 2–5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Strategic Finance, Corporate Development, Investment Banking, or Management Consulting.
  • Industry Exposure: Exposure to Digital Media, Podcasting, Audio, Entertainment, or Advertising Technology preferred, but not required.
  • Business Partnering: Proven ability to build trusted relationships with cross-functional partners outside of finance (Sales, Content, Product, Ops).
  • Financial Modeling: Strong 3-statement modeling skills, scenario planning, and commercial deal evaluation.
  • Executive Communication: Ability to package complex quantitative data into clean visual slides and summaries for executive review.
  • Systems & Tools: Proficiency with core financial tools (advanced Excel required; working experience with NetSuite or Tableau is a plus).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.

Overview:

Audacy’s San Francisco/Northwest Region’s TWIN Division has a rare, full time Traffic/Weather Producer/Reporter position, based at All-News KCBS Radio in San Francisco, the Bay Area’s number one news station. Are you an audacious and tech-savvy broadcast journalist with a positive attitude and impressive work ethic ready to join an elite news radio team? Are you a storyteller with a compelling on-air delivery? Can you translate dispatcher-speak into a language everyone can understand? Can you voice a weather report that doesn’t require a meteorology degree to follow?

 

You should have an expertise and high-comfort level with all things IT, a second-nature social media proficiency (Instagram, Tik Tok) with a natural curiosity and desire to touch the listener in as many ways as imaginable. You are expected to work under tight deadlines in a fast-paced newsroom. We are seeking a broadcast journalist who collaborates with editors and producers. You will be expected to actively participate on various social media channels and contribute content to the Audacy’s digital platforms. You must be passionate, committed, self-motivated and agreeable to a flexible work schedule, which may include evenings, overnights and/or weekends. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required, and candidates must be able to take a detail-oriented approach to work while meeting tight deadlines. This is not a job for a beginner. Experience in a major market is a plus.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Report from the Newsroom over the course of multiple hours on KCBS Radio and other Audacy and non-Audacy stations
  • Gather, write, record, edit and deliver traffic/weather/news content inclusive of providing live coverage
  • Conceptualize, pitch, produce and voice live and/or recorded traffic/weather segments
  • Interview traffic/weather news makers
  • Write scripts and ad-lib material for stories
  • Use social media - including but not limited to Instagram and Tik Tok - during the course of your shift to connect with listeners, promote upcoming stories and interviews, and to highlight station content
  • Contribute content - including but not limited to audio, video and written format - to Audacy’s digital platforms
  • Develop and research potential traffic/weather stories
  • Provide live reads of sponsors within designated reports by the company including logging commercials, mentions, entitlements and discrepancies
  • Record sponsor spec and demo spots as needed
  • Make station appearances as required
  • Protect the station’s FCC licenses
  • Other duties as required by management
  • Position offers SAG-AFTRA Benefits and applicant must be willing to join SAG-AFTRA, (Union Code 105)

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • Minimum 2-year traffic/weather/sports/news reporting for broadcast media
  • Must be computer literate, have excellent writing and presentation skills

job.title: Account Manager, Local Marketplace
job.description:

We’re hiring an Account Manager for our Local Client Success team to help manage and grow Axios Local Marketplace — a new offering designed to make it easier for local businesses to reach Axios’s trusted, highly engaged audiences. Marketplace is currently lives in Charlotte, NC, with plans to expand into additional Axios Local markets.

Why it matters: Axios Local Marketplace creates a new way for local businesses with smaller advertising budgets to connect with Axios audiences and promote their businesses, events, job openings, and brand messages across our digital channels. 

This role will play a critical part in scaling our new semi-service advertising model — managing the client experience from campaign setup through execution and reporting, while helping shape the processes, products, and workflows that will support Marketplace as it expands into new markets. job.title: Analytics Engineer
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company dedicated to helping people get smarter, faster on what matters. As we continue to scale, data plays a critical role in how we drive that mission forward.

Why it matters: As an Analytics Engineer at Axios, you’ll serve as the primary interface for delivering insights to the business. You’ll design and maintain the curated layers of our data platform (Silver and Gold), and also own the dashboards and visualizations that translate those data products into actionable insights. By combining engineering rigor with business context and storytelling, you’ll ensure decision-making is faster, clearer, and aligned with Axios’ mission.

In partnership with data engineers, data scientists, and product managers, you’ll transform raw and complex source data into well-structured data products, certified dashboards, and compelling visualizations that underpin reporting, experimentation, and advanced analytics.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Silver and Gold layers of the medallion architecture: define, version, and maintain business metrics and semantic models.
  • Build and maintain executive dashboards and visualizations that communicate key insights effectively.
  • Define and enforce best practices for data visualization, storytelling, and stakeholder adoption.
  • Build and maintain data marts and semantic layers that serve multiple domains across Axios.
  • Review and certify dashboards for accuracy, consistency, and adherence to standards.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to ensure Silver layer tables meet business needs.
  • Implement data quality tests, documentation, and lineage tracking to ensure trust in analytics outputs.
  • Serve as a bridge to data science, ensuring feature stores and model outputs are well-documented and reusable.
  • Contribute to the hub-and-spoke model: rotate through responsibilities such as intake, quality assurance, and participation in the analytics hub, while serving as a strategic partner to stakeholders, helping them shape the right questions and identify the decisions their data should inform.

Skills:

  • 2-5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development, or data visualization roles.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks.
  • Expertise in BI and visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, etc.).
  • Familiarity with modern data stack (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent).
  • Experience designing and modeling curated datasets, semantic layers or metric stores, and data marts that drive consistent and reliable decisions.
  • Understanding of medallion architecture and data governance best practices.
  • Solid grasp of versioning, testing, and CI/CD practices for data pipelines.
  • Strong data storytelling and presentation skills; ability to communicate complex concepts clearly.
  • Comfort working in a hub-and-spoke model, balancing central standards with domain-specific consulting.

What success looks like:

  • Business users rely on analytics engineers for both accurate data models and clear, actionable dashboards.
  • Stakeholders see insights delivered through compelling visualizations that drive decisions.
  • Data engineers know what to build in Silver because requirements are clearly defined upstream.
  • Data scientists can discover and reuse well-documented features and model inputs.
  • Leadership sees fewer instances of unreliable or inconsistent dashboards and more decisions influenced by consistent, well-visualized data.
  • You help establish analytics engineering as the cornerstone of the data-to-decisions lifecycle at Axios.

job.description:
The big picture: Axios is looking for a Manager of National & SME Growth to lead subscriber acquisition and audience growth across our national newsletter portfolio and a new SME audience growth initiative.

This is a highly visible growth role focused on scaling Axios’s flagship national newsletters while helping build and validate a new SME audience acquisition strategy.

Go deeper: The Manager of National & SME Growth is a strategic, data-driven growth leader responsible for acquisition strategy, experimentation, channel diversification, and audience expansion. In this role, you will:

National Subscriber Growth

  • Own subscriber growth targets across Axios’s national newsletter portfolio
  • Execute acquisition strategies across paid, owned, and earned channels
  • Monitor audience composition, growth performance, and acquisition efficiency
  • Contribute insights and recommendations to weekly growth reporting

Paid Media & Channel Diversification

  • Lead paid acquisition strategy across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms
  • Drive diversification away from concentrated acquisition channels
  • Establish and optimize CAC and conversion benchmarks by audience segment
  • Partner with Creative on campaign messaging and assets

SME Audience Growth Pilot

  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing on onboarding, engagement, and retention initiatives

  • Deep paid media expertise across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and emerging channels
  • Strong analytical skills across CAC, LTV, attribution, and funnel optimization
  • Experience with modern martech and analytics tools (Braze, Segment, Sigma, Piano, etc.)

  • Driving measurable national subscriber growth
  • Improving acquisition diversification and efficiency
  • Successfully validating and scaling the SME audience initiative

job.title: Local Advertising Account Executive - Denver
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to delivering trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We are building a new category of local revenue generation and are hiring Local Market Builders to help scale Axios Local across key markets.

This is not a traditional Account Executive role. This is a foundational, in-market revenue leader responsible for building Axios’ local advertising business from the ground up.

Why it matters: The Local Market Builder is the face of Axios in their city or region—responsible for developing deep relationships with local business leaders and converting those relationships into long-term advertising partnerships.

This role is critical to unlocking hyperlocal revenue and proving a scalable model for Axios Local expansion.

Go deeper: Local Market Builders are highly entrepreneurial sellers focused on building a book of business through their existing network and local market presence. In this role, you will:

  • Build and own a book of business from day one, leveraging existing relationships with local decision-makers
  • Prospect, pitch, and close new local advertisers (restaurants, healthcare systems, law firms, real estate, financial services, dealerships, and more)
  • Develop repeatable revenue streams through renewals and long-term partnerships
  • Serve as the Axios brand ambassador in-market, attending events, building community presence, and collaborating with editorial teams
  • Create and manage a high-volume pipeline of deals (typical deal size: $5K–$15K)
  • Operate with a founder mindset—owning outcomes, testing approaches, and building momentum in-market

Yes, but: This is not a traditional AE role with inbound leads or established accounts.

  • No house accounts or inherited book — you are expected to bring and build your own
  • Heavy reliance on your existing network to accelerate early revenue
  • In-market presence is essential — this is a relationship-driven role
  • Higher deal volume, shorter cycles, and community-based selling
  • Success is driven by reputation, trust, and consistency, not just pipeline coverage

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody a collaborative spirit, revenue mindset, and passion for the Axios mission. This position requires the following:

  • 5–8+ years in sales, digital media, advertising, or related field
  • Be deeply connected in your market and know how to turn relationships into revenue.
  • Proven ability to build and monetize a book of business
  • Demonstrated success in closing new business and generating revenue from personal network
  • Strong relationships with local advertisers, agencies, or business leaders in your market

Core Traits

  • Entrepreneurial and self-starting — comfortable building from zero
  • Highly networked in your local market
  • Strong hunter mentality with a bias toward action
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and longer ramp periods
  • Excellent communicator and relationship builder
  • Deep curiosity about local businesses and community dynamics

What Success Looks Like

  • Rapid activation of your existing network into revenue-generating clients
  • Consistent pipeline of new local advertisers
  • Strong renewal rates and repeat business
  • Established presence as a trusted partner in your market

This role is designed for highly motivated, network-driven sellers who want significant upside tied to performance.

  • Competitive base salary + strong variable commission structure
  • Uncapped earnings potential tied to revenue generation
  • Early ramp support (non-recoverable draw)
  • Additional incentives for new logo acquisition and early market traction

This remote position offers a $60,000 annual base salary plus an uncapped commission structure with on-target earnings (OTE) up to $150,000+ designed to reward performance and significant upside potential for top performers. We will also provide a guaranteed additional $5,000 per month for the first 4 months of employment.

All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

  • Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
  • Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option
  • Dental and vision coverage

  • Birth-givers will have an additional 6-8 weeks, depending on type of delivery, for a total of 18-20 weeks continuous leave
  • Generous vacation policy, plus holidays
  • One mental health day per quarter
  • Annual learning and development stipend

job.title: Local Memberships Marketing Coordinator (Part-time Temporary)
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are looking for a part-time, temporary Local Memberships Marketing Coordinator to run and help scale member giveaways across our Local markets.

Why it matters: Giveaways have proven to be a strong acquisition and engagement tactic. Five recent campaigns generated an overall 4x positive ROI across every market tested. We now want to test whether this can become a repeatable growth program across all Axios Local markets.

The opportunity is significant, but execution is highly manual. This individual will own the day-to-day coordination and execution of the program so the Membership team can increase campaign volume, test performance across markets, and determine whether giveaways should become a standing acquisition channel.

Go deeper: In this role you will manage Local member giveaways end to end, including:

  • Build and maintain the giveaway calendar across Local markets, targeting roughly four campaigns per week.
  • Coordinate with local journalists to identify restaurants, businesses and institutions that make each giveaway feel authentically local.
  • Draft campaign copy, including member announcements, acquisition emails and last-chance messaging.
  • Draft newsletter callouts for local editors and newsletter writers.
  • Coordinate campaign setup and launch across internal teams and tools.
  • Pull eligible member lists, randomly select winners and manage winner outreach.
  • Purchase and digitally deliver gift cards.
  • Track results by campaign, including members acquired, revenue generated and prize cost.
  • Maintain a simple performance tracker and surface patterns in what is working.
  • Help improve the underlying process by documenting repeatable workflows, templates and opportunities to reduce manual work.

Skills:

  • Strong project management and organizational skills; you can manage multiple campaigns and deadlines at once without losing details.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, particularly for concise promotional and email copy.
  • Comfort working independently and coordinating across multiple teams.
  • High attention to detail, especially around campaign eligibility, winner selection and fulfillment.
  • Comfort working with spreadsheets and basic performance metrics.
  • A test-and-learn mindset: you are interested not just in executing campaigns, but in identifying ways to make them more effective and easier to scale.

Experience in membership, lifecycle marketing, media, subscriptions or consumer growth is a plus, but not required.

What success looks like:

  • Giveaways run consistently and accurately across a growing number of Local markets.
  • The program reaches a sustainable cadence without creating significant additional workload for the core Membership team.
  • Campaign performance is tracked consistently enough to compare results across markets, timing, messaging and prize selection.
  • Strong-performing tactics are identified and incorporated into a reusable giveaway playbook.
  • We have a clear data-backed recommendation on whether and how to scale the program longer term.

How you'll work

  • Target engagement period: 6 months
  • Approximately 15 hours per week.
  • Work closely with the Director, Membership & Community and the broader Membership team.
  • Coordinate regularly with Axios Local journalists and editors.
  • Operate with significant independence once the process and campaign calendar are established.
  • Bring issues and opportunities forward early; the goal is to improve the system while running it, not simply execute a checklist.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $40 - $45 per hour and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

job.title: Part Time-Temp Reporter, Axios Local
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios Local is hiring reporters and writers near our existing markets in regions across the U.S. to support our growing network of local newsletters.

Why it matters: We’re looking for sharp, fast and curious journalists who can help us deliver smart, essential news and lifestyle coverage that young professionals in our cities care about.

Go deeper: Assignments vary based on market needs, with some opportunities for consistent, ongoing contributions.

What you’ll do:

  • Write high-impact local news items in Axios’ Smart Brevity style (typically short-form, daily pieces)
  • Jump on timely stories, events and trends
  • Contribute to Axios Local newsletters (we're in 39 cities and counting), plus their websites and social media accounts as needed, often with a daily turnaround
  • Collaborate with an editor and/or full-time newsletter author(s)
  • Help fill longer coverage gaps occasionally, (e.g. 1-3 months) as needed

What success looks like:

  • You deliver clean, accurate, engaging copy on deadline
  • You surface story ideas that resonate with local readers
  • You adapt quickly to feedback and sharpen your work over time

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong news judgment and clean, concise writing 
  • Ability to move quickly and hit deadlines
  • Omnivorous curiosity and enthusiasm for reporting & writing about numerous subject areas, from sports to business to dining to development to how we get around
  • Comfort writing in a conversational, reader-first voice
  • Equally comfortable doing original reporting and smart aggregation
  • Experience with newsletters or audience-focused writing
  • Familiarity with our Smart Brevity style (or willingness to learn fast)
  • Strong communication skills and experience working in a remote environment
  • A self-starter: While you may be assigned some stories, you'll be counted on to bring executable ideas forward every day

Who this is for:

  • Experienced local reporters and journalists
  • Writers seeking flexible, part-time temporary work
  • Former newsroom reporters or editors looking to stay engaged
  • Strong independent contributors comfortable with remote workflows

Details:

  • Part-Time employee role 
  • Remote, U.S.-based
  • Flexible assignments based on need and availability
  • Up to 29 hours per week, depending on assignments and availability
  • Onboarding, training, and access to Axios tools provided

job.title: Production Manager, Axios Live (Part-time Temporary)
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. Axios Live brings our journalism to life through dynamic, high-quality live experiences that spark meaningful conversations across business, politics, technology, and culture.

We’re looking for a part-time, temporary Production Manager to join our team, a hands-on technical producer who ensures flawless, high-caliber event execution across Axios’s public and branded experiences. 

Why It Matters: This role is central to delivering Axios’s smart, efficient, and creative approach to live events. As Production Manager, Axios Live, you’ll lead technical production and on-site execution for mainstage programs, filmed receptions, and other editorially driven events. You’ll serve as the connective tissue between creative vision and real-world production — translating concepts into precise, high-quality experiences that reflect Axios’s standards of excellence.

Go Deeper: This is a part-time role requiring approximately 15 - 20 hours per week for 8 weeks with the potential to extend the term. The Production Manager will manage technical planning, vendor execution, and on-site operations. This role requires an agile, solutions-oriented producer who thrives in live, fast-paced environments and balances technical precision with editorial sensitivity. Core responsibilities include:

Technical Production & On-Site Execution

  • Lead on-site technical execution for Axios Live events, including audiovisual systems, lighting, staging, livestream, and broadcast operations.
  • Create graphics with Adobe After Effects. 
  • Serve as show-caller and stage manager for various Axios Live event products. 
  • Coordinate site-specific builds, talent rehearsals, and technical run-throughs.
  • Oversee vendor setup, show cues, asset management, and technical execution to ensure seamless, brand-aligned experiences.
  • Support rapid post-event wrap processes, including media clipping and delivery to editorial and marketing teams.

Vendor & Logistics Management

  • Manage all pre-event logistics, timelines, and technical deliverables across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Coordinate production vendors, venue teams, and freelance technicians to ensure Axios standards are met.
  • Create floor plans in collaboration with the operations team. 

Worthy of your time: We’re looking for an experienced, technically skilled producer who embodies a calm, solution-oriented presence and thrives under pressure.

  • 6-8 years of experience in event production, with a focus on A/V systems, livestream, and show execution.
  • Strong understanding of live event and technical workflows, including rigging, lighting, comms, and streaming platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with show-calling, stage management, and backstage coordination.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple events simultaneously while maintaining precision, extreme attention to detail, and quality deliverables.
  • A “can do” and team-centered attitude with a positive approach to quality work. 
  • Strong ability to work independently on specific projects.
  • Excellent communication and time-management skills.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments and solving technical issues in real time.
  • Knowledgeable in production documentation (Run of Show , Tech Flows, Shoflo, Asset management)
  • Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Wrike, Airtable) 
  • Experience in Adobe products, specifically Adobe Premiere & After Effects.
  • Willingness to travel regularly and work early mornings, evenings, or weekends when required.

Contract details: 

  • Target engagement period: 8 weeks with the potential to extend.
  • Compensation: 
    • Pre-Production Hourly -$38.50-$44.00/hour (15-20 hours per week)
    • On-Site Flat Rate - $1,500/day (12-hour day)

job.title: Reporter, News
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a media organization dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We're hiring reporters to write for our newsdesk. 

Why it matters: Reporting to our Head of News, the news writers will play a critical role as a 24/7 nerve center for the newsroom.

  • We are after people with a “see it, write it” mentality who have a personal passion for news and a fast-twitch set of journalistic reflexes.
  • This is a job for the news junkies who “monitor the situation” for fun and want to do it for a living. 
  • We operate at one cadence - do it right now - and are after people who marry a love of news with the thrill of being busy.  

Go deeper: The role comes with a range of responsibilities, including:

  • Real-time news surveillance
  • Quick-turn writing of spot news stories
  • Monitoring developments on key stories and flagging them to experts

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will have a get-stuff-done attitude, a strong sense of personal responsibility and urgency, and a passion for being on top of the news at all times. Some of the skills include:

  • Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with a team of journalists.
  • Writing experience in a fast-paced news environment.
  • Demonstrated experience monitoring and activating on news. 
  • A belief in Smart Brevity as the core writing style of Axios.
  • Experience working across teams to produce quality content.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the digital and social media landscape.

job.title: Reporter, Transportation & Mobility
job.description:

Why it matters: Transportation is undergoing a once-in-a-century transformation. The convergence of AI, electrification, autonomous driving and geopolitics are reshaping the industry — redefining how we move, where companies invest, and which countries will dominate the next era of manufacturing and technology.

job.title: Salesforce Business Analyst
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Salesforce Business Analyst to help build and scale our CRM, reporting, and analytics capabilities, as part of our Revenue Operations team.

Why it matters: This role owns and administers our Salesforce Media Cloud instance, ensuring the platform supports the needs of our revenue organization and serves as a trusted source of data. Beyond day-to-day Salesforce administration, this role will develop reporting, analytics, and insights that turn revenue data into meaningful business intelligence. This role will report to the Senior Director of Revenue Strategy and Operations. 

Go deeper: This is an opportunity for someone early in their Salesforce and Revenue Operations career who wants hands-on ownership while expanding their skills across systems, processes, and analytics. You’ll partner closely with Revenue Enablement, Client Partnerships, Client Experience, and Business Development teams to solve business challenges, improve revenue processes, and help teams use Salesforce and data more effectively. Responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the day-to-day administrator for Salesforce Media Cloud, managing users, permissions, page layouts, flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and automation.
  • Partner with Revenue Strategy & Enablement, Revenue Operations, and sales leadership to translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions and operational improvements.
  • Build and optimize a Salesforce environment that supports Axios’ evolving revenue organization, sales processes, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and recurring analyses that give executives, sales leadership, and cross-functional partners actionable visibility into business performance, sales metrics, and KPIs.
  • Support data migration and ongoing data management efforts, ensuring data quality, integrity, consistency, and governance across Salesforce.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, streamline processes, and improve operational efficiency across the revenue organization.
  • Support sales planning and performance management, including sales goals, conversion and segment analysis, Quarterly Business Reviews, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting.
  • Troubleshoot user and system issues, recommend scalable solutions, and support testing, deployment, and change management for Salesforce releases and enhancements.
  • Create and maintain documentation, best practices, and training materials while supporting user adoption of Salesforce functionality, reporting tools, and revenue processes.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, have a passion for the Axios mission, and the following skills and experience:

  • 1–2 years of Salesforce Administrator experience.
  • 1–2 years of experience in sales operations or sales analytics.
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM-201) or plans to obtain certification within the first year.
  • Experience helping build or significantly expand a Salesforce organization from the ground up, or participating in a major Salesforce implementation.
  • Experience building flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, profiles, permission sets, and data management best practices.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-service mindset when supporting end users.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and improve business processes.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Salesforce Media Cloud.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications.
  • Experience supporting a Salesforce data migration from one CRM or Salesforce org to another.
  • Experience working in the media industry.

Within your first year, you'll help establish a scalable Salesforce foundation that supports Axios' revenue organization by:

  • Delivering a stable, well-governed Salesforce environment that users trust.
  • Successfully supporting the migration from our legacy CRM while maintaining data quality.
  • Improving automation and reducing manual administrative work across revenue teams.
  • Increasing Salesforce adoption through thoughtful training, documentation, and user support.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams to improve how they leverage data and analytics to understand their business.

job.title: Senior Account Manager, Client Success
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Senior Client Success Account Manager to support our advertising team!

Why it matters: In this role, you will join the Client Success team, leading post-sale account management for new and existing growth accounts, delivering best-in-class, turnkey client experiences from kickoff to wrap. This role requires a competent level of expertise, including the ability to apply skills independently in common situations, understand the broader business context, and contribute effectively with occasional support. A revenue mindset is key, as you will help drive client retention, identify growth opportunities, and support media planning efforts to maximize long-term value for both the client and Axios. 

Go deeper: This role will serve as a trusted partner to many clients who are new to Axios, ensuring they feel confident and supported from day one. The ideal candidate will have the ability to quickly learn and articulate how Axios’ products work, guiding clients and agency partners through each stage of the post-sale process. They will work closely with stakeholders, providing clear communication, proactive solutions, and a high-touch service experience every step of the way.

Working closely with multiple cross-functional teams (Client Partnerships, Smart Brevity Studio, Events, Brand Journalism, and Ad Operations), you will develop and execute a wide range of campaigns across the Axios product suite. You’ll also work with your Client Partnerships colleagues to support media planning, proposals, and renewal activities. 

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will possess a growth mindset with a drive to learn, embody an entrepreneurial spirit, and have a passion for the Axios mission. They will also be a team player who operates with integrity, practices radical candor, and fosters a culture of collaboration, kindness, and support for colleagues.

This person should have 3+ years of client-facing digital campaign management experience, including planning and execution, while demonstrating the following attributes:

Campaign Management/Customer Service 

  • Agile and adaptable in managing multiple campaigns simultaneously while meeting all deadlines and exceeding client expectations.

  • Manages all post-sale campaign elements, including ownership across kick-off calls, production, launch and reporting.
  • Monitors campaign performance and delivery to ensure campaigns are on track to meet client and revenue goals.
  • History of building and maintaining strong relationships and orchestrating effective communication across a myriad of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of client business goals and industry context to inform campaign strategy and recommendations
  • Proactively identifies opportunities for account growth, renewal & upsell.
  • Outstanding communication, organization, and project management skills with obsessive attention to detail.
  • Takes pride in delivering exceptional customer service.

Strategic Thinking/Problem-Solving

  • Ability to develop and implement long-term strategies aligned with team and company goals.
  • Capacity to analyze complex situations and foresee potential challenges and opportunities.
  • Proficient in identifying problems and formulating effective solutions independently.
  • Confident in pulling reports and using analytics to make data-driven campaign optimization recommendations.

Overarching Skills

  • Growth mindset and enjoys working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. 
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively.
  • Initiative to take on responsibilities and drive projects forward with minimal supervision.
  • Flexibility to pivot client marketing strategies in response to changing market conditions or organizational needs.
  • Willingness to embrace new ideas and approaches to enhance efficiency.
  • Proficiency in Google Office Suite (Slides, Sheets, Docs).

job.title: Senior Manager, Experience Optimization
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a media company dedicated to delivering trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Senior Manager of Experience Optimization to own the conversion layer of the Axios funnel: the subscription, registration, and paywall experiences where readers become subscribers and subscribers become members.

Why it matters: By continuously improving conversion rates, you'll increase the impact of every growth initiative while helping Axios maximize the value of its investment in subscriptions, paywalls, and audience growth.

Go deeper: In this role, you'll own the registration, subscription, and paywall ecosystem, lead landing page and first-party data capture testing, drive SEO/GEO conversion strategies, and orchestrate personalized onsite experiences to create a seamless journey across web and email. Reporting to the SVP of Audience & Growth, you'll partner across subscriptions, membership, and event marketing to optimize every step of the conversion experience. 

Responsibilities:

Subscription, Registration & Paywall Optimization

  • Own the performance and optimization of Axios's subscription, registration, and paywall experiences across national and local products.
  • Lead ongoing experimentation across offers, messaging, templates, and access rules to improve conversion.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for the Piano platform, driving platform capabilities and performance.
  • Establish conversion benchmarks, reporting, and scalable optimization processes across the business.

Conversion Optimization & First-Party Data

  • Design and execute experiments across landing pages, lead generation, and first-party data capture to improve acquisition and conversion.
  • Partner with Audience Insights and Lifecycle Marketing to strengthen first-party data collection and personalization.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized experimentation roadmap, using data and testing to drive continuous improvement.

Search, AI & Onsite Experiences

  • Optimize conversion experiences for SEO, GEO, and AI-driven traffic, partnering with Analytics to measure performance and identify new opportunities.
  • Own onsite audience segmentation and personalization in Segment, ensuring a seamless customer journey across web and email.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Editorial, Revenue, Analytics, Design, and Marketing to deliver high-impact growth initiatives.
  • Manage relationships with external vendors and internal stakeholders while driving a shared roadmap for onsite experience optimization.
  • Champion a culture of experimentation by documenting learnings, sharing insights, and scaling best practices across the Growth organization.

Skills

  • 6+ years of experience in conversion rate optimization (CRO), growth marketing, growth product, or digital experience optimization.
  • Proven success improving conversion through A/B testing and experimentation.
  • Experience with subscription, membership, or digital media businesses.
  • Hands-on experience with paywall or subscription platforms (Piano preferred).
  • Strong analytical skills, including funnel analysis, experimentation, and performance measurement.
  • Experience with marketing technology platforms such as Segment, Braze, Sailthru, or similar tools.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will:

  • Increase subscription and registration conversion rates through continuous experimentation.
  • Establish a scalable testing program with measurable improvements across the conversion funnel.
  • Improve first-party data capture to support personalization and audience growth.
  • Create seamless onsite experiences that work in concert with lifecycle marketing.
  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Editorial, Analytics, Revenue, and Growth to drive measurable business impact.

job.title: Senior Producer

We are seeking a creative, highly organized Producer/Senior Producer to help grow Axios’ original video portfolio. This hands-on, end-to-end producer will take ideas from concept through production, post-production, publishing, and audience growth.

The role will support original Axios video programming, including The Axios Show, and other editorial video formats across YouTube, social, and digital platforms.

Why it matters: At Axios, we deliver news that’s clinical, trustworthy, and informative — reaching millions of readers every day. As a Software Engineer, you’ll help power the services, APIs, and data flows that make our audience-facing products fast, reliable, and scalable. You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers across disciplines to build resilient systems that embody Axios’ commitment to clarity and make our readers smarter.

Responsibilities:

As a Software Engineer, you’ll develop high-quality, reliable services in a Golang and Python codebase, ensuring performance and stability across Axios’ publishing and delivery platforms. Key responsibilities include:

  • API development: Design, implement, and maintain scalable REST APIs to power Axios products.
  • Service reliability: Build and optimize backend services using Golang and Python, ensuring they are resilient, performant, and maintainable.
  • Data modeling: Design and evolve database schemas and performant queries to support new features and business requirements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with front-end engineers, quality engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver end-to-end features.
  • Testing & quality: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; contribute to Axios’ quality efforts by ensuring backend systems are covered with automated tests.
  • Performance & observability: Monitor system health, contribute to our logging/metrics implementation, and proactively improve performance and scalability.
  • AI fluency: Leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or other assistants to accelerate development, improve code quality, and explore creative solutions.
  • Continuous improvement: Participate in code reviews, propose improvements to architecture and practices, and stay up to date with evolving backend technologies.

Skills:

The ideal candidate is a thoughtful engineer who cares about reliability, scalability, and writing clean, maintainable code. You should have:

  • Experience: 2–5+ years in backend or full-stack development, with hands-on experience in Golang and/or Python.
  • API expertise: Strong understanding of designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Databases: Familiarity with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL) and ORMs (e.g., Gin, Django)
  • Testing: Experience with unit and integration testing in Golang and/or Python, and a mindset of embedding quality into development.
  • Performance & scalability: Awareness of common patterns for scaling backend services and optimizing performance.
  • AI tooling: Comfort using tools like GitHub Copilot or Claude Clode as part of your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally in an agile environment.

We’ll be even more excited if you have:

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar).
  • Experience with gRPC services.
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience working with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Honeycomb).
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with performance testing or load testing of backend services.

What success looks like:

  • Reliable systems: You build services that are stable, scalable, and meet the needs of Axios’ products and readers.
  • Quality code: You write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that reduces defects and simplifies future development.
  • Collaboration: You work closely with teammates across front-end, product, and QE to deliver features efficiently and effectively.
  • AI-driven efficiency: You integrate AI tools into your workflow to accelerate development, improve code quality, and continuously learn.
  • Performance focus: You monitor and improve backend performance, ensuring services are fast and resilient.
  • Continuous growth: You sharpen your skills, share knowledge with teammates, and contribute to improving Axios’ engineering practices.

 

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $130,000 - $165,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

job.title: SVP, Product
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment.

Axios is hiring an SVP, Product to lead how Axios builds products across the company, strengthening Product and Design while turning promising AI-enabled ideas into durable, supported products.

Why it matters: Axios builds and ships at multiple levels. Product and Design lead the development of durable, company-wide products and shared platforms. AI Enablement partners with departments to identify opportunities, prototype AI-enabled tools and workflows, and help teams put useful solutions into practice.

The SVP, Product will connect these levels by making decision rights, prioritization, and handoffs clear: what should remain a local workflow, what AI Enablement should support, and what Product and Design should develop into a durable, supported product or shared capability. The role spans the products, platforms, and workflows that power Axios, from the CMS, axios.com, newsletters, and Local products to internal tools and shared platforms supporting editorial, revenue, and company operations, as well as the growing set of AI-enabled solutions being developed closer to the work.

As Axios becomes more capable of building with AI, more teams will identify and prototype solutions for their own needs. Reporting to the CTO, this leader will establish the product operating model that allows Axios to evaluate, prioritize, and scale those ideas without creating fragmented, duplicated, or unsupported systems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead Product, Design, and AI Enablement, setting strategy, priorities, decision rights, and operating cadence.
  • Look ahead: turn a clear point of view on emerging technologies, behaviors, and opportunities into credible product choices and experiments.
  • Partner with business leaders to translate company and functional goals into clear product opportunities, outcomes, and investment choices.
  • Raise the product management bar through clear expectations, coaching, and accountability.
  • Create a clear path from promising experiments to durable, supported products.

Go deeper: This leader must be a trusted partner to the CTO and senior leaders, with a clear point of view on where technology is moving, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the judgment to turn ambiguity into decisions.

Success means a clear company-wide model for deciding what Axios should build and why, stronger and faster Product and Design decisions, and a repeatable path from promising AI experiments to durable, supported products.

What we’re looking for:

  • A trusted partner to senior leaders who can challenge assumptions, form a clear point of view, make hard tradeoffs, and keep decisions moving.
  • A clear vision for where product development is headed and how Axios can succeed as the technology landscape rapidly evolves.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency: you personally use AI to accelerate your work and prototype ideas, and you know how to turn AI capabilities into useful products and workflows.
  • Senior product leadership experience in software, information services, media, or another fast-moving environment, with a record of bringing Product and Design together.
  • Technical fluency across product strategy, workflows, tooling, data, and production tradeoffs.
  • Experience with prioritization and portfolio management across multiple stakeholders.
  • A track record of turning prototypes and experiments into durable, supported products.
  • The judgment to create useful governance without becoming a bottleneck.
  • The ability to distinguish a meaningful product opportunity from an interesting AI demo.

Worth your time: This is an opportunity to help define what modern product leadership looks like inside an AI-native media company. You’ll help shape not only what Axios builds, but how Axios operates.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $285,000 - $315,000, plus a 25% bonus, and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive

Position Summary

As an Account Executive, you will serve as a trusted marketing consultant to local businesses and advertising agencies, helping clients achieve their business goals through innovative advertising and marketing solutions. This role combines prospecting, relationship building, strategic planning, and revenue generation across Beasley Media Group's portfolio of broadcast, digital, streaming, event, and experiential marketing assets.

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter with a passion for sales, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop long-term client partnerships while driving new business growth.

Key Qualifications

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented professional who thrives both independently and in a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities with attention to detail.
  • Effective negotiator with a customer-focused, consultative sales approach.
  • Ability to identify client needs, develop strategic recommendations, and deliver impactful marketing solutions.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.
  • Passion for building relationships and creating measurable results for clients.

Essential Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and outreach efforts.
  • Maintain and grow existing account relationships while increasing revenue and market share.
  • Develop integrated marketing solutions utilizing Beasley Media Group's full suite of advertising platforms.
  • Create and deliver compelling sales presentations and marketing proposals to local businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Identify client business challenges and recommend customized advertising and marketing strategies.
  • Secure sponsorships, promotional partnerships, experiential marketing opportunities, and digital advertising campaigns.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, stakeholders, and business owners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring exceptional customer service and responsiveness.
  • Regularly communicate with clients regarding campaign performance, marketing initiatives, sponsorships, and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through upselling and cross-selling solutions.

Strategic Planning & Market Research

  • Prepare thoroughly for all client interactions by researching industries, market conditions, business objectives, and competitive trends.
  • Analyze client needs, target audiences, and historical advertising investment to develop effective recommendations.
  • Stay informed on emerging advertising, media, digital marketing, and consumer behavior trends.
  • Utilize market insights and audience data to enhance client outcomes and sales effectiveness.

Product & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Beasley Media Group's products, platforms, pricing, audience insights, and marketing capabilities.
  • Continuously expand expertise in radio, digital advertising, streaming audio, video, events, promotions, and experiential marketing.
  • Understand competitive offerings and effectively position Beasley Media Group's advantages in the marketplace.

Administrative & Reporting Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, activity logs, and sales opportunities within the company CRM.
  • Effectively manage schedules, appointments, account plans, and follow-up activities.
  • Provide timely sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance reports as requested by management.
  • Document client interactions and strategic account activities to support business growth and customer retention.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Maintain regular communication with leadership regarding sales activity, pipeline development, client opportunities, and business needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful execution of advertising campaigns and client initiatives.
  • Support client events, promotions, and experiential marketing activities as needed.
  • Contribute positively to a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently meeting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Developing strong client relationships that result in long-term partnerships.
  • Generating new business opportunities and expanding existing accounts.
  • Delivering strategic marketing solutions that help clients achieve measurable business results.
  • Serving as a knowledgeable and trusted advisor within the local advertising community.

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

You will manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to client retention, and contribute to businesses' growth through effective online advertising.

  • Strong self-motivation, well organized, and dependable.

  • Proven ability to work autonomously as well as establish effective communications and working relationships with co-workers and others while performing job responsibilities.

Physical Demands

Base salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to evaluation of the experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data.

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. Position Overview

  • Check studio equipment for proper functioning prior to going on-air, reporting technical problems and equipment malfunctions

  • Cut audio from weekday talk shows and upload as multiple podcasts that have engaging titles and SEO-heavy descriptions
  • Assist talk show producers in creating varied and unique content for posting to show's social media accounts
  • Screen phone calls as needed
  • Work with producers to create/edit "best of" library for assigned shows
  • Project an appropriate professional appearance and demeanor; maintain positive and cooperative rapport with staff, management and clients 
  • Management will assign responsibilities on a regular and/or rotating basis depending upon need and proven capabilities and the need to provide expertise for the future

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • College degree in communications, journalism, or other relevant field OR two years relevant experience

  • Proficiency in sound production and audio editing, including editing programs (Pro Tools, Adobe Audition, Audacity
  • Thorough knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Work, Excel, PowerPoint, Access)
  • Experience with Libsyn preferred

  • Proven ability to thrive in a fast paced, collaborative, deadline-driven, team environment while managing multiple priorities effectively
  • Highly creative in use of sound, production elements, and show ideas to build more interesting presentation
  • Solid understanding of digital media, SEO tactics, podcasting and social media strategy; desire to participate in stations' digital marketing efforts and stay on top of trending digital developments
  • Thorough understanding and ability to work in the areas of news, politics, and pop culture

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.

  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.

Your role 

Canadians know CBC/Radio-Canada for its programming and its presence, but there’s much more happening behind the  scenes. Whether your field of expertise is finance, HR, communications or IT, you are the highly skilled professional that  makes our business run smoothly.  

Join the People & Culture team at CBC/Radio-Canada on an exciting journey dedicated to administering time, attendance, and compliance while maximizing and optimizing our Workday platform.   

We are currently seeking a dynamic Administrative Specialist to join our HR Services team. Our focus is ensuring all timesheets, reporting, and inquiries are handled efficiently, accurately and in a timely manner. In this role, you will bring your precision and expertise to provide crucial administrative support, resolve  complex timekeeping discrepancies, audit records for compliance, and collaborate closely with timekeepers and other People & Culture teams to continuously improve our time-tracking processes.  

Additionally, this role offers great professional growth, with opportunities to cross train with our Expertise team in managing service dates, leave banks, and complex pay analysis. 

While work must conform to CBC/Radio-Canada operating standards, HR Policies, collective agreements, tax legislation, labour standards, and administrative procedures, this role encourages and requires independent judgment, analytical thinking, and independent decision-making within a complex environment. Work is subject only to general review, and you may occasionally coordinate the work  of others.

Responsibilities

  • Review, process and approve employee timesheets in Workday to ensure accuracy and completeness, while adhering to strict, recurring deadlines to support seamless payroll processing. 

  • Investigate and correct time-entry discrepancies, missing records or duplicates, collaborating directly with employees, managers, and timekeepers. 

  • Ensure compliance across all time tracking records and documentation with CBC/Radio-Canada operating standards, HR policies, collective agreements, provincial/federal labour standards, and tax legislation for audit readiness.

  • Collaborate closely with the Payroll and Operations teams to ensure accurate wage calculations, retroactive pay adjustments, and seamless, timely payroll processing.

  • Reconcile overtime, leave balances, holiday pay, and shift differential earnings to ensure accuracy. 

  • Provide training and support to employees and managers on timekeeping procedures and Workday system navigation.

  • Identify issues or improvement opportunities related to the Workday timekeeping module, collaborating with the Senior Specialist responsible for escalating and resolving issues with the People Systems and Analytics team. 

  • Collaborate with the HR Services Expertise Team to develop your skills and support various activities, including service date calculations, complex leave bank management, and deep-dive pay analysis. 

We are looking for a candidate with the following:

  • Post-secondary education or equivalent practical experience. 

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in HR, Payroll or administrative operations within CBC/Radio-Canada or similar complex organization.

  • Essential fluency in both English and French (written and spoken).

  • Exceptional attention to detail and high accuracy in data management.   

  • Hands-on experience with pay processing systems, such as Workday combined with strong knowledge of HR policies, collective agreements, and federal/provincial labour standards.

  • Excellent organizational skills, ability to manage several priorities and meet multiple, tight deadlines.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate with discretion, diplomacy, tact and absolute confidentiality.  

  • Sound judgment, initiative, analytical problem-solving abilities, and resourcefulness.  

  • Flexibility to work overtime as required during peak periods. 

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we all have a story to tell. What’s yours?

 

If you share our passion for Canadian storytelling, and you wish to help us engage with individuals and communities across our various digital platforms, this is where you’ll want to be!

 

Every day, you will have an opportunity to shape the way in which Canadians see themselves reflected in our digital services. Your work will have a direct impact on how millions of Canadians from various communities connect with our products, with one another, and with the diverse voices that make our country so unique.

 

You will have the opportunity to play a part in enlightening and entertaining Canadians through our innovative work in building the mediums that deliver our content. We are an innovative hub, where the talented professionals we work with are respected and valued for their contributions. Our product teams are vibrant and our work culture strives to achieve the highest standards of diversity and inclusion. We believe that hiring people with different career paths and backgrounds is fundamental in our shared success and in building healthy and highly performant teams.

 

When you join our mission, you are not only shaping the vision of CBC/Radio-Canada, but the future of our country.

 

We know that commitment to equity, inclusion and diversity is essential to creating content that mirrors and resonates with the rich and evolving makeup of our country.  We’re also committed to reaching out and connecting with our audience on multiple platforms this includes creating virtual places where communities can come together.

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

You will be an important element of our over-the-top platform team. As such, working closely with the product owners, architects and technical managers, your role is to ensure the smooth execution of product front-end development and coordinate the technical work required to deliver requested features, while adhering to the standards and practices agreed to by the development management team.

 

The team you will be part of is in charge of an harmonized product, powering CBC Gem and ICI Tou.TV.

You will be an important element of our over-the-top platform team.
