CBC Indigenous is looking for a full-time, permanent Videographer to join our team based in Winnipeg. This position requires the ability to travel periodically. In this role, you will be a vital part of the CBC Indigenous team, producing visual journalism for our platforms.

You will gather, edit, package, and distribute or deliver media for CBC platforms including CBC, GEM, YouTube, digital, streaming, radio, and television. With the creative use of video, still images, graphics, audio and other visual storytelling techniques, you are a specialist in video production who actively contributes creatively to storytelling. You understand video in a way that engages our audience, reaching them where they are and when they need us.  You’re excited about what opportunities lie ahead in video production at CBC Indigenous and supporting our video strategy.

You are a forward-thinking self-starter who thrives in the fast-paced, high-pressure world of a multi-platform newsroom. You are just as comfortable working to the tight deadlines of daily news video deliveries as you are with deliverables on a longer timeline. You are just as comfortable collaborating with colleagues as you are focusing on independent work. You are a strong problem solver and reliable trouble-shooter.

In this role, you will ensure that all CBC journalistic standards and practices are met and that our stories are fair, balanced, accurate, impartial, and told with integrity.

You understand the diverse and changing population of Indigenous communities and the importance of reflecting that in our content. You appreciate the range of perspectives that people hold and believe in the importance of giving voice to those perspectives.

You keep current with technologies and industry trends and champion new story treatments and new workflows. You will help create a diverse range of content on our video, digital and social platforms. You’re not afraid to take creative risks, and inspire others to do the same, while producing journalism that matters to our audiences. 

You live and promote an inclusive and respectful work culture. You love collaborating with colleagues and have a deep appreciation for different perspectives, opinions and experiences.

We are looking for a candidate with the following: 

  • Creative visual storytelling experience.

  • Demonstrated editorial judgment in breaking news and enterprise journalism.

  • An in-depth knowledge of video and audio standards, file formats and codecs

  • Knowledge of video production systems such as Avid or Adobe Premiere Pro and similar.

  • Ability to operate an Electronic News Gathering (ENG) camera and associated technology such as wireless microphones, lighting equipment, and communication tools.

  • Experience in shooting and editing video/mobile footage.  

  • Experience with daily deliverables and the ability to respond to the pressures of breaking news when required.

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to handle a variety of functions quickly and efficiently and meet multiple deadlines on multiple platforms.

  • Strong desire to live and promote the values of diversity and an inclusive and respectful work culture.

  • Self-motivated critical thinker with the ability to innovate.

  • Ability to work flexible hours and overtime as required.

  • Ability and willingness to travel to remote locations.

  • Ability to ask scripted questions of people being recorded or interviewed.

  • A strong team player with experience and willingness to work with new reporters to help them develop their on-camera skills.

  • A post-secondary degree or equivalent combination of education and experience along with three  years of experience relevant to journalism during which the candidate would gain exposure to daily journalism and video technology. 

  • Valid driver’s license and a driving record that meets the minimum requirements of CBC/Radio-Canada’s insurance company.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:

job.title: Swing Announcer - Corus Radio Vancouver
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Vancouver Radio

Work Status: Part-Time

Location: Vancouver, BC (On-site)

About the Role:

Legendary Rock 101 is looking for a Part-Time Announcer to join one of Canada's most iconic and influential rock stations.

Reporting to the Program Director, you're a dynamic storyteller and entertainer who knows how to connect with audiences on-air, online, and in the community. You live and breathe great content, thrive on authentic listener engagement, and have a strong understanding of the conversations, trends, and stories that matter to our audience.

You're passionate about the West Coast lifestyle, deeply knowledgeable about rock music and culture, and know how to create memorable moments that keep listeners coming back. Whether it's a compelling break, a great social post, or an unforgettable interaction with a listener, you understand how to build meaningful connections across multiple platforms.

Experience in a medium or major market is an asset, but what matters most is your ability to stand out, entertain, and leave a lasting impression every time you're behind the microphone.

If you're ready to bring your creativity, energy, and passion for rock radio to a powerhouse brand, we'd love to hear from you.

You will contribute by:

• Hosting and technically producing a multi-hour, live on-air show on weekends and during staff vacation coverage

• Collaborating with the Program Director (or designate) on show development and creative direction

• Researching, creating, and delivering compelling, shareable content to grow audience engagement both on-air and online

• Demonstrating a strong understanding of PPM methodology and how content drives ratings

• Interacting live and spontaneously with guests, co-hosts, and listeners

• Understanding our audience and how they consume and engage with radio

• Ensuring compliance with CBSC and CRTC regulations both on-air and online

• Adhering to commercial log requirements and execution

• Leading social media initiatives related to the show

• Voicing commercials, station IDs, and promos as needed

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Post-secondary education in broadcasting, journalism, marketing, or equivalent relevant experience

• Prior on-air radio experience (required)

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills

• Familiarity with tools such as Vox-Pro, WideOrbit, and Burli (an asset)

• A natural, dynamic presence with the ability to think on your feet and entertain

• A disciplined approach to show prep and storytelling

• Creativity and confidence in producing content across digital and social platforms

• A relatable personality that connects with the Rock 101 audience and reflects their lifestyle

• A positive attitude and a collaborative spirit, you’re a team player who contributes to a great culture

Application Deadline: Oct 1, 2026

When applying, please include your resume, cover letter, and a URL link to your demo.

Applications without a demo will not be considered.

job.title: Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle
job.description:
Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.  This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.
  • Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers.
  • Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists.
  • Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs.
  • Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business.
  • Effectively negotiates advertising rates.
  • Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships.
  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
  • Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role.
  • Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment.
  • Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience.
  • Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting
  • Fluent in Spanish

 

This position is 100% commission basis. Commission rates range from 1% - 12%. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience.   

 

Benefits for this role include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner). 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options  

  • Paid flexible vacation and up to four weeks (160 hours) of paid wellness time, inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. 

  • Up to eight (8) paid holidays throughout calendar year 2026

  • Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave  

  • Employee assistance program 

  • All other benefits required by applicable law. 

 

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-John Young

Job Title:  Activation Specialist (Part-Time) - Orlando Radio

 

Position Overview

The Activation Specialist for Orlando Radio reports directly to the Promotions & Activations Manager and represents the radio stations as a Brand Ambassador at events and on social media, as well as assisting the promotions team in the office by preparing for events, fulfilling contests and prizing, and utilizing other skills to create content across departments.

 

This role is an entry-level, part-time position, with the opportunity to potentially shadow current CMG employees and assist in videography, graphic design, social media, marketing, promotions, event planning, and sales and programming.

 

Exceptional communication skills and an energetic personality are a requirement. This role will require working nights, weekends and holidays regularly, as well as the ability to lift 50 pounds.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Engaging with the public at events ranging from client locations to major festivals and concerts, which may require high levels of energy for several hours
  • Show up professionally on-site at events, in the office and on social media
  • Represent each radio station in the cluster through knowledge of, and passion for, the brands
  • Set up and break down of station sound and promotional equipment (tents, banners, speakers, audio PA system) at station events
  • Assist with organization and maintenance of station vehicles and promotional equipment
  • Compose accurate and detailed event recaps for management
  • Effectively communicate with listeners via email, phone and in-person
  • Assist in various departments throughout the station as needed, including but not limited to digital content, programming, sales, and engineering

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be a professional team player with customer focus and ability to take initiative and direction
  • 18 years of age or older
  • Highly adaptable and professional
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Able to multi-task in a high-speed environment
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills including grammar, spelling and the ability to tailor copywriting to each stations’ brand voice
  • Must be able to lift 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends and holidays throughout the year
  • Possess a valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • High school diploma or equivalent required

Preferred Qualifications

  • College coursework in marketing, public relations, digital media, preferred
  • Videography, event coordination, customer service and/or social media skills preferred
  • Bilingual preferred

job.title: Assignment Editor - WFTV Orlando
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Assignment Editor - WFTV Orlando

 

Position Overview

WFTV Channel 9, the leading news station in Central Florida, is seeking a highly motivated, organized and experienced Assignment Editor to join our dynamic news team!

 

The ideal candidate is someone who can collaborate with newsroom staff and play a critical role in the daily newsgathering process, responsible for identifying, assigning, and coordinating news coverage for all platforms (broadcast, digital, social). This person must have strong editorial judgment, excellent communication skills, strong organizational skills, top-notch logistics coordination and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment. You must work well under pressure, meet strict deadlines and respond urgently in breaking news. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • See the big picture and understand the significance of editorial content
  • Attend daily editorial meetings, documenting and tracking reporter and photographer assignments in iNews and production planning systems
  • Responsible for logistics: working directly with reporters, photographers, producers, managers, and the Content Center to determine daily news priorities and assignments
  • Dispatch news crews and manage logistics including live gear assignment, parking and access
  • Manage and update the newsroom's assignment desk system, ensuring all story information, contacts, and assignments and photog live sheets are accurate and up to date
  • Communicate with broadcast and digital producers, field crews, and managers
  • Coordinate with Newsone/ABC affiliates, management of CMG share list, Florida partners, and other media organizations across the country, including Cox Radio
  • Conduct story research, fact-check information, maintain awareness of ongoing stories and daily identify follow-up opportunities
  • Plan and execute weekday, weekend and news special coverage on all platforms

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Creating and publishing content to digital and social media platforms
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with local law enforcement, fire departments, government agencies, and community contacts
  • Monitor scanners and social media, wire services, and internal tips to identify breaking news
  • Field incoming calls and emails from the public, assessing news value and directing appropriately
  • Assign photographers to edit anchor packages, retracks or other shooting duties 
  • Routine interruptions and unforeseen assignments are to be expected
  • Ensure compliance with journalistic ethics and legal standards
  • The schedule may include nights, weekends, holidays, and overnights
  • Expected to work under deadline constraints and meet precise deadlines

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 2-years of experience on a newsroom assignment desk or similar newsgathering role, preferably in a top 20 market.
  • Exceptional news judgment and ability to quickly assess the importance of events.
  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to multi-task, strong organizational and communication skills.
  • The ideal candidate is someone who can work well with newsroom staff and have technical knowledge of newsgathering resources
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and independently when necessary.
  • Strong understanding of AP-style writing
  • Strong knowledge of social media platforms
  • Physical demands and essential physical abilities include: a combination of physical work (standing, walking, lifting and carrying items such as laptop computers, pulling file drawers)
  • Knowledge of the local market is a plus
  • BA or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with iNews or similar newsroom content management systems.
  • Familiarity with digital news platforms and social media best practices for news dissemination.

WSOC‑TV Charlotte is seeking a Broadcast Engineer to join a talented, inventive, and dedicated Engineering team supporting live news production and broadcast operations. The Broadcast Engineer plays a critical hands‑on role in maintaining, supporting, and improving studio, control room, and transmission systems in a fast‑paced, live broadcast environment. job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Director of Engineering - WFTV/WRDQ Orlando

 

Position Overview

WFTV/WRDQ Orlando TV is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the station’s technical operations, broadcast infrastructure, facilities systems, regulatory compliance, and technology modernization efforts. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable on-air operations, protecting the station license, maintaining studio and transmitter facilities, and partnering with News, Production, Sales, Traffic, Master Control, IT, and station leadership to support high-quality local journalism and business continuity. The Director of Engineering leads the technical team, oversees capital and operating budgets, manages vendor relationships, and drives continuous improvement across broadcast, IT, RF transmission, automation, production, network, cloud, and facility systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead all technical operations for the station, including studio production systems, newsroom technology, master control workflows, automation, media storage, signal distribution, ENG, remote production, and transmission facilities.
  • Ensure reliable, compliant operation of transmitters, towers, RF systems, satellite and microwave systems, EAS equipment, monitoring systems, generators, UPS systems, HVAC, and other critical infrastructure.
  • Protect the station license by maintaining compliance with federal, state and local regulatory agencies, including required documentation, inspections, testing, and corrective actions.
  • Develop and lead a strong engineering culture focused on safety, accountability, service, collaboration, training, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage, coach, and develop the station technical team, including staffing plans, performance expectations, succession planning, technical training, and emergency coverage.
  • Partner with station leadership to align engineering priorities with operational goals, audience needs, local news production, company initiatives, and long-term technology strategy.
  • Plan, execute, and track annual operating and capital budgets, including forecasting, business case development, bid solicitation, vendor selection, documentation, and project delivery.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

  • Lead capital projects from concept through implementation, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and with minimal disruption to on-air operations.
  • Support modernization of the station’s broadcast and IT environment, including IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid systems, cybersecurity practices, disaster recovery, network resilience, and scalable production tools.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with vendors, contractors, corporate technology teams, property management, and internal departments to resolve issues and improve service.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders during outages, planned maintenance, project work, and operational incidents, including impact, status, timelines, and follow-up actions.
  • Lead after-action reviews for significant technical incidents, document root causes and corrective actions, and implement improvements to reduce repeat issues.
  • Prepare timely status reports, budget updates, project documentation, technical records, and leadership briefings as required.
  • Serve as an essential leader during emergencies, severe weather, breaking news, major technical failures, or other events requiring immediate technical response.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in broadcast engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, media technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 5–10 years of progressively responsible broadcast, media technology, or engineering experience, including leadership or management responsibility.
  • Strong understanding of television broadcast operations, RF transmission, studio production, newsroom systems, master control, automation, signal flow, media workflows, and FCC compliance.
  • Working knowledge of IT infrastructure, networks, firewalls, switches, servers, operating systems, endpoint management, cybersecurity fundamentals, and business continuity practices.
  • Experience managing operating budgets, capital budgets, technical projects, vendor relationships, documentation, and cross-functional project teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, prioritize, and develop technical staff in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, 24/7 operational environment.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and decision-making skills, including the ability to assess operational risk and respond effectively during urgent situations.
  • Customer-service mindset and professional approach when working with internal departments, corporate partners, vendors, contractors, clients, and the public.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, and provide leadership during nights, weekends, holidays, emergencies, or outages as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a mid- or major-market television station, multi-site broadcast environment, or highly complex live production operation.
  • Experience with IP video/audio, cloud playout, broadcast automation, newsroom systems, remote production, bonded cellular, streaming, virtualization, and disaster recovery workflows.
  • Familiarity with ATSC 3.0, HDR, SMPTE standards, cybersecurity frameworks, and emerging broadcast technology trends.
  • SBE certification, PMP certification, cybersecurity certification, or other relevant technical credentials.

job.title: Executive Business Partner - CMG
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Executive Business Partner - CMG

 

Position Overview

The Executive Business Partner plays a critical role in helping executive leaders operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. By providing proactive support, coordinating priorities, managing critical communications, and ensuring follow-through on key activities, the Executive Business Partner acts as a force multiplier for executive leadership, creating the capacity for leaders to focus on strategic objectives and business results.

 

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support by serving as a highly organized coordinator, relationship builder, and problem solver who helps create structure, streamline processes, and improve efficiency across the executive's areas of responsibility. Success in this role requires sound judgment, initiative, adaptability, strong communication skills, and a commitment to excellence.

 

By anticipating needs, identifying risks and bottlenecks, and proactively driving follow-through, the Executive Business Partner helps maximize organizational effectiveness and the impact of executive leader(s) and their teams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Executive Support & Coordination

  • Provides comprehensive support to executive and senior leaders, including complex calendar management, scheduling prioritization, meeting coordination, travel planning, expense reporting, and administrative support.
  • Proactively manages the executive’s time, energy and strategic priorities by identifying conflicts, anticipating emerging issues, preparing decision-ready materials, and ensuring leaders are well-prepared for meetings and positioned for effective decision making and execution.
  • Coordinates internal and external meetings, executive events, leadership forums, off-sites, and other business-related activities, including agendas, logistics, materials, and follow-up.
  • Maintains awareness of key business priorities, organizational developments, and leadership initiatives to help proactively coordinate activities; identify scheduling considerations, dependencies, risks, and opportunities; and items requiring executive attention.

 

Meeting & Communication Management

  • Develops meeting agendas, presentation materials, executive briefings, summaries, reports, and communications that support productive discussions and informed leadership conversations.
  • Coordinates follow-up communications, tracks action items, and maintains documentation of meeting outcomes and commitments to ensure accountability for critical deliverables.
  • Serves as a liaison between executives and internal and external stakeholders, maintaining professionalism, responsiveness, confidentiality, and discretion.

 

Project & Process Support

  • Supports special projects and business initiatives through organization, coordination, information gathering, documentation, and progress tracking.
  • Tracks key deliverables, deadlines, and commitments and follows up with stakeholders to support timely completion and clear accountability.
  • Creates and maintains project trackers, dashboards, templates, and other tools that support efficient execution and visibility.
  • Assists with coordination across departments, project teams, and executive support partners to promote alignment and effective communication.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Operational Excellence

  • Leverages technology and productivity tools, including AI-enabled solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, to streamline administrative and operational tasks.
  • Establishes and maintains effective processes, workflows, and organizational systems that improve efficiency and consistency.
  • Establishes and manages executive operating rhythms, including leadership meetings, business reviews, action-item tracking, communication cadence, and executive follow-up processes. 
  • Identifies opportunities for process improvements and recommends practical enhancements to increase effectiveness.

 

Relationship Management

  • Builds positive working relationships across all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment when handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • Supports a collaborative and service-oriented environment while maintaining flexibility in response to changing business needs

Competencies for Success

Executive Presence - Communicates professionally and effectively with leaders, employees, and external stakeholders.

Operational Excellence - Creates structure, manages details, and consistently delivers high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

Business Judgment - Understands priorities, exercises sound judgment, and appropriately escalates issues when needed.

Initiative - Anticipates needs, takes action, and looks ahead to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

Accountability - Demonstrates ownership, follows through on commitments, and ensures details are completed accurately and on time.

Relationship Building - Builds strong partnerships through collaboration, responsiveness, and trust.

Adaptability - Effectively manages changing priorities, ambiguity, and competing demands while maintaining a positive attitude.

Strategic Acumen - Understands organizational objectives, business priorities, and leadership goals; connects daily activities to broader business outcomes and helps drive strategic execution.

Influencing Without Authority - Builds alignment, gains commitment, and drives follow-through across stakeholders through credibility, relationships, communication, and accountability. 

Continuous Improvement - Seeks opportunities to improve processes, leverage technology, and enhance overall productivity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience providing executive support, executive operations, business operations, chief of staff, project coordination, or related support to senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate executive needs, exercise independent judgment, and operate with a high degree of autonomy while managing competing priorities. 
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability across teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience supporting C-suite, executive-level, or senior business leaders within a complex, fast-paced organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage highly complex calendars, competing priorities, time-sensitive meetings, travel, expense reporting, and executive communications.
  • Strong business judgment, discretion, professionalism, and ability to handle confidential information appropriately.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare polished executive materials, presentations, summaries, and correspondence.

job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Executive Producer - WFTV Orlando

 

Position Overview

The Executive Producer at WFTV in Orlando, FL will manage a team of TV producers and writers while working with, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors to create dynamic newscasts in one of the top newsrooms in the country. The EP crafts the look of the shows, manages story count, flow and placement of every story. They set the coverage expectation and manage repetition. The EP manages breaking news and the speed and style in which we get it on the air whenever news breaks. The person in this job must be a quick-moving innovator who can lead the team in a changing media environment. The EP assists in all aspects of leading and managing a team such as establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations and works closely with fellow managers to craft and execute successful strategies and newscasts.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Newscast & Brand Management – 90%

  • Ensure product stays on brand.
  • Manage breaking news.
  • Copy edits stories in newscasts to ensure they are on target with research objectives.
  • Manages story count and placement. Must be intimate with the rundown. Manage story count vs. big story coverage.
  • Set the coverage expectation by holding meetings with producers and conducting newscast critiques.
  • Manage repetition within newscasts and from newscast to newscast.
  • Ensures the product stays on brand. Holds producers accountable on story selection and ensures anchors and meteorologists stay on target with delivery.
  • Manages breaking news. Ensures that we are on the air quickly. Monitors the execution in the control room. Facilitates drills to ensure talent is up to speed.
  • Innovate to match research as viewing behavior changes.
  • Executes live-streaming strategy to encourage viewership on mobile and on other digital platforms.
  • Works closely with talent on social posts to encourage viewership of the newscast.
  • Crafts newscasts look by working with the Creative Services Department.
  • Holds writing seminars and trains new employees.
  • Must fill in line producer as needed

 

Administrative – 10%

  • The EP leads and manages a team of TV and digital producers, writers, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors.
  • Assists in establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations. 

 

Physical Demands:

  • A combination of physical work (standing, walking, lifting and carrying items such as laptop computers, pulling file drawers.
  • Document review and computer use, including ability to manipulate fingers to operate computer keyboard and mouse.
  • Expected to work under deadline constraints and meet precise deadlines (including self-imposed deadlines). 
  • Routine interruptions and unforeseen assignments are to be expected.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. 

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of newsroom experience required 
  • Must be a quick leading innovator who can lead a team in a changing media environment 
  • Must understand and be able to execute on evolving digital platforms 
  • Must be a good teacher and leader 
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. 
  • Must be well read on current affairs and have a wide range of working knowledge and understanding of general interest subjects. 
  • Must be able to understand research and execute on the findings. 
  • Ability to work well with others and deal with employee issues appropriately. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.A. Degree in Journalism, Communications, or other field of study preferred 
  • Large market experience preferred

Location: GA-Athens

Job Title:  General Sales Manager - Athens Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) Athens Radio is seeking a General Manager, Sales to lead the market’s advertising sales organization and own revenue growth across broadcast and digital platforms. This strategic sales leadership role requires significant digital advertising expertise, disciplined revenue management, and the ability to build accountable sales teams that deliver integrated marketing solutions for clients. Candidates without a strong foundation in digital advertising strategy, products, analytics, and sales leadership will not be successful in this role.

 

The successful candidate will be an accomplished sales leader with extensive knowledge of digital marketing solutions, including search, social media, streaming audio, OTT/CTV, digital video, display advertising, audience targeting, and campaign analytics. The GSM will be responsible for coaching and developing the sales team to confidently identify client challenges, recommend integrated solutions, and communicate measurable business outcomes across both traditional and digital platforms.

 

This leader owns total market sales performance, including local and digital revenue, new business development, forecasting discipline, pipeline health, and account growth. The General Manager, Sales, will serve as the market’s primary sales leader on integrated marketing strategy, helping sellers connect client objectives with effective multi-platform solutions while ensuring campaigns are measured, analyzed, and optimized to deliver results.

 

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading successful sales teams, growing digital revenue, building integrated marketing strategies, holding teams accountable to performance standards, and developing high-performing sales professionals in a digitally focused media environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers consistent growth across total local revenue, digital revenue, new-business revenue, and account expansion.
  • Builds a sales culture defined by accountability, proactive prospecting, strong coaching, forecast discipline, and high client-service standards.
  • Increases seller confidence and adoption of integrated broadcast and digital solutions, supported by clear needs assessments, strong client strategy, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintains healthy pipeline visibility, accurate forecasting, and timely use of CRM and reporting tools to guide decisions and performance conversations.
  • Improves client retention and growth by using campaign performance data, market insights, and optimization recommendations to demonstrate value.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and inspire the sales organization to achieve and surpass total local revenue, digital revenue, new-business, and account-growth goals.
  • Establish and execute a market revenue strategy that maximizes radio, digital, event, promotional, and other available assets.
  • Drive new-business development and maintain accountability for prospecting, discovery, pipeline development, forecasting accuracy, and closing activity.
  • Develop the sales team’s ability to lead effective client needs assessments and create insight-driven, integrated advertising recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on leadership in digital sales strategy, helping sellers connect products and tactics to client objectives, audiences, budgets, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of priority digital advertising solutions and ensure sellers understand how to position them within integrated client strategies.
  • Guide customized campaigns across multiple platforms and use reporting, analytics, key performance indicators, and client feedback to evaluate results and recommend optimization.
  • Coach sellers to communicate campaign performance clearly, set realistic expectations, and strengthen client retention and growth.
  • Lead sales meetings, one-on-one coaching, account strategy sessions, client presentations, and market sales initiatives.
  • Collaborate with digital strategy, account management, operations, programming, and other internal partners to support accurate execution and a positive client experience.
  • Develop advertising events, promotions, seminars, and B2B marketing strategies that support revenue and community relationships.
  • Use consumer insights, market research, competitive information, and performance data to strengthen sales strategy and client recommendations.
  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain talented sales professionals while setting clear performance expectations and building a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer focus.
  • Maintain accurate revenue forecasts, pipeline visibility, and sales activity through company-approved CRM and reporting processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated expertise in digital advertising strategy, campaign analytics, and performance measurement, with the ability to coach sellers and clients on solutions that support measurable business outcomes.
  • Minimum of three years of leadership experience in media sales, digital media, marketing, advertising, or a related field.
  • Proven success developing sales strategy, coaching and managing sales professionals, driving revenue growth, and achieving business objectives.
  • Strong understanding of search, social media, streaming audio, OTT/CTV, digital video, display, and audience-targeting strategies, with the ability to connect these solutions to client goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and present integrated marketing strategies that combine broadcast, digital, and promotional assets to solve client business challenges.
  • Experience using campaign analytics, consumer insights, market research, and performance metrics to guide decision-making and optimize advertising strategies.
  • Strong communication, presentation, relationship-building, coaching, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Demonstrated success in new-business development, pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, revenue accountability, and sales performance management.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM platforms, sales reporting tools, and digital campaign performance reporting.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Experience leading digital revenue growth within a local media, advertising, or agency environment, including coaching sellers on integrated solutions and campaign performance conversations.
  • Successful background recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing sales professionals.

job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking a detail-oriented, service-minded HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist to join the People Solutions team. Reporting to the SVP of People Solutions, this role partners with HR, Legal, managers, employees, and external vendors to deliver compliant, well-documented, and employee-centered outcomes across Television, Radio, and Corporate functions.

 

This role strengthens CMG’s employment compliance foundation by managing critical programs with accuracy, discretion, and disciplined follow-through. The HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist will help ensure workers’ compensation, workplace accommodations, policy governance, immigration administration, FCC/EEO reporting, and annual compliance training are executed consistently, documented appropriately, and aligned with legal, regulatory, and business expectations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Workers’ Compensation & Return-to-Work:

  • Own workers’ compensation claim administration from intake through resolution, including documentation, tracking, stakeholder communication, and coordination with managers, HR, carriers, administrators, and providers.
  • Advise employees and managers on claim requirements, timelines, documentation, return-to-work expectations, and related employment practices.

 

Policy Governance & Employment Practices:

  • Lead updates to employment policies, procedures, templates, and job aids in partnership with HR leadership and Legal.
  • Drive policy governance by tracking changes, maintaining version control, preparing stakeholder updates, and reinforcing consistent policy application.

 

Immigration Administration:

  • Manage immigration administration by coordinating documentation, tracking cases, partnering with vendors and attorneys, communicating with employees, monitoring renewals, and ensuring compliance follow-up.

 

Workplace Accommodations:

  • Coordinate with ASKHR to support workplace accommodation case management, including intake, documentation, employee and manager communication, and timely follow-through.
  • Gather and review job descriptions, essential job functions, and other role-specific information to support the interactive process.
  • Partner with Prudential to manage required documentation, case updates, and vendor coordination while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.
  • When an accommodation is approved, coordinate with the HRBP and manager to support implementation, communication, and ongoing follow-up as needed.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Compliance Training & Regulatory Reporting:

  • Execute the annual compliance training cycle, including assignments, launch communications, completion tracking, overdue escalations, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Deliver FCC/EEO reporting support by gathering and validating data, maintaining documentation, coordinating stakeholders, and submitting reports on time.

 

Reporting, Records & Risk Management:

  • Develop metrics and reports to surface trends, risks, gaps, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Flag emerging compliance risks using trackers, metrics, reporting, and program data.
  • Track critical deadlines for FCC/EEO reporting, immigration renewals, workers’ compensation follow-up, and compliance training completion.
  • Maintain accurate records and data integrity while safeguarding sensitive employee information.
  • Escalate complex or high-risk matters and help drive practical, compliance-minded resolution.

Year One Critical Success Factors

Program Execution & Service Delivery:

Delivers accurate, timely, and employee-centered administration of workers’ compensation, workplace accommodations, immigration, policy governance, FCC/EEO reporting, and annual compliance training.

 

Partnership & Compliance Credibility:

Builds trusted partnerships with HR, Legal, managers, and external vendors while providing practical guidance and escalating risk appropriately.

 

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement:

Maintains accurate records, strengthens reporting discipline, closes compliance gaps, and improves processes that support accountability and consistency.

 

Career Growth Opportunities:

This role provides meaningful exposure to enterprise HR compliance, employment practices, regulatory reporting, and cross-functional problem-solving. The HR Compliance & Employment Practices Specialist will deepen expertise in risk management, policy governance, program administration, data reporting, and stakeholder partnership while gaining visibility across HR, Legal, business leaders, and external partners. Over time, this experience can support growth in broader HR compliance, employee relations, HR operations, or people program leadership roles.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience, preferred.
  • 5+ years of HR, employment practices, compliance, benefits, or related experience, including exposure to workers’ compensation, policy administration, immigration, FCC/EEO reporting, compliance training, or regulatory program support.
  • Experience managing sensitive, deadline-driven processes with HR partners, Legal, business leaders, vendors, carriers, administrators, or immigration counsel.
  • Strong understanding of HR compliance, employment documentation, policy governance, case or program management, and multi-state employment environments.
  • Skilled in using HRIS, learning management systems, case management tools, vendor portals, Excel, and reporting tools to track activity, maintain records, and identify risks or trends.
  • Strong communication, judgment, discretion, organization, and follow-through; able to work independently and escalate risk appropriately.

Preferred Qualifications

Position Overview

CMG is a well-respected, premium media company with a proud history, a dynamic future and fast-paced environment. We are a start-up built on a 100-year legacy with dominant media brands, award-winning content, and the best-in-class team and culture. Across our markets you will find the creators, authors and voices behind trusted journalism, exciting entertainment, and authentic content. Through an internship at one of our premier 49 top-performing radio stations spanning 10 markets, you can learn, grow, and get hands-on experience alongside best-in-class professionals.

CMG operates more top 10 rated stations than any other radio station group and we pride ourselves on our diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where all voices matter, smart work is expected, development is encouraged, career growth is supported, and service to our community is at the heart of who we are.

 

We are here to support early career talent with our paid internship providing unparalleled hands-on experience, networking, and lasting connections. This is your opportunity to share your voice, combine your passion for radio, learn from the best, and transform our company and your career. Ready to learn, stretch and grow? The future starts with you. Apply today!

 

CMG’s hands-on internship program is designed to provide early career candidates with the opportunity to engage with top professionals an enhance their media and broadcast knowledge through hands-on experience in several departments within the radio station.

 

Our interns work closely with on-air talent, board operators, and producers to learn how to develop, produce and execute daily radio shows. You will help producers research and write stories for live and pre-recorded shows, create, edit, and post content on social media platforms during the shows. There will also be opportunities to help with promotions of local events. You also have the chance to participate in special projects identified by our radio market leaders. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Shadow various team members within the station to gain a better understanding of programming operations. 
  • Assist the promotions and activation team with local events. 
  • Conduct research on show topics and share content online. 
  • Contact interview sources and guests, as needed. 
  • Assist with and gather interviews for produced show segments. 
  • Create engaging content for all platforms, on-air, digital, and social.

Job Title:  Marketing Solutions Coordinator - WFXT TV

 

Position Overview

The Marketing Solutions Coordinator serves as a key member of the sales organization, providing operational, administrative, and strategic support to help deliver integrated television and digital advertising solutions. This role partners closely with Account Executives and internal teams to support the sales process from initial proposal development through campaign execution, optimization, and reporting, ensuring a seamless experience for both clients and the sales organization.

 

Success in this role begins with exceptional organization, attention to detail, and a commitment to execution. The ideal candidate enjoys solving problems, supporting others, and can think on their feet while working in a sales environment where priorities may shift throughout the day. As product knowledge and experience develop, this individual will become an increasingly valuable resource in supporting integrated television and digital advertising strategies while building trusted relationships with both clients and internal stakeholders.

 

The Marketing Solutions Coordinator develops working knowledge across CMG's integrated advertising portfolio, including:

  • Broadcast Television Advertising
  • Targeted Display
  • Streaming Video (OTT/CTV)
  • Digital Video
  • Digital Audio
  • Paid Social
  • Paid Search (SEM)
  • SEO/CRO

Sales Coordination & Operations

  • Coordinate campaign assets, creative materials, approvals, deadlines, and internal communication to support successful campaign launches.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, sales documentation, client information, and supporting materials.
  • Coordinate with Campaign Operations, Traffic, Creative Services, Digital Marketing Analysts, and other internal teams to ensure campaigns launch and deliver successfully.
  • Monitor project timelines, communicate updates, and proactively identify potential issues requiring attention.
  • Provide operational support across both local and national sales initiatives, contributing to a collaborative and flexible sales support environment.

 

Marketing Strategy & Client Support

  • Participate in client discovery meetings alongside Account Executives to better understand client objectives and marketing challenges.
  • Assist in developing integrated television and digital advertising recommendations aligned with client goals and budgets.

  • Review campaign performance reports and assist in communicating results, optimization opportunities, and strategic recommendations to Account Executives and clients.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen existing client relationships through additional television and digital advertising solutions.
  • Develop and maintain working knowledge across CMG's television and digital advertising portfolio while serving as a knowledgeable resource for the sales organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Collaboration & Continuous Learning

  • Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Product Marketing, Campaign Operations, Performance Management, Creative Services, and other internal teams to deliver exceptional client experiences.
  • Stay current on television and digital advertising products, marketing trends, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to continuously learn new products, systems, and marketing concepts while expanding knowledge of integrated advertising strategies.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Previous experience in sales support, customer service, marketing, advertising, media, client service, project coordination, or a related business environment preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple concurrent responsibilities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with the willingness to participate in client-facing meetings and presentations.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new systems, technologies, products, and business concepts quickly.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Collaborative mindset with a commitment to supporting team success and delivering outstanding customer service.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM platforms; experience with media systems, reporting tools, or digital advertising platforms is a plus.
  • Interest in learning television and digital advertising products, campaign strategy, and integrated marketing concepts.
  • Tech-savvy with a willingness to continuously expand professional knowledge.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience working within television, radio, digital media, advertising, or agency environments.
  • Experience supporting sales teams, coordinating projects, or managing multiple client deliverables.
  • Familiarity with digital advertising concepts, campaign reporting, marketing analytics, or integrated media planning.

job.description:
Location: GA-Athens

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Athens Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal skills, and business acumen
  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
  • Excellent marketing, presentation, and closing abilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Capable of successfully negotiating with customers to achieve a strong return on investment
  • Experience in prospecting for new clients, selling services to them, and maintaining and upselling to existing clients
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Oﬃce, PowerPoint, and CRM tools like HubSpot
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree
  • Three years of experience in media sales, account management, or media buying
  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Long Island Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  News Producer - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) has an exciting opportunity for a News Producer who is creative, curious, and highly organized, and can build fast-paced, accurate, and memorable newscasts for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.

 

This role is ideal for a strong storyteller who thrives in a live newsroom, makes sound editorial decisions under pressure, and brings urgency, context, and clarity to every story. The News Producer will collaborate closely with anchors, reporters, meteorologists, editors, photographers, digital teams, and production staff to deliver compelling coverage that serves our viewers and upholds the highest standards of journalism.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Produces engaging, accurate, and well-paced newscasts that reflect strong news judgment and clear editorial priorities.
  • Writes compelling broadcast copy, including opens, teases, intros, tags, headlines, and transitions.
  • Leads live coverage with confidence, including breaking news, severe weather, developing stories, and special coverage.
  • Makes smart, timely rundown adjustments as stories change throughout the day.
  • Collaborates with anchors, reporters, meteorologists, photographers, editors, digital teams, and production teams to execute strong storytelling across platforms.
  • Uses video, graphics, live elements, social media, digital tools, and studio resources to strengthen story presentation.
  • Contributes story ideas, coverage plans, and creative approaches in editorial meetings.
  • Verifies information, upholds journalistic standards, and ensures accuracy, fairness, and clarity in all content.
  • Communicates clearly in the control room and remains calm, flexible, and solutions-focused during high-pressure coverage.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, Communications, Media, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Experience producing live newscasts and writing for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.
  • Strong news judgment and understanding of newscast structure, pacing, showcasing, and execution.
  • Ability to make fast, accurate editorial decisions during breaking news, severe weather, and other high-pressure coverage.
  • Strong writing, communication, organization, and control-room leadership skills.
  • Ability to prioritize, multitask, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced newsroom
  • High professional standards, sound ethics, and a commitment to accuracy, fairness, and responsible journalism.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior medium- to large-market newsroom experience.
  • Demonstrated track record producing strong live, breaking news, or severe weather coverage.
  • At least 2 years of professional local television news experience.

 

The wage scale for this position is $33.56 per hour to $35.58 per hour.

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options  

  • Full-time hourly employees are eligible to earn up to 176 hours of PTO inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. 

  • Part-time employees will receive one hour of paid sick leave for every 40 hours worked. 

  • Up to eight (8) paid holidays & two (2) floating holidays throughout calendar year 2026

  • Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave  

  • Employee Assistance Program 

  • All other benefits required by applicable law

Position Overview

WFXT TV Boston is looking for a visual storyteller who has a passion for news and someone who wants to make an impact in their community. Photographers/Videographers work with reporters daily in the field to turn visually creative and compelling stories. We are looking for someone who takes ownership in all aspects of their work, loves breaking news and understands the importance of local news. job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Weekend Anchor - WFTV

 

Position Overview

WFTV Channel 9 Eyewitness News is seeking a dynamic, credible, and enterprising journalist to serve as our Weekend Anchor/Reporter. This position requires a strong newsroom leader who can confidently anchor weekend newscasts while also producing impactful, original reporting during the week.

 

The successful candidate will anchor Saturday and Sunday newscasts and report in the field three days per week. Reporting is a critical component of this role. We are looking for a journalist who can uncover stories through source development, document research, public records requests, and relentless newsgathering.

 

The ideal candidate is an enterprise-driven journalist who consistently generates original story ideas, develops exclusive content, and turns meaningful enterprise stories on the same day they are pitched, bringing forward investigative and accountability-focused story ideas that matter to Central Florida viewers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Weekend Anchor Responsibilities

  • Anchor live Saturday and Sunday newscasts with authority, credibility, and strong storytelling.
  • Lead breaking news and severe weather coverage during weekend broadcasts.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, meteorologists, and newsroom leaders to shape editorial content and presentation.
  • Write, edit, and review scripts to ensure accuracy, fairness, and journalistic excellence.
  • Serve as a newsroom leader who reinforces WFTV's standards of journalism and storytelling.

 

Reporting & Investigative Responsibilities

  • Report in the field three days each week for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
  • Pitch original enterprise story ideas in the morning editorial meeting and execute those stories the same day.
  • Develop and maintain a robust network of sources across government, law enforcement, business, education, and the community.
  • Generate exclusive content through public records requests, database research, source cultivation, and document analysis.
  • Pursue accountability journalism that uncovers information viewers would not otherwise know.
  • Identify investigative angles to daily news stories and develop them into deeper enterprise reports.
  • Deliver compelling live reports from the field, particularly during breaking news and major community events.
  • Write accurate, impactful, and visually compelling stories under daily deadline pressure.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and digital teams to maximize storytelling across all platforms.
  • Produce digital content and supporting materials related to enterprise and investigative stories.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing enterprise stories.
  • Exceptional live reporting and ad-lib skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with the ability to connect with viewers.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong news judgment and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of three to five years of television news reporting experience; anchoring experience strongly preferred.

About Your Role

The Account Strategist acts as an internal sales representative responsible for the conceiving, managing and executing online marketing initiatives and management of all advertising programs and associated revenue pre- and post-sale. This includes media plan creation, campaign implementation, optimization, reporting, program retention and renewal, and ensuring prompt and proper resolution of advertiser business issues.

Job Title

Associate Director, Research & Insights

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is looking for an Associate Director of Research & Insights to lead our research strategy for our Beauty, Style, & Entertainment verticals  (Core endemic portfolio: People, Entertainment Weekly, Instyle, Byrdie). Our high-quality content is aimed at helping people make decisions, find inspiration, and take action. And our first-party data is at the heart of informing everything we do--and not just on our beauty, style, & entertainment sites, but across powerful brands in home, food & beverage, tech, travel, family, and health (including powerhouses like Better Homes and Gardens, Food & Wine, Travel + Leisure, and AllRecipes).
 

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York)

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.
 

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

Across our brands and platforms People Inc.'s content engages, informs and entertains over 175 million U.S. consumers each month. Our team helps Beauty, Style and Entertainment brands understand and connect with these consumers, using data to surface insights that inform content, media and advertising strategies.

About The Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

Team Enablement (60%)

Develop and maintain systems that enable our current analysts/category experts to continue to provide best in class service and insights to our stakeholders while also ensuring their growth and professional development. Responsibilities include:

  • People Management 

    • Advise and mentor analysts in both day-to-day work and project management - requires understanding and knowledge of media sales/strategic advertising process, broader industry landscape (B/S/E categories and media in general), and tools and resources for audience and content positioning (including but not limited to MRI-Simmons, comScore, social media measurement tools, 1P resources, Print/Magazine resources, etc.).

    • Personnel administration | Includes but is not limited to process management. time off management, identifying and flagging challenges, escalating development opportunities, etc.)

    • Personnel development | Partner with Senior Director for opportunities for development as well as career path growth within the team and support your team in achieving those goals

    • Task Management | Manage analyst workflows, monitor capacity, & ensure deliverables are timely and meet the strategic objectives of our stakeholders.

  • Systems and processes |  refining and maintenance (project trackers, dashboards, report macros, external calendars, etc.)

Individual Contributor (40%)

  • Collateral Creation & Curation | Work with the Senior Director in the development and regular updating of collateral. Examples include category one-sheets and on-the-shelf go-to-market (GTM) materials, for both B/S/E Sales and Marketing teams and all other corporate divisions (Print, Enterprise, PR, Commerce, Content, etc.)

  • Insights & Analytics | Support and coverage for RFPs and day-to-day ad hoc requests when analyst bandwidth is stretched and/or PTO coverage. This means direct use of our toolkit (of 1st and 3rd party solutions) to deliver insights and strategic recommendation.

    • Expertise in working with large data sets to synthesize information and draw out key insights

    • Expertise in using multiple sources of data and information (whether syndicated, quantitative, qualitative, secondary, etc.) to guide business decisions

College degree required

  • 5+ years of experience, minimum 3 years of management experience

  • Experience directly supporting an Ad Sales and Marketing team(s) 

  • Experience managing and mentoring analyst teams of three or more

  • Understand the digital advertising landscape, products, and trends that are important to industry media buyers

  • Strong interest in engaging with and understanding key audiences, topics, trends, and events to tie market and world events to audience insights and present a point of view that is appropriate for and in context with the these industries

  • A true self-starter who provides proactive ideas, understands organizational goals, and moves initiatives forward - with a proven track record of leading projects from start to finish and delivering business value

  • An excellent communicator with outstanding research storytelling skills which allow you to draw out key insights, and can tailor compelling and engaging messages for different audiences 

  • A strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Solid grasp of media math, statistics, digital engagement metrics, and research methodologies

Nice to Have 

  • Direct Beauty, Style and/or Entertainment category experience

  • Passion for Pop Culture

Job Title
