Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

Assist in training and directing the Move Team and help ensure workers are scheduled and available when needed.  Assist in overseeing relocations and storage of furniture, office equipment, large packages, and other items.  Consult on space usage/placement and oversee setups for events and meetings.  Maintain office and special event furniture inventory and manage storage areas.  Partner closely with events and catering teams, Building Services, and Security.

Schedule Requirements:

Full In-Office

In-office Expectations: This position is a fully in-office role due to the nature of the work being done.

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

People Inc. is #1 in beauty & style on the internet, reaching over 27 million unique users a month, and in the top 10 in entertainment, reaching nearly 79 million unique users a month (almost as many as Netflix!). In the role of Building Services Lead, you will apply your professional expertise to facilitate the execution of daily logistical requirements for employees, clients, and guests, thereby supporting organizational business continuity.
 

About The Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

  • 60%:  Labor Management - Employee/Contractor/Vendor Management:  Assist in training and directing Move Team in moving and placement of furniture and equipment for moves, event setups, etc.  Be proactive in establishing workload, ensuring the most efficient use of time and staff, documentation, etc.

    • Workflow oversight of daily board and Amenity reports to ensure work requests and setup information are prioritized and communicated to the team.

    • Daily Briefings:  Conduct briefings of pending and outstanding tasks with the team, particularly during shift transitions and at the end of the day.

Workplace App, ensuring all tickets are printed, dispatched, and documented with accurate labor time in 10-minute increments. Monitor real-time communication via Slack or text to confirm task status, manage the "open punch list" for incomplete items, and coordinate the rerouting of specialized requests to external groups like ABM or Handymen.

    • Financial/Order Oversight:  Responsible for approving and placing orders for office supplies as needed.

    • Specific Inventory Management:  Manage 5th Floor Furniture Room and C2 backstock.

  • Project management or event management experience is a plus

  • Labor management

  • Strong understanding of spatial relations

  • Multitasking ability & excellent problem solving skills

  • Computer literacy (Google Docs, Excel, Calendaring, Smartphone, Inventory System use, Email.  Slack messaging is a plus.

  • Highly organized & Detail Oriented

job.description:
Job Title

Digital Marketing Manager

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

People Inc. is seeking a Digital Marketing Manager to support and execute the acquisition and retention marketing strategy for paid memberships. This is a hybrid role based in New York, with an in-office requirement of 3 days per week.

Reporting into the Director Acquisition & Retention Marketing, Paid Memberships, this role is responsible for owning the end-to-end execution of email campaigns and onsite marketing campaigns for paid memberships. This includes day-to-day project management, campaign management, asset trafficking, QA, performance monitoring, and campaign optimization—supporting a broader vision to grow paid memberships and membership renewal rates. 

This is a highly collaborative, execution-focused position ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, brings strong attention to detail, and is deeply comfortable with email marketing, digital marketing and CRM tools.

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand.

This role is part of our centralized Growth and Audience Relationship team, responsible for growing direct relationships between our brands and consumers, operating People Inc. brands' newsletter, notification and lifecycle marketing programs. This role operates in service to the Paid Membership marketing team, and is deeply embedded in the paid membership team’s day to day operations and business.


 

About The Positions Contributions:

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

  •  Execute Digital Marketing Campaigns:

    • Create and project manage the development and optimization of email and onsite marketing programs and assets across awareness, sign up, onboarding, engagement, and retention as defined by the Director.

    • Coordinate deployment of cross-channel campaigns including email, website, browser notifications.

    • Handle campaign QA, testing, scheduling, and approvals to ensure flawless execution.

  • Creative Briefing and Asset Management:

    • Write detailed project briefs and collaborate with marketing, copywriter, editorial, and design teams to ensure assets are timely, on-brand, and optimized for performance.

    • Review and traffic creative assets for stakeholder approval.

  • Campaign Operations:

    • Set up campaign tracking links and UTMs, and coordinate tagging with product and engineering.

    • Maintain comprehensive documentation for all live and upcoming campaigns.

  •  Performance Reporting and Optimization:

    • Monitor and report on campaign KPIs (e.g. conversion rate, click rate) using tools such as Piano, Looker, Iterable and other dashboards.

    • Surface insights, propose A/B tests, and recommend optimizations to improve acquisition and engagement performance over time.

  •  Cross-Functional Collaboration:

    • Work closely with brand, magazine, and newsletter to align campaign execution with larger brand business goals.

    • Communicate progress and challenges to stakeholders in a timely and solutions-oriented manner.

  • Measurable Results Expected:

    • Timely and accurate execution of all campaigns.

    • Demonstrated improvements in customer acquisition, member engagement, retention and renewal rates.

    • Increased operational efficiency.

    • Clear contribution to meeting paid membership growth and retention goals.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in direct marketing, lifecycle marketing, consumer marketing or CRM, preferably for a subscription-based on paid product.

  • Proven ability to manage end-to-end campaign execution, including briefing, QA, deployment, and performance tracking.

  • Knowledge of onsite targeting/segmentation and campaign optimization

  • Strong familiarity with tools such as Piano, Wunderkind, Digioh, Braze, Iterable, or similar.

  • Analytical proficiency in reviewing performance data and making recommendations for improvement.

  • High level of organization and attention to detail, with experience managing multiple priorities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfort working in a highly matrixed, cross-functional environment.



% Travel Required (Approximate):  5%

Director, Conversion Strategy

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

People Inc is seeking a Director of Conversion Strategy, to lead a conversion strategy team across onsite and in-app marketing. The Director will determine how Martech platforms fit into the acquisition roadmap for newsletter, app, subscriptions, and paid memberships.

job.title: Director, Executive Compensation
job.description:
Job Title

Director, Executive Compensation

Job Description

The Director, Executive Compensation serves as the leader and subject matter expert for the company’s equity and executive compensation programs. This hands-on role is responsible for administering and optimizing the equity compensation program at People Incorporated and ensuring a seamless experience for all participants.  Reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, this role interacts with Finance, Legal, and HR. The ideal candidate will balance technical excellence in equity governance with the executive presence required to design, communicate, and execute competitive reward strategies across the company.

The position is based in the New York City corporate headquarters and is hybrid in-office with the ability to work remotely up to 2 days per week.

Equity Program Administration

  • Manage and process the full lifecycle of global equity awards: grant setup, vesting, releases, cancellations, terminations/retirement, and quarterly dividends across multiple jurisdictions and equity structures.

  • Manage and optimize the employee equity database. Maintain flawless data integrity, update employee records, and generate routine and ad-hoc reports.

  • Act as a trusted, accessible stock plan expert to all levels of the organization, including executives and board members, providing support and addressing inquiries with clarity, accuracy, and timeliness.

  • Coordinate with Payroll and Finance regarding equity vests and reporting. Provide guidance to HRBPs and Subsidiary companies as needed. 

  • Review, interpret, and optimize stock plan data. Track and report on critical equity metrics including share utilization, burn rate, overhang, and dilution to inform long-term budgeting and forecasting. Prepare projections and provide recommendations on budgets.

  • Exercise sound judgment to resolve complex stock plan participant matters and address evolving stock plan provisions, balancing business needs and employee experience considerations.

  • Proactively educate employees on their equity plans and grants. Prepare and review stock plan participant communications, statements, and educational materials, ensuring clarity and comprehension across diverse participant groups.

  • Own the strategic relationship and service level agreements (SLAs) with external stock plan administrators (e.g., Morgan Stanley), ensuring seamless platform optimization and flawless database data integrity.

  • Act as the technical advisor on the equity and compensation implications of corporate restructurings, subsidiary management, and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).

  • Oversee equity plan compliance, monitoring insider trading policies, managing pre-clearance lists, and enforcing corporate blackout periods in partnership with Legal.

Executive Compensation, Proxy & Governance

  • Partner directly with the VP of Total Rewards to strategize, draft, and deliver high-impact, Board-level materials and data visualizations for the quarterly Compensation Committee meetings.

  • Contribute to executive compensation-related regulatory filings and disclosures, including the Compensation Discussion & Analysis (CD&A) and related proxy statement content.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving investor expectations and proxy advisor perspectives, regulatory developments, firm strategy and market practices and translate these into practical implications for Total Rewards program design and disclosure.

  • Lead executive benchmarking, peer group selection, and competitive pay analysis for senior leadership.

  • Ensure regulatory compliance for Section 16 executive and Board members and assist in the preparation of SEC Form filings.

General Compensation & Projects

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior management by providing strategic guidance and execution support for Total Rewards programs, especially compensation programs impacting senior leadership.

  • Serve as a trusted partner to HR and  Finance with Compensation initiatives throughout the year.

  • Support the Compensation team by collaborating on Compensation philosophy and with the year-end compensation cycle.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Finance, or Business. CCP certification is a plus.

Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in compensation in a publicly traded, mid-to-large-sized company with specific experience in hands-on equity administration including stock options, restricted stock, and performance-based stock awards.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a focus on detail and data accuracy.

  • Advanced Sheets/Excel Capabilities: Mastery of advanced spreadsheet functions (lookups, index/match, pivot tables, complex data modeling) to manipulate and interpret large datasets.

  • Discretion & Judgment: A proven problem-solving mindset with the ability to think critically, exercise good judgment, and handle highly confidential executive data with total discretion.

  • Agility & Time Management: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple competing priorities and tight deadlines seamlessly.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex equity and compensation topics clearly to both entry-level employees and executives.

  • Autonomy: A proactive, self-starter mentality who takes initiative and works independently while remaining a highly collaborative team player.

  • Continuous Improvement & Innovation: A forward-thinking mindset with a willingness to explore AI tools, automated workflows, and emerging technologies to streamline compensation processes and maximize efficiency. 

% Travel Required (Approximate): 0-5%

job.description:
Job Title

Executive Director, Account Strategy

Job Description

About Your Role

People Inc. is looking for an Executive Director of Account Strategy to lead our Health vertical. This is a critical leadership role responsible for overseeing a team of Account Strategists supporting our pharmaceutical and healthcare advertising business and driving revenue retention and growth through best-in-class client strategy, campaign management, and operational excellence.

With a focus on solutions, critical thinking, and analytical rigor, you are a proven leader who can successfully navigate the complexities of the health and pharmaceutical advertising landscape. You will serve as a senior strategic partner across Sales, Marketing, Ad Operations, Campaign Analytics, Research & Measurement, Product, Data, and other key functions, ensuring our programs are positioned for success from pre-sale strategy through execution, optimization, measurement, and renewal.

You understand that strong Account Strategy goes beyond campaign execution. You will help your team identify opportunities to improve performance, deepen client partnerships, grow revenue, and evolve our Health advertising capabilities. You are a growth-oriented, positive self-starter who proactively identifies ways to improve processes, increase efficiency, solve complex business challenges, and continually raise the standard of client service across the Health organization.

Hybrid 3x a week- (NYC, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand.

The Health vertical partners with leading healthcare and pharmaceutical clients to develop and execute advertising solutions that reach both consumers (DTC) and healthcare professionals (HCPs). The business operates within a highly dynamic and regulated industry, requiring a strong understanding of evolving health and pharma trends, client priorities, audience behaviors, and regulatory and compliance requirements that impact healthcare advertising. The team must stay closely connected to changes across the marketplace to anticipate client needs, identify emerging opportunities, and ensure our solutions continue to meet the unique needs and standards of healthcare and pharma marketers.

About Your Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

70%

Business & Client Leadership — Lead the Account Strategy function to drive client success, revenue retention and growth, and operational excellence. Partner with Sales and cross-functional leaders to address business needs, identify growth opportunities, and build scalable processes that improve performance and efficiency.

30%

People & Organizational Leadership — Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing Account Strategy organization, creating clear expectations, accountability and opportunities for growth. Coach and develop managers and individual contributors, proactively assess talent and organizational needs, and build structures that support the evolving needs of the business

  • Lead and develop the Health Account Strategy team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, strategic thinking, client service, and deep expertise across the pharmaceutical and healthcare business.

  • Serve as a senior strategic partner to Health Sales leadership, helping drive revenue retention, renewals, incremental opportunities, and long-term account growth across key clients and agency partners.

  • Develop deep expertise across the Health portfolio, including DTC and HCP advertising solutions, branded and unbranded programs, custom content, audience targeting, programmatic activation, and measurement offerings.

  • Ensure the team understands the unique requirements and complexities of pharmaceutical advertising and can confidently navigate client, agency, regulatory, operational, and measurement considerations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, processes, systems, and work products, creating greater efficiency and scalability as the Health business grows.

  • Provide strategic recommendations that help evolve our advertising product suite, measurement capabilities, client deliverables, and overall Health offering.

  • Build strong partnerships across the sales support teams.

  • Lead regular team meetings, training, and development opportunities to ensure the Account Strategy organization maintains strong expertise across Health products, systems, processes, measurement solutions, and industry trends.

  • Own the Performance Center of Excellence including campaign reporting and measurement, ensuring the team can confidently analyze first- and third-party data, identify meaningful trends, develop actionable insights, and translate performance into compelling client stories.

  • Ensure the team consistently connects campaign performance back to client objectives and broader business outcomes, moving beyond reporting metrics to delivering meaningful strategic recommendations.

  • Proactively communicate business, campaign, and client needs to senior management and cross-functional partners, identifying risks early and driving solutions before they impact the client or revenue.

  • Partner with Health leadership to identify broader trends across clients and campaigns and translate those learnings into new products, capabilities, processes, and commercial opportunities.

  • Represent Account Strategy as a senior leader within the Health organization, helping shape how People Inc. continues to evolve and grow its pharmaceutical and healthcare advertising business.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Education:

Bachelor's Degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience within digital media, advertising, publishing, or an advertising agency; pharmaceutical, healthcare, or health media experience strongly preferred.

  • 4+ years of experience managing and developing high-performing teams, including experience managing managers and/or senior-level individual contributors.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex, high-value advertising partnerships. Relationships with clients, agencies, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical advertising ecosystem, including DTC and/or HCP media, audience targeting, campaign measurement, data partnerships, and the operational complexities associated with healthcare advertising.

  • Working knowledge of programmatic media buying and execution across display, video, CTV, and other digital channels.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify larger trends across campaign and business data and translate them into actionable recommendations.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and navigate complex organizations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

  • A solutions-oriented leader who proactively identifies challenges, develops recommendations, and drives issues through resolution.

  • Strong executive communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior internal stakeholders, clients, agencies, and external partners.

  • Demonstrated commercial mindset with an understanding of how strong client service, campaign performance, and strategic partnership contribute to retention and revenue growth.

  • Driven to make things happen while consistently acting with integrity, professionalism, and respect for others.

job.description:
Job Title

GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization

Job Description

About The Position :

The GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization is a mid-to-senior execution leader responsible for the day-to-day coordination, commercial readiness, and field adoption of our enterprise ad product portfolio. Based in our New York City office, this role serves as the critical, high-touch bridge between our product capabilities and sales execution.

As the ultimate "keeper of the Ad Product Catalog," you will ensure that our New York-based revenue teams—including Sellers, Account Strategists, and Brand Marketers—fully understand our ad products, their operational nuances, and how to position them for maximum yield. Additionally, you will act as the on-the-ground project manager ushering new products through the formal GTM process, ensuring cross-functional alignment and gathering real-time field feedback to optimize our commercial engine.

Hybrid 3x a week- NYC

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Team:

The Ad Product Commercialization team partners across Product, Sales, Brand Marketing, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, and Commercial organizations to successfully bring advertising products to market. The team enables revenue growth by ensuring product launches are well coordinated, sales teams are equipped for success, and customer feedback continuously informs product evolution.

About The Position’s Contributions:

35% Ad Product Catalog Governance & Advisory

  • Single Source of Truth: Own and maintain the comprehensive Ad Product Catalog. Ensure all product specifications, packaging rules, pricing guidelines, and operational constraints are meticulously updated, accurate, and accessible.

  • Technical & Operational Advisory: Act as the primary, local "help desk" and subject matter expert for NYC-based Sellers and Account Strategists. Provide rapid, clear answers to complex, nuanced questions regarding ad product capabilities and custom configuration rules.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with the Brand Marketing team to ensure that their client-facing narratives match the exact technical and operational realities housed in the product catalog.

35% GTM Program Management & Training

  • Launch Traffic Control: Act as the dedicated project manager ushering individual products and packages through the formal GTM pipeline. Coordinate timelines, keep cross-functional stakeholders on schedule, and prevent rollout bottlenecks.

  • Operational Readiness & Briefings: Translate dense, technical ad product mechanics into clear, digestible operational instructions. Lead internal briefings and training sessions for revenue teams detailing what a product is, who it is for, and how to book it.

30% Field Adoption & Commercial Yield Analysis

  • Data-Driven Optimization: Regularly analyze internal sales data and product adoption metrics. Identify which packages are driving the highest yield and surface trends regarding what is selling well versus what isn't.

  • On-the-Ground Feedback Loops: Leverage your physical presence in the NYC office to build deep trust with sellers and CROs. Proactively capture field feedback, understand seller pain points, and investigate the "why" behind product adoption data to inform future iterations.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Media, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Experience:

  • 4–7 years of experience in ad product operations, go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, digital media project management, product marketing, commercial operations, or a related field.

  • Experience managing cross-functional product launches and commercialization initiatives.

  • Experience supporting revenue organizations within digital advertising, media, ad tech, or SaaS environments.

  • Experience partnering with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams in a fast-paced organization.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Relationship Building & Empathy: High emotional intelligence with a proven track record of earning trust across diverse commercial teams. Exceptional ability to act as a supportive, empathetic partner to quota-carrying sellers.

  • Program & Project Management: Highly organized with the disciplined capability to manage multiple moving parts of a launch simultaneously, enforce deadlines, and keep diverse stakeholders communicating effectively.

  • Product Literacy: Strong foundational knowledge of the digital advertising ecosystem, ad tech, and sales lifecycles. Ability to quickly master technical ad product configurations and explain them simply to non-technical teams.

  • Data Curiosity: A natural inclination to look at sales spreadsheets, ask probing questions about revenue performance, and translate numbers into actionable insights for catalog optimization.

% Travel Required (Approximate): < 5%

job.description:
Job Title

Manager, Growth Marketing Platforms

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

The Platform Operations Manager plays an important role within the Growth team, ensuring excellence across our email and SMS programs. This role acts as the primary operations partner, translating product initiatives into scalable, testable, and reliable email, push notification and SMS workflows. This individual is responsible for maintaining the operational integrity for email and notification campaigns for assigned brands—from setup through deployment.

Working at the intersection of email and SMS messaging, this role will oversee campaign setup, execution, monitor deliverability health, and partner with cross-functional teams to ensure our programs deliver both user value and growth. 

Hybrid 3x a week- (Des Moines, IA) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Positions Contributions:

Campaign Operations & Execution

  • Oversee day-to-day email and SMS campaign operations, ensuring flawless execution and timely delivery.

  • Build custom user selections and other connected programs for enhanced targeting.

  • Scope, build, and launch specific acquisition and retention campaigns, including blast and journey-based use cases (e.g., winback, onboarding, high affinity user flows).

  • Own QA workflows, including link validation, image rendering, data mapping, triggering effectiveness, journey flows, preview testing, and multi-device checks.

  • Manage scheduling, batching, throttling, and send-time logic to optimize throughput (including MPS requirements).

  • Ensure proper setup of newsletters, lifecycle journeys, real-time alerts, and triggered communications.

  • Set up or review A/B testing strategies and coordinate rollout of new templates with partners.

  • Monitor real-time send statuses, error queues, and fallback handling to ensure campaigns fire as expected.

Platform & Data Management

  • Monitor platform health, integration failures, and journey errors; drive real-time response and root-cause investigation.

  • Support advanced capabilities including segmentation, dynamic content rendering, conditional logic, and real-time triggers.

  • Maintain platform folder structures, naming conventions, asset governance, and permission controls.

  • Manage data hygiene efforts (inactivity criteria, churn processing, inactive segment monitoring).

  • Deliverability & Performance

  • Monitor inbox placement, blocklist status, bounce codes, and sender reputation across brands and IPs.

  • Partner with the deliverability consultant to identify and mitigate risks—spam traps, throttling, complaint spikes, cold IP warming, etc.

  • Oversee CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR, and CCPA compliance across templates, data handling, and unsubscribe processes.

  • Manage domain-level configurations (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) in partnership with Tech Ops.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • 2-3 years of experience in email, SMS, and/or mobile app messaging operations, marketing technology, or digital platform management.

  • Knowledge of ESPs and notification systems.

  • Strong project management and problem-solving skills, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work across editorial, product, data, and strategy teams.

  • Experience managing vendor relationships and holding partners accountable.

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand.

This role is part of our centralized Growth and Audience Relationship team, responsible for growing direct relationships between our brands and consumers, operating People Inc. brands' newsletter, notification and retention marketing programs, and delivering best in class experiences to millions of subscribers and members. This role works cross-functionally with product, data, production, and growth team counterparts, as well as brand leaders and brand editorial.

job.description:
Job Title

Nights Editor, EW

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

The Night Editor will lead EW’s after-hours news operation, overseeing writers and serving as the primary editorial decision-maker during their shift. They will curate the news list, assign and edit stories, handle breaking news, and ensure the team is focused on the biggest and most important entertainment stories of the day.

This person will oversee a high volume of content, prioritizing assignments based on editorial importance and audience interest. They will assign writers to priority stories, pivot coverage as news develops, lead edits, and ensure the edit queue is cleared before the end of their shift.

The Night Editor will help writers strengthen their news judgment and learn how to identify, advance, prioritize, and close out the biggest stories. They must be comfortable making independent editorial decisions during off-hours when senior leadership is unavailable and taking initiative to ensure strong coverage.

The ideal candidate will have excellent news judgment, editing and communication skills, a deep knowledge of entertainment and pop culture, and a strong understanding of the digital news landscape, including SEO, analytics, and traffic-driving opportunities.

The schedule for this role will be Monday-Thursday 2pm-10pm PT and Sunday 12pm-8pm PT

In-office Expectations: This position is fully remote with no in-office requirements, (might require coming into an office 1 or 2x a year)

Entertainment Weekly is an entertainment news brand with approximately 35 full-time employees, predominantly based in New York City and Los Angeles.

10% - Reporting and writing: deliver great entertainment access stories and news; other duties as assigned

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Journalism or related field or equivalent work experience

Minimum 3-5 years of experience, with at least 2 years in an editing role

People Inc. is looking for a Sr. Analyst  of Research & Insights to lead our research strategy for our Beauty, Style, & Entertainment verticals  (Core endemic portfolio: People, Entertainment Weekly, Instyle, Byrdie). Our high-quality content is aimed at helping people make decisions, find inspiration, and take action. And our first-party data is at the heart of informing everything we do--and not just on our beauty, style, & entertainment sites, but across powerful brands in home, food & beverage, tech, travel, family, and health (including powerhouses like Better Homes and Gardens, Food & Wine, Travel + Leisure, and AllRecipes).

Job Title

Senior Director, Social Strategy & Operations

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

The Senior Director, Social Strategy & Operations leads People Inc.'s centralized social strategy and operations function, responsible for accelerating audience growth across social platforms, scaling sponsored social capabilities, and building the systems, insights, and organizational infrastructure that drive social performance across the portfolio.

This role oversees a team of social strategy and operations professionals, including strategists and indirect reports, and serves as the primary social strategy partner to editorial, revenue, product, business development, video, TRX, and executive leadership teams. As the company's senior social media leader, the Senior Director defines enterprise social strategy, delivers executive insights that inform business decisions, and represents People Inc. to social platforms, technology partners, and the broader industry.

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Positions Contributions:

Strategy & Growth

  • Define and lead People Inc.'s enterprise social growth strategy across platforms.
  • Partner with brands and stakeholders to identify growth opportunities, optimize content performance, and expand off-platform audience acquisition.
  • Lead cross-brand initiatives, experimentation, and platform innovation efforts.
  • Establish social best practices, performance benchmarks, and strategic frameworks across the organization.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and mentor a team of social strategists and operations coordinators, including management of managers.

  • Set team priorities, allocate resources, and ensure strategic support is aligned with business goals.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.

Sponsored Social & Revenue Support

  • Own the strategic approach to sponsored social media across the organization.

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Ad Solutions teams to align sponsored content with platform best practices and audience insights.

  • Develop scalable workflows and operational processes that improve campaign execution and performance.

  • Identify opportunities to support social revenue growth through data, content strategy, and platform expertise.

Analytics, Operations & Reporting

  • Oversee social reporting, analytics, dashboards, and measurement frameworks.

  • Translate performance data into actionable insights and recommendations for stakeholders across the business.

  • Lead relationships with key social platforms, vendors, and technology partners.

Executive Leadership

  • Serve as People Inc.’s senior social media strategist and trusted advisor to executive leadership.

Job Title

Senior Manager, Conversion

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

The Audience Conversion team at People Inc. leads marketing strategies that acquire new audiences and convert unknown users into known. We are seeking a passionate and data-driven Senior Conversion Manager to develop, lead, and execute strategies that drive high-quality user acquisition across a range of brand products and initiatives.

This role builds direct connections between our brands and audiences. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, builds trust with cross-functional partners, and translates data and insights into clear, actionable strategies.

The Senior Conversion Manager will lead, manage, and optimize acquisition strategies for assigned brands, including efforts to grow subscription memberships, newsletter subscribers, app downloads, event ticket sales, and other audience growth programs. This person will own on-site conversion strategies from concept through execution, while continuously reporting on performance, learnings, and opportunities for improvement.

This role will oversee acquisition efforts across on-site marketing placements, interactive quizzes, sweepstakes, partnerships, and other conversion channels. The Senior Conversion Manager will work closely with an Audience Retention and Lifecycle Strategist to grow active subscribers and deepen subscriber engagement.

This position is part of a unified Conversion team and will collaborate closely with Product, Growth, brand leadership, and editorial teams. Success in this role requires a strategic, forward-thinking mindset, strong analytical skills, excellent communication, and the ability to lead through collaboration.

Hybrid 3x a week- (DSM or NYC) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Positions Contributions:

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

  • Conversion Strategy: Lead the development and execution of audience conversion strategies that drive new newsletter subscriptions and other key acquisition goals. Build Audience Conversion roadmaps for assigned brands, contribute to vertical and brand planning, launch new acquisition programs and levers, execute A/B tests, and share performance results, insights, and learnings on an ongoing basis.

  • Performance Analysis: Monitor, analyze, and report on the performance of conversion initiatives to ensure goals are met. Translate data into actionable insights, identify opportunities for optimization and growth, and communicate recommendations clearly to stakeholders.

  • Operations and Project Management: Build and manage campaigns within marketing technology platforms. Oversee QA, timelines, stakeholder feedback, and approval processes with strong attention to detail to ensure high-quality execution.

  • Best Practices: Stay closely connected to industry news, emerging trends, and audience growth innovations. Conduct internal and external program audits and deliver insights, recommendations, and best practices that strengthen conversion performance.

  • Collaboration and Partnership: Build strong, trusted relationships with brand leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. Proactively anticipate partner needs, offer strategic recommendations, and deliver high-quality work across multiple internal teams, including General Managers, Editorial, Design, Data, Product, Growth, and Audience Retention and Lifecycle counterparts.

Education: Bachelors and/or equivalent experience.

  • Strong project management skills

Job Title

Senior News Editor, Current Events, PEOPLE

Job Description

I. Job Summary | Major goals and objectives.

 The Senior News Editor will be responsible for coordinating PEOPLE’s personality-focused national affairs coverage with the Senior Editor to lead digital coverage for PEOPLE’s Current Events vertical. This includes leading digital coverage of key events and managing digital coverage, from routine daily news to breaking news situations that arise within the vertical; helping to develop strategy and content opportunities around trends, first families, national figures, and topical issues. The ideal candidate is a dynamic editor who’s extremely skilled at mining social media and other sources (both online and/or through contacts) for new and exclusive stories. A compelling storyteller, quick—and impeccable—line editor, writer (whenever needed), and headline writer.  Must have solid news judgment and the ability to prioritize and identify potentially high-traffic stories. This candidate would also need to be able to ideate key second beat and breakout posts, to fully leverage breaking and trending news stories. A fluent understanding of the digital landscape, including content streams, SEO and analytics is mandatory, and this editor needs to be extremely organized, efficient, and able to communicate quickly, clearly—and respectfully—to the team.

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in journalism or communications, related field or equivalent training and/or experience.

Experience:

Minimum 7 years experience working in a high volume, digital news operation, with proven leadership experience.

• Strong organizational skills and a proven ability to work independently.

• Passion for and knowledge of national affairs-related issues, and a fluency in the media landscape.

job.title: Senior Product Manager, Privacy & Trust
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Product Manager, Privacy & Trust

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements 

 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to take charge of our data privacy and platform strategy. You will be the point person for balancing our business needs, like audience growth and personalization, with the reality of global privacy regulations. This role is a mix of high-level roadmap planning and deep-in-the-weeds technical problem solving, specifically regarding our Data Subject Request (DSR) platform.

 

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

 

About The Team:

At People Inc., we treat reader trust as our most valuable asset. This role is not just building a platform; this role is building the infrastructure that allows our readers to trust us with their data. This team solves hard, "real-world" technical problems that have a tangible impact. 

About The Positions Contributions:

 

Weight % | Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

20% | Own the DSR Platform

  • Our current DSR process needs work. You will lead the roadmap to evolve this from a compliance checkbox into a scalable, automated system that handles access, deletion, and portability requests across all our data silos.

20% | Balance Privacy & Product

  • You’ll define how we manage data and identity. The goal is to stay fully compliant (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) without sacrificing the user experience or our ability to deliver relevant content.

20% | Build the Foundation

  • Partner with engineering to modernize our data architecture. You need to understand our data lineage, governance, and security well enough to guide architectural decisions across different business units.

20% | Make Privacy User-Friendly

  • Stop treating privacy as a legal chore. You will design transparent, user-centric flows that actually help our readers understand their data, which in turn builds long-term brand trust.

20% | Cross-Functional Strategy

  • You’ll be the bridge between Legal, AdTech, and Engineering. You need to be able to explain the technical risk to legal, and the regulatory requirements to our engineering leads.


The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree is preferred and/or equivalent experience.

 

Experience:

  • 5+ years in product management owning backend platforms. A candidate who has worked in data-heavy environments or managed compliance-related products or identity systems is required. 

 

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • DSR Platform Expertise: Experience developing or expanding DSR systems. You understand the friction involved in verifying identities and synchronizing data across disconnected stacks and have a vision for automation.

  • Technical Authority: Ability to lead technical discussions with engineers. You possess a strong grasp of APIs, data flow, and warehouse environments like BigQuery or Snowflake to guide fundamental architectural choices.

  • Articulate Communication: Skill in distilling complex legal mandates or technical constraints into clear, actionable insights for leadership across Legal, Editorial, and Revenue teams.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer 1
job.description:
Job Title

Senior Software Engineer 1

Job Description

Picksy is our next-generation product discovery platform connecting shoppers with the things they love across thousands of retail partners. Users save, organize, and share products they're excited about — and our platform turns those signals into a deeply personalized shopping experience. This team owns the foundational product data, services, applications, and integrations that power the Picksy experience.

Hybrid 3x per week

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements 

____________________________________________________________________________________________

As a Senior Software Engineer on Picksy Services, you'll take ownership of solution design and implementation for scalable, highly available services, while mentoring other engineers and helping shape the team's technical direction. You'll work closely with product owners, designers, and fellow engineers to translate requirements into prototypes and world-class features, and you'll be a go-to voice on architecture decisions and best practices across the team.

You will:

  • Partner with engineers across data, web, and mobile experiences to build and evolve the foundational services powering Picksy.

  • Design and implement new services, APIs, and operational monitoring functions.

  • Own production services end-to-end — investigating issues, resolving bottlenecks, and proactively identifying opportunities to improve reliability and reduce cost.

  • Lead code reviews and mentor other engineers, setting the bar for code quality and advocating for best practices across the team.

  • Drive the identification and prioritization of technical debt.

  • Provide thorough, readable documentation for the services you own.

  • Partner with engineers across the org to establish and align on shared best practices.

  • Bring strong technical judgment to ambiguous problems, and deliver high-quality, complex services under tight timelines.

 

About The Positions Contributions:

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

50%

Feature implementation: Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and tech leadership to plan and create new services, features, and enhancements.

15%

Architecture: Lead technical design of new and expanding systems; drive identification and prioritization of technical debt; proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability and reduce cost.

15%

Maintenance: Own production services end-to-end; investigate, troubleshoot, and implement fixes for bugs and operational issues.

10%

Review, Mentorship & Testing: Lead code reviews and mentor other engineers, setting the bar for code quality; work closely with quality-assurance engineers to facilitate feature testing and contribute to automated test coverage.

10%

Requirements Analysis: Consume non-technical user stories, providing feedback when necessary, translating into technical documentation, and/or using as a basis for implementation.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or relevant industry experience.

 

Experience:

  • 5+ years of relevant professional technology experience.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

You have practical knowledge of modern development techniques and trends, and you are eager to continue learning. You have:

 

  • Demonstrated deep understanding of REST, service architecture, monitoring, and the tenets of horizontal scalability.

  • Experience developing complex and highly available services running in a production environment with SLAs.

  • Extensive knowledge of object-oriented and functional software design patterns, including those commonly used within large web application platforms.

  • Proven experience developing and owning production services and applications deployed in AWS or GCP, leveraging containers, continuous integration, and codified infrastructure.

  • Extensive experience using Node.js, TypeScript, and the NestJS framework, with some knowledge of Java and GraphQL.

  • Familiarity with HTML/CSS and frontend web frameworks such as Vue or Nuxt (strongly preferred).

  • Knowledge of NoSQL data stores, graph databases, indexing, distributed locking, media transformation, and search engines such as Elasticsearch or Solr.

  • Experience working in an Agile environment, translating user stories into technical tasks and estimating effort effectively.

  • Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience leading architecture discussions, advocating for your approach, and mentoring team members.

  • Motivation to learn new technologies and grow as a developer.

 Travel Required (Approximate): 0%

job.title: Social Operations Manager
job.description:
Job Title

Social Operations Manager

Job Description

About The Position

People Inc. is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and service-minded Social Operations Manager to join the Social Strategy and Operations team. This role will own and improve the operational systems, workflows, tools, access processes, and cross-functional support that enable our social editors to work efficiently across a large portfolio of brands.

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Social Strategy, the Social Operations Manager will serve as a central operational partner to brand social teams, Sales, Paid Social, Security, IT, platform partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders. This person will manage day-to-day social operations, troubleshoot platform and tooling issues, oversee account and permissions processes, support employee onboarding and offboarding, and help ensure teams have the systems, documentation, and support needed to execute effectively.

This is an operations-focused role. It does not involve content creation, publishing social posts, setting social strategy, or running organic social campaigns.

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week

About The Positions Contributions:

Operational Support & Coordination:

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison between internal stakeholders, social platforms, and vendors.

  • Provide day-to-day technical and operational support across social platforms and tools, including troubleshooting access, reporting, distribution, and account issues.

  • Ongoing monitoring of the team's Slack channel to quickly address and help solve any issues raised by stakeholders in real time.

  • Create, manage, and track support tickets with social platforms and vendors, ensuring timely follow-through and clear stakeholder communication.

  • Proactively communicate platform issues, updates, resolutions, and process changes clearly to impacted teams.

  • Maintain strong working knowledge of social platform and social publishing tool capabilities, limitations, operational requirements, and account structures.

  • Lead coordination of enterprise-wide social operational initiatives spanning multiple brands, social teams, platform partners, and third-party vendors, ensuring complex, cross-functional work is planned, executed, communicated, and completed consistently at scale.

Account Management, Access, and Governance:

  • Handle setup, transfer, shutdown, and access management for accounts organization-wide. This involves establishing processes and workflows for integrating social media handles with new platform features, merging social media pages, and fixing content distribution problems.

  • Onboarding and offboarding of new and departing employees.

  • Partner with Security, IT, Legal, and relevant stakeholders to support access governance, account integrity, risk mitigation, and platform compliance.

Sales and Paid Social Operational Support

  • Help troubleshoot sponsored campaign setup, access,, tagging, permissions, and platform execution issues.

  • Document operational requirements, dependencies, and timelines for paid and sponsored social workstreams.

Social Tool Contracts & Renewals:

  • Spearhead social vendor tool evaluations and contract renewals. Collaborate and coordinate across strategic sourcing, brands, social leadership and finance.  

  • Evaluate social tools and vendors against business and editorial needs, and ensure People Inc. is aligned with the best suite of tools to meet our business needs. 

  • Manage vendor contracts, seats, and invoices.

Social Resources & Documentation:

  • Maintain the People Inc. Social Resource Repository and ensure documentation, process guides, training materials, and operational resources remain accurate and up-to-date.

  • Proactively identify documentation gaps and coordinate with subject matter experts to refresh or create needed materials.

  • Coordinate social platform and social publishing tool trainings, ensuring strong stakeholder participation and adoption.

  • Assemble, present and distribute recurring social operations updates, including platform news, process changes, and relevant operational guidance.

Data and Reporting:

  • Work with Business Insights, Data Operations and Marketing teams on social analytics and reporting, including overseeing the build out of key reports in Looker, QA’ing, and communicating to stakeholders as new data and reporting becomes available. 

  • Create and maintain key reports, compile data from various sources and/or coordinate data collection across stakeholders. 

  • Maintain expertise and understanding of the full suite of social reporting tools, metric definitions and data sources including those from the social platforms and our third party social tools.

Workflow Improvement and Cross-Functional Project Management:

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce manual effort, and streamline recurring operational processes.

  • Explore and implement automation and AI-enabled process improvements where appropriate.

  • Project manage cross-functional operational initiatives, ensuring workstreams stay aligned, owners are clear, stakeholders are coordinated, and deadlines are met.

  • Translate operational needs into clear project plans, timelines, dependencies, and communication plans.

  • Track progress, surface risks, resolve blockers, and ensure operational priorities are executed efficiently across teams.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: Bachelor's degree preferred/required in Marketing, Communications, Operations, Business, and/or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 3-5 years of experience in social operations, digital media operations, platform operations, project management, media, technology, or a related field.

  • Strong operational judgment and ability to manage complex, cross-functional workflows with many stakeholders.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities at once.

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills.

  • Experience managing vendor relationships, contracts, renewals, invoices, seats, and stakeholder communications.

  • Strong interpersonal and written communication skills, with a customer-service orientation.

  • Ability to remain calm, clear, and solutions-oriented in time-sensitive or high-pressure situations.

  • Comfort working with data, dashboards, reporting tools, and analytics workflows.

  • Experience coordinating with Security, IT, Legal, Finance, Sales, Paid Social, and external platform partners preferred.

  • Interest in workflow improvement, automation, AI-enabled processes, and scalable operational systems.

% Travel Required (Approximate): 5%

job.title: CRM Business Analyst I
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

The CRM Business Analyst I supports the effective operation and continuous improvement of Salesforce as a strategic tool for fundraising and donor engagement. This role conducts CRM-focused business analysis, gathers and documents business requirements, evaluates workflow and system improvement opportunities, and translates operational needs into scalable Salesforce solutions. The CRM Business Analyst contributes to enhancement, testing, reporting, and implementation support to strengthen fundraising effectiveness and donor engagement outcomes.

 

 

* This is an in-office position in Franklin, TN

 

Do our values align with yours?  Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on. 

 

 

  

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Perform CRM-focused business analysis activities by identifying workflow and system improvement opportunities and developing solution options within Salesforce.
  • Conduct discovery, synthesizes operational needs, evaluates system capabilities, data integrity considerations, and user experience factors, and translates those findings into structured process and system solutions.
  • Evaluate solution options, estimates potential operational impact, and contributes to implementation strategies to strengthen fundraising effectiveness and donor engagement outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot data and system issues, identifies root causes, and develops sustainable solutions in partnership with technical teams.
  • Partner with fundraisers, data analysts, and tech teams to design and implement enhancements that support fundraising and donor engagement
  • Build and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards that provide fundraisers with clear, actionable insights.
  • Support Gift Services processes by identifying system or workflow improvements that enhance accuracy and timely gift entry and donor support.
  • Provide User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new Salesforce features and related platforms enhancements to ensure alignment with defined business requirements and operational needs.
  • Provide training and onboarding support for new hires to ensure effective adoption of CRM processes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

We are looking for a very specific skill set and business acumen. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you!

  • Bachelor's Degree, or combination of education/training with relevant experience.
  • Minimum 1-3 years of experience in business analysis, including gathering requirements, supporting users, and improving system processes.
  • Skilled at gathering, analyzing, and organizing information from stakeholders to define clear requirements.
  • General understanding and curiosity of how systems and processes work.
  • Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce or similar), particularly in reporting and dashboard creation
  • Organized, detailed, and customer focused
  • A collaborative communicator who thrives in a team environment.
  • Proactive in identifying issues and opportunities for improvement, with a solutions-focused mindset.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/ministry relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

The Executive Assistant will provide a wide range of administrative and project support to relieve the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of administrative tasks to increase the time they can spend attending to executive-level responsibilities. This position often participates and manages multiple projects, ensuring strong communication and collaboration with the CFO, other Ministry Leadership, and Team Members.

 

This is an onsite role in Franklin, TN

 

 

Here's some of what you will be doing...

 

  • Serve as the primary administrative resource for the CFO to include, but not limited to: development of correspondence of time sensitive and both confidential and non-confidential matters; e-mail, telephone, voicemail and other electronic messaging communication; opening and sorting mail; purchasing supplies; managing receipts and filing completion of expense reports; photocopying, scanning and faxing; maintenance of filing and records management systems, both hard copy and electronic; and other general administrative functions as needed.
  • With minimal supervision and as directed, consistently and accurately plan, conduct, lead, and complete complex assignments requiring independent action and a high degree of initiative to resolve issues. Assignments may include develop and monitor budget activities, formulating long and short-range requirements; monitor project performance and timelines; coordinate administrative activities; act in a liaison capacity with other departments, divisions, outside counsel, and other organizations; evaluate progress or results and recommend major changes in procedures and process; and interpret policies and procedures.
  • Manage and maintain calendars, coordinate schedules, and handle a variety of meeting logistics, providing individualized support for phone messages; receiving and directing visitors; organizing, scheduling, and preparing for meetings and appointments, including conference calls, with increased ability to anticipate CFO needs; and independently updating department documents as needed.
  • Understand and continued development of specific goals and plans to prioritizing, organize, and accomplish work in coordination with CFO.
  • Provide outstanding customer service. Act as the main point of contact for all internal and external inquiries, appointments, and concerns.
  • Prepare CFO for meetings, bring urgent matters to the attention of the CFO, and handle emergencies and routine matters on behalf of the CFO.
  • Prepare materials for Board presentations and plan Board meetings and events.
  • Function as Board Members’ point of contact in the absence of the CFO.
  • Work within a wide scope of responsibility, requiring awareness of departmental areas of responsibility, which may include handling all inquiries within outlined capacity in order to relieve the CFO of administrative details and to maximize the time efficiency and availability of leadership. Independently research, review, retrieve, and analyze information (station files, legal files, accounting information, contract files) and create CFO summaries, reports, and spreadsheets pertinent to projects. Learn and master statistical software programs, creating appropriate reports and analysis.
  • Complete special projects/ad hoc reports and create engaging and informative presentations utilizing multimedia and technical tools.
  • Assist in the tracking of ministry and department budgets; make recommendations based on data collected toward budgetary requirements.
  • Coordinate appropriate travel and develop itineraries, including for conferences and complex group and meeting arrangements.
  • Exercise administrative judgment on a regular and continuous basis and assume responsibility for decisions, outcomes, and results have an impact on people, costs, and/or quality of service within the functional area. Perform to earn leadership’s confidence, assuring confidential and discreet handling of all business with reliability.
  • Act as an information source on organization policies and procedures.
  • Know the formal and informal ministry and departmental goals, standards, policies and procedures, and maintain familiarity with other departments within the ministry, preserving sensitivity to the inter-relationship of both people and functions with the ministry.
  • Maintain K-LOVE polices and procedures such as time keeping, expense reporting, IT systems and software products, HR policies and procedures, etc., training staff, and regularly answering questions and/or concerns.
  • Support compliance with ministry standards by maintaining the privacy and confidentiality of information, protecting organizational assets, acting with ethics and integrity, reporting noncompliance, and adhering to applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
  • Support and contribute to ministry endeavors through following employment policies and practices and supporting a safe and healthy work environment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Here's some experience and skills we are seeking...

 

  • Minimum 4-7 years’ executive level administrative experience.
  • Excellent/advanced knowledge of administrative and clerical procedures; principles and processes for providing a service-oriented environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including managing complex spreadsheets, pivot tables, and performing mail merges and specialized software as determined by the ministry.
  • Strong research skills, including the abilities to obtain research from multiple sources, conduct valid Internet research, investigate, and convey information to enable strategic decision-making, and to research and analyze a variety of complex issues and recommend solutions.
  • Demonstrated flexibility and adaptability in relation to others’ needs and priorities, using discernment to prioritize and integrate those needs with ongoing responsibilities.
  • Confidence with humility to bring creativity, initiative, and innovation to routine and non-routine situations; and ability to exercise judgment in the resolution of administrative problems.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects concurrently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Verbal comprehension, communication, and interpersonal skills in various situations. Must have strong skills in reading comprehension and written communication with the ability to produce a variety of documents based on intent and audience. Knowledge of the structure and content of the English language, including the meaning and spelling of words, rules of composition, and grammar.
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information on a regular basis. A proven ability to maintain confidences is essential to success in this position.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills in all work-related relationships, including self-monitoring, self-assessing, and being sensitive to develop constructive and cooperative working relationships with others and maintaining them over time. Demonstrate experience in negotiating conflict and difficult situations with tact, candor, and humility.
  • Possess a professional attitude, along with a willingness to support ministry and management needs.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

What can we offer you?

  • Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance and company paid Dental
  • Company paid life insurance and short term/long term disability insurance
  • Company 401k with a generous company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay

job.title: Field Engineer
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

Do you feel called to use your gifts to serve something bigger than yourself?  K-LOVE inspires people to move closer to Jesus. Every signal we send carries hope, truth, and transformation into homes, cars, and communities. Behind that mission is a team of engineers who see their work as more than technical - it's eternal. Join our team as a Field Engineer, where you'll be at the forefront of ensuring K-LOVE programming is broadcast seamlessly and at the highest quality. From diverse locations to dynamic work environments, you’ll play a crucial role in supporting broadcast facilities with top-notch technical and engineering expertise. Ready to make an impact in the world of broadcast? This is the role for you!

 

 

What will you do?

  • Evaluates the overall technical operation of facilities within area of responsibility and takes corrective action as necessary to ensure equipment is functioning to the highest level of quality.
  • Install, maintain, and repair broadcast equipment (such as audio processors, mixers, microwave and satellite equipment) used in preparing and transmitting K-LOVE’s programming to the highest possible level of quality.
  • Regularly operate equipment that regulates the signal strength, clarity, and sound of K-LOVE’s broadcasts.
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable FCC rules and regulations and ensure all equipment within area of responsibility is operating safely and legally.
  • Proactively analyze and fix technical faults on equipment and systems to the component level.
  • Partner and communicate with contract engineers to resolve technical problems. Evaluate work quality from contract engineers and assist in coordinating and reviewing contract engineer projects.
  • Proactively communicate and work with other staff to resolve technical problems.
  • From time to time, carry out work on non-broadcast equipment (such as electrical generators, air conditioning units, light fixtures, plumbing fixtures, etc.) as conditions dictate.
  • Make trips to sites, as required, performing installations or repairs; or company headquarters as needed for training or special projects. The length of these trips varies depending on the specific needs.
  • Maintain professional competency, knowledge and skills necessary to effectively perform job duties by taking personal responsibility for professional development and training.
  • If assigned, serve as Chief Operator/Engineer for one or more broadcast station(s).
  • Carry out other duties as assigned by supervisor.

 

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent college or technical studies in electronics, communications, or related field(s), or three more years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • SBE Certification highly desirable.
  • 3+ years’ experience troubleshooting and repairing failures in broadcast electronic equipment, or similar relevant experience.
  • Thorough understanding of the components necessary in a broadcast air-chain.
  • Proven ability to deal with multiple, simultaneous problems in a systematic, logical manner.
  • Ability to read and understand electronic schematics, electrical drawings, and construction drawings, making appropriate modifications when necessary.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to carry out calculations in common broadcast-related formulae such as transmitter efficiency, transmitter power output, wavelengths, and antenna system gain.
  • Intermediate understanding of satellite technology.
  • Thorough understanding of radio frequency emissions.
  • Ability to solder and desolder electronic components without causing damage to the components or PC board.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-related FCC rules and regulations.
  • Ability to apply common-sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in oral, written or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situation.  Ability to think logically from problem to solution.
  • Proficiency with standard broadcast test equipment, such as VOMs, Oscilloscopes, and Spectrum Analyzers.
  • Proficiency with MS Office products and other common software (internet browsers, etc.).

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

Why work for K-LOVE? 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ.     • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of FCC rules and regulations, ensuring all equipment and operations meet or exceed legal and safety requirements.

    • Perform essential maintenance on non-broadcast equipment (e.g., electrical generators, HVAC, minor electrical/plumbing) for holistic site functionality.
    • Undertake necessary trips to sites for installations or repairs, or K-LOVE Campus for training or specialized projects.

  • Thorough understanding of broadcast air-chain components and IP-based signal distribution.
  • Intermediate networking skills (TCP/IP, routing, switching) and ability to diagnose common network issues.
  • Intermediate understanding of modern microwave and Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite technologies.
  • Thorough understanding of radio frequency (RF) emissions.
  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting electronic schematics, electrical drawings, and construction blueprints.
  • Ability to perform precise calculations for common broadcast-related formulae.
  • Expertise in soldering and desoldering electronic components.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of applicable broadcast-related FCC rules and regulations.
  • Proficiency with standard broadcast test equipment (VOMs, Oscilloscopes, Spectrum Analyzers).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and other common software.
  • Proven ability to systematically and logically address multiple, complex technical problems.
  • Ability to apply common-sense understanding to carry out instructions and think logically from problem to solution.
  • Communicates effectively with grace, respect, and humility; listens well and receives feedback openly.
  • Demonstrates lifelong learning, proactively taking personal responsibility for advanced professional development.
