job.title: Bureau Producer I
job.description:
This position works closely with reporters and talent in the field to produce accurate and compelling video content for ESPN’s linear and digital platforms. Uses technical expertise and creativity to deliver expanded shoots, split shows, or full shows without traditional crew support. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Works with reporters and talent in the field to produce accurate and compelling video content that meets or exceeds ESPN’s editorial standards. 

  • Communicates clearly and effectively with camera crews and other support positions to ensure that everyone in the field is working toward the same goal. 

  • Proactively pitches ideas, news angles, writes and edits scripts, formulates questions for anchors in collaboration with show coordinating producers and segment producers. 

  • Partners with our assignment desk and digital/social teams to deliver content to all platforms across ESPN’s networks and digital properties.

  • Embraces new technology in order to enhance storytelling or improve efficiency. 

  • Displays strong news judgement and sports knowledge and understands how to frame a story so that it engages the largest possible audience. 

  • Builds strong relationships with leaders across ESPN’s platforms to understand unique show and platform needs. 

  • Displays the ability to ably navigate the changing dynamic of show production, including overseeing split shows and/or serving as the point person on a multi-camera shoot. 

  • Presents coverage ideas and plans in a timely fashion to be available for show planning meetings 

  • Participates in relevant planning meetings and conference calls to create coverage plans. 

  • Coordinates with assigned reporters in researching, preparing, and reporting on news and feature elements.  

  • Creates or participates in producing on-air news and features, including communicating with reporters, assignment editors, and news editors on both content and logistic details.

  • When working with a hired crew, coordinates the scheduling of field production crews assigned to producing specific features and stories.

  • Reviews and approves all scripts that are submitted from the field.

  • Interacts with news sources, athletes, leagues and conference representatives and other news makers to gather information and insight for news stories.

  • Participates in resolving issues with technical staff and related production issues.

  • Provides feedback to management and coaching to support the growth and development of fellow producers and reporters.

Basic Qualifications: 

  • A minimum of 7 years of progressively complex related studio or related production experience 

  • Has strong production skills related to sporting events 

  • Has exceptional news judgement 

  • Fluent in social media and popular culture

  • Has an established knowledge of sports and sports history 

  • Detailed technical knowledge required, must have knowledge of what “works” on television and what is realistic to accomplish in time allotted for show production 

  • Strong organizational and communication skills 

  • Specific knowledge of television production techniques used in a digital control room 

  • Had working mastery of real-time sports news productions processes 

  • Commitment to learning new technologies and sharing that information to help the group benefit with new coverage plans

Required Education:

  • High School diploma or equivalent 

Preferred Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree 

#ESPNMedia


The hiring range for this remote position is $107,300 to $174,300 per year, which factors in various geographic regions. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

job.title: Content Producer
job.description:
Responsible for creative development, preparation, and production of a wide range of sports content related to the NBA and WNBA, as well as the NFL and other sports, including segments, highlights, teases & bumps, and other content from start to finish for air to reach viewers and increase ESPN’s market penetration, rating and viewership across multiple platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • In coordination with the assigned senior production staff (e.g. Producer, Coordinating Producers), identifies and develops basketball content that interprets, enhances and reinforces the concepts of sports content to tell stories.

  • Oversees production of content from start to finish, including:

    • Leads a team of production staff (e.g. APs, CAs, PAs) to conceive of, plan and execute the production of highlights, teases, bumps, segments, etc. 

    • Uses mastery of basketball knowledge, creativity and news judgment to research, generate, select & pitch concepts and content ideas

    • Evaluates & influences the style and story lines of content. Guides staff in topic selection, highlight development, writing, sound & shot selection.

    • Coordinates with the production staff to write accurate and informative content (e.g. teases & bumps, shot sheets, scripts)

    • Oversees & influences editing associated with the content to ensure desired story line and pacing

    • Arranges and schedules content components (e.g. talent, graphics, animations, and edit time) and works with the talent, operators and producers of each component, communicating expectations, vision and plans of how each element will be executed in the show.

    • Collaborates directly with on-air talent under the guidance and supervision of the CP and producer - including analysts, reporters, insiders, and guests - ensuring their insights and commentary align with the editorial vision of show segment(s).

    • Coordinates with technical staff to maximize the technical process & tools with which content is created and delivered to fans across multiple platforms to best tell a story

    • Adjusts content to accommodate breaking news situations and changing storylines

    • Provides final review of content to ensure quality and accuracy

    • Familiarity with control room environment and able to communicate it a clear, concise and respectful manner to handle live TV pressure and ensure the best quality product it put on air 

    • Contribute to and often lead pre-production meetings that foster an inclusive environment where all staff is encouraged to pitch, workshop and develop content ideas.

    • Forward thinking approach to help evolve the way our NBA/WNBA/NFL studio shows tell stories, present content and engage the viewer in an entertaining and informative way.

  • Leadership responsibilities:

    • Effectively maintains leadership in a group environment;  maintains professional relationships within the production staff to ensure professionalism, teamwork and objective reporting

    • Oversees direct reports, solicits & delivers feedback in a timely manner

    • Trains, coaches, develops and mentors production staff on idea generation, communication, edit room performance, and overall quality & accuracy of content production

  • Includes a diverse set of viewpoints and experiences through the planning and execution of content.

  • May occasionally produce entire programs with guidance from the responsible leader (e.g. Producer, Coordinating Producer, etc.).

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 5-years of progressively complex production experience with an emphasis on sports content.

  • Solid ability to interpret basketball stories and to create and assemble compelling content to support the concept of the story.

  • Strong knowledge of the NBA, WNBA and working knowledge of the NFL, as well as other sports.

  • Strong knowledge of real-time sports production processes and working knowledge of equipment and all relevant technologies used to carry out a broad range of assignments.

  • Must have detailed knowledge of what “works” across multiple platforms and what is realistic to accomplish in time allotted.

  • Good editorial judgement

  • Good understanding of people supervision, the development of teams and leadership skills

  • Strong organizational, time management, and communication skills

  • Good content interpretation skills related to sporting events

  • Good appreciation of popular culture, and understands the tastes of ESPN’s consumers

  • Good understanding of ESPN’s market positioning and strategies

  • Has an established knowledge of sports and sports history

  • Strong working knowledge of production workflows

  • Availability to work nights/weekends/holidays as required

Required Education:

  • High School Diploma

Preferred Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree


The hiring range for this position in Inglewood, CA is $87,100 to $116,800 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

job.title: Disney College Program
job.description:
About our Program: Magic is Within You

Live. Learn. Earn.

Looking for ways to expand your resume?

The Disney College Program is an exciting, unique opportunity for college students and recent graduates to work at Walt Disney World Resort near Orlando, Florida. While on a program, participants will:
  • Receive valuable professional experience while working at our world-renowned theme parks and resorts.
  • Meet people from around the globe and create friendships and memories to last a lifetime.
  • Take part in uniquely Disney learning and development opportunities, exclusive program events and more.
Please note: you’re applying to the Disney College Program itself — not one specific job. Your individual role and location will be shared closer to your arrival date, so we ask every applicant to come in open to being placed in any role within the program.

Where You’ll Work

Every role in the program, whether front-line or backstage, plays a part in delivering the guest experience Disney is known for. Applicants should be open to either type of role.
  • Front-line roles: Guest-facing positions directly interacting with visitors in our theme parks, resorts and Disney Springs locations.
    • Examples: Attractions, Quick Service Food & Beverage, Custodial, Merchandise, etc.
  • Backstage roles: Supporting the guest experience behind the scenes.
    • Examples: Costuming Operations, Houseperson, etc.
Program Overview
  • Starting pay: $19/hour
  • Program length: four to eight months, with potential to extend up to 12 months (one year)
  • Arrival dates: January – February 2027
  • Departure dates: No sooner than May 2027
  • If selected, you will be able to choose your dates (date options are subject to availability and chosen on a first come, first serve basis. More information can be found here: Spring Program Dates )
Living on your Program: Flamingo Crossings Village
  • Program participants can live at Flamingo Crossings Village, the fully furnished apartment community owned and operated by American Campus Communities, just minutes from Walt Disney World Resort.
  • The community includes double-occupancy, shared apartments with amenities like resort-style pools and a 12,500 sq. ft. fitness center. Various special events and activities are also hosted every month exclusively for residents on the program.
  • Bus transportation provided by Disney Programs connects you to Disney parks and resorts as well as local grocery stores and shopping.
Learn and Grow Professionally with Disney
  • Discover career paths and build your network – there are endless possibilities with Disney to explore after you complete your program!
  • Attend Disney Programs learning sessions where you can gain new skills, meet industry professionals and Disney leaders and more.
  • Actively enrolled in school? You could earn academic credit through the American Council on Education. Check with your advisor and see the Accreditation site for the specifics.
Benefits and Perks
  • Weekly pay
  • Complimentary theme park admission
  • Cast-exclusive discounts
  • Housing and work transportation are offered
  • Exclusive events, trips and activities


Basic Qualifications :

Eligibility Requirements

  • You're at least 18 years old when you submit your application.
  • You're currently enrolled at an accredited college or university in the United States or the United States territories and actively working toward an Associate's, Bachelor's, or Graduate degree*.
  • You graduated from an accredited college or university in the United States or the United States territories* within the last 12 months of this job posting. (Graduation after August 17, 2025).
  • Before your program start date, you must have completed at least one term at your college or university (or a minimum of 6 credit hours) towards your degree. Credits must have been earned after graduating high school or earning your GED.
  • You're in good academic standing at your school. Some schools require a minimum GPA or advisor approval before you can participate in an off-campus program. Check with your academic advisor before applying. Disney's approval doesn't override a hold your school places on your participation.
  • You have valid work authorization in the United States for the full duration of your program. U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, green card holders, and F-1 students with valid OPT or CPT authorization are all welcome. If you have a different type of employment authorization that will be valid (unexpired) for the duration of the program dates you select, reach out to your DSO (Designated School Official) to confirm eligibility before applying. Disney does not sponsor visas for this program.

job.description:
About the Role & Program 

Through innovative storytelling and a culture of collaboration, Disney Live Entertainment creates, produces, and delivers remarkable and engaging entertainment experiences. From the intimate to the spectacular, our work can be seen at Disney theme parks, resort hotels, cruise ships, and other locations the world over! Our diverse team – representing a wide variety of disciplines and talents from technical directors, writers, and lighting designers to choreographers, cosmetologists, and music producers – brings magical worlds to life through technical expertise, performance excellence, incomparable ingenuity, unparalleled spectacle… and a dash of pixie dust! 

The approximate date of this internship is January 2027 to June 2027, located in Anaheim, CA.

What You Will Do 

The Lighting Design Team is responsible for the development of inspired designs that help to tell the stories of our live show offerings including parades, stage shows and special events on and off the Disney property. We are looking for an experienced individual with an innovative mindset and a passion for Disney quality and creativity. We are seeking a motivated individual who will ensure that the Disney standards are reflected consistently in all design & technical materials. 

  • Supporting the Lighting Designers in the technical and creative production process, including producing documentation, design intent, and light plots 
  • Providing technical drawing support via Vectorworks & ConnectCAD
  • Assisting with design and technical research 
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams including other designers, safety teams, production teams and facility teams 
  • Attending and contributing to Disney Live Entertainment department and project production meetings 

Required Qualifications & Skills 

  • Excellent oral/written communication and interpersonal skills 
  • Creative problem-solving skills 
  • Ability to work independently and self-manage time and responsibilities
  • Knowledge of lighting technology and supporting equipment 
  • Familiarity with the Entertainment industry and a creative background 
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Vectorworks; ability to learn new software applications as appropriate 

Education 

Junior, senior or graduate student pursuing a degree or in Theater (technical) or related field 

Preferred Education  

Earning or completing MFA in Theater (technical design-related field) 

Eligibility Requirements & Program Information

Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all the requirements below:

  • Be enrolled in an accredited college/university, taking at least one class at the time of application posting, OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship.
  • Be at least 18 years of age
  • Possess unrestricted work authorization
  • Possess a valid US driver’s license and have the ability to operate a company vehicle

  • Able to have a consistent, reliable work schedule throughout the internship

Additional Information

job.title: HR Business Partner
job.description:
Disney Entertainment & ESPN Product and Technology is looking for a HR Business Partner to join our dynamic HR Team! DEEP&T is a global tech organization that provides the technological backbone and product development for Disney’s premium streaming services, including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, and other industry leading products that showcase Disney’s unmatched content and characters across our brands and franchises.

The HR Business Partner contributes to defining and implementing a Human Resource strategy which aligns and integrates the client strategy and objectives. This role serves as a strategic partner to leadership within Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology client teams by developing and delivering integrated and inclusive HR Services such as: Strategy Development, Organization Design, Talent Management, Organizational Effectiveness, Change & Transition Management and Functional HR Integration. This role reports to the Director, People & Culture Business Partner.

Responsibilities

  • Serves as the point of contact with the business client groups to implement effective Human Resources solutions to business issues, strategies and initiatives

  • Understands the business and plays a significant role in driving the people initiatives aligned to the business strategy

  • Collaborates with HR Partners, leveraging their expertise to execute human resources strategies and enable business objectives and drive business growth

  • Analyzes trends and metrics, collaborates with HR functional experts to develop solutions, make recommendations and develop programs to optimally support the people needs of client groups

  • Maintains an effective level of business literacy to provide a consultative approach to deliver HR services. Leverage HR / business skills and knowledge to challenge or influence leadership in decision-making processes

  • Identifies issues that require escalation

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Human Resources

  • Proven experience in managing multiple projects with strong prioritization skills

  • Demonstrated strong integration and strategic planning skills

  • Experience analyzing data, deriving key insights, and using data to tell stories

  • Strong Excel skills, including experience using formulas, pivot tables and graphs to organize, assess and present data

  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to dig into the details to identify and solve problems

  • Resourceful; finds ways to help clients navigate complex situations, where answers are not clear cut; learns from client inquiries to determine where additional training or communications may be necessary

  • Demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills including experience creating presentations

  • Proven knowledge of HR industry practices

  • Demonstrated strong facilitation and presentation skills

  • Demonstrated ability to influence and partner within a diverse organization to help drive business results

job.title: Media Systems Engineer II
job.description:
This role is a permanent afternoon/evening shift and weekends are required.  Friday (2PM-11PM), Saturday-Sunday (12PM-9PM), Monday-Tuesday (2PM-11PM). Wednesday and Thursdays off.

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. 

 Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

  • Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come
  • Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally
  • Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams.

Job Summary:

Disney Media Systems Engineers have a clear charter: to transform the capability and flexibility of how Disney acquires, produces, and distributes content worldwide, all while ensuring the highest levels of quality, efficiency, and resiliency.

Disney Media Systems Engineers often find themselves at the crossroads between hardware, and software-based technology and must possess a comprehensive theoretical and practical understanding of the technology that powers the generation, monetization, and distribution of all forms of consumer- facing linear and digital video/audio content. Responsibility includes numerous systems such as Playout Technology, Studios, Production Control Rooms, Remote Production, Post-Production, Contribution/Distribution Systems, Networking, Cloud Compute, Production Software and Virtual Environment and more.

The Media Systems Engineer II position is the perfect role for an engineer who has some hands-on sustainment and design/build experience with the creation, production, and distribution of linear or digital video/audio content. Media Systems Engineer II’s are primarily focused on the sustainability of our existing technology. They are the start of a tiered sustainment model where incidents are escalated from a shared operations team (tier 1) to the Media Systems Engineer II’s (tier 2) and beyond. Additionally, while Media Systems Engineer II’s are learning the nuances of Disney’s technology and learning to apply their own education and engineering experience, they may be asked to work on some system integration projects; documentation and preventative engineering.
 

Media Systems Engineer II’s use their experience to solve increasingly complicated issues without much support for more senior engineers and can easily perform integration tasks with little direction.

Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:

  • Architect, design, source, and construct media technology environments that allow DEET Technology the ability to acquire, produce, store, stream, distribute our content.
  • Resolve issues that affect production, broadcast, and content distribution across multiple DEET networks including system outages, malfunctions, and related technical problems, and conduct diagnostic testing, repair, and replacement activities necessary to solve routine, specialized, and complex problems.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot streaming audio/video signals in traditional SDI and IP 2110 essence flow routing environments.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot cloud platforms as necessary.
  • Manage third-party service providers by enforcing the agreed upon scope of services within the various signed service agreements (i.e., full time, freelance, union agencies, maintenance providers, contractors, service providers, etc.).
  • Select, train, motivate and evaluate technical staff; provide or coordinate staff training; work with employees to correct deficiencies; implement discipline procedures.
  • Specify and procure equipment, supplies and materials for Media technology systems within budget guidelines; receive and maintain equipment and supplies.
  • Develop long range plans for future media technology needs, including capital improvements, to enhance production and distribution capabilities.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of policies and procedures regarding technology facilities with a focus on maximizing the integration of all systems to meet business, marketing, and entertainment goals.
  • Provide operational support of all activities related to operating, maintaining, and programming the audio and video production/distribution systems across the enterprise and other connected properties.
  • Utilize system software health and performance monitoring platforms; troubleshoot and participate in repairing system problems and failures, participates in maintenance of systems, installs software patches, updates etc., to resolve and avoid service problems, and troubleshoots system problems as they relate to these services
  • Performs upgrades to system hardware and software workflows under the supervision of a more experienced engineer or supervisor.
  • Participates in complex engineering projects at the direction of more experienced engineers.
  • Reviews, maintains, and contributes to system/workflow documentation.
  • Participates in training and development objectives. Conducts peer training and development sessions.
  • Extraordinary influencer who is skilled at connecting the dots at the organization, strategy, program, project, and event levels. Able to persuade and change the thinking of others without damaging relationships.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, growth environment with minimal direction, delivering under tight deadlines while multitasking, prioritizing projects, and communicating priority updates to team members.
  • Able to operate with limited resources, exhibit dispassionate critical-thinking, and creatively solve problems. Motivated and inventive, always finds a way forward—eternal optimist with a committed drive for contributing and making a difference.
  • Any other duties needed to help achieve Business Objectives.

Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3-4 years years of demonstrated and relevant experience in leading others ensuring efficient design/build, uptime, and overall stability of the technical environments of live media production and distribution.
  • Proficient in SMPTE standards for broadcast television and video production/streaming environments. With a current certification such as not limited to ST 292M, ST 424M, ST 2110, ST 2059, IEE1588, ST 2022-7, SCTE-104, etc.
  • Knowledge and experience with on-prem and cloud-based storage and compute infrastructure platforms and current technological offerings. At least one foundational cloud certification required, including but not limited to Microsoft Certified: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, CompTIA Cloud+, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.
  • Knowledge and experience with compression techniques such as MPEG2/4, HEVC, JPEG 2000, and JPEG XS.
  • Knowledge and experience with Evertz software control systems such as frame control via VistaLink or Magnum, EQX/EXE routers, and their monitoring software VLPRO, SDVN, VIP, VUE, MVP.
  • Knowledge and experience with major media systems and the vendors that supply them in areas such as asset management systems, file-based workflows, media acquisition, transcoding/encoding, graphics, and NAS/SAN technologies.
  • Knowledge and experience with coordinated receiver decoders IRDs, core devices, edge devices, timing of video and audio systems, audio, and video media file formats are a plus.
  • Ability to create, read and interpret AutoCAD and other technical drawing/documentation tools.
  • Proven troubleshooting and sustaining in one or more of the following:
    • IP-based broadcast equipment including routers, switchers, audio boards, signal processers, encoder/decoder, video scalers, playback systems, etc.
    • Studio technology includes video walls, cameras, VR set technology, image processing systems, touch screens, lighting, etc.
    • File-based workflows like enterprise Media Asset Management systems (Cloud-based Cloud Compute or Local Network-based) including storage, compute, encode and distribution.
    • Production control systems such as Imagine Communications or Grass Valley automation systems, Avid, Adobe, Viz, Dalet, Riedel trunking, Lawo, Calrec, Evertz, Ross and others.
    • Transmission systems such as RF (Radio Frequency), Satellite Distribution, Fiber Distribution, etc.
    • Proven track record for troubleshooting and sustainment knowledge of AWS Infrastructures and other cloud-based technologies including S3/Glacier storage and cloud compute (EC2) services.
  • Physical requirements and work environment: Ability to climb ladders, work on raised structures and building roofs, operate areal lift platforms and have valid driver’s license.

Required Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in electrical engineering, computer science or equivalent major, and/or equivalent work experience.

job.title: Project Design Manager Senior (PH/IA)
job.description:
Project Design Manager Senior

Island & Destination Planning | Port Strategy, Development & Operations Integration

Role Summary

The Senior Project Design Manager leads the planning, integration, and delivery of design and engineering across a portfolio of complex capital projects supporting Disney Cruise Line’s island and destination assets.

Serving as the Owner’s Representative for design and engineering, this role is accountable for ensuring that architectural, engineering, creative, and operational requirements are fully integrated from concept through construction and turnover. The position blends technical expertise, design leadership, and cross-functional influence to deliver innovative, high-quality environments that enhance the guest and crew experience while maintaining operational continuity.

This is a temporary assignment with no guarantee of permanent placement.

Key Responsibilities

Design Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end design and engineering delivery across multiple concurrent projects, from concept through construction and close-out
  • Ensure design excellence, constructability, and alignment with project scope, schedule, and quality expectations
  • Drive incorporation of innovative, sustainable, and experience-driven design solutions
  • Prepare feasibility studies and/or code assessments of existing/future facilities

Multi-Disciplinary Integration

  • Lead integration of architectural, engineering, creative, show, ride, and operational disciplines to deliver cohesive and fully coordinated solutions
  • Partner closely with internal technical partners and Creative, Show/Ride, Operations, Engineering, and external consultants to align design intent with functional requirements
  • Ensure all design packages meet RFP requirements, project scope, and enterprise standards

Owner’s Representative & Consultant Management

  • Serve as the Owner’s Representative for design and engineering, overseeing consultants, deliverables, and contract compliance
  • Direct the activities of in-house teams and external design partners in the development of construction documents
  • Develop scopes of work, lead RFP processes, and support consultant selection
  • Provide input into bid packaging and contracting strategies

Planning, Financial & Design Controls

  • Own design schedules, labor plans, and associated budgets, ensuring alignment with overall project delivery milestones

  • Monitor design progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies to maintain schedule and cost targets
  • Partner with functional leadership on staffing, resource planning, and cost management

Stakeholder Engagement & Executive Communication

  • Translate complex design concepts, risks, and trade-offs into clear, actionable insights for executive leadership
  • Provide regular updates on design status, key decisions, risks, and impacts to project and operations
  • Facilitate alignment and decision-making across cross-functional stakeholders

Operational & Regulatory Integration

  • Ensure design solutions are fully integrated with operational requirements, minimizing disruption to ongoing operations and enhancing guest and crew experience
  • Serve as the primary liaison with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) and regulatory agencies across the project portfolio
  • Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and enterprise requirements
  • Ensure adherence to and possess working knowledge of Disney standards.

Technical Design Management

  • Provide day-to-day technical leadership across multiple venues or project scopes
  • Ensure quality, consistency, and coordination of design documentation across all disciplines
  • Maintain and validate facility base information and existing condition documentation

Leadership Capabilities

  • Strategic & Systems Thinking – Integrates design, operational, and business requirements into cohesive solutions
  • Decision Quality & Ownership – Drives timely, informed decisions in complex and ambiguous environments
  • Collaboration & Influence – Builds alignment across diverse internal and external stakeholders
  • Executive Communication – Delivers clear, concise messaging tailored to senior leadership audiences
  • Adaptability & Resilience – Thrives in dynamic, high-pressure project environments
  • Talent & Capability Development – Elevates team performance and builds organizational capability

Required Qualifications

  • 10–15 years of experience in architecture, engineering, or design management within complex project environments
  • Demonstrated success leading multi-disciplinary design teams across full project lifecycle delivery
  • Broad knowledge of commercial construction practices, codes, engineering systems, and integrated design processes
  • Experience acting in a client-facing or owner’s representative role
  • Proficiency with design and project tools (e.g., Revit, AutoCAD, BIM platforms)
  • Exceptional presentation and communication skills, including the ability to influence executive decision-making
  • U.S. Professional licensure (Architect or Engineer)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in themed entertainment, hospitality, or complex destination development environments
  • Strong understanding of storytelling through environment and guest experience design
  • Familiarity with facility operations and lifecycle considerations
  • Membership in professional organizations (AIA, ULI, CSI, USGBC, etc.)
  • Experience with visualization and digital design tools (e.g., Rhino, Maya, Adobe Creative Suite)

    Education

    • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, or related technical field required
    • Advanced degree (Master’s or MBA) preferred

job.title: Security Guest Service Manager, $72,000 - $96,500
job.description:
Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa, is more than an enchanting, family-friendly destination. We’ve combined the spirit of O`ahu with the magic of Disney to create a place where guests and cast members alike can feel the magic, can feel the spirit of the island and can truly feel welcome. Here, you’ll bring the spirit of the islands to life in every part of your role. Are you ready to join this team and make an impact?

The Security Guest Service Manager is a frontline, salaried people leader responsible for overseeing security and life safety operations at Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa, within the Disney Experiences segment. In this management role, you lead and supervise a team of Security H/H, aligning daily operations with Disney’s high standards of guest service, safety, and brand protection while fostering a creative, customer-focused, culturally aware, and accountable environment.

In this role, you will provide strategic and tactical leadership for security and life safety operations, supervising daily activities, setting priorities, and coordinating with other leaders to ensure a safe, welcoming, and service-minded resort experience for Guests and Cast Members. As a salaried leader, you will have substantial responsibility for leading Security Hosts, managing performance and conduct, making independent decisions within your authority, handling sensitive matters, and representing the Security leadership team. This role matters because it protects people, assets, and Disney’s reputation while requiring a collaborative, adaptable, and detail-oriented manager who can mentor teams, solve problems, and inspire high performance.

This full-time, salaried position reports to the Manager, Security and will be working onsite at Aulani Resort on the island of Oahu, Hawaii.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day strategic and tactical leadership in all aspects of security and life safety operations, ensuring alignment with resort and Disney Experiences goals.
  • Conduct investigations and prepare detailed reports on injuries, crimes, policy violations, and other safety or security incidents involving Guests and Cast, including coordination with state and federal agencies as needed.
  • Protect sensitive Cast, Guest, investigative, employee-relations, and operational information. Apply confidentiality and need-to-know principles consistently, sharing information only with authorized individuals and appropriate partners.
  • Promote and enforce company policies related to safety regulations, asset protection, and loss prevention, ensuring consistent compliance across the operation.
  • Understand the business, its culture, and operational challenges to identify opportunities to reduce risk and implement efficient, effective safety measures.
  • Directly engage with leaders and Cast to provide clear direction, expectations, staffing plans, and resources needed to deliver on the mission to serve and protect while achieving the highest level of guest service.
  • Maintain a positive, collaborative, and productive workplace by identifying and resolving issues promptly, managing conflict, providing candid feedback, and addressing performance or conduct concerns appropriately, consistently, and with respect. Partner with Human Resources, Employee Relations, Security leadership, and other appropriate partners when necessary.
  • Independently assess routine and escalated situations, exercise sound judgment, and make timely decisions within the scope of authority. Accurately determine urgency, the appropriate response, and when escalation is required, while providing steady leadership and operational continuity in the Manager’s absence.
  • Lead in the development and reinforcement of a strong culture of safety, modeling Disney values and ensuring that safety is a foundational priority for the team.
  • Establish clear performance and conduct expectations, monitor results, provide timely coaching, and hold Cast Members and leaders accountable for commitments and organizational standards in an appropriate and consistent manner.
  • Plan and prioritize teamwork by listing organizational goals into well-defined outcomes, aligning schedules and resources to meet operational needs.
  • Collaborate across departments and with other leaders to coordinate security support for resort operations, events, and guest activities in a team-oriented manner.
  • Lead, develop, and coach Cast Members through ongoing feedback, recognition, and development planning, while recognizing individual strengths and working styles and supporting career aspirations.
  • Model professional leadership presence and sound emotional intelligence by maintaining appropriate professional boundaries, building trust, managing difficult conversations with composure and respect, and balancing care and compassion with accountability and organizational standards.
  • Create an environment where Disney values are experienced daily, encouraging creative problem solving, ensuring every voice is heard, and reinforcing a service-minded, guest-focused culture.

Required Qualifications:

  • State of Hawaii, Security Guard License: Must possess a current, valid and in-good standing Hawaii Security Guard card license visible on the Hawaii DCCA website
  • 5+ years professional experience in security and/or life safety management within hospitality, resort, or a closely related environment, including 1+ years in a people-leadership or management capacity.
  • Proven track record as a hard-working, meticulous, and dedicated leader with strong judgment and effective decision-making skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound leadership judgment, organizational discretion, and emotional intelligence when handling sensitive employee relations, performance, investigative, and operational matters. Understands and consistently applies appropriate confidentiality and need-to-know principles when communicating sensitive information.
  • Exceptional people-management skills with experience creating and sustaining a healthy, diverse, trusting, and team-oriented work culture.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence, mentor, and provide clear direction to frontline teams.
  • Ability to maintain the utmost confidentiality of sensitive information and handle investigations with discretion and professionalism.
  • Proficiency with computers, including Microsoft Office, Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Availability to work all shifts including overnight, weekends and holidays as needed.
  • Knowledge of Hawaii State Statutes, hospitality law, and experience interacting with law enforcement agencies.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience directing the operations, services, and activities of a comprehensive security program and team in a resort or hospitality environment.
  • Knowledge of and experience with integrated access control technologies, crisis management, emergency preparedness, response, and business continuity practices.
  • Working knowledge of investigative and intelligence services, including private and government organizations, with an active network of contacts and partnerships.
  • Highly effective oral communicator with a positive leadership voice, strong analytical skills, and comfort using metrics to manage the business.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Aulani Resort policies, procedures, property, and resources.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent job experience in a related discipline.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Disney offers a rewards package to help you live your best life. This includes health and savings benefits, educational opportunities and special extras that only Disney can provide. Learn more at https://jobs.disneycareers.com/aulani-benefits

job.title: Senior Manager, Data Product Management
job.description:
Job Summary:

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands, including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club. Lucasfilm Animation Ltd., the creators of the Emmy award-winning animation series “Star Wars: The Clone Wars” and the highly successful animation series “Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord” “Star Wars Rebels,” “Star Wars Resistance,” “Star Wars: The Bad Batch,” “Tales of the Jedi” and “Tales of the Empire” are looking for a Floater Storyboard Artist  who reflects the innovative spirit, creative talent, production excellence, collaborative mindset and passion for great filmmaking that defines Lucasfilm Ltd..

The Floater Storyboard Artist works closely with a variety of writers, story artists, and directors to convey the narrative through visual storytelling techniques in a 3D computer graphics environment. They work directly from screenplays and revision notes to setup the stage and cameras in a 3D environment. It is their job to explore the possibilities of each scene, capture them as shots with 3D camera setups, and edit their work together as movies for submission to the show's story reel. The Floater will at times work as a Story Revisionist, as needs arise, often working on multiple episodes. The ability to solve story problems in a fast-paced environment is mandatory.

This position requires someone to be located in the San Francisco Bay Area.  This position is considered Hybrid, which means the employee will work onsite in our San Francisco office and occasionally from home. 

What you’ll do

  • The 3D Story Artist handles composition, screen direction, camera angles, staging, posing, pace, and timing (all the while ensuring that it maintains and fulfills the storypoint.) 

  • Work is done when final 3D camera setups are delivered to downstream production departments.

  • Innovative Project Contributions: Participate in special projects and initiatives, leveraging unique skills in photography, camera, and visual arts to push the boundaries of storytelling in CG animation.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in feature film or television production, or equivalent experience.

  • Bachelor's degree in Film, Animation, or Fine Arts Recommended.

  • Reel containing examples of work in live-action or animated film that exhibits a strong emphasis on visual storytelling, including staging, composition, and editing.

job.title: Part-Time Promotions Assistant – Fort Wayne Radio
job.description:
Federated Media | Fort Wayne, Indiana
Part-Time | $20.00 per hour

Want to get your foot in the door in radio, promotions, events, and media?

Federated Media is looking for dependable, energetic people to join our Fort Wayne team as Part-Time Promotions Assistants. You’ll help bring some of Fort Wayne’s biggest radio stations into the community at concerts, client events, festivals, sporting events, live broadcasts, and other station promotions.

Our Fort Wayne stations include 97.3 WMEE, 98.9 The Bear, K105, WOWO 1190 AM/92.3 FM, and 1380 The Fan.

What You’ll Do

As a Promotions Assistant, you’ll work alongside our promotions team and on-air personalities to make sure station events and remote broadcasts are set up properly, run smoothly, and represent our stations professionally.

Responsibilities include:

  • Driving station vehicles to and from remote broadcasts, appearances, and events
  • Loading and unloading station vehicles with equipment and promotional materials
  • Setting up and tearing down station equipment at remote broadcasts and events
  • Setting up microphones, speakers, PA systems, banners, tables, promotional materials, and other equipment
  • Testing equipment and connections before broadcasts begin
  • Assisting on-air personalities during live broadcasts and appearances
  • Helping with event execution, listener interaction, contests, and promotional activities
  • Positioning station vehicles, banners, and displays for maximum visibility
  • Troubleshooting basic equipment or setup issues
  • Inventorying and organizing equipment before and after events
  • Keeping station vehicles and equipment clean, fueled, and ready for the next event
  • Representing Federated Media and our radio stations professionally with listeners, clients, and community partners

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is:

  • Dependable and punctual — being early and ready is an important part of this job
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of an assignment
  • Friendly and professional when interacting with listeners, clients, and station staff
  • Willing to learn basic audio and broadcast equipment
  • Able to solve problems and communicate quickly when something isn’t working
  • Organized and responsible with company vehicles and equipment
  • Comfortable working outdoors and in a variety of event environments
  • Able to lift, carry, load, and set up typical event and audio equipment
  • Available for a flexible schedule that may include evenings, weekends, concerts, sporting events, and holidays
  • Able to legally operate company vehicles and meet Federated Media’s requirements for authorized drivers

Previous radio or broadcast experience is not required. We’ll train the right person. Experience with events, audio equipment, live production, promotions, hospitality, or customer service is a plus.

Why This Job?

This is a great opportunity for someone interested in radio, broadcasting, marketing, promotions, live events, sports, music, or media to gain hands-on experience while working with some of Fort Wayne’s best-known radio brands.

You’ll see firsthand how radio stations execute live broadcasts, concerts, promotions, community events, and client appearances — and you’ll work directly with our programming, promotions, and on-air teams.

Pay: $20.00 per hour

Location: Fort Wayne, Indiana

Schedule: Part-time and flexible, with evening and weekend availability required.

Federated Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

FOX Weather is a 24/7 ad-supported streaming service operated by FOX News Media. Launched in October 2021, the platform builds upon FOX News Channel’s expansive newsgathering units & FOX Television Stations’ added resources with a combined 120 meteorologists for a comprehensive suite of weather products featuring local, regional and national reporting, in addition to live programming. Utilizing multiple radar systems, including an immersive mobile 3D radar, and more than 100,000 HD cameras located around the country, the service offers users an innovative approach to forecasting, including coverage surrounding all weather patterns, from immediate to long-term. FOX Weather is available via foxweather.com, the FOX Weather app on IOS and Android devices, as well as Tubi, Apple TV, Amazon, and Roku, through FOX’s Connected TV Apps.

job.title: Assistant, Content Sales - EMEA
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Entertainment Global is FOX Entertainment’s centralized content sales division, providing the worldwide multi-platform marketplace with exclusive access to its diverse, rapidly expanding production pipeline and library of owned original programming and co-production partnerships.  A central component of FOX Entertainment’s long-term growth strategy is to fortify its globally recognized, world-class brand and owned distribution platforms spanning broadcast and streaming with FOX Entertainment Global’s singular focus on broadly distributing the company’s full portfolio of owned intellectual property across all genres of scripted, unscripted, and animated programming, including both film and television titles.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

  • Source, budget, and offer multiple solutions for new and existing events
  • Manage technical execution of production requirements from conception to execution, collaborating with internal teams and external partners as required.  
  • Develop and manage budgets, ensuring successful project delivery within budget and on schedule
  • Plan, schedule, and manage resources for concurrent projects, teams, and deadlines
  • Secure necessary equipment and services through vendor coordination
  • Troubleshoot on-site technical challenges, implementing solutions for smooth operations
  • Develop innovative strategies to hit and exceed event goals
  • Collaborate seamlessly with all stakeholders (events team, vendors, etc.) to deliver exceptional events
  • Foster efficient information flow through clear and concise communication across all teams and partners
  • Research and integrate cutting-edge technologies to keep FOX event production at the forefront of the industry

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 8+ years of hands-on and supervisory experience in corporate events or broadcast
  • Leadership, prioritization, and delegation in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment (grace under pressure!)
  • Stellar verbal and written communication with C-Suite & diverse stakeholders
  • Effective vendor negotiation skills
  • In-depth knowledge of live production systems (video, audio, lighting)
  • Meticulous eye for flawless technical execution
  • US travel with occasional global trips
  • Ability to work long hours (evenings/weekends), lift 50lbs, and work on feet for extended periods

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Union labor management knowledge

Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As our advertising business continues to scale at Red Seat Ventures, we are seeking an Ad Sales Finance Senior Manager to build and optimize the ad sales finance strategies that drive revenue growth and sales performance across the organization.

 

The  Ad Sales Finance Senior Manager serves as the critical bridge between company financial objectives and sales force execution by partnering across Sales Leadership, Finance, Revenue Operations, HR, and Executive Leadership. 

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in ad sales finance, revenue operations, sales compensation, and media sales analytics. They possess exceptional attention to detail, strong financial acumen, and the ability to translate complex business goals into effective compensation strategies.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Budgeting/Forecasting

  •  Prepare Forecast models for advertising sales channels - Update with actuals, revise forecasts for monthly/quarterly forecasts, annual budget
  •  Work closely with sales groups to gather forecasting inputs/assumptions.  Network Research (viewership), Ad Sales Research, (ad capacity), Sales, Yield/Ad Ops.
  • Prepare metrics reporting and variance analysis/commentary for executive reporting packages.
  • Provide variance analysis and metrics for network finance teams

Monthly Close

  • Accrual and billings – align with Ad Ops to own monthly accrual and billings process. Will extract data from traffic system and other sources for use in booking revenue accruals by digital property for monthly close.
  •  G/L reconciliation – monthly reconciliation of ad revenue general ledger accounts by project, including monthly accrual, prior period true-ups and any other adjusting entries.
  • Prepare monthly metrics reporting and detailed variance analysis.  Identify variance drivers for consideration in the next forecast.  Monitor key metrics (pricing, sellout, yield) and investigate as necessary.

Compensation Management

  • Manage compensation processes through manual and automated incentive compensation platforms, including proprietary and possible Salesforce integrations.
  • Align individual seller goals with Red Seat Ventures revenue targets, budgets, and growth initiatives.
  • Assist leadership in forecasting attainment, commission expense, and incentive program ROI.
  • Evaluate whether incentive structures are successfully driving strategic sales behaviors, including growth across priority podcasts, content verticals, sponsorship offerings, and emerging revenue streams.
  • Develop reporting and dashboards on CRM tools that provide visibility into attainment, compensation expense, productivity, and revenue performance.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations to leadership based on compensation and sales performance trends.
  • Partner closely with Ad Sales Finance and FP&A teams to forecast commission expense and variable compensation costs.
  • Support annual budgeting, quarterly reforecasting, and long-range planning processes.
  • Model the financial impact of proposed compensation changes, organizational shifts, and new revenue initiatives.
  • Ensure compensation programs remain financially sustainable while maintaining market competitiveness.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

job.title: Senior Producer, LiveNOW from FOX
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We're hiring a Senior Producer to join the team behind LiveNOW from FOX, FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news channel. LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate content creators seamlessly moving between the biggest live events and stories as they happen to keep our viewers informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live, and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion. 

As a Senior Producer, you will serve as an editorial leader for our team and take an active role in boosting the quality of our product while championing the LiveNOW mission. If you describe yourself as a tech-savvy multitasker obsessed with news and producing it differently, this is your opportunity to create compelling content in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

With your guidance, you will help take LiveNOW’s content to the next level!

This position is based in LiveNOW’s West Coast newsroom located in Phoenix, Arizona.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  •  Take a hands-on role in producing relevant, timely, live coverage of breaking news and major news events for all digital platforms.

  • Lead editorial decisions and ensure content meets editorial standards while staying on top of current news, events, and industry news.

  • Monitor video feeds, social media, and other newsgathering tools for fresh, live content and the latest information. 

  • Contribute to coverage plans of major stories and live events to drive viewer engagement.

  • Support the development of other producers as you ensure a positive work environment and mentor them. 

  • Actively participate in training news staff on all technical, editorial, and presentation aspects of LiveNOW.

  • Work closely with LiveNOW leadership to develop and adjust producer workflows as needed. 

  • Support LiveNOW’s efforts to cultivate relationships with key players at FTS O&O stations and other internal or external partners.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 3-5 years of experience leading the planning and producing of live news content, including breaking news on digital, social, and broadcast platforms.

  • BA/BS degree preferably in Journalism, Communications or a related field. 

  • Strong knowledge of technical aspects of digital news production, including live streaming and video publishing

  • Prior experience leading and developing, with a track record of taking ownership to successfully deliver key projects or initiatives. 

  • Superior news judgment, strong attention to detail, and impeccable organizational skills.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment under deadline pressures.

  • Proficient in social media, SEO, and various tools used for web-based newsgathering, content creation, and digital analytics.

  • Varied hours including regular weekend and evening shifts, and holidays as required.

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX is seeking a Senior Transmission Engineer to join our Fox Network Engineering and Architecture team in Los Angeles, supporting high-profile live sports productions across FOX Sports.  As a member of the team, you will collaborate closely with FOX Sports’ Engineering and Field Operations teams, designing, implementing, monitoring, and troubleshooting network transmission systems that deliver mission-critical video, audio, and data signals from venues to broadcast and digital platforms.

The ideal candidate brings expertise in networking and broadcast transmission technologies, a strong operational mindset, and the ability to perform under the demands of live event production. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role operating in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment aligned with live sports schedules, requiring flexibility for nights, weekends, and major events.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect, deploy, and maintain transmission paths for live sports events, including fiber, satellite, IP-based transport (SMPTE ST 2110 / 2022), and bonded cellular solutions
  • Coordinate and manage contribution and distribution workflows between venues, broadcast centers, and cloud environments
  • Provide real-time operational support for live sports broadcasts, including rapid troubleshooting and escalation management
  • Collaborate with production, engineering, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless signal acquisition and delivery
  • Monitor network performance, signal integrity, latency, and redundancy across all transmission paths
  • Design and implement failover strategies and redundancy plans to ensure high availability during live events
  • Support integration of emerging technologies, including cloud-based workflows and remote production (REMI) models
  • Maintain documentation of transmission infrastructure, signal flows, and standard operating procedures
  • Participate in on-call rotation and provide support during nights, weekends, and major sporting events

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years of experience in broadcast transmission, network engineering, or live production environments

  • Strong understanding of IP networking concepts, including BGP, OSPF, multicast (PIM, IGMP), QoS, VLANs, and STP

  • Familiarity with streaming and transport technologies, multicast distribution, and packetized video/audio workflows

  • Experience supporting or deploying systems using SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022, AES67, or Dante is a significant plus

  • Hands-on experience with network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls) in high-bandwidth environments
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex signal paths under time-sensitive conditions
  • Demonstrate ability to perform and analyze packet captures using tools like Wireshark or tcpdump.
  • Understanding of redundancy models, QoS, and network reliability principles

  • Knowledge and practical experience with Arista switches and EOS

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with production and engineering teams

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience supporting Tier 1 live sports broadcasts (NFL, MLB, FIFA, etc.)
  • Knowledge of cloud-based media workflows (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Familiarity with remote production workflows and distributed control rooms
  • Scripting or automation experience (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, AWS Certified Solutions Architect)

job.title: VP, Digital Growth and Product Marketing
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The VP, Digital Growth and Product Marketing is responsible for identifying and driving digital revenue initiatives outside of our traditional linear revenue streams with a major focus on casual game development. This includes audience growth and user retention across our owned and operated platforms; our website, mobile apps, and Connected TV (CTV) applications to achieve the revenue goals for the digital business.

This role leads the monetization of new efforts deployed for the digital business, oversees the incubation and testing of new digital lines of business, and directs the go-to-market (GTM) and product marketing strategies for all new digital features and content experiences.

The position works closely with Product Development, Engineering, Ad Sales, Editorial, and Data teams to ensure new digital initiatives are optimized for consumer engagement, user registration, and revenue optimization. The VP also works closely with our digital commerce expansion and CRM strategies to maximize lifetime value (LTV) across the digital ecosystem.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

Platform Monetization & New Business Strategy

  • Lead revenue growth, development and rollout of the casual gaming effort for Fox News Media

  • Lead the testing, and scaling of other new digital lines of business, including premium subscription tiers and novel ad-based models.

  • Identify and implement platform monetization opportunities across the website, mobile apps, and CTV applications to maximize ARPU (Average Revenue Per User).

  • Monitor competitive landscape and digital product trends to pilot cutting-edge audience growth and revenue initiatives.

Product Marketing & Feature Rollouts

  • Own the end-to-end strategic promotion, user acquisition, and rollout of Fox News Games.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive GTM strategies for major new product features, specifically including Vertical Video experiences and "For You" personalization algorithms.

  • Partner with product teams to translate technical capabilities into compelling consumer-facing value propositions that drive active feature adoption.

Commerce Revenue Strategy & Development

  • Aid the scale a robust digital commerce strategy to drive revenue through various commerce initiatives (affiliate, direct sales, partnership) with affiliate commerce team and eCommerce marketing.

  • Partner with Ad Sales and commercial teams to integrate sponsored and advertiser-driven experiences into new digital products and games.

  • Collaborate with business development to evaluate external technology partners and platforms to accelerate commerce capabilities.

CRM, Registration & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Oversee data-driven audience segmentation and personalized messaging strategies across email, push notifications, and in-app messaging.

JOB DESCRIPTION

OutKick is looking for a versatile Sports Betting Writer to create compelling daily betting content that informs, entertains, and helps sports fans make smarter wagers.

This is more than writing picks. You’ll analyze the biggest games, explain betting trends, identify value before the market catches up, and engage one of the most passionate sports audiences online. job.description:
