USA TODAY Co., Inc. is a diversified media company with expansive reach at the national and local level dedicated to empowering and enriching communities. We seek to inspire, inform, and connect audiences as a sustainable, growth focused media and digital marketing solutions company. Through our trusted brands, including the USA TODAY NETWORK, comprised of the national publication, USA TODAY, and local media organizations, including our network of local properties, in the United States, and Newsquest, a wholly-owned subsidiary operating in the United Kingdom, we provide essential journalism, local content, and digital experiences to audiences and businesses. We deliver high-quality, trusted content with a commitment to balanced, unbiased journalism, where and when consumers want to engage. Our digital marketing solutions brand, LocaliQ, supports small and medium-sized businesses with innovative digital marketing products and solutions. USA TODAY Co. open roles are featured on various external job boards. When applying to a position at USA TODAY Co., you should be completing an application on USA TODAY Co. Careers via Dayforce. Job postings directing you to complete an application on other external sites may not be valid. If you are a California resident, you acknowledge that by applying for a job with us, this California Job Applicant Privacy Notice will apply to our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com

USA TODAY Executive Editor of Audience and Digital Production

Role summary

USA TODAY is seeking a visionary, highly accomplished Executive Editor, Audience & Digital Production to serve as key driver of USA TODAY’s digital audience strategy and the executive owner of newsroom digital production across platforms. In one of the most critical leadership roles in our organization, this editor will set the agenda for how USA TODAY’s journalism is transformed into signature digital experiences that grow reach, deepen engagement, and build enduring reader loyalty.

Reporting directly to the SVP of USA TODAY, the Executive Editor, Audience & Digital Production will own and evolve the operating model for audience and production bringing together dedicated digital content pillar teams, platform owners, and a 24/7 central digital production desk into a cohesive, high performing system. They will oversee a sophisticated organization that spans our core editorial pillars, enterprise level planning, and experts across web, apps, newsletters, video, social and emerging platforms, ensuring that every major story and franchise is executed with clarity, speed and impact.

This executive will be accountable for portfolio wide digital performance, including growth in loyal users, repeat visitation, engagement depth, and conversion into newsletters and other owned channels. They will work as a true peer and strategic partner to pillar leaders across News/Life, Opinion, Sports and Entertainment shaping digital growth priorities, championing big bet projects, and making data driven decisions about where, when and how USA TODAY shows up for its audiences.

Central to the role is building a modern, scalable operating system for digital journalism. The Executive Editor will design and continuously refine workflows that make our coverage data informed, visually distinctive and relentlessly aligned to USA TODAY’s brand promise and enterprise priorities. They will lead a disciplined culture of experimentation standing up formal testing programs for formats, distribution strategies and audience journeys, and integrating responsible AI assisted tools into daily production in ways that strengthen quality, speed and efficiency.

As a senior newsroom executive, this editor will lead, inspire and develop a high caliber team of managers, editors, producers and platform specialists. They will be expected to set a clear vision, translate it into concrete operating standards, and build an inclusive, performance driven culture grounded in candor, coaching and accountability. This leader will ensure that audience insight, platform intelligence and journalistic ambition come together in a unified strategy.

The ideal candidate will bring a track record of leading complex digital news operations at scale, deep fluency in audience analytics and platform dynamics, and a demonstrated ability to drive change in fast moving environments. They will combine urgency and creativity with sound judgment and integrity and will be energized by the opportunity to build a flagship audience and digital production organization that positions USA TODAY to win the next decade of digital news.

This role must be based out of Washington, DC or NYC.

Responsibilities:

Own the audience strategy across platforms

• Set and communicate the audience and distribution strategy for USA TODAY’s digital portfolio, with a birds-eye view of business needs and growth targets.

• Ensure the structure intentionally integrates newsletters, social discovery, video/visuals distribution, search, and AI support across all pillars.

Accountable for performance, KPIs, and division goals

• Monitor performance against key metrics (pageviews, unique visits, return visits, loyalty, platform growth) and be accountable for hitting audience and engagement goals.

• Close the loop between data and editorial decisions by ensuring platform owners and pod leads act on live analytics and audience insights.

Leadership of the Compass operating model

• Lead and oversee the full Audience & Digital Production structure: digital content pillar team owners, platform owners, and central desk, under one unified model.

• Maintain a cohesive view of the entire portfolio and resolve conflicts or prioritization questions between pillars, platforms, and central desk.

• Serve as key advisor to executive leadership on audience strategy and digital production capacity.

Planning, tentpoles, and live coverage

• Own the daily and look-ahead planning calendar, including tentpole events, live moments, and major initiatives.

• Ensure the central desk and pods execute against agreed strategies in fast-moving scenarios (breaking news, major sporting events, large entertainment initiatives).

Cross functional partnership and prioritization

• Partner cross-departmentally and cross-divisionally (News, Entertainment, Sports, Opinion, Product, Sales, Brand, Local, Content Strategy, Content Monetization) to align audience priorities with business objectives.

• Participate in and help lead the Audience Growth Council with platform owners and pillar leads.

Standards, brand voice, and editorial quality

• Monitor site content and editorial standards from an audience perspective, ensuring brand voice and platform strategies are coherent and consistent.

• Maintain clear decision rights so pods own creation, platform editors own how each platform wins, and central desk executes in real time.

Workflow, innovation, and AI integration

• Champion the integration of AI and innovation tools (SEO drafts, content tagging, briefings, social copy) into production workflows, in collaboration with platform owners and Content AI teams.

• Ensure the team’s structure supports scaling, pivoting, and experimentation across emerging platforms and formats.

People leadership and structure optimization

• Hire, manage, and develop senior editors (Central Desk & Operations, Platforms, Pods) and ensure clear reporting lines and responsibilities across the 23–30 person model.

• Adjust staffing assumptions, meeting cadence, decision rights, and role scopes based on operating experience, with regular reviews and model refinements.

Key deliverables:

• A functioning hybrid team (pods + platforms + central desk) that delivers 24/7 digital publishing, clear ownership by pillar, and expert platform stewardship.

• Documented audience strategies per pillar and platform, tied to measurable KPIs and reviewed quarterly.

• A central desk and platform owner layer that reliably execute homepage, alerts, newsletters, social and search strategies under pressure.

• Integrated AI and innovation workflows that measurably improve speed, depth, and scalability of digital production.

Requirements:

• Significant leadership experience in digital newsrooms or audience/production teams, preferably at national scale.

• Proven track record driving audience growth across multiple platforms (site, app, newsletters, social, video, search, aggregators).

• Strong fluency in audience analytics and the ability to translate data into clear editorial and distribution decisions.

• Experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and complex, multi-team operating models.

• Comfort leading change, including reorganization, workflow design, and adoption of new tools (especially AI and automation in production).

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit:

1. Your resume – one to two pages.

2. A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the role.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

#Newsgnt

#LI-NC1

The Auburn Printing Facility is looking for a full-time entry-level Pressman 1 position to assist with daily production on our presses. We are looking for a Product Manager who combines strong product management skills with deep expertise in Display advertising, programmatic ecosystems, and paid ads. You will lead strategic initiatives across our display and paid ads portfolio, helping thousands of Enterprise and SMB advertisers improve performance through programmatic optimization, automation, and platform innovation.

The ideal candidate is an experienced product leader who can identify opportunities, define strategy, influence stakeholders, and deliver measurable business outcomes. You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to build scalable solutions that improve advertiser outcomes, optimize inventory monetization, and drive business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

• Own and execute a significant portion of the Display and Paid Ads product roadmap.

• Define product strategy for programmatic bidding, O&O display inventory monetization, automation, measurement, and advertiser-facing capabilities.

Product Execution & Delivery

• Lead initiatives from discovery through launch and ongoing optimization.

• Translate business challenges and customer needs into clear product requirements, user flows, success metrics, and rollout plans.

• Partner directly with Engineering and Data Science to deliver scalable product solutions.

• Balance customer value, business impact, and technical complexity when making prioritization decisions.

AI, Optimization & Measurement

• Drive innovation across programmatic bidding strategies, yield optimization, automation, and display asset recommendations.

• Translate emerging AdTech, SSP/DSP capabilities, and industry innovations into differentiated product experiences.

• Define measurement frameworks and success metrics to evaluate product effectiveness and campaign viewability.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Deep understanding of the programmatic landscape, including bidding strategies, yield optimization, viewability, attribution, conversion tracking, and AI-driven campaign management.

• Experience partnering directly with engineering teams to deliver products from concept through launch.

• Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear product strategies and execution plans.

• Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.

• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Go-to-Market teams.

• Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills.

Sales Associate, Marketing Solutions

Position Summary

LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network are seeking a motivated, career-driven Sales Associate to join our Marketing Solutions team. This entry-level sales role serves as the foundation for future growth into Media Specialist and Account Executive positions.

The Sales Associate is responsible for generating new business opportunities, building prospect pipelines, supporting open territories, and securing qualified meetings for the sales organization. Working closely with sales leaders and account teams, this role plays a critical part in driving future revenue growth through proactive prospecting, lead generation, and customer engagement.

What You'll Do

Prospecting & Business Development

• Conduct outbound prospecting through phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and other lead-generation channels.

• Research local businesses and identify potential advertising and marketing opportunities.

• Build and maintain prospect lists utilizing Salesforce, market intelligence tools, and industry resources.

• Schedule qualified discovery meetings for Media Specialists and Account Executives.

Sales Activity & Pipeline Management

• Execute daily activity plans designed to achieve prospecting, meeting, and opportunity goals.

• Follow established sales processes for lead qualification and opportunity management.

Collaboration & Sales Support

• Partner with Sales Managers, Media Specialists, Account Executives, and Account Coordinators to support business growth.

• Participate in ongoing coaching, training, and professional development programs.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support exceptional customer experiences.

Customer Engagement

Qualifications

Required

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong customer service mindset.

• Familiarity with digital marketing, advertising, media, or customer acquisition strategies.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique

This position offers a structured pathway into a full-cycle sales career. You'll receive hands-on experience in prospecting, pipeline management, customer engagement, and sales strategy while working alongside experienced media sales professionals. Successful Sales Associates will develop the foundational skills needed to advance into Media Specialist and Account Executive opportunities.

• Sales engagement and prospecting tools

• Market research and business intelligence platforms

Work Environment

Why LocaliQ?

LocaliQ combines the strength of the USA TODAY Network with leading digital marketing technology, helping businesses attract, convert, and retain customers through innovative marketing solutions. job.description:
|Current USA TODAY Co. Employees- Please ensure you are using our abbreviated process on the internal Careers site by logging into Dayforce through MyApps|

If you are a California resident, you acknowledge that by applying for a job with us, this California Job Applicant Privacy Notice will apply to our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com

About the role

USA TODAY is seeking a Sr Director - Enterprise Data Architect to lead the strategy and hands-on delivery of a next-generation Advertiser Intelligence Platform. This leader will build the trusted data and AI foundation that enables unified advertiser profiles, peer benchmarking, opportunity intelligence, predictive insights, and workflow integration across sales, customer success, and operations.

This is a high-impact leadership role for a builder who can define the strategy and also execute. The platform vision is rooted in creating trusted identity and data capabilities that power advertising, subscriptions, commerce and loyalty, personalization, experiences, and stronger monetization across a connected platform.

What you’ll do

• Define the enterprise architecture and phased roadmap for the Advertiser Intelligence Platform.

• Build the golden advertiser profile strategy and canonical data model.

• Architect AI enrichment, opportunity scoring, similarity matching, and predictive intelligence capabilities.

• Partner with engineering and product teams to deliver MVP through scale.

• Integrate insights into CRM, BI, and business workflows.

• Establish governance for data quality, privacy, lineage, explainability, and cost control.

• Work directly with GTM and operations leaders to ensure the platform delivers measurable business results.

What you bring

• Deep enterprise data architecture experience in complex, cross-functional environments.

• Proven success building production-grade data and intelligence platforms.

• Strong background in cloud data ecosystems, modern analytics, and AI/ML-enabled architecture.

• Ability to lead at executive altitude and execute at implementation depth.

• Strong communication, influence, and operating discipline.

Core responsibilities

Platform strategy and target architecture

• Define the end-to-end architecture for USA TODAY’s Advertiser Intelligence Platform, aligned to the business goal of turning advertiser data into revenue growth, retention improvement, and faster decision-making.

• Establish the multi-phase architecture spanning golden advertiser profiles, AI enrichment, similarity matching, intelligence UI, predictive analytics, and AI as a central integration layer.

• Translate business goals into a pragmatic implementation roadmap that starts small, validates core mechanics, and scales responsibly.

• Create architectural standards for trust, lineage, freshness, transparency, explainability, privacy, and operational resilience.

Data architecture and modeling

• Design the canonical advertiser domain model and golden profile architecture across identifiers, business profile, lifecycle stage, seasonality, product portfolio, financial metrics, performance metrics, creative intelligence, engagement history, geographic footprint, competitive positioning, and data freshness metadata.

• Define normalized schemas and data products for advertiser core profile, products, financial metrics, platform performance, temporal metrics, lifecycle history, seasonality profiles, creative inventory, freshness indicators, opportunity packs, and churn-risk signals.

• Architect data ingestion, harmonization, identity resolution, deduplication, quality controls, and lineage patterns across the data lake and operational platforms.

• Ensure the platform supports lifecycle-normalized and seasonality-normalized comparisons so commercial teams can trust the intelligence surfaced to them.

AI, ML, and intelligence architecture

• Lead the design of AI-enriched advertiser intelligence, including profile health scoring, opportunity scoring, tiered enrichment, online presence research, competitive intelligence, and evidence-pack generation.

• Architect vectorized advertiser representations and peer matching patterns using embedding features such as vertical, spend trajectory, product mix, campaign mix, creative diversity, geography, performance, seasonality, and lifecycle stage.

• Partner with data science and engineering teams to define prediction and recommendation patterns for churn, expansion, product adoption, and ROI impact modeling, with clear confidence labeling and non-causal positioning where appropriate.

• Ensure AI is implemented as a decision-support capability for business teams, not as an uncontrolled automation layer.

Delivery and execution

• Lead discovery, architecture definition, MVP design, phased delivery, and production rollout for the platform.

• Personally review and contribute to schemas, interface contracts, orchestration logic, data quality rules, and implementation plans.

• Guide teams through pilot execution, manual validation with sales teams, feedback loop instrumentation, and post-MVP expansion.

• Drive integration of platform insights into operational tools such as CRM, BI, email workflows, and collaboration channels.

Governance and operating model

• Establish governance for enrichment costs, token and API budgets, cooldown rules, privacy compliance, source transparency, and quarterly ROI reviews.

• Define controls for data quality, misleading peer comparisons, confidence labeling, and research-source compliance.

• Build an operating model for continuous improvement using user feedback, closed-loop outcomes, and weekly or daily data refresh patterns.

• Act as the senior technical voice across executives, product, engineering, commercial operations, and GTM stakeholders.

Required experience

• 15+ years in enterprise data architecture, data platform engineering, analytics architecture, or closely related leadership roles, including ownership of complex cross-functional data programs.

• Proven experience designing enterprise-scale data architectures that unify data from multiple operational and platform systems into trusted, governed, and production-ready domain models.

• Demonstrated success building or modernizing advertiser, customer, identity, martech, adtech, subscription, or revenue intelligence platforms.

• Strong experience with cloud data platforms and large-scale analytical ecosystems, ideally including BigQuery, modern orchestration patterns, semantic modeling, and near-real-time or daily refresh pipelines.

• Practical experience designing AI/ML-enabled data products, including feature design, scoring frameworks, recommender patterns, similarity matching, vector search, or predictive analytics capabilities.

• Experience translating ambiguous business goals into phased roadmaps, MVPs, architecture standards, and shipped capabilities adopted by business users.

• Experience partnering directly with sales, customer success, operations, finance, and product leaders to convert data strategy into business impact.

• Track record leading hands-on architecture reviews, mentoring engineers and architects, and unblocking execution in delivery-critical moments.

#LI-REMOTE

#LI-NR2

Variable incentive compensation, including commissions, is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Good Karma Sports and ESPN Chicago are looking for part-time Marketing Events Supervisors to join our marketing team and assist with promotional street team events, remote broadcasts and partnership activations across the region. The ideal candidate will play an important role in producing social and sales content for ESPN Los Angeles and will also help develop new ideas to market our brand to our partners.  

Career responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

  • Capture, create, edit, and livestream content for show-specific, partner, social media, and digital platforms, including video, photo, and graphics across ESPN Los Angeles assets.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Consultants and the sales team to support partner-related content ideas, campaign goals, and revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Support talent during projects and shoots by helping bring creative concepts to life while following partner guidelines and campaign expectations.
  • Ensure that partner goals are met and campaign deliverables are executed.
  • Produce recaps, sizzle reels, and specs for social and sales purposes.
  • Actively participate in Digital Team Connect meetings to share ideas, best practices, and social media recommendations across Good Karma.
  • Be an integral part of a team that communicates directly with existing and potential social media fans of ESPN Los Angeles’ assets.
  • Travel to help capture events, live shows/podcasts, in-game content, and more.
  • When applicable, assist with setup, teardown, and other marketing responsibilities at our events and live remotes.
  • Integrate AI tools into daily workflows to enhance and optimize digital content, improve communication, project coordination and operational efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight.
  • Collaborate across departments to support organizational goals and perform other duties as assigned.
  • Be a Good Karma ambassador by demonstrating our core values: Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Listen, Teamwork, and Follow Through.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications 

  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Photoshop, as well as Canva and PowerPoint
  • Ability to set up camera, lights, and audio equipment 
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work within tight deadlines
  • Experience with Illustrator, Adobe Animate, vMix, CapCut, and Sway is a plus
  • Knowledge of Switcher Studio, OBS, Streamyard or livestreaming platforms
  • Ability to participate in brainstorm sessions and ideate marketing solutions
  • Valid driver's license and ability to drive station vehicles to and from events as needed.

This is a part-time, hourly position.

Pay Transparency: The anticipated starting hourly range for California-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $18.42 - $20.00 per hour. The hourly rate is to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow within Good Karma and are responsible for representing Good Karma Sports, our story, and our core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
KOCO-TV, Hearst Television’s ABC affiliate in Oklahoma City, OK, has an opening for an Account Executive. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to local businesses, developing and executing data-driven, multiplatform marketing strategies that deliver measurable results. You’ll leverage the power of broadcast, streaming (CTV/OTT), digital, CRM systems and AI-enabled tools to help clients grow and compete in today’s evolving media landscape.

 

If you are competitive, driven, and focused on results, this is an opportunity to grow your career with a market leader. This is an in-person position reporting to the Local Sales Manager.

 

What You’ll Do
As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue and build long-term client partnerships through multi-platform advertising solutions.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate revenue by selling integrated TV, digital, and multi-platform advertising solutions 
  • Prospect, develop, and close new business opportunities 
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business owners and key decision-makers 
  • Manage and grow an active book of business through ongoing client engagement 
  • Develop strategic, data-informed marketing solutions using audience insights, CRM systems (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics), and AI-enabled tools 
  • Create and deliver compelling sales presentations that align with client objectives 
  • Negotiate pricing and maximize revenue across accounts 
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual sales targets 
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support client success and overall team performance

 

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking a results-driven, consultative sales professional who thrives in a competitive environment.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of sales experience (media, digital, or related field) 
  • Proven success in new business development 
  • Experience using CRM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics or similar) to manage client relationships and sales pipeline preferred
  • Experience using data, analytics, or AI tools to support business decisions or sales efforts 
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills 
  • Ability to perform in a goal-driven environment 
  • Experience working directly with decision-makers 
  • Strategic mindset with focus on results 
  • Strong work ethic and accountability 
  • Team-oriented approach 
  • Related military experience will be considered
  • Valid drivers license required

 

Why Join KOCO-TV and Hearst Television

  • Work for a leading, trusted media company 
  • Sell best-in-class advertising solutions 
  • Join a high-performing, results-driven team 
  • Access strong leadership, tools, and support 
  • Build a long-term career with growth opportunities

job.title: Anchor/Reporter
job.description:
Local News Anchor Reporter

WMTW-TV, the ABC affiliate in Westbrook, Maine is looking for an Anchor/Reporter. The Anchor/Reporter is someone who can bring the energy of live reporting to our anchor desk. In addition to credibility, poise, and personality; you are an anchor who isn't afraid to head out into the field and break the big stories. You will enterprise exclusives, tell compelling stories, and complete live shots. You are someone who isn't afraid to ask the tough questions, will hold those in power accountable and help mentor producers and reporters. You will write and edit scripts with viewer interaction in mind. You are versatile, enterprising, and can work fast and efficient, and works well under tight deadlines, can develop sources, and has excellent live reporting skills. You will report to the News Director.  The salary range for this position is $70,000 - $87,000

Responsibilities

  • Deliver scripted and ad-lib material with professionalism, personality, and purpose.
  • Work with and guide reporters and producers in newscast production.
  • Plan, gathers and assembles stories on day-of news or special project assignments.
  • Coordinate with news managers and producers to develop stories that go beyond surface details, that accentuate unique enterprise angles, and have exclusive content
  • Develop a network of sources who provide tips, early access to information, and allow the reporter to break stories of significance
  • Appear on behalf of the station at public events.
  • Will contribute pictures, video and text updates to mobile platforms throughout the day
  • Work on different stories and projects at once and meeting all deadlines
  • Summarize information into easy-to-understand components

Requirements

  • 2+ years of anchor experience required
  • 2+ years of reporting experience required
  • Your demo reel is indicative of your everyday work
  • Anchor that connects with viewers, in addition to reporting skills
  • Operate mobile transmission devices and use latest technology.
  • Can work in all weather conditions, work varied shifts, including overnights and weekends and carry up to 50 pounds
  • Have a valid driver's license and a clear driving record
  • Have and exhibit unwavering journalistic integrity and ethical standards
  • Can deal with the stresses and pressures of time-sensitive newscast production
  • Related military experience will be considered

job.title: Broadcast Maintenance Technician
job.description:
WLWT Engineering operates in a fast-paced, technically advanced environment that supports broadcast systems, IT infrastructure, and live production workflows. We are seeking a Broadcast Maintenance Technician to join our Engineering team. 

This position is responsible for maintaining and supporting the broadcast and IT systems that keep the station on the air and operating at a high level. It is ideal for a technically capable individual who enjoys troubleshooting, learning new systems, and working collaboratively across multiple departments. 

The Broadcast Maintenance Technician will work with a wide range of technologies, including broadcast equipment, RF systems, networking, servers, automation, video and audio routing, and live production systems. 

Responsibilities 

• Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair broadcast and IT systems to support reliable daily operations. 

• Execute and improve preventative maintenance programs.

• Install, configure, test, and maintain broadcast equipment, networking systems, servers, workstations, and related infrastructure. 

• Provide technical support to News, Production, Creative Services, Sales, and Administration. 

• Support live broadcasts and remote productions, including technical setup, operation, and troubleshooting. 

• Assist with the maintenance and operation of digital transmitters, satellite systems, automation platforms, and content-distribution workflows. 

• Travel as needed to transmitter sites, remote locations, and live event venues. 

• Respond to equipment failures and technical issues, including those requiring service outside normal business hours. 

• Document systems, workflows, technical procedures, maintenance activities, and configuration changes. 

• Collaborate with engineering and IT team members on station operations, system improvements, and new technology deployments. 

• Maintain compliance with FCC regulations, industry standards, and Hearst Television technical requirements. 

• Participate in equipment evaluations, system testing, capital projects, and technology planning as assigned. 

 

Requirements 

• A strong technical foundation in broadcast engineering, IT, audiovisual systems, electronics, or a related field. 

• Experience with managed network switches and IP-based systems. 

• Working knowledge of servers, workstations, and network infrastructure. 

• Understanding of TCP/IP networking, VPNs, and LAN environments. 

• Experience with Windows desktop and server operating systems. 

• Familiarity with broadcast equipment, production environments, RF systems, video and audio routing, automation, or digital transmission. 

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. 

• The ability to work effectively under pressure during live broadcasts, technical failures, and time-sensitive situations. 

• The ability to lift 50 pounds and work on rooftops, at transmitter sites, and in confined spaces as required. 

• A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel to remote locations and live event venues. 

 

Education and Preferred Qualifications 

• An associate degree or higher in Electronic Engineering Technology, Broadcast Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; completion of a comparable accredited technical program will also be considered. 

• Cisco, VMware, Microsoft, SBE, or similar certifications are preferred. 

• Military technical training or experience is valued. 

• Candidates with strong IT, audiovisual, electronics, or technical aptitude who are interested in learning broadcast systems are encouraged to apply. 

• A commitment to ongoing professional development in broadcast, IT, networking, and emerging technologies. 

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all cultures, backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That's why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization as diverse and varied as the audience we reach, ensuring that the content we create is more compassionate, and more representative of the communities we serve.

job.title: Broadcast Operations Technician
job.description:
WTAE-TV, the ABC affiliate in Pittsburgh, PA, is seeking an experienced Broadcast Operations Technician to join our Engineering team. This position is responsible for delivering and monitoring the station’s on-air signals from content acquisition through distribution. The successful candidate will support both in-studio and remote production operations and report directly to the Assistant Chief Engineer.

Responsibilities

  • Operate and manage file-based broadcast workflows, including media preparation, playlist management, recording schedules, and robotic camera shot recall.

  • Provide creative input and work with newscast producers and production crew.

  • Staff the master control room to operate and monitor studio and transmission equipment, including:

    • Broadcast automation systems

    • Robotic cameras

    • Satellite downlinks

    • HD video servers

  • Ensure the accurate execution of on-air playlists, commercial breaks, and programming.

  • Perform floor directing duties during live and recorded productions, communicating effectively with anchors, reporters, and other on-air talent to ensure seamless coordination between the production control room and the studio.

  • Operate and monitor news automation systems to ensure clean technical execution of the newscast.

  • Monitor video and audio quality using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and other quality control equipment to ensure broadcast standards are met.

  • Quickly identify technical issues and communicate equipment problems promptly to Engineering staff to minimize operational disruptions.

  • Support station operations during live broadcasts, special events, and remote productions.

Qualifications

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining 

    exceptional attention to detail.

  • Strong decision-making skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues and respond effectively under time-sensitive conditions.

  • Highly proficient with computers and comfortable learning new software and broadcast technologies.

  • Understanding of newsroom ENPS and video playback systems.

  • Technical know-how to resolve existing issues and to work around problems that arise during live newscasts.

  • Experience with file-based media workflows and modern broadcast automation systems is strongly preferred.

  • Reliable, punctual, and able to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.

  • Valid Pennsylvania driver’s license and dependable transportation.

  • Able to stand for long periods of time.

  • Able to lift and carry 50 lbs.

Preferred Experience

  • Television control room and studio operations experience.

  • Education or training in Broadcast Communications, Electronics, or a related technical field.

  • Technical School degree, Electronics Certification, and/or Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE) Certification.

  • Military technical experience is welcomed and will be considered.

Values in Action

That’s why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

job.title: John DiStaso Political Fellowship
job.description:
John DiStaso Political Fellowship

The John DiStaso Political Fellowship is a one-semester paid position at Hearst ABC affiliate WMUR-TV in Manchester, NH.  Our Fellow will work closely with members of our political team on several projects including daily political coverage, our 2022 and 2024 election-related coverage, and our weekly political show, “CloseUP”.  The Fellowship will be awarded to a motivated junior or senior in college who is interested in pursuing a career in political journalism.

More about John DiStaso

John DiStaso was the most experienced political journalist in New Hampshire. He was often referred to as the “dean” of New Hampshire’s political press corps. John died from complications of pancreatic cancer on April 21, 2022, at the age of 68.  Throughout his career, DiStaso interviewed four sitting presidents and countless presidential candidates while covering 11 New Hampshire primaries. John spent much of his career working for New Hampshire’s largest newspaper, “The Union Leader”.  He spent the last seven years of his career working for WMUR, where he wrote daily for WMUR.com regularly breaking stories.  He also often appeared on WMUR-TV to provide analysis for political stories.

The opportunity

In this political fellowship, you’ll play a meaningful role on the experienced political team of WMUR. You’ll follow in John’s footsteps working on daily political coverage. You’ll learn from John’s enduring legacy, as well as the experienced political team at WMUR to gain the knowledge and experience to launch a successful career in political journalism.

How to qualify

  • Working toward a bachelor’s degree in Political Science, Journalism, Communications or a related degree
  • Experience in journalism through internships or college media
  • Goal to work in the field of journalism
  • Excellent writing and research skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Deadline driven
  • Willingness to work various shifts including nights, weekends and holidays
  • You also need to have a strong academic record, and two recommendations from faculty or internship supervisors

How to apply

Please apply on our career site. Include the following documentation in your application:

  • Include the following documentation in your application:
    • A letter expressing interest in the fellowship and promoting your candidacy
    • A summary of your commitment to journalism (one page, single-spaced)
    • A current resume citing work experience and accomplishments
    • A complete academic transcript through your completed semester
    • Two academic or professional recommendations
    • Finalists will be interviewed by phone and either in-person or via video conference

Application deadlines

For the fall fellowship, applications are due by June 15th. For the spring fellowship, applications are due by September 15th. Decisions regarding fall selection will be made in July and decisions regarding spring selection will be made in October.

job.title: Meteorologist
job.description:
Meteorologist / Weather Reporter

WGAL-TV, the Hearst-owned NBC affiliate serving the Harrisburg, Lancaster, Lebanon and York, PA market has an immediate opening for a Meteorologist / Weather Reporter.

We’re looking for both expertise and personality. You understand the science, and you also understand that great weather coverage is about connecting with people. You can explain why tomorrow’s forecast matters, be a trusted voice when severe weather threatens, confidently report from the middle of a developing weather story, and bring energy and curiosity to a community event.

If you’re a meteorologist who loves forecasting, thrives during live coverage and genuinely enjoys connecting with viewers and the community, we want to hear from you.

Our ideal candidate will be one who thinks outside the box – can deliver a polished in-studio forecast and then turn right around and produce an engaging, memorable vertical video about a timely weather topic. 

Innovation is critical: whether it’s in the middle of a snowstorm or a community fair, you’re always looking for new and creative ways to tell the best story. We’re looking for a storyteller at heart: with the ability to write and craft a weather-related report fit for any screen. You will produce enterprise content and deliver accurate forecasts across television, digital and other platforms. This position reports to the News Director.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze weather data and develop accurate, timely forecasts for the WGAL viewing area
  • Deliver compelling, conversational and easy-to-understand in-studio weather forecasts
  • Build graphics and forecasts with little supervision
  • Provide urgent, authoritative and calm coverage before, during and after severe and high-impact weather events
  • Report live from the field during severe weather, providing viewers with immediate observations, context and safety information
  • Interpret radar, model guidance and other meteorological data and translate complex information into useful information for viewers
  • Create and deliver weather content across television, digital, streaming, social and partner platforms
  • Report live from the field on community events, seasonal stories and other assignments in addition to weather coverage
  • Develop community-focused stories and find opportunities to connect weather with the people, places and events important to our audience
  • Serve as an enthusiastic ambassador for WGAL in the community at station appearances and events
  • Gather, verify and summarize information for broadcast and digital coverage
  • Participate in daily editorial meetings and contribute weather and story ideas
  • Keep newsroom personnel informed about current and developing weather conditions
  • Collaborate with anchors, reporters, producers, photographers and digital teams on coverage across platforms

 

Requirements

  • Strong knowledge of meteorology, weather science and forecasting
  • Dynamic, authentic and conversational on-air presence
  • Ability to combine scientific credibility with personality, warmth and strong storytelling
  • Experience with television weather systems and graphics
  • Strong live reporting skills
  • Digital/social media expertise and enthusiasm for innovative storytelling
  • Must work weekends, in addition to a flexible schedule in the event of severe weather, holiday fill-in coverage, etc. 
  • NWA Seal of Approval and/or AMS Certified Broadcast Meteorologist (CBM) designation or intent to work toward certifications.
  • Related military experience will be considered

This is a hands-on opportunity to gain real-world experience in sports broadcasting while building your editing, producing, and storytelling skills.

Application Requirements

Please upload with your application attachments:

  • Resume and Cover Letter in PDF format (do not submit a Word doc).
  • A Letter of Recommendation from a professor specifically for the WCVB Internship Program.
  • Creative Works/Writing Samples, relevant to your areas of interest.
  • Intern applications are limited to one submission based on area of interest.

 

Salary: $20/hour


Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all cultures, backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That's why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization as diverse and varied as the audience we reach, ensuring that the content we create is more compassionate, and more representative of the communities we serve.

job.title: Stagehand
job.description:
WTAE-TV, the ABC affiliate in Pittsburgh, PA has an opening for a part-time Stagehand. We are looking for a team player who understands the flexible schedule that the broadcast industry requires to join our production crew. You will be responsible for operating teleprompter related to live broadcasts and post-production. You will work to guarantee a successful broadcast is produced. You will report to the News Operations Manager.

 

Responsibilities

  • Move and handle props and sets during productions
  • Construction, maintenance, installation and operation of props, cameras, prompters, sets and other production equipment
  • Lighting and script preparation for newscasts
  • Maintain appearance of studios including cleaning of set and floors
  • Climb ladders to change light bulbs and adjust fixtures on the grid
  • Assist the directors

 

Requirements

  • Can deal with the stresses and pressures of time-sensitive newscast production
  • Related military experience will be considered
  • Must be a member of the International Alliance of Theatrical and Stage Employees union Local #3 or be willing to join the union by tendering initiation fee and monthly dues as required by I.A.T.S.E, Local #3 to maintain employment.
  • In-person attendance is required

 

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all cultures, backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That's why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization as diverse and varied as the audience we reach, ensuring that the content we create is more compassionate, and more representative of the communities we serve.

job.title: 2027 Hearst AI Newsroom Developer Fellowship Program
job.description:
Hearst Journalism Fellowship Program, Newsroom AI Development

The Hearst Fellowship for Newsroom AI Development is a one-year program focused on building tools for journalists and experiences for readers with the cutting-edge technology. The successful candidate will embed on the DevHub, Hearst’s San Francisco-based editorial innovation team, and they will work on AI-assisted projects, tools and news products with our core product and engineering teams and our top metro newsrooms: San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, Dallas Morning News, Austin American-Statesman, San Antonio Express-News, (Albany) Times Union and our Hearst Connecticut newsrooms. 

Fellows will receive training, mentorship and real-world experience alongside top journalist-programmers who build interactive experiences and automation tools focused on building connections to the local communities we cover. 

Hearst Fellows are full-time employees with competitive salary and benefits, including health insurance, relocation allowance and a housing stipend.

 

What the DevHub does

The Hearst DevHub is a team of editorial engineers, AI developers, data journalists, interactive designers and content strategists who collaborate with local newsrooms to create best-in-class digital experiences. We make things like election results pages, AI tools, searchable databases, severe weather trackers, elegantly designed alternative story forms and whatever else you can dream up. You can learn more about the DevHub here.

 

What this fellowship could mean for your future 

Our goal for the program is for Fellows to earn full-time employment at the end of the yearlong term. We want to train our next builders, and then continue supporting them as they grow into our future leaders.

While participation in the program is not a guarantee of future employment, our goal is to recruit candidates who eventually will join our full-time professional staff. All of us here have an investment in your future and in the future of Hearst Newspapers. 

 

What the successful candidate will do on the DevHub

  • Create AI tools for newsrooms and experiences for readers that adhere to our strict editorial standards and company policies.
  • Work with newsrooms on best practices for AI usage.
  • Enrich existing tools and interactives with fresh approaches to workflows, data analysis and visualization.
  • Innovate with new technology to benefit journalists and the communities we cover.

 

Hearst Fellowships jump-start great journalism careers 

The experience you gain as a Hearst Fellow is the start of a strong foundation for your journalism career. Our objective is to recruit, train and retain journalists who have experience with AI, data journalism and programming. Candidates should be college graduates with interest, experience or background in journalism and AI. 

 

How Fellows are selected 

Hearst DevHub team members will conduct multiple interviews and test the top candidates.

If you are offered and accept a position, you will be assigned a mentor, and we’ll help you develop relationships with seasoned professionals throughout Hearst Newspapers and beyond. 

 

Requirements and Information 

Please see our Fellows website at https://hearstfellowships.com. In addition, candidates must be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area and work a hybrid in-office schedule.

 

To be considered you must submit in all required documents in PDF format: 

  • One-page resume that includes past journalistic experience, academic major and minor, date or expected date of graduation, permanent and current addresses, email, website, and social media addresses (if applicable).
  • Reference page that includes three work references including titles, email addresses and phone numbers.
  • Page with links to portfolio or digital work samples. 

Deadline to apply for the Fellowship program is Jan. 4, 2027.

job.title: 2027 National Hearst Journalism Fellowship Program
job.description:
Hearst Newspapers Journalism Fellowship

Duration: 2 Years Location: Rotations in San Francisco, Houston, San Antonio, Albany, or Connecticut
Deadline to Apply: January 4, 2027

Are you ready to launch your journalism career with one of the most respected names in media?

The Hearst Journalism Fellowship is a prestigious, full-time, two-year opportunity designed to catapult the next generation of journalists into impactful careers in today’s fast-changing digital landscape.

This isn’t just a foot in the door, it’s a front-row seat to the future of journalism.

What You’ll Experience

  • Two immersive, 12-month rotations at leading Hearst newspapers—including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News, Albany Times Union, or one of our respected publications in Connecticut.
  • Work alongside Pulitzer-winning journalists and newsroom leaders who are telling powerful stories with data, video, and AI-driven tools.
  • Receive hands-on mentoring from seasoned editors and specialists who are invested in your growth.
  • Access cutting-edge newsroom tech and training in digital reporting, investigative journalism, breaking news, and audience engagement.

What’s in It for You

  • Full-time employment with a competitive salary and benefits from day one
  • Health insurance, relocation allowance, and housing stipend (depending on location)
  • Personalized career development plans, mentorship, and peer networking across our national newsroom network
  • The opportunity to turn your Fellowship into a long-term journalism career with Hearst Newspapers (many of our Fellows do!)

Who We’re Looking For

We’re seeking bold, curious, and digitally savvy storytellers with a passion for public service journalism. You might be a reporter, digital producer, data journalist, visual storyteller, or multimedia creator.

Ideal candidates will:

  • Be recent college grads or early-career journalists
  • Have a background or demonstrated interest in journalism or related fields
  • Be eager to relocate and take on new beats in multiple cities
  • Bring a hunger to learn, create, and lead in a modern newsroom environment

How to Apply

Please submit the following in PDF format:

  1. Resume (1 page) – Include major/minor, graduation date, contact info, and social handles
  2. Work Samples (1 page with clickable links)
  3. Cover Letter (max 2 pages) – Tell us why you should be our next Fellow
  4. Three Professional References – Names, titles, emails, and phone numbers
  5. Two Letters of Recommendation – Sent directly to: fellowships@hearstnp.com

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. for the full two-year duration.
We are unable to sponsor work visas for this program.

Deadline to Apply: January 4, 2027

About Hearst Newspapers

With 24 daily and 52 weekly newspapers across the U.S.—including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, and Albany Times Union—Hearst Newspapers is one of the nation’s most influential media networks. We are investing boldly in the future of news—through digital innovation, community journalism, and the talent of storytellers like you.

This is more than a fellowship. It’s your launchpad.
Join us and shape the future of journalism.

Learn more at hearstfellowships.com

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Hearst Times Union Media Group is looking for a driven Account Executive to join our Capital Region sales team. This is a full-cycle, new business-focused sales role where you’ll be responsible for prospecting, closing, and growing new accounts, while building long-term partnerships with local and regional companies.  You’ll also have a book of existing accounts that generate commissions and you can upsell on our wide swath of digital marketing solutions. 

You’ll have the backing of one of the most recognized media brands in the country, plus access to cutting-edge AI tools that help you prospect smarter, close faster, and maximize your earning potential.

 If you’re competitive, resourceful, and motivated by uncapped earnings, this is an opportunity to take your sales career to the next level.

Why Join Hearst Times Union Media Group?

Uncapped Earnings Potential
Base salary + aggressive commission structure. Top performers consistently exceed targets.

Sell with a Competitive Edge
Leverage advanced tools like ChatGPT Enterprise to streamline prospecting, sharpen presentations, and accelerate deal cycles.

High-Impact Role in a Strong Market
Albany is a dynamic market for SMB’s, with endless opportunity to build new business and expand client relationships.

Trusted Brand & Premium Products
Represent a respected media organization with a powerful portfolio of advertising solutions and a massive audience reach.  Our team makes sales from $5000 to $500,000. 

Career Growth & Mobility
We invest in our people. Whether you want to grow your book, move into leadership, or expand into new markets, there’s a path here.

Be part of a team of six AE’s reporting to a Sales Director who invests their time in you, making you better every day! 

Work inside (presenting on Microsoft Teams) and Go outside, we highly value in person meetings. 

Regular get togethers, happy hours, be part of a Sales office of over 30 sales and support staff. 

Hybrid schedule, Monday and Friday remote, Tues/Wed/Thursday in office. 

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the Full Sales Cycle
    Prospect, pitch, close, and grow accounts across digital, event, and print solutions.
  • Drive New Business
    Proactively identify and connect with small, medium and large businesses through outreach, networking, and market awareness.
  • Present a compelling suite of products including best in class Content Marketing, Hearst Any Screen Streaming Television Advertising, SEO, SEM, display including programmatic, paid social media marketing, Email marketing, print solutions, and more.
  • Build & Manage Your Pipeline
    Maintain a strong pipeline of new and existing business using Salesforce, Outreach, ChatGPT Enterprise, and consistently meet activity and revenue targets.
  • Deliver Compelling Presentations
    Lead discovery conversations and present media plans that clearly demonstrate value and ROI.
  • Leverage AI to Win More Deals
    Use over a dozen of our customized GPT’s, AI-powered tools that increase your efficiency, improve client engagement, and close business faster.

 

What Sets You Apart:

  • You’re a hunter who thrives on winning new business
  • You are dynamic on the phone and in person. 
  • You know Albany and the Capital Region well. 
  • You’re competitive and goal-oriented, with a track record of exceeding targets
  • You’re confident in client-facing situations, from cold outreach to executive presentations
  • You’re adaptable and resourceful, able to navigate challenges and find solutions
  • You’re strategic in your approach, not just transactional
  • You bring strong communication and relationship-building skills

 

 Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of B2B sales experience (media, advertising, business or related industry preferred)
  • Proven success in new business development and revenue growth
  • Experience managing a full sales cycle
  • Adept at using CRM tools (Salesforce, Outreach, or similar. 
  • Existing relationships in the Albany market are a plus

 

Our Benefits: At Times Union Media Group we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.
  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

 

Ready to Make an Impact?

Join us and be part of a team that’s transforming local media through technology and human connection.

Apply now to launch your next chapter as a trusted media partner to businesses across Albany.

Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York State. The reasonable estimated starting base salary, if hired in New York State, would start at about $50,000 (base salary), plus commissions with on target first year earnings potential of $75,000 - $125,000 (annualized) based on individual performance. There is no commission cap.  Please note this information is specific to those hired in New York State. If this role is open to candidates outside of New York State, the salary range would be aligned to that specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

About Us:

Based in Albany, the Times Union (www.timesunion.com) is the leading news organization in New York’s Capital Region, Hudson Valley and beyond. The news organization is widely respected for its focus on local news and watchdog reporting, particularly on state government and politics. It has won numerous state and national awards for its work on both print and digital platforms and has repeatedly been named New York’s ‘Newspaper of Distinction’ by the state editors association. Through the Times Union Media Group, we offer innovative marketing and advertising solutions to local, regional, and national clients. These include event marketing, a full complement of digital marketing solutions, targeted and total market coverage print solutions and more. 

HNP Overview: 

With 2,500 employees across the nation, Hearst Newspapers (HNP) represents a network of 28 daily and 50 weekly publications, including the Austin American-Statesman, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News, San Francisco Chronicle and Times Union (Albany). Our portfolio also includes several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites such as Chron., CT Insider, MySA and SFGATE, along with marketing services businesses like Medium Giant and entertainment brands such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we’re investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories — growing newsrooms, diversifying tools and evolving platforms — to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired. 

Be part of something bigger — Your Headline Awaits

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Role Overview: Hearst Newspapers is investing in its sales force, and we want you to be a part of it! We are looking for a digitally savvy, highly motivated Account Executive to join our advertising team at The Houston Chronicle. As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for developing and managing a sales pipeline and building new business relationships with local advertisers throughout the Houston area. You will work with your customers to promote compelling solutions that best fit their marketing needs. As an advocate for the customer within the Houston Chronicle, the role works in cooperation with other departments to ensure we can meet and exceed customer expectations both in performance and process. Hearst Newspapers operates on a hybrid work week schedule.

Why The Houston Chronicle? Our people make the difference! Our diverse team is filled with passionate individuals who want to win. We offer an upbeat and collaborative working environment where challenging the norm is encouraged. With ample opportunities to learn new skills and advance within the organization, our team members are given the tools to learn and grow their careers.

What will you do?

 

  • Lead Generation: Call on local small to medium sized businesses to show the value of our suite of digital media advertising products from social media, display, video, programmatic, SEO/SEM to traditional advertisements. You will generate new leads through cold calling, networking, and prospecting, as well as staying aware of any new businesses opening in the area. You will own the sales cycle and will have the support of your local account management team to aid in continued support after the sale!
  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on our digital and print products/services. The first three weeks of hire, you will be provided with both global and local training to be fully educated before even going out on your own! You will also have full support throughout your career which includes continual learning and training to grow and achieve success as an Account Executive.
  • Execute sales tactics: Implementing marketing strategies, delivering effective sales presentations with passion to consistently earn, retain and increase revenue.
  • Advertising Solutions: Create engaging advertising solutions to solve clients’ business needs.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executives/AE, Senior AE and Strategic AE’s – Connecticut 

Location: Connecticut- Hybrid/Field-Based- (Fairfield, New Haven, Meriden, Waterbury)

Company: Hearst Connecticut Media Group (CTInsider.com)

Join Our Sales Team in Connecticut

Hearst Connecticut Media Group is seeking several driven and digitally-savvy Account Executives to help deliver powerful advertising solutions to local, regional and state businesses across Connecticut. This is more than a sales job—it’s a chance to grow your career with a forward-thinking, tech-enabled media company that values innovation, collaboration, and your professional success.

Why Hearst Connecticut Media Group?

  • Exclusive AI Tools to elevate your performance
  • Hybrid flexibility to build relationships in the field while balancing remote work
  • A culture of growth where your ideas and impact are recognized
  • Uncapped commission with competitive base pay

What You'll Do

  • Own the Sales Cycle: From cold outreach to closing, you'll consult with businesses to deliver custom print and digital media campaigns.
  • Manage Book of Business: You’ll be assigned existing clients who trust their marketing to Hearst Connecticut Media Group. You will work closely to insure we are delivering for our clients as well as upselling them with additional solutions to strengthen further our relationships.
  • Build Client Relationships: Serve as a trusted marketing advisor by understanding client goals and recommending solutions across a host of solutions including; Content Marketing, SEO, display, social media, programmatic, print and more.
  • Drive New Business: Prospect new leads through networking, cold calling, email campaigns, and community engagement.
  • Leverage Cutting-Edge Tools: Use advanced sales platforms like ChatGPT Enterprise and Gong.io to increase efficiency, improve messaging, and shorten your sales cycle.
  • Collaborate for Success: Work closely with account managers and internal teams to ensure seamless campaign execution.
  • Track Performance: Manage your pipeline and forecasting in Salesforce, ensuring accurate revenue projections and reporting.

AI-Powered Onboarding & Continuous Training

From day one, you’ll be supported by personalized AI tutors and coaching tools designed to help you succeed faster.

  • Interactive onboarding led by ChatGPT Enterprise adapts to your learning pace and role-specific needs
  • Gong.io provides real-time sales conversation insights and coaching to sharpen your pitch and identify improvement areas
  • Access self-guided modules and bite-sized coaching tips throughout your career—so you’re never without support
  • Learn to craft stronger proposals, handle objections more effectively, and close deals faster using real-time data

This isn’t just training—it’s on-demand development built into your daily workflow.

What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years of business-to-business sales experience, preferably in media, advertising, or marketing
  • A successful history of meeting or exceeding revenue goals
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or equivalent experience preferred

Our Benefits: At Hearst Connecticut Media Group we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

Apply now to launch your next chapter as a trusted media partner to businesses across Connecticut.

job.title: Apprentice Pressperson
job.description:
$1,000.00 Sign-on Bonus!

The Times Union is seeking a reliable, conscientious, and mechanically adept person interested in entering a four-year apprenticeship program to become a Journeyman Offset Pressperson in their Albany, NY production operation. If hired, you will work with an experienced, close-knit team responsible for maintaining and operating a state-of-the-art KBA Commander CL press that produces the Times Union, 14 other daily newspapers, fourteen weeklies, three monthlies, and numerous commercial print publications in a high quality and cost-effective manner.

•    Interest in learning a trade that consistently produces high-quality print products.
•    Detail-oriented with a focus on meeting deadlines and customer expectations.
•    Well-developed verbal communication skills.
•    Comfortable with computers and learning how to use them to operate printing presses.
•    Technical knowledge/mechanical aptitude in other production environments helpful.
•    Understands the importance of equipment maintenance and enjoys same.
•    Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
•    High school diploma or equivalent.

Hours: Hours and days can vary based on training and production needs. The normal shift length is 7-1/4 hours. Day shifts currently begin at 10:15 a.m. and evening shifts start at 5:45 p.m.

Pay: Starting pay is $22.43/hour for the first year. As an apprentice progresses and acquires required knowledge and skills, the pay rate increases in steps until full Journeyman status is acquired, usually within 4 years.

Sign-on Bonus: Receive $500.00 after 90 days and $500.00 after 6 months of satisfactory employment.

 

The Times Union is located in New York’s Capital Region. We offer great pay, substantial benefits and the ability to live in a beautiful area of the country. Our commitment to multiculturalism, inclusion and anti-racism is reflected in our content, hiring strategies and culture. We encourage members of underrepresented communities to apply, and all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

 

Interested applicants should contact Darrell Foster, Production Director, at 518-454-5744 or via email at dfoster@timesunion.com

job.title: Audience Editor, Chron
job.description:
Audience Editor

Chron | Houston, TX

Full-time | Digital • Audience • Social • Video

Chron is chasing Texas-sized audience growth. We need an editor who knows how to make sharp journalism travel farther—across social platforms, search, newsletters and video—while building deeper, more direct relationships with Texans who come to Chron for news, culture and everyday curiosity.

 

Chron’s next Audience Editor will drive great content to new heights both on- and off-platform, grow our most loyal audience and find ways to reach new ones. The ideal candidate has read Chron, understands the brand—sharp, fresh and unmistakably Texan—and brings a strategic-first mindset with the hands-on fluency to execute. This role is the connective tissue between editorial ambition and audience reach.

job.title: Deputy Photo Editor
job.description:
Deputy Director of Visuals, San Antonio Express-News

 The deputy director of visuals helped to lead daily operations of the department to ensure an audience-driven focus on informative and engaging photography and videos, with a mission to increase engagement and enhance the visual quality of our digital and print news reports. The position reports to the regional director of visuals, Michel Fortier.

Major daily responsibilities: 

  • Edit visual content for quality, accuracy and relevance across platforms.
  • Coordinate scheduling and logistics for daily assignments and breaking news.
  • Collaborate across departments to seek out visual opportunities.
  • Help manage and coach visual journalists.
  • Coordination with the audience team on initiatives to build audience. 
  • Daily presentation of visuals in the afternoon budget meeting
  • Editing of video projects as needed


Attributes needed for success: 

  • Audience-first mentality, willingness to experiment with new story forms to promote digital audience engagement with print as a secondary element.
  • Understanding of social media as a tool to increase our reach, emphasizing work which puts audience growth first
  • Editing ability for both daily, short and long-term projects for digital and print.  
  • Sense of urgency and the ambition to win the 24/7 news cycle on digital platforms
  • Ability to work effectively under deadline pressure.
  • Adherence to journalistic ethics.
  • Knowledge of communications law as it applies to photography.
  • Working knowledge of photo software programs such as Photoshop, Premiere Pro and Photo Mechanic.
  • A passion for journalism that elevates and motives others. 


Requirements: 

  • Hybrid, 40 hours a week, with four-day-per-week in-office requirement.
  • Some weekend, evening and holiday work will be required.
  • A minimum of 3 years of visuals experience within a news organization. 
  • Previous supervisory experience is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, photography, video or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be substituted.
  • Ability to edit video on deadline when needed.

 

About the San Antonio Express-News

The Express-News is the third-largest daily newspaper in Texas and the only daily in San Antonio. It serves a metro area of 2.5 million people. By one name or another, it traces its roots back to 1865. Over the past three years, the paper has reorganized to focus on digital journalism and substantially increased the audience for its subscriber website, ExpressNews.com. Over the same period, the Express-News has won a George Polk Award, two IRE (Investigative Reporters and Editors) Awards, and numerous regional and state journalism prizes.

It is part of Hearst, a diversified global media, services and information business. Hearst Newspaper Group includes the Express-News, the Houston Chronicle, the Austin American-Statesman, the San Francisco Chronicle, the Albany Times Union and other daily and weekly papers.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.
