job.description:
Director of Finance

The Houston Chronicle is seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Finance to help lead financial operations for one of Hearst Newspapers' most important local media businesses. This role is ideal for a finance leader who combines strong technical accounting judgment with business curiosity, operational discipline, and the ability to translate financial results into clear recommendations and strategy.

Reporting to the VP of Finance, the Director of Finance will oversee key close processes, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, advertising accounting and analysis, and cost control activities while partnering closely with department leaders, centralized accounting teams, and senior leadership. The position requires a leader who can manage the details, improve processes, develop people, and support decision making across a fast-moving and transforming digital and print media operation.

What You Will Do
  • Own the monthly close process, including accruals, variance analysis, review of financial results, and timely completion of close deliverables.
  • Lead weekly P&L reporting, monthly financial reporting, forecasting, and business review support for the VP of Finance, Houston Chronicle leadership, and Hearst Newspapers finance teams.
  • Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial reporting, with clear communication of revenue, expense, margin, headcount, and payroll trends.
  • Manage and develop the finance/accounting team, including advertising-focused accounting support and related operating analysis.
  • Oversee advertising accounting activities, including revenue recognition, digital advertising margins, commission processing, goaling, and coordination with advertising operations.
  • Lead advertising analytics and KPI reporting, including trends and insights to support the VP of Finance, VP of Advertising and Publisher.
  • Develop and monitor financial KPIs that help leaders understand performance, optimize product P&Ls and advertising margins, improve budget adherence, and identify cost savings opportunities.
  • Partner with department heads to project, budget, and monitor expenses, improve business processes, and strengthen accountability for financial outcomes.
  • Serve as a liaison with centralized accounting teams for accounting functions such as balance sheet reconciliations
  • Assist internal and external audit support in partnership with centralized accounting, including maintenance of internal controls and SOX compliance requirements.
  • Provide technical accounting guidance and support system improvements, reporting enhancements, process automation, and AI-enabled efficiency opportunities.
  • Optimize AI opportunities to automate daily and monthly reporting and improve process workflows. 
  • Prepare ad hoc analysis, special projects, and executive-ready reporting for senior leadership, the VP of Finance, and the Publisher.
Key Relationships
  • Vice President of Finance
  • President and Publisher, Houston Chronicle
  • Senior Vice President of Advertising
  • Executive Editor and senior leadership across functions
  • Hearst Newspapers finance and centralized accounting teams
  • Department heads and operating leaders across the organization
What You Bring
  • 8-10+ years of progressive finance or accounting experience, preferably in a complex operating environment.
  • Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required; MBA preferred.
  • Prior experience as a Director of Finance, Finance Manager, Assistant Controller, or comparable financial leadership role required.
  • Strong technical accounting foundation with experience in monthly close, financial reporting, accruals, variance analysis, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, and audit support.
  • Experience with advertising accounting and revenue recognition, digital margins, commission processing, or media revenue operations preferred.
  • Experience in media, publishing, digital media, marketing services, or a related industry preferred.
  • Proficiency with ERP, planning, and reporting systems; Oracle ERP, Oracle Cloud, Hyperion Planning, business intelligence tools, advanced Excel experience, and AI products preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop finance or accounting team members, including team members who support multiple business partners.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain financial results and business implications to non-finance leaders.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong process improvement mindset, including interest in automation, AI-enabled tools, and scalable ways to improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • High integrity, sound judgment, and a service-oriented approach to working with internal and external partners.

 

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.  

Be a part of something bigger – your headline awaits.

We will only respond to inquiries concerning requests for a reasonable accommodation through this email address.

job.title: Director, Marketing Operations
job.description:
Job Summary

The Director, Marketing Operations is responsible for the operational strategy, execution, reliability, and advancement of the platforms and processes that power Hearst Newspapers' digital subscription marketing strategy. This role leads day-to-day marketing technology operations across Sailthru, BlueConic, Casper, subscription rates and offers, data integrations, and platform quality assurance, ensuring the marketing technology stack operates reliably while continually improving how Marketing uses technology, data, AI, and automation. This is a centralized role supporting nine markets, with responsibility for building consistent, scalable processes and capabilities across the portfolio.

 

The ideal candidate is a technically fluent marketing operations leader who combines deep hands-on marketing technology experience, strong data and systems thinking, and disciplined operational leadership. This person will manage a distributed team of four and serve as a key bridge between Marketing and Product, Business Intelligence, Editorial, Finance, Customer Service, and technology vendors - translating marketing needs into clear requirements, identifying new capabilities and opportunities, and driving adoption across marketing and newsrooms.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Marketing Operations team, managing workload, performance, priorities, and professional development while establishing clear ownership, service levels, operating rhythms, and accountability.

  • Own the Marketing Operations intake and prioritization process, evaluating incoming requests, allocating team capacity, managing tradeoffs, and keeping stakeholders aligned on timing, scope, and dependencies.

  • Own day-to-day marketing technology operations across Sailthru, BlueConic, Casper, and any other future platforms, including platform administration, workflows, audience segmentation, campaign activation, personalization, troubleshooting, documentation, governance, and scalable execution across markets, with particular responsibility for supporting Marketing and newsroom teams in their use of Sailthru.

  • Ensure operational reliability across recurring marketing processes, integrations, audience and data flows, rates and offers, tracking, and platform capabilities; proactively monitor for issues, diagnose root causes across systems, and partner with BI, Product, and vendors on resolution and safeguards.

  • Oversee email operations across newsletters, lead generation, acquisition, retention, and other lifecycle communications, including audience selection, campaign/template setup, scheduling, suppression logic, deployment, and operational readiness. Partner closely with marketing and newsroom teams to strengthen newsletter capabilities, workflows, and best practices.

  • Manage the operational setup and governance of checkout and cancellation flows, subscription rates, pricing configurations, and promotional offers, partnering with Finance, Marketing, Product, and Customer Service to ensure accurate implementation across customer experiences.

  • Serve as Marketing's close partner to the Product Director and as the primary Marketing-to-technology translator: turn loosely defined business problems and ideas into clear functional, data, and operational requirements; support prioritization, ideation, implementation, testing, and rollout; and translate technical capabilities, constraints, and tradeoffs into practical marketing implications and opportunities.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to expand Marketing's capabilities through existing or new technology, data, AI, automation, and self-service. Assess business value and operational feasibility, reduce manual work and handoffs, enable appropriate self-service, and move the strongest opportunities from concept to implementation while maintaining governance and human oversight.

  • Manage marketing technology vendors, including relationships, contracts, renewals, platform performance, issue resolution, roadmap alignment, and service levels. In partnership with Product and technical stakeholders, represent Marketing in evaluating prospective technology and assessing capabilities, gaps, integration needs, and tradeoffs against business requirements.

  • Lead capability rollout and adoption across Marketing and newsrooms by translating new functionality into usable workflows, documentation, training, governance, and operating practices; establish rigorous QA and change-management standards to ensure capabilities are implemented accurately and sustainably.

 

Qualifications & Skills

  • Significant experience in marketing operations, marketing technology, lifecycle marketing, CRM, or digital subscription operations, including experience leading teams and managing complex cross-functional workflows.

  • Strong hands-on experience directly configuring and troubleshooting marketing technology platforms, including customer data platforms, email/CRM platforms, audience segmentation, automation, personalization, business rules, and campaign activation; BlueConic and Sailthru experience are strongly preferred.

  • Strong technical fluency across marketing technology ecosystems, including data integrations, APIs and data feeds, audience schemas, identity and profile data, tracking, campaign logic, platform dependencies, and data flows between marketing platforms and enterprise data environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose marketing technology and data issues, trace problems across systems and data flows, identify likely root causes, and partner effectively with BI, Product, Engineering, and vendors on resolution.

  • Strong data and systems literacy, including the ability to interpret data schemas, understand field-level logic and transformations, validate outputs, translate business needs into precise technical and data requirements, and assess upstream and downstream dependencies; familiarity with SQL or similar data-querying concepts is strongly preferred.

  • Strong experience with email and newsletter operations, including supporting both Marketing and newsroom use cases, segmentation, lifecycle campaigns, automation, deployment workflows, deliverability considerations, and identifying and implementing new platform capabilities and best practice.

  • Experience managing checkout or monetization platforms, subscription pricing, rates, promotional offers, or comparable configuration-driven customer subscription programs.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, partner effectively with Product and technical teams, evaluate technology capabilities and tradeoffs, and drive adoption of new tools and functionality across non-technical users.

  • Proven people-management experience, ideally leading remote or distributed teams, with strong coaching, prioritization, stakeholder management, communication, and accountability skills.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI, automation, and self-service approaches to improve operational workflows, QA, speed, and team capacity while maintaining appropriate governance and human oversight.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong problem-solving and operational judgment, and the ability to balance business urgency with platform integrity, data quality, scalability, and sustainable processes in a fast-moving environment.

 

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.
  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

 

This position does not provide sponsorship. All applicants should have the right to work in the U.S. without immigration sponsorship.

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York, NY. The reasonable estimate is $150,000 - $160,000. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

job.title: Director, Programmatic Ad Sales
job.description:
Position Summary

Hearst News is Hearst’s unified programmatic team across Hearst Newspapers and Television, bringing premium local news, lifestyle, sports, entertainment, and video supply across Web, App, and CTV together in a single omnichannel marketplace. As Director, Programmatic Ad Sales, you will help define and execute the commercial strategy for this growing business, translating the scale and quality of our owned-and-operated inventory into meaningful outcomes for agencies, brands, and trading desks.

This is a senior sales leadership role for a modern programmatic seller who can move fluidly between strategy and execution. You will build trusted relationships with senior agency and brand stakeholders, create demand for Hearst News’ differentiated supply, develop direct and curated opportunities, and help clients understand how our premium content, first-party signals, addressability, contextual intelligence, and cross-screen reach can work together in a cohesive activation. You will also lead and develop a sales team, with a focus on coaching, operational excellence, accountability, and building lasting customer trust.

Reporting to the SVP, Programmatic Strategy, you will collaborate across Sales, Strategy & Operations, Technical Ad Management, Analytics, Product, Data, and Marketing. You will bring a strong point of view to the market, create clarity for internal partners, and translate customer insight into scalable commercial opportunities. This is an opportunity to help shape the next phase of Hearst News’ growth and define how advertisers access premium, omnichannel supply at scale.

What You'll Do

Commercial Strategy & Revenue Growth

  • Own and execute a growth strategy across national agencies, brands, holding-company trading desks, and programmatic buying teams.

  • Develop new business and expand existing relationships through programmatic direct, private marketplace (PMP), preferred, programmatic guaranteed, and curated deal opportunities.

  • Position Hearst News as one premium, omnichannel marketplace spanning local and national audiences across Web, App, and CTV.

  • Build a disciplined pipeline with clear account priorities, business hypotheses, revenue potential, and next steps.

 

Agency, Advertiser & Partner Leadership

  • Build trusted relationships with agency investment teams, programmatic leads, data and activation teams, and senior brand stakeholders.

  • Lead consultative conversations that connect client objectives to Hearst News' inventory, audience, data, and measurement capabilities.

  • Create compelling solutions that combine display, video, and CTV supply with addressable audiences, contextual signals, suitability controls, and first-party data where appropriate.

  • Represent customer needs internally and ensure that opportunities move from discovery to proposal, activation, optimization, and renewal with strong ownership throughout.

 

Omnichannel Product & Market Expertise

  • Stay current on the programmatic ecosystem, including DSP and SSP dynamics, identity, privacy, CTV, data collaboration, supply-path efficiency, measurement, and evolving buyer expectations.

  • Translate Hearst News' capabilities into clear, differentiated narratives for sellers and buyers, including our premium O&O supply, audience scale, addressability, contextual and suitability solutions, and cross-divisional packages.

  • Partner with Strategy & Operations, Technical Ad Management, Analytics, Product, and Data to align pricing, packaging, inventory allocation, deal execution, and performance insights.

  • Bring the voice of the customer into product development and help identify the next opportunities to improve our commercial proposition.

 

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate across Hearst News and broader Hearst teams to create larger, more integrated opportunities for advertisers.

  • Work closely with technical and operational partners to troubleshoot issues, improve the buyer experience, and protect campaign performance.

  • Coach and develop junior sellers, establish strong sales operating habits, and contribute to a culture of accountability, curiosity, and shared ownership.

 

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience in programmatic advertising, digital media, publisher sales, ad technology, or a related commercial role, ideally 5+ years in a selling role.

  • A strong understanding of programmatic buying and selling, including PMPs, curated supply, direct deals, audience activation, and the agency decision-making process.

  • A proven record of building senior agency and advertiser relationships and converting those relationships into durable revenue.

  • The ability to sell both the strategic story and the operational details, from market positioning and packaging through deal setup, delivery, and optimization.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and organizational skills, with a bias toward action and follow-through.

  • A collaborative leadership style and the ability to create momentum across teams in a changing, cross-divisional environment.

  • A deeper understanding of CTV inventory is also a plus.

 

Why Hearst News?

You will join a team building a more connected, data-informed, and buyer-friendly way to access Hearst's premium owned-and-operated news supply. Hearst News combines the trust and local relevance of Hearst Newspapers with the reach and premium video capabilities of Hearst Television, giving advertisers a differentiated omnichannel platform with meaningful scale and quality. This role offers the opportunity to shape the commercial strategy, influence product direction, and help define what modern programmatic advertising looks like at Hearst.

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.

  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.

  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.

  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.

  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.

  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.

  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.

  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

 

This position does not provide sponsorship. All applicants should have the right to work in the U.S. without immigration sponsorship.

 

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York, NY. The reasonable estimate is $165,000 - $169,000. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

job.title: Distribution Assistant
job.description:
Distribution Assistant - Houston Chronicle

Join a team that is dedicated, customer centric, able to adapt to change and enjoys working in the field making sure customers are receiving the best experience in a fast-paced environment.

Assist Distribution Managers Areas of responsibility include home delivery, single copy, third party distribution of the Houston Chronicle along with several third-party distribution partner contracts. The Distribution Assistant may also receive work assignments within many areas of the distribution function, which may include transportation, customer service, and redelivery operations.  This position may be full time or part time. 

What will you do?

  • Ensure compliance with independent contractor agreement; recommend corrective action for violations.
  • Monitor delivery of all products distributed by contractors within the delivery area.
  • Assume delivery responsibilities for open routes when necessary.
  • Contact customers with service-related problems; Work with Distributors and independent contractors to resolve service issues in a timely and permanent manner.
  • Verify the accuracy of information submitted by independent contractors.
  • Monitor and assist in delivery of customer issues such as missed, damaged, or late delivered papers.
  • Regularly attend departmental meetings to maintain a cohesive, well-informed unit.
  • Assist other departments as necessary.
  • Regularly communicate progress and concerns to supervisor.
  • Prepare requested reports in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Periodically audit routes to evaluate service performance and route structure efficiency. 
  • Actively recruit independent contractors.
  • Ensure that the distribution center is maintained in a safe, secure, and clean manner.
  • Other essential duties and tasks as assigned.

 

What will it take to be successful?

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Ability to adapt and react to change.

  • Some Computer skills using Outlook, Word, and Excel. Ability to learn 3rd Party programs such as RouteSmart.

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule.

  • Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license, and proof of auto liability insurance.

  • Ability to lift, push and pull up to 75 pounds.

  • Ability to frequently climb stairs.

  • Standing – 50% of the time.

  • Walking – 50% of the time.

  • Kneeling – 25% of the time.

  • Hearing – 100% of the time. 

  • Depth Perception – 100% of the time. 

 

The Houston Chronicle serves Houston’s 2.3 million residents — as well as all of Texas — with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites, HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our newspaper and magazine brands. The content and innovative business solutions we provide invite readers to join conversations about communities we’ve been helping prosper for more than 120 years.

The Houston Chronicle is a division of Hearst Newspapers (HNP) 

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.

job.title: District Manager
job.description:
Are you a night owl who wants a well-paid position with benefits? The Times Union is looking for a District Manager to service the many customers of our newspaper and our partners in New York's Capital Region. APPLY TODAY!

What You'll Do:

  • Provide excellent service to Times Union, New York Times and other home delivery customers.
  • Manage and administer formal Requests for Proposal (RFP) and Independent Contractor proforma’s as applicable within assigned region(s).
  • Identify and execute regional best practices and assist in identification and execution of cost containment strategies.
  • Provide input into budgets and capital submissions for assigned region(s).
  • Prepare, analyze, and execute substantive contracts and renegotiation requests.
  • Measure and audit contract service metrics for each Independent Business/Contractor as related to the Delivery Service Agreement. 
  • Work directly with the Distribution Director to determine whether to extend or terminate contractual relationships with independent contractors, distributors, and wholesalers.
  • Works closely with staff and Commercial Partners to ensure 3rd Party data accuracy, billing and returns. 
  • Interacts with Independent Contractors and single copy partners to ensure timely and accurate submission of single copy returns. 
  • Interfaces with Independent Contractors to reduce escalated complaints and poor service stops. 
  • Manages Independent Contractor service levels and DQI in accordance with Home Delivery Service Agreement. 
  • Manage distribution of product to independent contractors in an efficient manner at the warehouses.
  • Interact with customers to determine best means of customer satisfaction, complaint resolution and delivery efficiency.
  • Ensure that all routes and all products are delivered by their specified deadline.  When a route is not covered, deliver route(s) to ensure maximum customer satisfaction when necessary.
  • Practice safe working habits in all working environments.
  • Other duties assigned and as needed.

What You'll Need to Succeed: 

  • High School Diploma with 1-3 years relative experience.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including nights, weekends and holidays.
  • Computer skills such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, NCS, touch-typing and internet services.
  • Proficiency in contract administration, negotiation, and compliance.
  • Ability to prepare and analyze contracts in an effective and error-free manner.
  • Analytical ability to manage contract performance metrics and complete departmental level reporting. 
  • Work effectively across departments, including Operations, Field Services, Customer Care, Newsroom and Sales. 
  • Work closely with Management to ensure all leased facilities are maintained in the appropriate condition and costs are minimized. 
  • Ability to manage budgets and identify opportunities for cost savings and optimization.
  • Ability to respond to frequent demands of multiple customers (internal and external).
  • Strong interpersonal skills. Must be very customer focused and must be a team player willing to help when and where needed.
  • Strong ability to troubleshoot, think forward to identify potential issues, and formulate responsive plans.     
  • Strong conflict management skills.
  • Ability to work in multiple different environments. Warehouse, driving/field work, office settings, etc.
  • Ability to lift, push and pull up to 75 lbs.

  • MUST HAVE a valid driver’s license, operable vehicle, and current proof of automobile insurance. 


     

District Managers begin their workday at or about 12:30 AM., weekends included. The work week is generally 37.5 hours per week; two consecutive days off each week, except OT for Holidays, and any needed circumstances. Hours and days are subject to change and may vary as the job warrants; mandatory overtime may be required. Extra pay comes with night and weekend work; two-and-a-half times pay for holidays, and time and a half for OT. Additional benefits include a monthly cell phone stipend, and a $100 quarterly auto-use bonus. Annual base pay is $51,928.50, with potential to grow. 

The Times Union manages home delivery for several newspapers in Eastern New York. This is a union position with benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid vacations, sick leave and personal time; pension; tuition assistance. 

You must list your job history in your application, or attach a resume, in order to be considered. Proof of valid NY Drivers' License and auto insurance required.

The Times Union offers great pay, substantial benefits and the ability to live in a beautiful area of the country. Our commitment to multiculturalism, inclusion and anti-racism is reflected in our content, hiring strategies and culture. We encourage members of underrepresented communities to apply, and all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

job.title: General Assignment Reporter/Staff Reporter
job.description:
Reporter, The Beaumont Enterprise

Tell the Stories That Matter Most to Your Community

Your work can make a real difference here.

In a smaller market, local journalism is personal. It’s about more than headlines — it’s about helping a community stay informed, feel connected, and understand the people and issues shaping daily life.

At Hearst Newspapers and The Beaumont Enterprise, we’re looking for a curious, driven Reporter who wants to do meaningful work in a place where strong journalism truly matters. This is an opportunity to be at the center of a community’s conversations — covering breaking news, uncovering important stories, and building trust with the people you serve.

If you’re energized by local reporting, excited to be part of a collaborative newsroom, and motivated by the idea of making a visible impact, we want to hear from you.

The Role

As a Reporter, you’ll cover the stories, people, and issues that matter most in the community. You’ll report on breaking news, attend meetings and events, build local sources, and develop enterprise stories that add depth and accountability.

In a smaller market, this role is both important and highly visible. You won’t just be filing stories — you’ll be helping readers understand what’s happening around them and why it matters.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is naturally curious, comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, and excited to be deeply connected to the community they cover.

What You’ll Do

Cover the community with urgency and purpose

  • Report on breaking news, local developments, and key community issues
  • Attend meetings, events, and public forums to stay close to the story
  • Write quickly and clearly across digital and print while balancing daily production with longer-term reporting and follow-up.
  • Prioritize and move stories forward independently, knowing when a story requires a quick digital report, a follow-up, or deeper reporting

Develop strong, meaningful local coverage

  • Build a broad, diverse network of reliable sources and consistently develop new relationships beyond official spokespeople and press releases.
  • Generate original story ideas and pursue reporting beyond official sources.
  • Produce enterprise stories that go beyond the daily headline
  • Develop expertise in an assigned subject and geographic area, becoming a reliable source of news and information in them.

Help strengthen the local news report

  • Collaborate with editors, photographers, and other newsroom teammates
  • Contribute story ideas and bring energy to daily coverage planning
  • Use digital tools, social media, and audience insights to better reach readers
  • Comfortable creating video and social content, with a strong instinct for stories that will resonate on digital platforms.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism or related field required 
  • Newsroom reporting experience with strong news writing skills and familiarity with AP style.
  • Strong reporting, interviewing and newsgathering skills, with sound news judgment and the ability to work effectively under deadline.
  • Curiosity, initiative, and a genuine interest in local communities
  • Comfort with digital storytelling and audience-focused journalism
  • A willingness to spend significant time outside the newsroom building relationships, attending community events and finding stories where people actually live and work

You ask good questions.
You build trust.
You understand that local stories can have lasting impact.

Why This Role Matters

In a smaller market, the connection between a newsroom and its community is immediate and real.

Your reporting can inform residents, spotlight issues that deserve attention, and help people feel more connected to where they live. This is a chance to do journalism that is seen, felt, and valued — and to grow your career in a role where your work has everyday relevance.

If you believe local journalism still matters deeply, this is the kind of role where you can prove it.

Our Commitment to You

At Hearst Newspapers, we support our employees through professional development and comprehensive wellbeing benefits, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Competitive retirement plan with matching
  • Generous paid time off and paid parental leave
  • Dependent care reimbursement
  • Mental wellness support
  • Inclusive healthcare benefits
  • Pet wellness reimbursement

Apply

Ready to tell stories that matter where it matters most?

Submit your resume, cover letter, and writing samples.

Your next story starts here.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP represents a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories–growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms–to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired. 

Be a part of something bigger–Your Headline Awaits

 

About the Beaumont Enterprise

The Beaumont Enterprise is a daily newspaper in Southeast Texas that most recently won 56 awards from the Press Club of Southeast Texas’ annual contest. Beaumont is a place to grow with a team of committed journalists, who have covered everything from the explosion of a petrochemical plant to catastrophic storms and everything in-between.

Beaumont also is close to the Gulf of Mexico, along a river and between Houston and Louisiana.

The Enterprise, which is Southeast Texas’ oldest business, is a part of Hearst Communications, which notably has been investing in its properties while media companies across the nation have been cutting.

We understand the value of bringing everyone to the table, particularly individuals from traditionally underrepresented communities. As a result, the company has put together a series of goals to improve representation across departments and levels. Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people of marginalized communities.

job.title: Packaging Assistant, Part Time (Nights)
job.description:
Packaging Assistant - Part Time

Hearst Midwest Media has an opening for a Part Time Packaging Assistant on the Evening shift, Sunday- Friday. This position requires feeding pre-prints into an Inserting machine, inject-mailing, and postal distribution. Hearst Michigan Newspapers prints 4 Dailies and Weeklies owned by Hearst, plus a variety of Commercial Printing. We are seeking an individual with high standards in quality, maintenance, and crew leadership. Shifts are Sun to Fri, 5 PM to 1 AM, three nights per week.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

job.title: Senior Audience Producer
job.description:
About Hearst Connecticut Media Group

Hearst Connecticut Media Group is the state’s largest local news organization. Through CT Insider’s websites and app, as well as newsletters, social media, audio and print, we deliver ambitious, useful journalism to audiences across Connecticut.

We are committed to reaching readers wherever they are, building lasting relationships with local communities and investing in journalism that informs and engages the people we serve.

The Opportunity

Hearst Connecticut Media Group is hiring two innovative, collaborative Senior Audience Producers to help shape how our journalism reaches, engages and retains local audiences.

Each Senior Audience Producer will serve as an audience-strategy partner to editors and reporters across one or more topic teams. Coverage areas may include data, state politics, investigations, education, business, real estate, high school sports and UConn sports.

This is a hands-on newsroom role for someone who combines strong editorial judgment with audience analytics, platform expertise and an experimentation mindset. You will help teams understand audience behavior, identify coverage opportunities, optimize journalism across platforms and responsibly evaluate emerging tools - including AI - under HCMG’s editorial standards.

Working closely with the broader audience team, you will help increase engagement, reader loyalty, subscriptions and return visits while supporting high-impact local journalism.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with editors, reporters, photographers and audience team members to develop and execute audience strategies for assigned coverage areas.
  • Use audience data to identify opportunities, evaluate performance and inform short- and long-term coverage decisions.
  • Translate analytics into clear, actionable recommendations for newsroom colleagues with varying levels of data experience.
  • Optimize stories and other journalism for websites, search, social platforms, newsletters and additional distribution channels.
  • Develop effective headlines, framing, packaging and promotional strategies while maintaining editorial accuracy and integrity.
  • Apply topic-area knowledge and audience insights to identify story ideas, recurring coverage opportunities, content series and annual special projects.
  • Coordinate across departments during breaking news and planned events to ensure audiences receive timely, accurate updates across platforms.
  • Create or edit multimedia assets, including video, photography and audio, to strengthen storytelling and distribution.
  • Test new formats, tools and audience-development approaches, measure their effectiveness and share lessons with the newsroom.
  • Help newsroom teams assess and use AI-supported tools responsibly, transparently and in accordance with editorial policies.
  • Support a newsroom culture that values experimentation, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong editorial judgment and experience working in a deadline-driven newsroom or comparable publishing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to use analytics to guide editorial, distribution or audience development decisions.
  • Experience optimizing journalism for websites, search, social media and newsletters.
  • Excellent writing, editing and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain data and audience insights clearly to editors, reporters and other stakeholders.
  • Experience creating or editing multimedia content using tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Premiere or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to build effective working relationships across teams.
  • Comfort troubleshooting technical or workflow challenges in a fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule when coverage requires it, including occasional nights and weekends.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant coverage areas, such as data, politics, investigations, sports, education, business or real estate.
  • Experience planning or producing livestreams, podcasts or other recurring audience-focused programming. One of the two openings may have a stronger emphasis on these formats.
  • Experience contributing to audience growth, subscription conversion or reader-retention initiatives.
  • Familiarity with newsroom AI policies, responsible experimentation or emerging publishing technologies.
  • A bachelor’s degree in journalism, English, communications or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.

Benefits

At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family):

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • A resume
  • A cover letter explaining your interest in the role
  • Relevant work samples or clips
  • Nonconfidential examples or summaries of audience strategies, social campaigns, newsletters, video work, or other relevant projects. 
  • Please do not submit confidential or proprietary materials belonging to a current or former employer.
  • This role is based in Norwalk, Connecticut and is not eligible for remote candidates.

job.title: Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement
job.description:
Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement

The Houston Chronicle is seeking a Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement to lead the next chapter of our digital strategy.

This senior leader will oversee efforts to grow and deepen audiences for the Houston Chronicle across video, engagement and conversation, social platforms, emerging platforms, local trends and trending content. The role will help transform viewers, listeners, readers and commenters into loyal fans of our journalism—and build meaningful relationships with audiences across Houston.

We’re looking for someone who is deeply curious about audiences: what they need, how they discover information, what makes them return and how journalism can better serve them. This leader should be able to articulate a clear, actionable philosophy for digital growth and translate that philosophy into newsroom strategy, daily operations and measurable results.

This is a hands-on role for a creative, data-informed and operationally minded digital leader who is comfortable with experimentation, change and scale. The successful candidate will understand that the audience strategies that worked in the past will not be enough for the future. As search traffic declines and platform and consumer habits continue to evolve, this leader will help us build new ways for audiences to discover, engage with and depend on our work.

This is an opportunity to bring your vision to a senior leadership team boldly reimagining what local news can be. You will help make the Houston Chronicle a powerhouse of digital journalism—one that serves all of Houston and remains essential for years to come.

As a member of the newsroom’s senior leadership team and masthead, the Senior Director of Audience Growth and Engagement will help shape strategy across the organization. This role reports to the editor-in-chief and oversees teams focused on video, audience growth and engagement, local trends and trending content, and social media.

You’ll join our news organization at a pivotal moment.

The Medill School at Northwestern recently named our newsroom a Bright Spot in Local Journalism. The American Press Institute recently included us in a creators cohort, and we wrote about our experiences innovating with creators. We were named the Best Newsroom in Texas for 2026 and were finalists for ONA Awards for innovative journalism and INMA’s Global Media Awards for newsroom innovation.

Some newsrooms are talking about change. We’re actually changing. Join us.

The Responsibilities

  • Lead audience growth and engagement strategy across platforms, formats and content teams.

  • Develop new strategies for audience discovery and loyalty as search declines and traditional content distribution models evolve.
  • Help the newsroom move beyond legacy content strategies by identifying new opportunities in video, audio, social, newsletters, communities, emerging platforms, creators and other forms of audience connection.
  • Articulate a clear point of view on digital growth and turn it into actionable plans, priorities and operating practices.
  • Coach teams and ideas with metrics at the forefront of decision-making; establish goals, evaluate performance and use audience data to guide experimentation and investment.
  • Build strategies that move audiences from casual discovery to sustained engagement and loyalty.
  • Understand how to grow fans on different platforms and operationalize effective tactics across the newsroom.
  • Lead and support experimentation, taking smart risks and learning quickly from what works and what doesn’t.
  • Embrace AI across the organization to help journalists with their work, improve audience understanding and drive innovation.
  • Work collaboratively with the managing editor of news and strategy to oversee the daily operations of the newsroom.
  • Champion inclusive reporting that reflects the diversity of Houston, with strategies and journalism designed to serve communities—not simply report about them.
  • Demonstrate collaborative, creative and transformational leadership centered on learning, strong journalism and innovation.
  • Push the organization to bring new approaches to old problems and explore new platforms, possibilities and audience relationships.

  • Partner across editorial, product, technology, marketing, analytics and business teams to align audience strategy with the organization’s broader goals.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will bring:

  • Significant experience leading audience growth, engagement, digital strategy or a related function in a news or media organization.

  • A strong understanding of how audiences discover, consume and engage with journalism across platforms.
  • Experience developing new growth strategies in a rapidly changing digital environment
  • Proven track record of developing viewership around franchise shows and YouTube strategy
  • A track record of using data, experimentation and audience insights to improve reach, engagement and loyalty.
  • Experience leading, coaching and developing multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong editorial judgment and a deep respect for journalism and public service.
  • Comfort working across strategy and execution, with the ability to move from a big-picture vision to daily operational decisions.
  • A creative, entrepreneurial mindset and enthusiasm for emerging platforms, technology and AI.
  • A commitment to inclusive journalism and serving the full breadth of Houston’s communities.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

To Apply

As part of your cover letter, please explain your philosophy of audience growth and engagement. Please also share specific examples of how you have driven digital growth and built meaningful relationships with new readers, listeners or viewers, particularly through strategies that went beyond traditional search or legacy distribution models.

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.  

Be a part of something bigger – your headline awaits.

We will only respond to inquiries concerning requests for a reasonable accommodation through this email address.

job.title: Texas A&M Reporter
job.description:
The Houston Chronicle is looking for a digitally savvy reporter to cover Texas A&M and one of the most passionate fan bases in college sports. This is a role for a journalist who understands that Aggie athletics is more than scores and press conferences. It’s a year-round online conversation shaped by recruiting drama, fan reaction, coaching speculation, traditions, memes, social media and the rapidly changing business of college athletics.

 

We’re looking for someone who can move quickly, spot stories before they fully break and connect with audiences wherever they are — including social platforms, YouTube and video. The ideal candidate understands internet culture, thrives in a competitive news environment and knows how to turn complicated college sports developments into smart, accessible journalism that fans want to read, watch and share.

 

This reporter will cover Texas A&M athletics with urgency, creativity and authority, helping shape one of the Chronicle’s most visible and audience-driven coverage areas.

Key responsibilities

  • Deliver timely, audience-focused coverage of Texas A&M athletics that goes beyond game recaps and press conferences
  • Break news on recruiting, coaching changes, NIL developments, conference shifts and the evolving business of college sports
  • Identify and cover trending conversations, fan reactions and online moments shaping the Texas A&M community
  • Live-blog football and key volleyball, baseball and softball games
  • Produce smart analysis and explainers that help readers understand major stories and developments in college athletics
  • Collaborate with video and audience teams to create video content for social platforms, YouTube and Chronicle platforms, including quick reactions, explainers and analysis
  • Use analytics, search trends and audience insights to guide coverage decisions and identify opportunities for growth
  • Write and produce a Texas A&M newsletter
  • Collaborate with photographers, videographers, editors and audience strategists to create engaging, multiplatform storytelling
  • Build sourcing across the athletic department, the college sports landscape and the Texas A&M community
  • Travel as assigned for major games, SEC events and key coverage opportunities

We’re looking for someone who

  • Has three to five years of relevant sports reporting experience, ideally covering college athletics or another highly competitive, audience-driven beat
  • Understands the culture of college sports fandom and how online communities shape conversations around teams and athletes
  • Is comfortable reporting quickly and accurately in a fast-moving digital news environment
  • Has strong instincts for social storytelling, audience engagement and identifying stories that fans care deeply about
  • Is comfortable on camera and capable of creating compelling video explainers, reactions and analysis
  • Thinks creatively about storytelling formats and embraces experimentation across platforms
  • Is collaborative, audience-focused and committed to producing accurate, high-quality journalism under deadline pressure

Success is measured by

  • Breaking news and producing must-read coverage that stands out in the competitive college sports landscape
  • Growing audience engagement across platforms, including social, search, newsletters and video
  • Building a loyal readership among Texas A&M fans and broader college sports audiences
  • Creating content that consistently sparks conversation, drives sharing and strengthens the Chronicle’s presence in Texas college sports coverage
  • Helping readers better understand the culture, business and evolving future of college athletics

 

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • In-Depth knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes
  • Ability to apply expertise in a complex sales environment to service large accounts and/or complicated business segments
  • Confidence to prospect and quickly build rapport with customers, adapting messaging and style based on customer needs
  • Ease working with senior level executives and using influencing skills to negotiations and drive sales
  • Desire to stay abreast of emerging market trends and customer needs to expand relationships and trust
  • Confidence to solve complex problems using analysis, judgement and multiple sources of information
  • Accountability for your own work and a desire to provide guidance to new team members
  • Business development experience with new and existing customers

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. In addition to salary, this position is also eligible for commissions.


$100,000 - $125,000

                                                                             

Location:

Hartford, CT: 10 Columbus Blvd, 06106

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. What You'll Do:

You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

Utilize and position qualitative data, market data and competitive information to grow market share and revenue.

Research and develop new revenue for IHM stations.

Effectively communicate all components of sales to internal management.

Experience working with advertising agencies and large, Fortune 500 accounts

Problem solver with the ability to ‘think outside the box’.

Strong work ethic with a strong desire and passion for excellence.

job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service.  In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

The Financial Analyst, Corporate FP&A supports the company's enterprise-wide financial planning process including monthly actuals, budget, forecast, and Long-Range Forecast. This role partners closely with segment finance teams to consolidate results, analyze variances and margin trends, and prepare accurate, well-supported reporting for senior finance leadership

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Support the preparation and maintenance of the consolidated Income Statement, Cash Flow, and related schedules across Actual, Budget, Forecast, and Long Range Forecast (LRF) scenarios.

  • Partner with segment FP&A teams across the Multiplatform Group, Digital Audio Group, and Audio & Media Services to consolidate monthly and quarterly results and prepare Budget-vs-Forecast-vs-Actual variance analysis.

  • Build and maintain detailed revenue and expense models, including revenue trends, seasonal patterns, and other key business drivers.

  • Analyze consolidated and segment-level Adjusted EBITDA margins; investigate and clearly explain movement in cost of sales and operating expense trends.

  • Perform detail-level audits of financial models to confirm formula integrity and consistency before models are used for internal or external reporting.

  • Assist with the annual budget and periodic reforecast cycles, including templates, timelines, and consolidation across business units.

  • Identify and help implement opportunities to streamline and automate recurring reporting processes.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

  • 1–3 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, transaction advisory, or public accounting.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (complex formulas, financial modeling, pivot tables) and strong PowerPoint proficiency.

  • Excellent analytical and organizational skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present financial information clearly to non-finance audiences.

  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines and shifting priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Experience with Workday ERP and/or SQL or Power BI is preferred.

  • Experience in media, advertising, broadcasting, or another advertising revenue driven industry is preferred.

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Accountability for own work and desire to provide guidance to new team members
  • Ability to contribute to several projects at the same time under a moderate level of direction
  • Application of objective judgement, technical skills and prior experience to solve business problems
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including a knack for explaining complex information in a straightforward manner
  • Desire for continued knowledge sharing and learning
  • Understanding of impact of own decisions

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.


$70,000 - $85,000
