  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

                                                                             

Location:

Cedar Rapids, IA: 600 Old Marion Road NE, 52402

Regular

Salaried

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • In-Depth knowledge of the media industry and related sales processes

  • Ability to apply expertise in a complex sales environment to service large accounts and/or complicated business segments

  • Confidence to prospect and quickly build rapport with customers, adapting messaging and style based on customer needs

  • Ease working with senior level executives and using influencing skills to negotiations and drive sales

  • Desire to stay abreast of emerging market trends and customer needs to expand relationships and trust

  • Confidence to solve complex problems using analysis, judgement and multiple sources of information

  • Accountability for your own work and a desire to provide guidance to new team members

  • Business development experience with new and existing customers

What We Need:

We are seeking a highly motivated Payroll Operations & Payroll Tax Specialist to join our payroll team. This unique role will split responsibilities between Payroll Operations and Payroll Tax, providing support across both functions daily.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, adaptable, and eager to learn established processes while working collaboratively with a tenured team. This position requires someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is comfortable managing changing priorities, and values accuracy, teamwork, and continuous learning.

This role requires an individual who can effectively balance responsibilities across Payroll Operations and Payroll Tax throughout the day. The successful candidate must be comfortable shifting between payroll processing, employee support, tax compliance activities, vendor coordination, and issue resolution while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

Success in this role begins with understanding and executing current processes, building strong relationships, and becoming a trusted member of the team. This role offers opportunities for professional growth and expanded responsibilities as business needs evolve.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

Payroll Operations

  • Support end-to-end payroll processing activities.
  • Review payroll data for accuracy and compliance.
  • Audit payroll reports and resolve discrepancies.
  • Process adjustments, corrections, and off-cycle payroll requests.
  • Assist with payroll inquiries from employees and internal partners.
  • Support payroll balancing and reconciliation activities.
  • Maintain payroll documentation and process controls.

Payroll Tax:

  • Support payroll tax compliance activities across federal, state, and local jurisdictions in a multi-state, multi-FEIN environment.
  • Research and respond to payroll tax notices and agency inquiries.
  • Partner with the payroll tax vendor to support accurate and timely tax filings, payments, and account maintenance.
  • Review payroll tax data and filings for accuracy and assist in resolving discrepancies when identified.
  • Assist with year-end payroll tax activities, including W-2 review and validation processes.
  • Research payroll tax issues and partner with internal and external stakeholders to resolve concerns.
  • Maintain payroll tax records, registrations, and supporting documentation.
  • Monitor regulatory changes and communicate potential impacts to payroll processes and compliance requirements.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Strong knowledge of payroll processing principles and payroll tax regulations.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency with payroll systems and Microsoft Excel. Workday experience is a plus.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Multi-state payroll experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting payroll processes in a multi-FEIN environment preferred.
  • Experience working with a third-party payroll tax vendor preferred.
  • Experience working in a corporate environment is preferred.
  • CPP certification is a plus.

The successful candidate will:

  • Demonstrate a willingness to learn and understand existing processes and procedures.
  • Respect established practices while building knowledge and credibility within the team.
  • Develop positive working relationships with an experienced and tenured group of payroll professionals.
  • Remain flexible and productive when priorities shift or unexpected challenges arise.
  • Demonstrate ownership and accountability while leveraging the knowledge and expertise of team members when needed.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, supportive, and positive team culture.
  • Exhibit adaptability and a willingness to jump in wherever needed to support the team and business.
  • Thrive in an environment where change is constant and the ability to stay calm, organized, and solutions-focused is critical.
  • Demonstrate the ability to quickly shift priorities and seamlessly pivot between Payroll Operations and Payroll Tax responsibilities throughout the day, balancing competing demands while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and excellent customer service.
  • Take initiative, demonstrate sound judgment, and consistently deliver high-quality results.
  • Show a commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and process improvement.
  • Enjoy being hands-on in payroll operations and payroll tax activities.
  • Demonstrate a strong customer-service mindset and commitment to supporting employees and business partners.
  • Demonstrate the ability to manage details and maintain accuracy across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and payroll tax requirements.
  • Work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • Full proficiency and understanding of job function

  • Open communication with colleagues and direct reports that encourages collaboration and team consensus

  • Strong problem solving skills

  • Efficiency with independent work under minimal guidance

  • Commitment to process improvement for overall team effectiveness

  • Professional communication that stresses diplomacy, empathy and patience

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
KATZ Radio Group

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

As the nation’s largest media representation firm, Katz Media Group delivers local relevance at scale. Whether you want one idea that sounds local in a hundred different markets or a hundred unique ideas, we have your solution.

Over our long history, the Katz name has been synonymous with leadership in the media industry. Founded in 1888, Katz was the nation’s first media representation firm. Today, Katz Media Group is comprised of two divisions, Katz Radio Group and Katz Television Group. Collectively, the company represents both the on-air and online assets of more than 4,000 radio stations and 800 television stations, making Katz Media Group the largest media representation company in America. In addition to our deeply rooted media expertise, our unique regional sales structure is key to driving our clients’ success. Katz Media Group is based in New York City, with 15 regional offices across the country, providing advertisers and agencies with local expertise and insights across the nation.

Be a part of the largest media representation company in America. At Katz Media Group, we have the best, brightest and boldest talent in the media industry — individuals who deliver unparalleled value for our business partners and clients. We are looking for people who can grow, think, dream and achieve. Every employee brings inspiration and imagination to our constantly evolving and expanding business. If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At Katz Media we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                              

What We Need:

At Katz Media Group, we strive for success and support our teams that are dedicated to excellence in client service. You’ll play a vital role in helping our sales teams deliver on our mission to super-serve our clients and listeners. You’ll be the operational backbone that ensures our sales process runs smoothly, efficiently, and with heart.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Support Account Executives in the pre-sale and post-sale process, including proposal development, order entry, campaign tracking, and reporting. 

  • Coordinate with internal departments (traffic, production, digital, promotions) to ensure flawless execution of campaigns across radio, digital, podcast, social, and event platforms. 

  • Prepare sales materials such as presentations, recaps, and client-facing documents using tools like PowerPoint, Salesforce, and internal systems. 

  • Monitor campaign performance and assist in compiling data for client reporting and renewals. 

  • Manage deadlines and deliverables to ensure all client expectations are met or exceeded. 

  • Serve as a liaison between sales, programming, and operations to ensure alignment and communication. 

  • Assist with billing and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and timely processing.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel and PowerPoint); Salesforce experience is a plus.

job.title: Promotions Coordinator
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service.  In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

At iHeartMedia, events are more than just moments—they’re a core pillar of our brand. With over  20,000 local and national events annually, our Promotions & Events teams play a critical role in shaping how audiences experience the power of audio in real life. As a member of the team, you’ll be at the heart of this mission—bringing our stations, talent, and clients to life through unforgettable experiences.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Support the planning and execution of local events and promotions that align with station branding and client objectives, including concerts, community activations, and live broadcasts.

  • Coordinate logistics such as venue setup, staffing, signage, giveaways, and technical needs. 

  • Collaborate with Sales, Programming, and Marketing teams to develop integrated promotional campaigns that drive listener engagement and revenue. 

  • Serve as on-site lead during events, ensuring smooth execution and representing iHeartMedia with professionalism and positive energy. 

  • Engage with listeners and clients to create memorable brand interactions and gather feedback. 

  • Maintain promotional inventory and ensure all materials are prepped and transported as needed. 

  • Support digital and social media efforts by capturing content and promoting events across platforms. Track and report on event performance, including attendance, engagement, and client satisfaction. 

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. 

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable engaging with the public and clients. 

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as needed for events. 

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with social media platforms and content creation tools is a plus. 

  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation required.

  • Strong organization with excellent communication skills.
  • Bilingual (English & Spanish) a plus.
  • Must be available nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft office.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

  • Ability to work within standardized procedures and an understanding of when to escalate
  • Skills to solve straightforward problems using established procedures
  • Close attention to detail, following up until issues are resolved
  • Common courtesy when communicating with coworkers and outside contacts

As an Accountant, “crunching the numbers” is how people describe what we do, but if you’re looking for an Accounting opportunity that allows you to have a unique level of ownership and impact, iHeartMedia is the place for you. We are looking for accountants who are decision makers, strategic partners, problem solvers, have a growth mindset and desire to understand the “why.” While terms like “month-end close,” “accounts payable,” “accounts receivable,” and “journal entries” are common in job descriptions and resumes, they only scratch the surface of what we do. At iHeartMedia, these tasks are part of a much bigger story—one defined by ownership, innovation, and impact.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Work directly with the Accounting Team in close collaboration with our Finance partners to transform financial data into actionable information and insights.

  • This position has full P&L responsibility for the lines of business they support, including recording and reviewing standard and non-standard accounting transactions, explaining variances to forecast and budget, able to identify opportunities for improvement, and work with the finance team to identify business risks and opportunities.

  • Owner of complex balance sheets reconciliations, including preparing executive summaries, reviewing balance sheet reconciliations prepared by iHeartMedia Staff Accountants, and proactively working open items to resolution to ensure the balance sheet is correct.

  • Connect the dots between transactions and their impact on the P&L and balance sheet.

  • Identify and communicate opportunity areas to supervisors while also proposing solutions.

  • Provide internal and external audit support, compiling documentation, coordinating efforts with both financial and non-financial resources, and ensuring audit documentation is complete and demonstrates an adequate audit trail.

  • Assist in preparing footnote disclosures and supporting schedules for Corporate Accounting.

  • Participate in special projects and cross functional teams.

  • Develop expertise in iHM’s accounting systems to effectively and efficiently process and mine financial data.

  • Develop subject matter expertise on different areas assigned.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting and 5+ years of relevant accrual-based accounting experience required.

  • Advanced skills in Excel including advanced formulas, pivot tables and v-lookup functions in order to manipulate large data sets.

  • Financial systems experience (COGNOS, NetSuite, Peoplesoft, etc.).

  • Able to effectively communicate across multiple levels of the organization, both written and oral.

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • Full proficiency and understanding of job function

  • Ability to work independently with minimal guidance

  • In-depth knowledge of key business drivers and how this impacts your team

  • Experience in team and project management for mid-sized projects

  • Ability to recognize and mitigate risk

  • Confidence to solve complex problems using multiple sources of information

  • Growth mindset and desire for continued knowledge sharing and learning

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Ability to identify new opportunities for continued improvement across business

  • Comfort acting as a trusted advisor for colleagues with less experience

  • Ability to manage complex and confidential information and to influence others to build consensus across all levels

The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As a Sr. Automotive Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.

  • Ability to interact with Automobile dealers, their agencies, and Tier Two dealer group representatives

  • Ability to speak the language of automobile dealers

  • Comfort in being in front of Dealer owners on a weekly basis

  • A love and passion for Auto

  • Build a book of business that consistently produces budget-beating results through prospecting, presenting, and closing integrated marketing solutions plans..

  • Ability to ask and close business for significant budgets.

  • Exhibit experience with prospecting and developing client business relationship.   

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

What We Need:

iHeartMedia is seeking a strategic, results-oriented Senior Director, Ad Tech & Data Partnerships to lead the development, growth, and execution of key demand-side platform (DSP), retail media, audience data, identity, and measurement partnerships across the company's audio ecosystem.

Reporting to the SVP of Advanced Audio and Data Revenue, this role will be responsible for driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships with major DSPs, data providers, agencies, retail media networks, clean room partners, identity solutions, and measurement companies. The Sr. Director will serve as a subject matter expert on programmatic audio, audience targeting, attribution, and emerging ad tech solutions, while collaborating across Sales, Programmatic Operations, Product, Marketing, and Business Development teams.

The ideal candidate combines deep ad tech expertise with strong commercial acumen and a passion for advancing iHeartMedia's position as a leader in audio advertising.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

DSP & Ad Tech Partnership Management

  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with key DSP and SSP partners including The Trade Desk, Magnite, DV360, Yahoo DSP, Amazon DSP, StackAdapt, Viant, Freewheel Buyer Cloud, Blis, and other emerging platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to increase programmatic demand, unlock new buying capabilities, and accelerate revenue growth across existing and newly-identified DSPs and buying platforms.
  • Negotiate partnership agreements and joint business plans with platform partners.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between DSP partners and iHeartMedia's internal teams.
  • Lead sales engagements across retail and commerce media networks to align iHeart’s solutions with RMN inventory and measurement needs.

Data & Audience Solutions

  • Build and expand relationships with audience data providers, identity resolution partners, clean room providers, and attribution vendors.
  • Evaluate and onboard new audience targeting, measurement, and data enrichment capabilities.
  • Drive adoption of first-party data activation strategies and privacy-compliant audience solutions.
  • Develop scalable audience products leveraging iHeart's data assets and partner ecosystems,

Industry Leadership & Market Development

  • Represent iHeartMedia at industry conferences, agency events, and partner meetings.

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

The Senior Financial Analyst, Corporate FP&A supports the company's enterprise-wide financial planning process including monthly actuals, budget, forecast, and Long-Range Forecast. This role partners closely with segment finance teams to consolidate results, analyze variances and margin trends, and prepare accurate, well-supported reporting for senior finance leadership and executive management. 

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Support the preparation and maintenance of the consolidated Income Statement, Cash Flow, and related schedules across Actual, Budget, Forecast, and Long Range Forecast (LRF) scenarios.
  • Partner with segment FP&A teams across the Multiplatform Group, Digital Audio Group, and Audio & Media Services to consolidate monthly and quarterly results and prepare Budget-vs-Forecast-vs-Actual variance analysis.
  • Build and maintain detailed revenue and expense models, including revenue trends, seasonal patterns, and other key business drivers.
  • Analyze consolidated and segment-level Adjusted EBITDA margins; investigate and clearly explain movement in cost of sales and operating expense trends.
  • Support preparation of materials for lenders, rating agencies, and the Board of Directors, including debt schedules and leverage ratio analysis.
  • Perform detail-level audits of financial models to confirm formula integrity and consistency before models are used for internal or external reporting.
  • Assist with the annual budget and periodic reforecast cycles, including templates, timelines, and consolidation across business units.
  • Prepare ad hoc analyses, board decks, and presentations for senior finance and executive leadership.
  • Identify and help implement opportunities to streamline and automate recurring reporting processes.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, transaction advisory, or public accounting.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (complex formulas, financial modeling, pivot tables) and strong PowerPoint proficiency.
  • Solid understanding of financial statements, GAAP, and core corporate finance principles.
  • Excellent analytical and organizational skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present financial information clearly to non-finance audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines and shifting priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Master's degree in relevant field or CPA designation.
  • Experience with Workday ERP and/or SQL or Power BI is preferred.
  • Experience in media, advertising, broadcasting, or another advertising-revenue-driven industry is preferred.

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Full proficiency and understanding of job function
  • Ability to work independently with minimal guidance
  • In-depth knowledge of key business drivers and how this impacts your team
  • Experience in team and project management for mid-sized projects
  • Ability to recognize and mitigate risk
  • Confidence to solve complex problems using multiple sources of information
  • Growth mindset and desire for continued knowledge sharing and learning
  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions
  • Ability to identify new opportunities for continued improvement across business
  • Comfort acting as a trusted advisor for colleagues with less experience
  • Ability to manage complex and confidential information and to influence others to build consensus across all levels

Compensation:


Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in office administration, sales operations support and employee coordination, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a media environment. This position plays a key role in supporting the sales team processes, coordinating traffic and accounting activities, and assisting with local HR initiatives. Success in this role requires excellent organizational skills, professionalism, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving.  As a trusted member of the leadership support team, the Office Manager will contribute to the overall success of the market by ensuring seamless office operations, supporting cross-functional departments, and helping maintain a positive and productive workplace culture.

 Accounting:

Help coordinate all accounts receivable functions, including client billing, collection of payments, credit card processing, and banking tasks.

Assist with any local Vendor matters as may be required by accounting for prompt processing of all invoices and vendor payments

Partner with the Sales Management Team to oversee review of aging reports, assist with timely collections, and conduct follow-up on outstanding advertising accounts.

Organize, maintain, and reconcile trade agreements and ticket inventory, ensuring all trade documentation meets internal audit standards and FCC requirements where applicable.

Provide accounting support during month-end close cycles and periodic audit requirements.

Execute sales order entry for local, regional, and national broadcast accounts— serving as a key support to the Sales Manager and liaison to traffic department.

Input and manage commercial traffic instructions for all levels of client accounts, ensuring accurate placement and timing within program logs.

Prepare and distribute pre-logs, post-logs, and affidavits for client campaigns across all markets, maintaining compliance with client expectations, agency standards, and industry regulations.

Coordinate with offsite Business Office as may be needed to maintain accurate and timely financial records and reporting

Office Management:

Oversee general office operations, including supplies, equipment, front desk tasks, and vendor relationships.

Coordinate facility maintenance, mail distribution, and office cleanliness.

Support senior management with administrative tasks, scheduling, and internal communications as needed.

Assist with the monthly collection of rent from tenants and follow up on outstanding balances as needed.

Assist with additional duties, projects, and tasks as requested by the General Manager and General Sales Manager.

Human Resources:

Serve as a liaison between market and corporate HR.

Facilitate local implementation of company-wide HR initiatives, training sessions, and compliance meetings.

Support diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts, including EEOC documentation and reporting.

Proven experience as an Office Manager, HR Coordinator, or similar administrative role.

Strong understanding of general HR practices, employment law, and office operations.

Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

High level of confidentiality and professionalism.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and HRIS systems preferred.

Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Human Resources, or related field preferred.

job.title: Part-Time/Relief On-Air Personality
job.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Legendary 95.5 KLOS is seeking an experienced and engaging Part-Time/Relief On-Air Personality to provide on-air coverage as needed. This position will primarily provide coverage for regularly scheduled on-air personalities due to vacations, holidays, illness, leaves of absence, and other programming or operational needs.

The ideal candidate is a polished, versatile broadcaster who can step into various dayparts, connect authentically with the KLOS audience, and deliver compelling content consistent with the station's sound and brand.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide live or pre-recorded on-air coverage as assigned by the Program Director or station management.

  • Deliver engaging, authentic, and entertaining on-air content consistent with the KLOS brand and programming direction.

  • Prepare topical and relevant show content using current events, music, entertainment, online resources, and social media.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of rock music, the KLOS audience, and relevant pop-culture and entertainment news.

  • Operate the studio control console and station automation systems.

  • Execute contests, promotions, station imaging, and other programming elements according to station specifications.

  • Contribute content for digital, social media, and other station platforms as requested.

  • Attend station events, remote broadcasts, promotional appearances, or client appearances when scheduled.

  • Follow all FCC regulations, EAS requirements, station procedures, and Company policies.

  • Work collaboratively and professionally with Programming, Promotions, Engineering, Digital, Sales, and other station personnel.

  • Maintain a positive and cooperative attitude within the station and when representing KLOS in the community.

  • Perform other job-related duties and on-air assignments as required.

     

     

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Degree in mass communications, broadcasting, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional broadcast experience.

  • Previous professional on-air radio experience strongly preferred.

  • Strong knowledge and understanding of rock music and its influence on entertainment and pop culture.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop compelling, topical, and original on-air content.

  • Experience operating radio automation systems, studio equipment, VoxPro, Adobe Audition, or similar broadcast software preferred.

  • Experience creating content for social media and digital platforms.

     

     

REQUIRED SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Dynamic, natural, and authentic on-air communication style.

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Ability to adapt quickly to different shifts, dayparts, and programming needs.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to work independently with limited preparation time when necessary.

  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven broadcast environment.

  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with on-air personalities, producers, entertainers, clients, and station personnel.

  • Social media and digital content proficiency.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office applications.

     

     

SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY

This is a part-time/relief position. Assignments will be offered and scheduled on an as-needed basis based on station coverage and operational needs. Hours will vary, and there is no guarantee of a minimum number of hours or shifts in any workweek.

Coverage opportunities may include vacations, holidays, illness, leaves of absence, and other programming needs. Flexibility to accept assignments across various dayparts, including weekdays, weekends, holidays, early mornings, and evenings, is preferred.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Work location: Burbank, California.

  • Must have authorization to work in the United States.

  • Must be willing to submit to a background investigation.

  • Valid driver's license and state-mandated automobile insurance may be required for assignments involving Company business or station appearances.

  • This position is represented by SAG-AFTRA and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

  • Compensation will be provided in accordance with the applicable SAG-AFTRA collective bargaining agreement and Company practices.

     

     

    Meruelo Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Payroll Specialist
job.description:
Title: Payroll Specialist

Reports to: Payroll Manager

 

At Meruelo Enterprises, we’re building more than infrastructure, we’re building communities, careers, and a better tomorrow.

Founded in 1986 and proudly minority-owned, we’ve grown into one of California’s leading construction and engineering firms, serving major utility, transportation, and telecom clients across the West Coast. With a talented team of over 2,500 professionals and a family of top-tier subsidiaries, we deliver innovative, high-impact solutions in gas, electric, water, and more.

From the ground up, we’re committed to safety, quality, and integrity. If you're looking to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven company making a real difference, welcome to Meruelo Enterprises.

 

About the Role:

Meruelo Enterprises located in the city of Downey, CA is looking for a Payroll Specialist to timely process Company payroll and comply with all governmental and union regulations.

 

Key Responsibilities:

²  Enters timesheet and equipment information into the Company’s payroll system.

²  Reviews timesheet information for inconsistent or conflicting information. Follows up with Supervisors for resolution.

²  Reconciles payroll entries, corrections and transfers of labor and equipment when necessary.

²  Ensures all required paperwork is received on a timely manner.

²  Prepares manual checks as needed.

²  Responds to inquiries from various governmental agencies

²  Prepares and submits certified payroll in compliance with contracts

²  Prints and files various reports

²  Respond to employee issues related to payroll matters

²  Assists department in carrying out various human resources programs and procedures for all company employees.

²  Prepare monthly union reports

²  Other necessary and required duties as assigned.

 

Qualifications:

²  A high school diploma or GED equivalent is required.

²  Must have a minimum of (5) years’ experience processing payroll

²  Must have experience preparing union payroll reports and/or certified payroll reports.

²  Must have payroll experience working in the construction industry

²  A working knowledge of all federal, state and local tax filings is preferred.

²  A working knowledge of all federal, state and local payroll regulations is preferred.

²  A working knowledge of processing union payroll and compliance matters is preferred.

²  A working knowledge or certified payroll and labor compliance is preferred.

²  General knowledge of the various disciplines and procedures utilized by the Construction industry is preferred.

²  Ability to stay focused and work without close supervision.

²  Works well in a team environment as well as independently.

²  Ability to accurately enter data and perform mathematical calculations.

²  Able to adjust priorities on short notice, manage interruptions and work well under pressure.

²  Ability to timely meet deadlines; coordinate workloads with Supervisor.

²  Effective communication, organizational and problem-solving skills.

²  Complies with and maintains company confidentiality practices and policies.

 

At Meruelo, we believe that diverse teams drive innovation and better business outcomes. We are dedicated to fostering a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

job.title: Associate Producer - Local Media Game Production
job.description:
WORK OPTION

The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week. _________________ Associate Producer, Local Media Game Production (NABET)

Position Summary

The Associate Producer, Local Media Game Production, supports live NBA game broadcasts and related programming by managing production assets, coordinating content delivery, and ensuring broadcast-ready materials are available to game production teams. Reporting to the Game Production Lead, this role collaborates with internal departments and external production partners to maintain editorial, technical, and NBA brand standards while supporting efficient live game operations. Working in conjunction with the Local Game Production Supervisor, Producer, and onsite ATL Producer/Director team, the Associate Producer helps ensure production teams have timely access to the content, graphics, music, and other production assets necessary to execute assigned NBA broadcasts. This role serves as an important connection point across NBA content teams and game production teams, supporting content coordination and asset readiness across Local Media productions.

Major Responsibilities

Produce and distribute high-quality, shareable content aligned with NBA brand standards and relevant current and historical NBA storylines. Curate and package content for use across live broadcasts and related programming, ensuring required video and audio clearances are secured prior to content distribution. Coordinate the delivery, management, and distribution of music assets for live game productions, ensuring production teams have access to cloud-based music resources, receive necessary platform training, and maintain required onsite music assets. Perform quality control (QC) on video, audio, graphics, and other production elements to ensure materials meet established broadcast and production standards. Work with Advertising Sales and Traffic teams to support the maintenance, delivery, and quality control of sponsored graphic elements in accordance with established deadlines and production standards. Collaborate with Graphics teams to maintain, deliver, and quality-check graphic elements according to production schedules and broadcast standards. Support music licensing and related business operations by facilitating music requests, administering cue sheets, coordinating music clearances, validating third-party reporting, and tracking music budgets. Work cross-functionally across NBA content teams to identify daily content opportunities and opportunities to improve content-sharing efficiencies. Liaise with game production teams regarding newly created and available content relevant to their respective markets. Support the Local Game Production Supervisor, Producer, and onsite ATL Producer/Director team with content and production asset needs throughout pre-production and live game execution. Required Education/Professional

Experience

Bachelor's degree in Communications, Broadcast Journalism, Television Production, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional

experience

will be considered.

Experience

managing digital media assets, broadcast content, or production materials in a live production environment.

Experience

supporting content management and production operations.

Experience

working cross-functionally in a highly matrixed environment. Adobe editing proficiency and advanced content editing skills.

Experience

supporting live sports or broadcast production preferred.

Required Skills/Knowledge

Attributes Extensive knowledge of NBA teams, players, league storylines, historical context, and emerging digital and social media trends. Strong understanding of content and asset management within a live broadcast production environment. Diverse knowledge of music genres and an understanding of music workflows within a broadcast production environment. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple concurrent production needs. Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams and external production partners. job.title: Local Game Production Supervisor (Coordinating Producer)
job.description:
WORK OPTION

The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week. _________________

Position Summary

The Game Production Supervisor, Local Media, is responsible for coordinating and overseeing the planning and execution of live NBA game broadcasts and related programming across assigned Local Media productions. Reporting to the Game Production Lead, this role translates overall production strategy and editorial direction into consistent, high-quality game broadcasts, providing day-to-day production leadership from pre-production through live event execution and post-production review. Working closely with internal production teams, team and local broadcast partners, Studio Teams, Event Teams, Production Technology, Broadcast Engineering & Operations, Graphics, Programming, Distribution, Content Planning, and third-party vendors, the Game Production Supervisor ensures assigned productions meet established creative, editorial, technical, operational, and financial expectations. This role serves as a leader for assigned games and markets, with primary responsibility for editorial execution, production quality, budget and schedule oversight, and effective coordination among internal and external partners, while escalating broader strategic, stakeholder, or resource decisions to the Game Production Lead as appropriate.

Major Responsibilities

Oversee assigned live NBA game broadcasts and related programming from pre-production through live event execution and post-production, ensuring productions meet established creative, editorial, technical, and operational standards. Execute production strategy and editorial priorities established by the Game Production Lead and Local Media leadership, translating direction into actionable game plans, rundowns, schedules, staffing needs, and production workflows. Provide editorial leadership for assigned productions, coordinating storylines, content priorities, talent needs, graphics, replay, sponsored elements, and other game presentation components with internal and external production teams. Lead day-to-day communication with studio teams and other production partners regarding content and talent availability, daily schedules, production requirements, and special requests. Manage production quality, schedules, and budget performance for assigned remote and centralized productions; identify variances, risks, and resource needs and escalate material issues to the Game Production Lead. Coordinate with Programming, Content Planning, Advertising/Sales, Graphics, Production Operations, Distribution, and Broadcast Engineering & Operations to ensure production deliverables, integrations, and technical requirements are aligned and executed accurately. Build and maintain strong working relationships with team production staff, local broadcast partners, freelance personnel, production vendors, and other third-party partners supporting assigned broadcasts. Liaise with contracted and third-party vendors as needed, including coordination of services, deliverables, production expectations, and issue resolution within approved plans and budgets. Lead pre-production meetings, production rehearsals, game-day coordination, post-game reviews, and operational debriefs for assigned productions to drive continuous improvement and consistency. Identify opportunities to improve production workflows, editorial execution, operational efficiency, and broadcast quality across Local Media productions, and partner with the Game Production Lead on longer-term enhancements. Advance in-game storytelling and broadcast presentation through effective use of production tools, emerging technology, alternate production approaches, and new workflows consistent with Local Media strategy. Mentor and provide day-to-day guidance to producers and production personnel supporting assigned broadcasts, fostering collaboration, accountability, strong editorial judgment, and consistent execution. Experience

Bachelor's degree in Communications, Broadcast Journalism, Television Production, Media Production, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional

experience

will be considered. Five or more years of progressively responsible

experience

producing live sports television broadcasts, including

experience

in a coordinating producer, senior producer, or equivalent production leadership role.

producing and overseeing live sports broadcasts in fast-paced environments, including responsibility for multiple productions, markets, or game assignments.

Experience

managing production schedules, budgets, staffing, and production resources for live or remote productions.

Experience

working with internal production teams, local or regional broadcast partners, vendors, and cross-functional technical and content teams.

Experience

with REMI, centralized production, IP-based production, or cloud-enabled production workflows preferred.

Attributes High level of expertise producing compelling live sports broadcasts, with strong knowledge of NBA game production, storytelling, and presentation. Extensive knowledge of NBA teams, players, league operations, historical context, and current storylines. Strong editorial judgment and demonstrated ability to shape content and make effective production decisions under live broadcast deadlines. Strong understanding of live sports production workflows, including producing, directing, replay, graphics integration, production coordination, and remote/centralized production operations. Financial and operational awareness, including

experience

managing production budgets, schedules, vendors, and resources within established parameters. job.title: Account Executive (Local Ad Sales), The California Post
job.description:
Job Description :

California Post is a brand-new digital-first news organization backed by the trusted legacy of the New York Post. Our mission is to deliver breaking news, compelling storytelling, and innovative content to readers across the West Coast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing team, shape the future of a newsroom, and help advertisers connect with a highly engaged audience.

We are looking for a hungry, results-driven local Ad Sales Account Executive to join our Los Angeles team. This individual contributor role will be responsible for driving new business, managing client relationships, and delivering revenue growth for California Post, with a strong focus on local and regional advertisers. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in media sales, deep local market knowledge, and understands how to prospect, negotiate, and close deals in a competitive marketplace.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a sales strategy to drive revenue growth across digital advertising, sponsorships, and brand partnerships, with an emphasis on local and regional accounts.
     

  • Identify, prospect, and secure new clients across key local verticals, including Tier 2 automotive, casinos and gaming, real estate, hospitals and healthcare systems, legal services, and other local service-based businesses.
     

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local advertisers, agencies, and key regional stakeholders.
     

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing and editorial, to craft integrated, custom advertising solutions tailored to local market needs.
     

  • Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, RFP responses, contract negotiations, and post-sale account management.
     

  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipelines, and CRM data.
     

  • Stay up to date on industry trends, competitors, and emerging opportunities to effectively advise clients and position California Post as a trusted local media partner.
     

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years of advertising sales experience, preferably within media or digital news organizations.
     

  • Demonstrated success selling to local or regional advertisers, ideally across verticals such as automotive, gaming, real estate, healthcare, or professional services.
     

  • Proven ability to prospect, close deals, and consistently exceed revenue targets.
     

  • Strong network of media and advertising contacts in the Los Angeles market.
     

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
     

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
     

  • Ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail.
     

  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed.
     

Note: This role is primarily based in our Los Angeles office. Occasional remote work may be permitted, with the expectation of on-site presence for core team collaboration and client-facing activities, excluding external sales meetings or required travel.

Compensation: $100,000 - $125,000 Base + commission/sales bonus plan. A final decision on the successful candidate's starting salary will be based on a number of factors, including but not limited to competitive market practice, internal equity, experience, tenure, and essential skills.

job.title: Associate Commerce Editor
job.description:
Job Description :

About The Post: The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment, pop culture and shopping, with wit, irreverence and authority across print, digital, video, audio, app and commerce.


The Role: We’re hiring an Associate Commerce Editor for the revenue-generating commerce team. This is not a business reporting role. In this dynamic, expanded position, you will balance daily writing with foundational editing responsibilities, serving as a critical bridge between our reporting and editing desks. You will be responsible for writing a minimum of two short-form deal stories per day, continuing to publish fast, useful shopping stories that drive revenue and taking ownership of editing daily deals, updating evergreen posts and stepping up to manage larger packages when needed.


This role is ideal for a prolific commerce reporter ready to hone their editorial judgment, refine their packaging skills and take on emerging leadership responsibilities across the New York Post Digital Network.


What You’ll Do:
● Write a baseline of 2–3 commerce stories per shift (deals, explainers, how-tos and buyer’s guides) that drive conversions, ensuring consistent daily revenue-generating output.
● Edit 15+ fast-turn deals and standard shopping content daily from reporters. Move copy from draft to live with speed, ensuring clean formatting, airtight affiliate linking and FTC compliance.
● Take point on executing sponsored content and flat-fee product placements, seamlessly weaving revenue-driven partnerships into daily coverage while maintaining reader trust and the iconic Post voice.
● Step in to report, write or co-edit larger, high-priority features and tentpole packages
(Prime Day, Black Friday, Cyber Week) as assigned by leadership.
● Share ownership of the evergreen strategy. Audit and update top-performing posts for price, stock and SEO/AEO/GEO optimization to maximize long-tail revenue.
● Write sharp, on-brand headlines (providing 3-5 variants for testing). Begin providing actionable, constructive feedback to reporters to maintain voice and standards.
● Monitor performance dashboards to iterate headlines, framing and placement. Pitch high-intent stories based on search data, real-time signals and competitor coverage.

How We Measure Success:
● Output Balance: Consistent daily writing output (2–3 stories) combined with reliable, rapid editing of assigned copy and on-time handoffs.
● Quality & Accuracy: Clean copy (both written and edited), rigorous fact-checking, zero avoidable corrections and strict link hygiene.

● Impact: Measurable lift in CTR, conversion rates, revenue per session and search visibility for both authored and edited pieces.
● Ownership: Demonstrated progress in editorial decision-making, proactive pitching and the ability to seamlessly pivot between writing and editing mindsets.

What You’ll Bring:
● Professional experience commensurate with an associate-level role in features, news or commerce writing, backed by a portfolio of strong clips and early experience (or a demonstrated aptitude) for editing.
● Obsession with the commerce landscape, reader value and producing service-oriented content with a commercial focus.
● Command of the iconic NY Post voice and a proven track record of writing crisp, authoritative headlines.
● Working knowledge of SEO, AEO and GEO, plus social media best practices.
● Comfort reading dashboards (Search Console, GA4, Looker or similar) and using data to pivot quickly to trends or live news without losing accuracy.
● CMS fluency and sharp attention to detail, including mastery of AP style and
FTC-compliant disclosures.
● A collaborative, growth-oriented mindset – highly organized, adaptable and ready to take on coaching responsibilities.

Nice to Have
● Hands-on familiarity with affiliate dashboards and networks (Amazon Associates, Skimlinks or similar), project management platforms and SEO tools.
● Experience jumping between categories and services that help shoppers protect value.
● Deeper understanding of AEO, GEO and AI overviews.
● Newsletter experience.

Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. This role will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic. EEO/Disabled/Vets
