job.title: Associate Producer - Schein Daily Sports Video Show
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post is the nation’s oldest newspaper with the youngest, most ambitious video department. We want to make our mark in digital video and create memorable work and new watching habits among our audience. The legacy of the great headlines conveys the attributes of our videos: bold, irreverent, judgmental, confident and clever. We want to make videos that surprise viewers. We seek someone who appreciates serious and quirky stories. Let’s talk! 

The New York Post video team is seeking an Associate Producer for “Schein Time” with Adam Schein, a new daily live sports show that is national in scope. This AP will play a key role in assisting all aspects of the daily production process and be responsible for creating compelling, shareable videos and disseminating the show across social platforms. These clips will help drive in tune-in and be content worth watching. 

The candidate we seek has deep knowledge of and interest in a wide range of sports, including NFL, MLB, NBA/WNBA, College Sports, NHL, emerging sports, gambling, fantasy, and current New York/California sports news.
  
Per our publication’s mantra, you agree that news doesn’t have to be boring and you appreciate the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones.  

This is an opportunity to join an iconic media brand as it continues exponential digital growth. The New York Post has garnered more than a billion video views across various platforms in the past year. 

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in all aspects of daily production for a nationally distributed live sports show

  • Produce compelling, shareable short-form video clips to drive tune-in and audience engagement

  • Lead the creation of thumbnails, headlines, and other visual/packaging elements optimized for digital and social platforms

  • Manage and execute interactive promotion of show content across social media channels

  • Socialize show clips strategically to maximize reach, viewership, and engagement

  • Ensure smooth day-to-day production workflows while juggling multiple simultaneous tasks

  • Collaborate with producers and team members to generate ideas and contribute to daily show brainstorming

  • Support the production of digitally native video content tailored to platform-specific audiences

  • Apply deep knowledge of sports—including major leagues, emerging sports, gambling, esports, and fantasy—to content creation and promotion

  • Identify and help elevate unconventional, entertaining, and newsworthy sports stories in line with the publication’s brand voice

 

QUALIFICATIONS: 

  •  Minimum 2 years of experience in a digital/sports newsroom environment

  • Encyclopedic sports knowledge including upstart sports, fantasy, and esports. 

  • Ability to pitch, produce, and script

  • Ability to polish on camera talent

  • Ability to work closely with internal stakeholders and reporters. 

  • Excellent communication and people skills

  • Experience creating video for social platforms like YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, X and more a plus 

  • Strong news judgment, track record of successful video production

  • Implement best practices for video metadata, thumbnails, and discovery on all videos

  • Fluency with key tools in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Photoshop, After Effects) also a plus. 

  • Familiarity with the New York Post and our writing style

  • Use web analytics to monitor audience engagement with our videos and strategize for growth on various platforms

  • Excited about new types of multimedia storytelling

  • Must enjoy working collaboratively and accurately in a fast paced but fun environment

  • Strong news judgment and attention to detail and journalistic values a must 


 

NEEDS:

·       Resume and cover letter. 

NOTE: This is an in-office 5 day a week job with occasional weekend and evening work.

job.description:
Job Description :

The California Post is seeking an Audience Development Specialist to help execute our audience optimization strategy as we expand to California. This role will report into the Senior Audience Development Manager (California Post), working closely with cross-functional teams. 

The Audience Development Specialist will play a key role in driving multi-platform discoverability, ensuring our journalism reaches the widest possible audience across search, video, social, and emerging AI-driven platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Work alongside the Sr. Audience Development specialist on audience optimization and discovery for tentpole events, ensuring optimized visibility across Google, YouTube, social, and AI-driven search.

  • Pitch trending, evergreen and planned content strategies that strengthen The California Post’s authority and multi-platform presence.

  • Contribute to optimization strategies for franchises, brand initiatives, and key content verticals, both on- and off-platform.

  • Support execution of optimization strategies for homepage, landing pages, and article templates to enhance discoverability, engagement, and conversions.

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders — including editorial, product, development, video, data, and marketing — to align audience strategies.

  • Conduct keyword and platform research to identify content gaps, emerging trends, and audience demand.

  • Monitor performance metrics, competitive benchmarks, and platform analytics to inform strategy and adjust in real time.

  • Participate in editorial meetings and contribute real-time optimization insights to shape coverage.

  • Conduct regular training sessions and audits to ensure best practices are embedded across the newsroom.
     

Qualifications:

  • At least 3 years of experience in SEO, audience development, or platform optimization within a newsroom or relevant digital media environment

  • Expertise in multi-platform optimization (Google, YouTube, emerging AI search engines; social media optimization experience a plus)

  • Experience using competitive SEO and analytics tools (SEMrush, Google Trends, Google Search Console, Google Analytics)

  • Understanding of the SEO industry and Google’s evolving web standards; proficiency in structured data/schema.org is a plus

  • Ability to balance priorities and thrive in a fast-paced start-up environment; experience in a California-based newsroom is a plus

  • Ability to be both a self-starter and team player; strong interpersonal and communication skills are required

  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail

This role is responsible for identifying, negotiating, and managing distribution and partnership opportunities across media platforms, publishers, and brand partners.

Strategic Distribution Partnerships

job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post delivers the best in News, Sports, Entertainment and Pop Culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

New York Post Data Labs is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Commerce Business Analyst to join our Data Science and Analytics team. In this role, you will be the dedicated analytics partner for the New York Post Commerce department. You will be responsible for providing insights that drive business growth by analyzing performance metrics, identifying trends, and optimizing our Commerce strategies. This is a crucial position for someone who is passionate about data and its power to inform strategic business decisions in a fast-paced media & Commerce environment.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Performance Monitoring: Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all affiliate marketing campaigns, including clicks, conversions, commission, and return on investment (ROI).

  • Data Reporting: Develop and maintain recurring reports and dashboards using business intelligence tools to provide clear visibility into performance for stakeholders.

  • Strategic Insights: Proactively identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities in data to provide actionable recommendations for improving affiliate program efficiency and profitability.

  • Forecasting & Modeling: Assist in building and maintaining models and forecasts to project future performance needs.

  • A/B Testing & Optimization: Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests to optimize landing pages, offers, and partner performance.

  • Data Partnership: Serve as a dedicated data partner to the Commerce Team, working closely with leadership to translate business goals into data strategy and deliver clear, actionable insights.

  • Data Integrity: Ensure the accuracy and reliability of all data sources, reporting, and analysis.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 2+ years of professional experience in data analytics within a publishing environment or affiliate marketing organization (publisher-focused experience strongly preferred).

  • Experience with a business intelligence platform (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).

  • Familiarity with affiliate tracking & Commerce business models, platforms and tools.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Business, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science) or equivalent professional experience. 

  • Demonstrated ability to perform in-depth analysis, draw conclusions, and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience with statistical analysis and data visualization.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with languages like Python & SQL for data manipulation and statistical analysis.

  • Proven experience working with large, complex datasets.

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Thinking: You're a problem-solver who can turn raw data into a compelling story.

  • Communication Skills: You can clearly and concisely explain complex data concepts to a variety of audiences.

  • Attention to Detail: You have an eye for precision and are committed to data accuracy.

  • Collaboration: You're a team player who can build strong relationships with stakeholders.

  • Proactive & Curious: You love to dig into data and are always looking for ways to improve performance.

The ideal candidate will bring a built-in network, a proven book of business, and experience selling advertising solutions across political, advocacy, and B2B channels.

You will serve as the primary point of contact in DC, cultivating and maintaining relationships with clients, agencies, and organizations seeking to reach influential audiences. The right candidate thrives operating independently, is excited about representing an iconic and influential brand, and has a track record of translating networks and market knowledge into measurable revenue and strategic growth.

  • Leverage an existing DC-based network and book of business to generate immediate impact while expanding relationships with direct clients and agencies

  • Contribute to the commercialization of new initiatives, helping shape offerings, products, and positioning as the DC franchise grows

job.description:
Job Description :

Join the New York Post Media Group Talent Community

Interested in joining one of the most iconic and fast-moving media organizations in the world? You’re in the right place.

The New York Post Media Group is always looking to connect with talented professionals who are interested in future opportunities across our editorial, newsroom, digital, audience, photo, video, commercial, revenue, marketing, communications, HR, and business teams.

By joining our Talent Community, you can stay on our radar and keep up with new opportunities across the New York Post Media Group. If we see a role that looks like it could be a great fit for your background and experience, we may reach out.

That said: don’t wait for us!

If you see a specific opportunity posted that interests you and matches your experience, we strongly encourage you to apply directly

.

If you're so inclined, we also welcome you to submit a cover letter telling us a little more about yourself, including the types of opportunities, teams, or areas of the business that interest you. It can help us better understand what you’re looking for and where you might be the right fit.

NOTE: This Talent Community is intended for professionals interested in full-time opportunities (40 hours per week) and professional-level roles and above across our organization.

A quick note about where we work

  • The New York Post Media Group is a highly collaborative, fast-paced organization and the majority of our roles are on-site.

  • Most opportunities are based in either New York City or Los Angeles, so candidates should be prepared to work from one of those locations depending on the role.

Whether your passion is breaking news, entertainment, sports, digital storytelling, audience growth, advertising, sales, technology, or building the business behind the headlines, we’d love to get to know you.

Join our Talent Community and stay connected. The next big opportunity could have your name on it.

job.title: Lifestyle Trending News Editor
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post delivers news, sports, pop culture and entertainment with unmatched speed, attitude and authority, reaching more than 90 million unique viewers each month. With a 225 year legacy and a fast moving digital first newsroom, the Post operates across print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce, and continues to define the city’s most talked about stories.


We are seeking an experienced and audience driven Lifestyle Trending News Editor (Tuesday-Saturday) to direct our daily lifestyle news content — working across verticals including sex & relationships, fashion, real estate, parenting, travel, food & drink, science & technology and general interest.


The successful candidate will be audience and SEO obsessed, have an innate ability to identify the topics everyone wants to read and talk about, and have proven experience in using data and insights platforms to maximize traffic. They will have proven skills at crafting audience and editorial strategy, be obsessed with setting the lifestyle news agenda, driving traffic across multiple sources, and know how to write a sparkling headline that everyone wants to click on.

The candidate will also be able to produce and edit content in The Post’s uniquely irreverent tone of voice, at high speed.


The role requires a confident editorial leader, who will manage writers across multiple verticals including consumer lifestyle, science, tech, and viral trends. It reports to the Lifestyle Editor.


Note: the shift for this role is Tuesday-Saturday.


Responsibilities:


● Generating an endless font of innovative and agenda-setting daily trending and exclusive ideas.
● Assigning and editing trending daily stories, at high speed.
● Creating a short and long term strategy for the lifestyle news department, leveraging audience insights platforms, to meet the department’s goals.
● Overseeing the production of a number of daily stories — from writing headlines in the Post’s signature wit to ensuring SEO best practices to coordinating photo shoots and imagery.
● Constantly analyzing web traffic and referral metrics to drive audience engagement and
traffic.
● Monitoring the news to look for opportunities to add depth to our headlines through original reporting, first-person perspectives and expert explainers.
● Managing the lifestyle news reporters and editors on the team.
● Coordinating closely with other departments such as photo, video, and audience development.


Requirements:

● At least 5 years of editing experience in a news or fast moving magazine environment, preferably in a lifestyle or culture department.
● Excellent news judgement and the sharpest editing and writing prowess.
● Your finger on the pulse of the topics and trends of interest to the Post audience.
● Proven understanding of what makes a story successful across digital platforms - from headlines to visuals and optimization.
● Proficiency in WordPress or similar CMS.
● Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple stories, writers, and deadlines simultaneously.
● Comfortable making fast, decisive editorial calls in a breaking news environment.
● Proven team leader who is skilled at managing and developing writers and can work across departments including visuals, social, and audience development.
● Expertise with analytics tools and performance metrics to help guide coverage and strategy.
● A deep understanding of referral traffic, particularly, social, search and Discover.
● Proven experience in driving and retaining audiences, with deeper, engagement-focused content.

job.title: Page Six Video Lead Editor
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The Page Six video team is seeking a Lead Video Editor who will help us make existing series and compelling, shareable videos about celebrities, and fashion - subjects that are the mainstay of the nation’s most iconic gossip column. You should love celebrity journalism and possess deep knowledge about the latest celebrity gossip, trends, feuds, and hookups. You should live and breathe celebrity lifestyle, fashion and social media, with your fingers on the pulse.

You’ll work in an extremely fast-paced environment enabling producers to hit

production targets and goals. You’ll be the lead editor for the most important Page Six video series, both the audience favorites and the branded content as well. You’ll help create sizzles and other marketing assets as needed. You’ll supervise the rest of the editors, giving them creative notes, video editing workflow best practices, troubleshooting problems and overall quality control. You’ll coordinate media backups with our production management team. And work with our team and creative director to have graphic guidelines as well as create custom graphics and thumbnails to help click through rates. You must edit fast and with a flourish. Expertise with key products in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Photoshop, After Effects) as well as Adobe graphic templates. You’ll edit videos for digital platforms using a mix of original footage, stock footage and social media content.


Along with editing digitally-native video, you will help generate our content, pitching video ideas daily and contributing to the team brainstorming. We seek a candidate who is excited about new types of multimedia storytelling and has a track record of creating digital video in a fast-paced news organization. Must be aware of the latest formats and trends in digital video as a distinct form of content versus television.


This is a fast-paced job that requires a love of all things celebrity, a strong editorial sense and the ability to stay organized while multitasking.


Like us, you believe news doesn’t have to be boring and you appreciate the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones.


This is an opportunity to work with an iconic media brand as it experiences exponential digital growth. New York Post and Page Six videos have received more than a billion views in the past few years.


Responsibilities:
● Lead the editing and post-production of high-priority Page Six video series,
branded content, and celebrity-focused digital features optimized for social and
web platforms.
● Supervise and mentor video editors by providing creative direction, workflow
guidance, troubleshooting support, and overall quality control in a fast-paced
newsroom environment.
● Edit compelling, digitally native videos using original footage, stock assets, and social media content while maintaining Page Six’s signature voice, tone, and style.

job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The NY Post is looking for an experienced editor for a part-time role with the Sunday staff. The editor is expected to be a line and assignment editor who possesses fine attention to detail, critical thinking skills, and who can also aggressively transform breaking copy on deadline to sing in The Post's unique tabloid voice.


The editor should be able to mine, assign and edit an array of stories -- impactful, quirky, scandalous, etc. -- on immediate deadline for our website, and also for the Sunday print edition. The editor must be able to give clear direction to our team of award-winning field reporters and in-office journos.


The Sunday team breaks local, national and international news, investigates government corruption, crushes hypocrisy wherever we find it, mines the world for the quirky and the funny, and delivers award-winning, long- and short-form journalism in the boldest tabloid voice.


The NY Post is the nation’s 5th-largest U.S. newspaper by circulation and its website routinely generates tens of millions of pageviews every weekend. The ability to handle anything from a breaking brief to a sprawling news feature, in a wide range of subjects, is needed. And you’ll even get to spitball with the rest of us on our world-famous Page 1 headlines.


Qualifications:
● Bachelor’s degree or higher

● A minimum of 5 years of editing in a busy newsroom

● Comfortable editing/re-writing both breaking news and long-form stories in lively tabloid prose for web and print

● A keen understanding of the voice of the Post

● A knack for finding stories our readers crave

● A critical eye for facts and tone

● Broad knowledge base

● Willingness to collaborate and ability to communicate with a close-knit team of NYC’s best journalists


Note: The New York Post adheres to a hybrid work model. As a part-time editor, you will work an 8-to-10-hour Saturday shift in the office, with the possibility of working additional hours on Thursday and Friday.

job.title: Senior Manager, Growth & Lifecyle Marketing
job.description:
Job Description :

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Growth & Lifecyle Marketing to lead audience growth, engagement, and retention strategies across our newsletter portfolio, free membership offerings, and suite of mobile applications.

This role will be responsible for driving subscriber acquisition and lifecycle marketing initiatives that scale high-quality audiences while maintaining strong engagement and retention performance. You will partner closely with editorial, creative, product, analytics, and external partners to execute data-informed growth strategies across paid, owned, earned, and partnership channels.

The ideal candidate combines performance marketing expertise, strong analytical capabilities, and cross-functional collaboration skills with a passion for media, audience growth, and consumer engagement.
 

Key Responsibilities:
Growth Strategy & Audience Acquisition
● Develop and execute full-funnel growth strategies to drive acquisition for newsletters, membership offerings, and mobile apps
● Manage a balanced channel mix across paid and organic acquisition tactics, including
digital advertising, owned platforms, partnerships, and referral programs
● Identify new opportunities to scale qualified audiences while maintaining efficiency and engagement quality

Paid Media Planning & Optimization
● Plan, execute, and optimize acquisition campaigns across channels such as Meta, LinkedIn, search engine marketing, sponsored newsletters, and other relevant platforms
● Manage budgets, pacing, and performance against key growth targets
● Partner with external agencies, consultants, or vendors as needed to support campaign execution and scale


Creative Campaign Development
● Collaborate with internal creative and marketing partners to develop effective campaign concepts and assets
● Write creative briefs that clearly define campaign goals, audiences, messaging, and performance objectives
● Ensure creative assets align with brand standards and are optimized for channel performance

Partnership Marketing
● Develop and manage strategic partnerships that support audience acquisition, awareness, and engagement goals
● Identify opportunities for co-marketing, list growth, referral exchanges, and other mutually beneficial initiatives
● Track performance and optimize partnership outcomes over time

Referral & Organic Growth Programs
● Lead referral and advocacy programs designed to encourage existing users and subscribers to share products with new audiences
● Manage referral tools, incentives, and testing strategies to increase word-of-mouth growth

Performance Analysis & Reporting
● Analyze campaign and channel performance to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
● Use data and testing insights to refine targeting, messaging, creative, and lifecycle strategies
● Present recommendations and results to internal stakeholders on a regular basis

Lifecycle Marketing & Retention
● Own post-signup engagement strategies, including onboarding and automated lifecycle journeys
● Optimize welcome series, re-engagement flows, and retention campaigns to improve long-term engagement and audience value
● Partner with editorial and product teams to support ongoing audience engagement initiatives

Cross-Functional Collaboration
● Work closely with editorial, product, analytics, creative, and business teams to align marketing initiatives with broader company priorities
● Support integrated planning across channels and departments to maximize growth opportunities
● Partner with editorial to align content with audience needs.
● Work with ad sales to execute sponsorships and campaigns.


Requirements:
● 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, or audience development
● Experience managing acquisition and retention campaigns across multiple digital channels
● Background in media, publishing, subscription, app-based, or consumer-facing
businesses preferred

● Strong knowledge of paid media platforms, campaign optimization, and performance marketing principles
● Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau, or similar tools
● Familiarity with email service providers (ESPs), CRM systems, and marketing
automation platforms
● Ability to translate performance data into actionable recommendations
● Strong project management and organizational skills
● Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:
● Experience with newsletter growth, app user acquisition, and direct response marketing
● Familiarity with referral marketing platforms and lifecycle testing strategies
● Experience working with editorial or content-driven organizations
● Understanding of subscription or membership business models

job.title: Senior Reporter (Courts & Crime), California Post
job.description:
Job Description :

As part of our bold expansion, we are seeking a driven Senior Reporter (Courts & Crime Focus) to join the California Post team.
 

Reporting to the Deputy News Editor, this reporter will react quickly to major breaking news across the San Francisco Bay Area while bringing a strong background in courts, crime, and public safety. This role requires flexibility, sharp instincts, and a high-velocity reporting style—whether you’re covering a high-profile trial, responding to an emergency scene, or breaking down a rapidly developing regional story. You will be on the front lines of one of the nation’s most dynamic news environments, turning fast-moving events into clear, authoritative reporting.

Responsibilities:

  • Cover real-time breaking events across the San Francisco Bay Area with speed, accuracy, and urgency for the California Post.

  • Lead coverage on major criminal and civil court cases, law enforcement agency accountability, and high-impact crime trends shaping the region.

  • Pivot seamlessly between spot news, trending digital stories, public safety incidents, and broader regional enterprise assignments as news breaks.

  • Spot local stories with viral potential or national resonance and deliver exclusive angles before the competition.

  • Cultivate strong relationships across law enforcement, city agencies, legal communities, emergency services, and local neighborhoods.

  • File rapid updates across web, mobile, social media, and video platforms, continuously updating developing stories in real time.

  • Actively monitor court filings, police blotters, public records, and social media feeds to spot scoops and emerging trends.

  • Travel regularly to courthouses across the Bay Area to cover hearings, arraignments, trials, and major verdict announcements in person. 

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience reporting for a fast-paced digital or print newsroom, with a strong background in general assignment, breaking news, or public safety beats.

  • Superior news judgment with a proven ability to write fast, clean, and compelling copy on tight deadlines while managing multiple assignments.

  • Strong familiarity with legal documents, court filings, and police operations, with the ability to translate complex legal jargon into clear, accessible prose.

  • A relentless approach to newsgathering and a track record of building trusted sources across public safety and municipal agencies.

  • Proficiency with CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress), SEO best practices, and social media distribution tools.

  • Strong preference for candidates comfortable discussing their stories on camera or presenting short-form video updates for digital platforms.

  • A desire to be first and best on major breaking stories while maintaining the highest standards of journalistic integrity and accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Spanish or secondary language fluency.

  • An established social media presence or professional digital following.

Note: This role is expected to be based remotely in the San Francisco Bay Area. All work arrangements are subject to change based on business needs.

job.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. 

Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next. 

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our technology team and lead the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands-on engineering role with core responsibilities around infrastructure services, data pipelines, personalization systems, consumer AI, internal AI tooling, and custom APIs across AWS and GCP projects. 

You are a hands-on technical leader who builds robust high-performance services for websites. You will own the plumbing that enables our newsroom, data science, marketing, and product teams to deliver cutting-edge digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside technology leadership in a fast-paced newsroom. You will partner with editorial leaders, share architectural solutions with other business units in the US, UK, and Australia, and direct your engineering team with experienced tactics and thoughtful strategy. 

Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Sponsorship, including employment visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position now or in the future.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Manage and support a small team of high-achieving agile software and data engineers.

  • Design, build, and operate cloud-based APIs supporting specialized needs of our consumer websites, native mobile apps. 

  • Work daily with compute services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery. 

  • Be able to personally troubleshoot an issue from Javascript in a browser down through DNS, networking, applications, containers and operating systems or serverless services, and into dependent service tiers. 

  • Own data ingestion pipelines for real-time and batch processing of large-scale content and event data. 

  • Understand how to implement and scale custom APIs to support editorial workflows, AI, personalization, analytics, and user-facing applications. 

  • Own the team’s codebases, pull requests, testing, maintenance and release process.

  • Partner with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs. 

  • Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud-based systems.

  • Communicate and present a vision for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Organize architecture discussions. 

  • Run and/or supervise agile sprint ceremonies. 

Qualifications:

Must-Haves 

  • MS or BS in computer science, or related field. 

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience. 

  • 5+ years experience leading engineering teams. 

  • Agile best practices. 

  • Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, Node.js, or Go.

  • Solid familiarity of common AWS and/or GCP services . 

  • Robust experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication/authorization, and API best practices. 

  • Firm grasp of the tools of the trade including AI tools, IDEs, Git, JIRA, and agile methodologies.

  • Comfort with code reviews, unit tests, QA and UAT processes, and knowledge of end-to-end testing frameworks. 

  • Strong troubleshooting skills 

  • Attention to detail, thoroughness, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a comfort in diving in and learning things from scratch. 

  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Great-to-Have Experience

  • Familiarity with content-management systems, media, news, publishing, video technology, ad technology, or other high-traffic consumer-facing industries. 

  • Hands-on experience with generative-AI models, LLM prompting, and/or machine learning.

  • Personalization and recommendation systems. 

  • Experience building and deploying data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dataflow, Glue, or similar tools)

  • Comfort with Linux administration, shell scripting, ssh, crontabs, etc. 

  • Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboard, and alarming tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.) 

  • Knowledge of data warehouse technologies (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)

  • Understanding of CI/CD workflows and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes a plus) 

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change).

job.title: Social Media Intern (Newsroom)
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

From celebrity news to viral stories and breaking headlines, the New York Post is the place where news, culture, and entertainment collide.

We are looking for a dynamic and creative Social Media Intern (24 hrs/week) to join our Audience Development team this summer. If you’re a content enthusiast who loves engaging with a massive audience, staying on top of trends, and making an impact across social platforms, this is your chance to gain hands-on experience with a world-class media brand! You’ll be working for one of the most influential news brands in the world, helping to drive engagement and grow our audience.

Note: This internship is scheduled to run from February 2, 2026 - April 10, 2026 . Participants are expected to work part time hours and adhere to our on-site work schedule. Open to current juniors and seniors pursuing a BA, MA students, and recent graduates who completed their degree within the past year

What You’ll Do:

  • Assist in managing and creating content for the New York Post’s social media accounts across platforms like Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, and TikTok.

  • Engage with our vibrant audience by responding to comments, sharing updates, and sparking conversations.

  • Help discover and curate viral content to keep our feeds fresh, fun, and trending.

  • Collaborate with the editorial team to highlight breaking news, top stories, and exclusive Post content.

  • Analyze social media performance to help optimize strategies and increase engagement.

  • Gain valuable experience in social media management, content creation, and audience growth.

What We’re Looking For:

  • A passionate, social media-savvy student or recent grad with experience in a news or newsroom setting

  • A strong communicator with a creative flair who knows how to capture attention with a single post.

  • Someone who’s up to date on social media trends, viral content, and pop culture—especially in the fast-paced world of news.

  • A team player who can collaborate across departments, with a go-getter attitude and enthusiasm for learning.

  • Previous social media experience is a plus, but a genuine passion for digital content and engagement is key.

Pay: $17/hr

job.title: Video Editor, PageSix.com (Virtual Reali-Tea)
job.description:
Job Description :

Page Six provides readers with the best in Pop Culture and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 25 million unique viewers a month. For the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The Page Six video team is seeking an in-office Video Editor who will help us make existing series and compelling, shareable videos about reality TV: the shows, the personalities, the characters. Like us, you believe news doesn’t have to be boring and you appreciate the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones. You should possess deep knowledge about the latest celebrity gossip, feuds, scandals and hookups. You should live and breathe reality TV lifestyle, fashion and social media, with your fingers on the pulse.


This is a fast-paced job that requires a love of all things celebrity, a strong editorial sense and the ability to stay organized while multitasking. You’ll work in an extremely fast-paced environment enabling producers to hit production targets and goals. You will assist on dozens of videos throughout the day, taking lead from the producers and studio technical director.


Responsibilities:

  • Edit high quality, engaging short form videos focused on celebrity news, reality television, entertainment, and pop culture for digital and social media platforms.

  • Transform original footage, stock footage, archival assets, and social media content into compelling, shareable video content.

  • Collaborate closely with producers and the Studio Technical Director to execute a high volume of daily video productions while consistently meeting tight deadlines.

  • Maintain exceptional speed and accuracy in video editing without compromising creativity or editorial quality.

  • Create visually dynamic content using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Adobe Motion Graphics templates.

  • Generate and pitch fresh video concepts daily that align with trending celebrity news, reality TV, and audience interests.

  • Participate in editorial meetings and brainstorming sessions to develop innovative multimedia storytelling ideas.

  • Monitor celebrity news, entertainment, reality television, fashion, social media, and digital trends to identify timely content opportunities.

  • Ensure all content aligns with Page Six's editorial voice, brand standards, and quality expectations.

  • Stay current on emerging digital video formats, platform best practices, and audience engagement trends to continuously improve content performance.

  • Manage multiple editing projects simultaneously while remaining highly organized in a fast paced newsroom environment.

  • Collaborate with cross functional editorial and production teams to deliver timely, accurate, and engaging video content.

  • Contribute to production goals by supporting the efficient execution of daily publishing schedules across digital platforms.

  • Exercise strong editorial judgment when selecting footage, pacing stories, and crafting narratives that resonate with digital audiences.

  • Help evolve existing video franchises while identifying opportunities to develop new recurring series and formats.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience editing high volume, digital first video content in a fast paced newsroom, entertainment, or media environment.

  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro. Experience with After Effects and Photoshop strongly preferred.

  • Experience editing with a combination of original footage, stock footage, archival assets, and social media content.

  • Ability to create engaging horizontal and vertical videos optimized for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, and other digital platforms.

  • Strong understanding of platform specific video formats, audience behaviors, and emerging digital video trends.

  • Deep knowledge of celebrity news, reality television, pop culture, entertainment, and social media, with the ability to identify timely content opportunities.

  • Ability to edit quickly and efficiently while maintaining exceptional editorial judgment, creativity, and attention to detail under tight deadlines.

  • Experience with multicamera editing, color correction, audio mixing, and pacing content for maximum audience engagement.

  • Motion graphics, basic animation, and experience using Adobe Motion Graphics templates are a plus.

  • Strong instinct for selecting music and sound design that enhances storytelling and complements the tone of each video.

  • Ability to generate, pitch, and develop fresh video concepts daily while contributing meaningfully to editorial brainstorming sessions.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate closely with Executive Producers, Producers, Studio Technical Directors, social teams, and cross functional newsroom partners.

  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing competing deadlines, planning for contingencies, and adapting quickly in a rapidly changing news environment.

  • Highly organized, proactive, and self motivated, with the ability to work independently while thriving as part of a collaborative team.

  • Positive, solutions oriented attitude with a passion for creative storytelling and a belief that news can be engaging, entertaining, and shareable.

  • Ability to make sound editorial decisions and maintain accuracy while working under pressure.

  • Flexibility to work a nontraditional schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and major news or entertainment events as needed.

Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. This role will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week.

·         Extensive experience editing and creating animations for projects on deadline.

·         Working within After Effects, Adobe Creative suite, and project management systems.  

Requirements & Skills:

·         College degree preferred

·         Advanced knowledge of the post-production process, including media management and encoding video to various formats

·         Must have strong communication skills to communicate project status, assets needed, expectations, and provide customer service skills across a large group.

The Marketing and Creative Services Producer must be able to stand, sit, conduct telephone conversations, use electronic mail, write letters and memos, conduct face-to-face discussions with individuals or groups, make decisions without supervision, make decisions that impact the results of co-workers, work near others, work outdoors in all weather conditions, and work indoors in environmentally controlled conditions.  In addition, the Creative Services Producer must be able to lift, set up, and operate equipment weighing up to 40 pounds, and be able to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls.  Repetitive movements are required.  Work may be conducted in extremely bright or inadequate lighting conditions.

job.title: Marketing Consultant
job.description:
Known as the “Horse Capital of the World,” Lexington, Kentucky, offers a rich blend of equine culture, bourbon experiences, a thriving arts community, friendliness, and charm, making it one of the most vibrant cities in the Southeast. 

 

U.S. News and World Report recently named Lexington one of the Top 25 Best Cities that offer the best quality of life, citing education, safety, affordability, and healthcare. U.S. News and World Report also named Lexington one of the Top 10 best small cities in the U.S. Come join a growing team in an exciting Southeastern city.

 

As a local Marketing Consultant in the FOX 56 Sales Department, you will help Central, Southern and Eastern Kentucky businesses realize growth opportunities by introducing them to customized screen-based advertising solutions.  Our cross-screen marketing approach includes, but is not limited to, industry leading digital products such as Amazon advertising solutions, YouTube, all streaming television platforms, targeted automotive products, social media solutions, digital display, custom content opportunities as well as broadcast television on FOX 56.

 

FOX 56, as a FOX affiliate, is home to best-in-class sports, including the NFL, 2026 World Cup, World Series, NASCAR, College Football, College Basketball, Belmont Stakes and much more! FOX 56 is also home to the only morning newscasts that stay local from 5a-10a, providing maximum local exposure to its advertising partners.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Cultivating new relationships and strengthening current relationships with local direct clients while promoting station/company image and perception.
  • Identifying the needs of advertisers and preparing customized sales presentations.
  • Consulting with sales management on opportunities and the specific needs of clients.
  • Curating new programs to maximize revenue from existing clients with a heavy focus on business development.
  • Maintaining a customer-friendly attitude while being dedicated to company requirements and customer needs.
  • Being a results-driven, customer-focused, solution-oriented, aggressive self-starter.
  • Ensuring all financial budget goals are met by using WDKY/Nexstar advertising products to prospect, develop, maintain, and grow your account/revenue base.

Job Requirements:

  • Proficient in computer applications, such as Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc.
  • Ability to multitask and operate with a sense of urgency.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and presentation skills.
  • Confidence to speak with decision makers.
  • Experience in advertising or marketing sales preferred but not required.

Nexstar, Inc. / WDKY-TV is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace.

  • Perform other duties as assigned

  • Exceptional writing, grammar and spelling, technical formatting

  • Excellent time management skills maintaining strong attention to detail
  • Excellent editing skills with Adobe Premiere and video camera/news photography skills

  • Proven problem-solving ability and adaptability during live production

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of television programming and scheduling experience, strong organizational and communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced broadcast environment.

This role is responsible for maintaining programming schedules, managing metadata, working with listing services, supporting programming initiatives, and ensuring schedule accuracy. Experience with SIMS programming software and broadcast television operations is preferred.

  • Working knowledge of SIMS programming and scheduling software.
  • Strong understanding of television scheduling strategies, broadcast operations, and programming workflows.
  • Experience managing programming metadata and maintaining schedule accuracy.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience scheduling multiple television networks simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with FCC regulations, broadcast standards, and compliance reporting.
  • Experience with television listings services and metadata providers.

Key Competencies

  • Television programming and scheduling
  • Metadata management
  • Attention to detail

  • Ability to thrive in a deadline-driven environment

job.title: Reporter I, Meteorologist
job.description:

We are looking for an energetic, accurate, and digitally savvy storyteller who knows how to deliver weather coverage to our viewers where they are. From tracking severe spring storms to winter weather in the heart of the Ozarks, you will produce critical content for broadcast, digital platforms, and our streaming app.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver multi-platform content: Produce engaging, accurate weather forecasts for TV, web, social media, and our streaming app.
  • Own the weather story: Track severe storms, winter weather systems, and daily hazards with precision and clarity.
  • Connect with the community: Engage with viewers where they are, breaking down complex meteorological data into simple, conversational information.
  • Severe Weather Coverage: Provide urgent, clear, and calm on-air coverage during tracking events.
  • Digital First: Deliver weather segments on Ozarks First +, update weather stories on ozarksfirst.com, and provide weather content on social media channels constantly.

job.title: Streaming Host/Digital Producer
job.description:
If you’re a video-savvy person who is innovative and lives for creating  news content for streaming and digital platforms, we want to hear from you!

DC News Now has an exciting opportunity for someone to join us as a Streaming Host/Digital Producer.

The ideal host/digital producer is creative, thriving  in a collaborative environment. The person serving in the position will be a leader in the newsroom, developing quality content that follows the highest journalistic standards and provides a rich experience for our community.

We are looking for a storyteller who is plugged into the community and takes an audience-first approach to producing and sharing programs, videos, and other content across streaming, digital, social, and linear platforms. We operate as one content team in our newsroom, which means the host/digital producer will work closely with other content creators including broadcast producers, photojournalists, anchors, and reporters.

•    Urgently and aggressively report news on streaming and digital  platforms as it happens

•    Work with all newsroom team members on content coverage, digital-broadcast coordination, and social listening

•    Use digital and social analytics to inform editorial decisions

•    Assist reporters and anchors in the creation of native social content

•    Implement best practices on DC News Now digital, streaming, and social media platforms

•    Ensure newsroom upholds journalistic integrity and the DC News Now brand across platforms

QUALIFICATIONS 

•    1-2 years experience in streaming and/or digital content production, including on-camera work, preferred

•    Excellent organization and time management capabilities

•    Strong written and verbal communication skills

•    Video editing experience

job.title: Studio Technician
job.description:

job.title: Associate, Club Consulting
job.description:
The NFL's Club Business Development department (Club BD) supports the 32 clubs in delivering direct local value & optimization, best-in-class fan experiences via data-driven insights, and innovative fan, digital, and stadium enhancements and strategies, through direct Club Consulting, strategic analysis, and Club benchmarking. In addition to working directly with the clubs, Club BD works cross-functionally to help guide key strategic initiatives at a League level. The team utilizes a combination of analytics and functional expertise in sales, marketing, data & analytics, digital strategy, and more to develop "next practices" and facilitate the sharing of "best practices" between clubs.

The Club Consulting team within Club Business Development drives integral conversations with the clubs across their day-to-day business efforts inclusive of Ticketing, Sponsorship, Premium, Marketing, Digital, Fan Engagement, and more, both domestically and internationally. This role will assist the Club Consulting team in identifying and sharing business and digital best practices, analyzing data collected from clubs, building out materials to highlight key strategic efforts, and disseminating communications to the clubs.

This role will support clubs through a combination of proactive and reactive consulting efforts, maintaining day-to-day interactions with club business leaders while serving as a strategic resource across a variety of business disciplines. The role will also be asked to support the Club BD team across the department on strategic projects and department-wide initiatives, including operational efforts surrounding international games and tentpole events.

The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about the business of sports and wants to be fully immersed in the business of the 32 NFL Clubs. Whether having worked for a team, league office, agency, technology company, consulting firm, or outside of sports, the role requires intellectual curiosity and a desire to engage with clubs daily to help support and grow their business.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate across the Club BD Account Directors and Club Consulting group to ensure key initiatives are being communicated effectively both internally and across the clubs.
  • Identify and disseminate best practice strategies through materials that highlight "best-in-class" business and digital practices that are applicable to NFL club business efforts while working as a subject matter expert across core local revenue areas including ticketing, sponsorship, premium seating, marketing, fan engagement, and digital.
  • Supporting clubs' digital business efforts, including helping clubs optimize their owned and operated channels (club websites, mobile apps, email, and digital platforms), drive fan engagement, improve digital monetization opportunities, and implement innovative digital strategies that support business growth.
  • Work with NFL clubs on individual ad hoc requests related to business objectives (e.g., ticketing, sponsorship, digital strategy, fan engagement, marketing, etc.).
  • Identify strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and challenges across club business operations through a holistic understanding of club business performance.
  • Support data collection efforts related to club surveys, benchmarking initiatives, digital performance trends, and other strategic business analyses.
  • Work with Club Business Development's Strategy & Analytics team on reporting, data-led insights, and additional ad hoc studies and initiatives.
  • Support across tentpole league events (e.g., Super Bowl, NFL Draft, International Games, etc.), including a significant role in operational liaison support across each.
  • Support the league’s fan experience program including overall program coordination/logistics, participating as a gameday observer and post event reporting
  • Support Club Business Development department-wide efforts, including club data collection and club surveys, benchmark reporting, preparation of department presentations, communications, and meeting materials.
  • Build and cultivate trusted relationships with club staff across key business disciplines, including ticketing, sponsorship, marketing, digital, and fan engagement.
  • Meet with third-party vendors across the sports and digital ecosystem to provide introductions, recommendations, and resources to clubs.
  • Participate in all-32 league meetings, workshops, and calls, including leading and facilitating recurring club calls specific to key business and digital areas.
  • Research and share emerging industry trends, technologies, and innovative business practices that may help clubs drive fan engagement, revenue growth, and operational efficiencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 2+ years of experience.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and interpersonal skills.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a passion for the business of the NFL.
  • Excellent presentation skills, including PowerPoint and similar tools.
  • Ability to derive insights from data, analytics, and research and present findings to all levels of an organization.
  • Ability to anticipate clubs' needs and match them with appropriate work products and/or individuals at the League Office.
  • Significant experience in Microsoft Excel.
  • Understanding of digital business strategies, including websites, mobile applications, digital marketing, fan engagement, audience development, and digital monetization.

 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks, strong time management skills, and exceptional organizational abilities.
  • Detail-oriented.
  • Consulting and/or strategy background preferred.
  • Team, league, agency, technology, or media industry experience preferred.
  • Strong interest in digital innovation, fan engagement, and emerging trends within the sports industry.

 

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

Travel 10-15%

  • Club markets
  • League meetings and workshops

Significant league events (e.g., Super Bowl, NFL Draft, International Games, etc.)

Salary $1,450—$1,600 USD

Benefits Information
To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

At the NFL, in-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered. 

NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.

The NFL is committed to building an inclusive work environment that reflects our incredible fan base. We provide an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants without regard to status as protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

WHO WE ARE:

NFL Core Values:

  • Respect: Everyone matters. We celebrate diverse opinions, honor hard work, and value every contribution.
  • Integrity: We do what's right, even when it's tough. We hold ourselves accountable and always follow through.
  • Team Responsibility: We support each other and our communities. No one is bigger than the game, and every action impacts others.
  • Resiliency: We set high standards, overcome adversity, and adapt to challenges, always striving for excellence.

job.title: Associate, Hotels & Meetings (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Live Events team is responsible for the planning and execution of the league’s tentpole events and International Games. The Associate position plays an integral role in supporting the Events team with the execution of all tentpole events and executive meetings with a focus on hotel management, meeting planning and execution.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the execution of 100+ hotel contracts for future Super Bowl and Draft bids and assist with onboarding process through our supplier portal.
  • Assist with the RFP process and hotel sourcing strategy for NFL International Games, which includes identifying and securing staff, vendor, and headquarters hotel accommodations while managing contract negotiations, and working with Finance on budget considerations.
  • Support the Super Bowl hotel assignment process by working closely with departments and partners assigning 20,000 rooms.
  • Manage hotel reservations for 800+ attendees at all tentpole events which include Super Bowl, Pro Bowl, Combine, Draft, Flag Championships, Hall of Fame, Kickoff, International games and meetings.
  • Execute Super Bowl headquarter hotel operations that include contract management, hotel reservations, meeting space logistics, food & beverage, signage, and vendor coordination.
  • Coordinate planning meetings across all tentpole events for current year and future. This entails sourcing hotels through our RFP platform and tracking proposals.
  • Lead effort for on-site event management for Owners Meetings and department meetings including room block management, client check-in, credential distribution, and registration.
  • Attend all planning meetings, as needed for current and future tentpole events and outline goals and objectives for each trip.
  • Work cross functionally with various internal departments on meetings throughout the year.
  • Reconcile budgets and invoices with finance team on for all tentpole events and meetings.
  • Support the team in various capacities including contract management, updating the special events calendar and tracking budgets.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum 2 years of hotel with a focus on room management and function room operations
  • Adept at contract negotiations and proven experience working with hotel contracts
  • Hotel and venue management with a focus on room block build/management, attrition mitigation, function room costing and management
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
  • Ability to lead others and collaborate with a variety of groups at different levels
  • Strong organizational and presentation skills
  • Strong writing and communications skills
  • Proactive self-starter who works well within a team, strong interpersonal skills

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience with hotel contracts, negotiating, and meeting planning
  • Experience with Meeting Evolution, Cvent or other event registration sites
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills
  • C level/VIP management and service
  • Knowledge in RFP creation and process

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Team player with positive attitude
  • High energy
  • Entrepreneurial spirit
  • Strong work ethic

Physical Demands:

This is a Special Events hotel and VIP management role, at times may require physicality.  This could involve lifting, long hours of standing and physical movement during an event and extensive travel requirements.   

Travel:

Significant domestic and international travel required, including some weekends, up to 50%.   Several weeks on the road during event delivery.

job.title: Associate, HR Operations (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
Overview:

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Operations Coordinator to join our Shared Services team. This role is helping to enhance the NFL employee experience and scale our HR capabilities. You will have an immediate impact on the overall NFL employee experience as the first point of contact for many employees, ensuring timely and accurate support throughout the employee lifecycle. You will manage HR tickets, process transactions in Oracle HCM. In this highly collaborative role, you will maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, including HR, Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT.

Responsibilities:

  • Case Management:
    Manage and resolve tier-1 HR inquiries through ServiceNow, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional responses all questions and issues regarding HR related policies, procedures, and systems, including but not limited to Onboarding, Benefits, Compensation, Learning, Performance, and Offboarding.
  • Process HR transactions including new hires, rehires, transfers, leaves of absence, terminations, personal data changes, and other complicated system transactions
  • Support the talent acquisition processes by posting job requisitions, managing the candidate experience, extending offers, and facilitating onboarding activities. 
  • HR Systems Support:
    Enter and maintain employee data in Oracle HCM Cloud, ServiceNow, and UGK, supporting lifecycle transactions and identifying opportunities to streamline or automate recurring processes.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with cross-functional teams as necessary, including Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT. 

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience:
    2–4+ years in HR Operations, Shared Services, HRIS, or an HR support role. Experience with ServiceNow (or similar ticketing system), Oracle HCM Cloud and UGK preferred.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Positive attitude and strong work ethic.
    • Customer-first mindset with a pleasant, team-oriented demeanor.
    • Eagerness to learn and grow in both HR operations and analytics.
    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
    • Clear and concise communication skills to collaborate across functions.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

You are driven to improve processes, deliver excellent employee support, and ensure data accuracy. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are excited to shape the future of HR Shared Services.

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a growing HR Operations team that's focused on efficiency, innovation, and elevating the employee experience. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their HR career who wants to grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

job.title: Director, Broadcast Engineering
job.description:
The Director, Broadcast Engineering is responsible for leading the strategy, operation, modernization, and reliability of mission-critical broadcast engineering systems that support live production, studio operations, transmission, post-production, digital media, and multi-platform content delivery. This role manages a team of engineers, technicians, specialists, and vendor partners while bridging traditional broadcast workflows with IP-based, virtualized, and cloud-enabled media infrastructure. The Director will provide technical leadership, staff development, operational discipline, and long-range planning to ensure high-quality, resilient, and scalable production services.

Responsibilities

Staff Leadership and Management

  • Lead, manage, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary broadcast engineering team responsible for live production, technical operations, maintenance, system support, and engineering projects.
  • Define team priorities, assign resources, manage schedules, establish performance objectives, and conduct regular performance reviews.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational readiness, documentation, continuous improvement, and inclusive leadership.
  • Develop career paths, training plans, succession plans, and cross-training programs to strengthen technical depth and leadership bench strength.
  • Partner with production, operations, IT, transmission, digital media, security, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders to align staffing and engineering priorities with business objectives.

Broadcast Infrastructure and Operations

  • Oversee the design, deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of studios, control rooms, routing, intercom, audio, video, replay, graphics, monitoring, transmission, post-production, and media asset systems.
  • Ensure reliable operation of live broadcast environments through preventive maintenance, system monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery planning, and root-cause analysis.
  • Establish engineering standards, documentation practices, escalation procedures, commissioning processes, and operational readiness checklists.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable broadcast, safety, security, accessibility, and regulatory requirements. 

IP, Cloud, and Emerging Technology Strategy

  • Lead the transition from traditional SDI and hardware-centric workflows toward IP-based, software-defined, virtualized, and cloud-connected media infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and implement technologies such as SMPTE ST 2110, PTP timing, NMOS discovery and control, AES67, Dante, JPEG XS, SRT, NDI, bonded contribution, REMI production, virtualization, containerization, cloud playout, cloud production, remote monitoring, and observability platforms.
  • Develop hybrid architectures that connect on-premises broadcast facilities with digital media platforms, OTT distribution, FAST channels, content supply chains, and cloud-based production workflows.
  • Partner with IT, cybersecurity, network engineering, and cloud architecture teams to ensure media systems meet requirements for latency, timing, resiliency, security, scalability, and operational support.
  • Create roadmaps that balance current broadcast reliability requirements with future-facing digital media, automation, AI-assisted workflows, metadata, and cloud-native capabilities.

Project, Budget, and Vendor Management

  • Lead capital and operational engineering projects from concept through design, procurement, implementation, testing, training, handoff, and ongoing support.
  • Develop budgets, forecasts, business cases, technical requirements, scopes of work, risk assessments, and implementation schedules.
  • Manage vendor relationships, integrators, managed service providers, service contracts, support agreements, and equipment lifecycle planning.

Operational Support and Incident Management

  • Provide senior technical leadership during live events, critical outages, major launches, and high-priority production support scenarios.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts across broadcast, IP network, storage, compute, cloud, audio, video, and application layers.
  • Develop incident reports, postmortems, lessons learned, corrective actions, and preventative controls.
  • Ensure teams are prepared for 24/7 operations, live-event support, escalation coverage, and business continuity requirements.

Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for executive, operational, production, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration between engineering, production, digital media, IT, security, facilities, vendors, and business leadership.
  • Represent broadcast engineering in strategic planning, technology evaluation, roadmap development, standards alignment, and operational governance.

 Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, broadcast engineering, computer science, information technology, media technology, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in broadcast engineering, media systems engineering, technical operations, or live production technology, including leadership of complex broadcast facilities or production environments.
  • 5+ years of people-management experience leading engineers, technicians, managers, project teams, vendors, or managed service providers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing live production environments where reliability, speed, operational discipline, and incident response are critical.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast signal flow, studio systems, production control rooms, intercom, audio, video, routing, replay, graphics, transmission, post-production, monitoring, and media asset workflows.
  • Working knowledge of IP media standards and systems, including SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022-6/7, PTP/IEEE 1588, NMOS IS-04/IS-05, AES67, Dante, multicast networking, QoS, and media-over-IP troubleshooting.
  • Experience with cloud, virtualization, digital media, or software-defined infrastructure, including hybrid workflows that connect broadcast operations with cloud production, streaming, OTT, FAST, remote production, or digital distribution platforms.
  • Familiarity with compute, storage, networking, cybersecurity, automation, orchestration, APIs, monitoring, observability, and DevOps-style support practices as they apply to media systems.
  • Proven ability to lead technical strategy, capital projects, budgets, vendor negotiations, RFPs, scopes of work, implementation plans, and lifecycle management.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours as needed to support live events, urgent technical issues, launches, maintenance windows, and business-critical operations.

Qualifications

  • Experience with ST 2110 facility design, IP fabric architecture, timing design, boundary clocks, grandmaster redundancy, multicast routing, and vendor interoperability testing.
  • Experience with media supply chain platforms, MAM/DAM systems, storage orchestration, transcoding, cloud-based playout, streaming workflows, and metadata-driven content operations.
  • Experience leading engineering teams through organizational change, facility transformation, SDI-to-IP migration, cloud adoption, or major technology refresh initiatives.
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted media workflows, automation, quality control, captioning, accessibility, rights-aware distribution, and digital content monetization platforms.

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

Salary $190,000—$235,000 USD

job.title: Manager, Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Manager, Flag Football to play a key role in driving the growth of youth flag football. This individual will be responsible for growing global youth participation, with a focus on the U.S., and is a critical member of the Flag integrated team, collaborating across the League, 32 NFL Clubs, and the broader flag football ecosystem to accelerate the growth of flag football.

This is a key leadership role that, in partnership with internal and external stakeholders, will play a formative role in the development of the youth flag football ecosystem during a period of exciting growth. This role requires strategic thinking, operational prowess, and strong partnership management skills. The Manager will serve as the point of contact for key strategic partnerships and will work closely with leaders across the League (including in Football Operations, International, Marketing, Comms, Events, Club Business Development, and Social Responsibility) to operationalize these partnerships and other key initiatives in the flag space. This position reports to the VP, Flag Football and offers significant exposure to senior NFL executives and an opportunity to shape the future of flag football at a national and global level.

Responsibilities

  • Develop & Execute Growth Strategy – Lead initiatives to expand youth flag football participation, driving engagement among key audiences, including players, parents, coaches, officials, and administrators.
  • Manage Strategic Partnerships – Serve as the primary liaison for key partners on flag football, including RCX Sports, GENYOUth, other youth organizations, and federations, ensuring operational alignment and maximizing impact.
  • Lead & Execute Flag Football Events – Serve as Flag lead for all youth- focused flag activations, including NFL FLAG Championships. Lead strategy and drive collaboration across internal & external stakeholders, ensuring seamless execution and maximal impact.
  • Awareness & Engagement – Oversee all phases of the participation funnel, from increasing awareness to enhancing player development through innovative programs and resources.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with internal teams such as Marketing, Events, Sponsorship, and Broadcasting to integrate flag football initiatives into broader NFL priorities.
  • Lead Meetings & Stakeholder Engagement – Organize and lead meetings with League, Club, and external partners, operating as a strategic project manager driving agendas and actionable outcomes.
  • Support International Growth – Partner with the International Flag team to share best practices and assist with global event execution where needed.
  • Strategic Planning & Execution – Support the VP, Flag Football in continuing to build out and evolve long-term strategy and for youth flag football within the broader framework of the Global Flag Football team

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5+ years of professional experience, with a focus in partnership management, flag/youth football, sports events/operations, or consulting
