job.title: Manager, Sponsorship New Business
job.description:
The Manager, Sponsorship New Business, is a key member of the Business Development team responsible for generating revenue by developing and selling integrated marketing partnerships for the NFL globally.

This position will work collaboratively across the NFL to identify partnerships that support key initiatives such as NFL FLAG, International growth, audience growth across youth, multicultural and women, and game innovation.

Given the new business focus of this position, we are seeking candidates with a demonstrated track record of independently sourcing, negotiating, and closing sponsorship or partnership deals, and who can quickly contribute to revenue growth.

Responsibilities: 

  • Responsible for developing a global pipeline and executing partnerships with blue-chip brands to reach Sponsorship revenue goals 
  • Cultivate global and local market category prospects through category analysis and market research, with a focus on international markets without a dedicated new business resource  
  • Establish and build relationships with key external contacts (e.g., corporate decision makers at Fortune 500 companies and influencers in the sports marketing and agency world) 
  • Pursue prospects through contact strategy, development, and delivery of sales presentations, negotiation, and contract execution 
  • Actively contribute innovative thinking and fresh ideas that help lead to new revenue-generating sponsorship opportunities and contribute to cross-functional working groups consisting of key internal stakeholders (e.g., Media, IT, Football Operations, Social Responsibility, etc.) to develop customized marketing platforms that align with prospective partner objectives 
  • Develop and write strategic, customized presentations and partnership proposals for prospects 
  • Effectively maintain sales pipeline and reporting documents, as well as other duties as directed 
  • Help manage Sponsorship Business Development Senior Coordinator contributions to the team in partnership with the Senior Director 

Required Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's Degree 
  • 5+ years of direct sponsorship sales experience at league, team, agency and/or company 
  • Hands-on experience leading the full new-business sales cycle, from prospecting through deal execution, required

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Excellent written and verbal communicator; ability to build trusted relationships and influence across all levels both internally and externally 
  • Proficient with MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint 

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics: 

  • Energetic, self-starter with a passion for uncovering synergies between Fortune 500 brands and the NFL 
  • Strong knowledge of sports marketing and/or sponsorship landscape 
  • Proficient in conducting industry research, prospecting, outreach, pitch ideation, and proposal development 
  • Excellent written and verbal communicator 
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and influence across all levels, both internally and externally 
  • Experienced in leveraging your network to initiate and develop relationships with senior-level marketing executives 

Physical Demands: 

  • N/A 

Travel: 

  • Travel as needed for new business meetings (expected 10 percent of time)

job.title: Part-Time Media Design Group Designer/Animator
job.description:
The NFL Media Design Group is seeking a Designer/Animator to create high-quality graphics, motion design, and visual storytelling assets that support shows, live events, special programming, and emerging platforms. This role combines concept development, design execution, and animation, requiring creativity, technical expertise, and a strong attention to detail.

Working closely with Art Directors and Creative Producers, the Designer/Animator will develop original concepts, iterate on creative solutions, and deliver polished motion graphics that meet the highest production standards.

Responsibilities

  • Conceptualize, design, and animate high-production-value graphics for a variety of NFL Media projects.
  • Create original visual concepts and translate them into compelling motion design solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Art Directors to ensure creative alignment and execution excellence.
  • Develop scalable, repeatable animation systems and templates that can be shared across internal teams, editors, and external vendors.
  • Maintain organized project files and adhere to established workflows and production standards.
  • Partner with Creative Producers to establish realistic timelines and manage design, revision, and delivery schedules.
  • Balance multiple assignments while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Execute projects efficiently, including those with accelerated turnaround times, by leveraging existing toolkits, templates, and custom assets.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in design, motion graphics, or animation.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe After Effects (including Scripting and Mogrts), Photoshop, and Illustrator.
  • Experience using Figma, UI/UX design
  • Knowledge of Cinema 4D (C4D)
  • Ability to develop custom designs and animations from original concepts, style guides, existing graphic packages, and creative references.
  • Strong understanding of motion design principles, visual storytelling, and production workflows.
  • Ability to follow established file naming conventions, organizational standards, and production processes.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Proactive, detail oriented, organized, and accountable, with the ability to perform in a highly collaborative setting. 
  • Confidence in a fast-paced environment 
  • Flexibility when faced with new information, needs or challenges 
  • Ability to ask questions and communicate with art directors and creative producers when uncertain a current assignment or when ready for the next one. 
  • Willingness to invest in understanding the business of the NFL to better support and enhance how the League serves our clubs and engages our fans.  

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Part-time, up to 29 hours per week
  • Flexibility to work non-standard hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays, as production schedules require.

job.title: Seasonal Bilingual Video Editor, Global Creative Marketing
job.description:
The NFL Global Creative Marketing team is seeking a bilingual (Spanish/English) seasonal video editor adept in the Adobe Creative Suite who will help bring to life imaginative video content. This position will be executing a variety of projects and campaigns, including support for owned & operated social channels, player social media support, original content series, marketing campaigns and more. As a part of the most creative and experimental group of the NFL, this role is for someone who is comfortable with change and able to balance a heavy workload. Success in this position is reliant on being a self-starter with a willingness to learn and grow alongside the brand. The successful candidate is a creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, with a deep understanding of and experience with creating social video.

Essential Functions:

  • Pitch and create video optimized for social platforms
  • Embrace new and innovative ways to tell stories across the NFL’s social channels
  • Identify opportunities to create new and fresh video content by utilizing new trends and tools
  • Ensure logical sequencing through organizing and trimming footage segments
  • Stay up to date with industry standards and best practices
  • Handle critical deadlines and short turnarounds in a fast-paced environment

Required Education and Experience:

  • Fluency in English and Spanish mandatory; working proficiency in Portuguese a bonus
  • 2-4+ years of proven editing experience (sports editing preferred, but not required) for social and digital platforms
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, with a strong emphasis in Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, and Media Encoder
  • Strong audio and music editing skills
  • Thorough knowledge of the National Football League, associated events and storylines
  • Meticulous attention to detail and high level of resourcefulness
  • Working knowledge of video and audio encoding, standards and formats
  • Familiarity with special effects, 3D and compositing are a plus

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred in film studies, cinematography or related fields

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, including nights and weekends
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Must demonstrate exceptional problem-solving skills

job.title: Seasonal Football Operations Coordinator
job.description:
Summary/Objective:

The Football Operations Coordinator supports the Football Operations team by coordinating routine game day logistics, crew communication, credentialing details, travel coordination, shipments, and administrative tracking under general direction.

Responsibilities:

  • Confirm support staff for assigned camera and audio crews for weekly games, escalating staffing challenges as needed.
  • Communicate club policies and procedures relating to credentialing, parking, security, and stadium access to assigned crews.
  • Prepare and track FedEx shipments to crew members and resolve any delivery exceptions.
  • Coordinate routine travel needs with the travel department, including air, hotel, and ground transportation details.
  • Maintain detailed game notes, documentation, and crew communications to ensure crews receive accurate information.
  • Monitor timecards, onboarding paperwork, and background check status in coordination with HR.
  • Coordinate with courier company all details required for prompt recovery of media from games.
  • Collaborate with other departments to ensure proper documentation of game media is provided to crews.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 1–2 years of production, field operations, event operations, or related logistics experience preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Microsoft Teams.

Preferred Education and Experience:

Working knowledge of NFL game operations, NFL Films production workflows, crew roles, and stadium access processes.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented approach
  • Accountability and sound judgment
  • Responsibility to team and commitment to supporting crew needs
  • Resiliency and ability to adapt quickly to change
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to build strong working relationships
  • Strong time management skills and ability to meet strict deadlines

Supervisory Responsibility:

  • None

Physical Demands:

None

Travel:

  • Some travel to NFL games may be needed (10%).

  • Must be available to take emergency calls and emails over the weekend.
  • Must stay until work is completed to meet deadlines.

job.title: Seasonal Live Content Correspondents Production Coordinator
job.description:
The NFL Live Content Correspondents (LCC) Program is seeking an experienced Coordinator to join their team in supporting 100+ LCC contractors in the weekly capture and delivery of gameday and event content across the NFL social ecosystem (in direct partnership with social leads at all 32 Clubs). This position will be focused on the logistical and operational functions in the capture and real-time distribution of all LCC generated content. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, everchanging content production environment that incudes shifting priorities and the need to remain calm under pressure. Organizational skills and a strong knowledge of pre- and post-production workflows will be invaluable.

Responsibilities

  • Support 100+ LCC contractors in the weekly capture and delivery of gameday and event content across the NFL social ecosystem
  • Support annual staffing of LCC contributors across all relevant markets w/ associated performance management
  • Lead daily communication with LCCs to ensure a seamless production workflow
  • Coordinate with the Player Social team to continue to scale LCC content creation opportunities in collaboration with NFL players
  • Collaborate closely with other internal stakeholders to execute with LCCs around tentpole events (e.g. Super Bowl, Combine, Draft, Pro Bowl, etc.)
  • Stay up to date with industry standards and best practices
  • Thoroughly track the LCC program’s activity in partnership with key groups including: publishing of LCC content, consumption / engagement of LCC content, attributable revenue, etc.
  • Consistently and reliably communicate information to key stakeholders across internal and external entities.

Required Qualifications

  • 4-year degree preferred. BS or BA in content/film/production related field preferred.
  • Thorough understanding of social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, etc.
  • Advanced understanding of all Microsoft Office programs such as Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
  • Thorough understanding of social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, etc.
  • Strong working knowledge of the production environment, including both pre and post
  • Must be able to work nights and weekends during NFL gamedays or during League events (e.g. Combine, Draft)
  • Must be able to work holidays depending on NFL game schedule (including but not limited to Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year’s Eve, New Year’s Day)
  • Thorough knowledge of the National Football League, associated events and storylines
  • Meticulous attention to detail and high level of resourcefulness

 Preferred Education and Experience

  • Minimum 1-2 years in the production space, preferably with a background in social media responsible for content / production, but open to backgrounds in broadcast, television, or theatrical
  • Strong knowledge of social, digital, and broadcast television content production dynamics and working knowledge of the equipment and technologies therein
  • Experience with communication platform Slack

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, including nights and weekends

job.title: Seasonal Recruiter
job.description:
The Seasonal Recruiter will lead seasonal recruitment efforts for various NFL offices.  In this role, you will be a talent advisor and build strong relationships with the senior management team. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role with senior management, hiring managers, compensation, finance, and HR Business Partners in driving hiring and employee retention efficiencies that support the NFL's vision, mission, and values. 

 

Please note this role is in-person/office five days a week based in Mount Laurel, NJ. Up to seven months of anticipated engagement (subject to change based on business needs).

 

Responsibilities 

  • Manage 40 to 50+ open seasonal requisitions at once across multiple departments and locations during peak hiring periods 
  • Execute full-cycle, high volume recruitment including screening, interviewing, and extending offers 
  • Support Early Career recruitment efforts during non-peak seasonal hiring times 
  • Build strong working relationships with HR and hiring managers to understand business needs, seasonal headcount planning, and job requirements 
  • Identify, and recruit candidates for a wide range of temporary roles across media, production, and game operations 
  • Maintain accurate and organized data in the applicant tracking system (Greenhouse) for all candidates and requisitions 
  • Create and deliver regular search status updates to hiring managers and partners 
  • Ensure equitable hiring processes in line with NFL standards and policies 
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines to support recurring seasonal staffing needs 
  • Represent the NFL at in person or virtual hiring events, job fairs, and recruiting programs as needed 
  • Manage offer processes including recommendations, drafting and extending offers, and negotiations as permitted

job.title: Seasonal Rights & Clearances Coordinator
job.description:
Summary

The Rights & Clearances Coordinator is responsible for researching, sourcing, and securing third‑party materials for use in NFL Films programming. This role works closely with producers, post‑production, media management, business affairs, and project managers to fulfill content needs while ensuring all material is properly licensed according to deadlines, budgets, and legal requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Research, request, and acquire third‑party materials including—but not limited to—photos, footage, newspaper articles, social media posts, podcasts, and other intellectual property.
  • Navigate and research archival collections, stock footage libraries, and professional photo agencies to locate hard‑to‑find materials.
  • Screen down cuts/programs and create detailed clearance logs to document all third‑party material usage.
  • Secure licenses, permissions, and releases for all third‑party content used in NFL Films programming.
  • Serve as a resource for production teams regarding rights, usage restrictions, and clearance options at all stages of production.
  • Track, organize, and maintain accurate records for all research and clearance documentation including agreements, invoices, purchase orders, and correspondence.
  • Communicate with internal departments to move acquired materials through workflows and deliver them to producers.
  • Maintain strong administrative procedures and uphold departmental standards.
  • Learn and use internal rights/clearance tracking systems and screening tools.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2 years dedicated Rights & Clearances or Archival Producing experience.
  • Foundational understanding of third‑party rights, licensing, and clearances.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in post‑production or within a similar archival/rights/clearances environment.
  • Experience with AirTable or similar systems.
  • Experience navigating and interpreting EDLs.
  • Proven negotiation experience with major archives, stock footage/photo libraries, and independent rights holders

Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational and time‑management skills.
  • Strong problem‑solving ability; resourceful and proactive.
  • Ability to manage sensitive or confidential information.
  • Flexibility to be on call for occasional weekend work.
  • Comfort working in deadline‑driven environments with shifting priorities.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • Assist with training and mentoring interns as needed.

Physical Demands

  • Occasional handling of physical archival materials such as footage reels, tapes, newspapers, and photo collections.

Travel

  • No regular travel expected.

job.title: Seasonal Video Editor, Global Creative Marketing
job.description:
The NFL Global Creative Marketing team is seeking a versatile seasonal video editor adept in the Adobe Creative Suite who will help bring to life imaginative video content. This position will be executing a variety of projects and campaigns, including support for owned & operated social channels, player social media support, original content series, marketing campaigns and more. As a part of the most creative and experimental group of the NFL, this role is for someone who is comfortable with change and able to balance a heavy workload. Success in this position is reliant on being a self-starter with a willingness to learn and grow alongside the brand. The successful candidate is a creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, with a deep understanding of and experience with creating social video.

Essential Functions:

  • Pitch and create video optimized for social platforms
  • Embrace new and innovative ways to tell stories across the NFL’s social channels
  • Identify opportunities to create new and fresh video content by utilizing new trends and tools

  • Stay up to date with industry standards and best practices

  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, with a strong emphasis in Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, and Media Encoder
  • Strong audio and music editing skills
  • Thorough knowledge of the National Football League, associated events and storylines
  • Meticulous attention to detail and high level of resourcefulness
  • Working knowledge of video and audio encoding, standards and formats

job.title: Senior Manager, International Data & Strategy
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Manager, International Data & Strategy, to lead and scale the NFL’s international managed model as part of a transformative enterprise initiative. In this role, you will partner closely with League and Club stakeholders to deliver high-quality, scalable data solutions and program operations that enable informed decision-making and drive business outcomes across global markets.

The ideal candidate brings 6 - 8+ years of experience with a demonstrated track record of delivering centralized, enterprise-scale initiatives. You will work hands-on across data strategy, technology, and program execution—owning delivery, driving cross-functional alignment, translating business needs into actionable requirements, and ensuring scalable, high-quality outputs.

This role is well-suited for a strategic yet hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment, excels at stakeholder management, and is passionate about leveraging data to unlock value and build scalable enterprise capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership: Drive cross-functional alignment and champion adoption of the International managed model through clear communication, best practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Program Management: Oversee day-to-day program operations for the international managed model, tracking progress across data onboarding, curation, fulfillment, reporting and insights.
  • Customer Partnership: Partner closely with clubs to drive adoption of the international managed model by capturing requirements and translating them into prioritized program initiatives.
  • Data Product Architecture: Translate business needs into scalable data and platform requirements to support segmentation, data access, and performance measurement.
  • Operational Excellence: Ensure efficient and consistent execution by establishing standardized processes and continuously optimizing workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 6 - 8+ years of progressive experience in data strategy, product management, data governance, or technology leadership roles, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale initiatives.
  • Proven track record leading complex data and analytics programs, including cloud data platforms, data lakes, governance frameworks, and cross-functional transformation efforts.
  • Strong understanding of privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, consent management, and responsible data practices.
  • Experience supporting fan, customer, or consumer-centric organizations, with knowledge of engagement strategies, audience development, and lifecycle marketing preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging enterprise data and marketing technology platforms, including AWS Redshift, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies.
  • Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, drive alignment across business and technology teams, and translate strategy into measurable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, drive organizational change, and scale processes, capabilities, and teams to support evolving business needs.
  • Strong strategic and operational mindset, with experience establishing governance models, prioritizing competing demands, managing risks, and delivering results in fast-paced environments.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Master’s degree or higher in statistics, data science, computer science, or other data related fields preferred

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Limited Travel

job.title: Senior Manager, Player Engagement
job.description:
The Senior Manager, Player Engagement is responsible for serving, equipping and empowering NFL players and Club Heads of Player Engagement (HPE) within the five Player Engagement pillars (continuing education, financial empowerment, personal and professional development and HPE development). The Senior Manager supports a cluster of 8 club HPEs and serves as the lead for player mandatory education per the Collective Bargaining Agreement. In addition, the role will lead/support multiple Player Engagement initiatives and programs.  

Responsibilities

  • Offer support in the five pillars of Player Engagement, working closely with clubs Heads of Player Engagement to ensure comprehensive player support
  • Oversee player mandatory education, devise the strategy, assist with the development of evergreen content/curriculum, lead internal collaboration & communication within the league office, and implement changes that align with player needs
  • Train presenters, including Legends and League staff, on player mandatory education
  • Develop the strategy for the continuing education pillar, drive participation, conduct degree verifications, and lead educational webinars
  • Direct all aspects of the Paul J. Tagliabue NFL Academic Excellence Award, coordinating nominations, committee engagement, and recipient recognition
  • Lead and facilitate off-season programs and workshops for players that focus on post NFL experience career exploration
  • Responsible for leading NFL Family Programming efforts, including the creation, implementation, and evaluation of programs, resources, and services that support the holistic development of NFL players and their families
  • Manage and respond to club HPEs, players, NFL Legend inquiries, ensuring that support and resources are provided  
  • Assist in the planning and coordination of the Player Engagement Annual Meeting
  • Serve as the department lead for invoices and contracts

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
  • Minimum 7 years of related experience in professional sports or college athletics/student-athlete support
  • Must work from the NFL League office in New York, 5 days per week

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, strong time management and organizational skills
  • Strong communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills
  • Self-motivated and able to perform with minimal supervision
  • Attention to detail
  • Critical thinker
  • High level of proficiency with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint and Excel)and Adobe Creative Suite (preferred)
  • Team oriented and can work with diverse team members
  • Goal oriented and demonstrate an ability to apply in-depth knowledge to achieve stated goals and solve problems
  • Act as a true Servant Leader

job.title: IT Network Manager
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

As our IT Network Manager, you will lead a dedicated team of network and voice engineers while bridging the gap between traditional enterprise networking and cutting-edge broadcast technology. We are looking for a people-first, Cisco-certified leader to guide, mentor, and empower an engineering team overseeing the lifecycle of our network infrastructure. Beyond technical mastery, you will cultivate a high-performing team culture centered on collaboration, continuous growth, high availability, and proactive security. If you thrive in inspiring technical talent within an 'always-on' environment and have a passion for seamless media delivery, this is your next challenge.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership & Talent Development: Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of network and voice engineers; establish clear goals, manage team performance, drive professional development, and champion a collaborative, supportive engineering culture.
  • Enterprise Architecture & Infrastructure Management: Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise network, wireless, and Storage Area Networking (SAN) infrastructure across Cisco ACI, Catalyst/Nexus, Firepower (FTD), SD-WAN, and Meraki platforms.
  • Broadcast Network Alignment: Partner with broadcast engineering teams to guide your team in maintaining a high-availability IP broadcast network that carries low-latency, real-time audio and video traffic for NPR’s daily content production and live transmission.
  • Operational Excellence & Incident Leadership: Lead network operations, incident management, and root-cause analysis for complex issues; coach team members through high-pressure troubleshooting using monitoring tools like SolarWinds, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, and ThousandEyes.
  • Documentation & Standards: Develop and maintain network architecture documentation, standard operating procedures, and routing protocols (BGP, EIGRP), ensuring network reliability, scalability, security, and team operational best practices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate with Security, DevOps, Systems, and Enterprise Application teams, while effectively communicating network performance, risk analyses, incident reports, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise networking.
  • 3+ years directly managing and developing technical teams in a network leadership or manager role.
  • Proven track record of talent development, performance management, team building, and leading engineering teams through major operational projects.
  • Strong hands-on experience with at least two of the following:
    • Cisco Nexus (NX-OS)
    • Cisco Firepower (FTD)
    • Cisco Routing and Switching
    • Cisco ACI
    • Cisco SD-WAN
    • Cisco Meraki
    • Enterprise Wireless Networks
  • Strong expertise in routing and switching (BGP, EIGRP).
  • Experience with at least one of the following network management and observability platforms: SolarWinds, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Intersight, or similar enterprise network monitoring and management tools .
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, team leadership, and documentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams through critical production outages and high-pressure incident response, ensuring fast service recovery, effective team coordination, and business continuity.
  • Ability to translate complex broadcast requirements into scalable network architectures, overseeing robust business continuity planning, and fostering a team culture of technical excellence and psychological safety.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Data Center).
  • lCisco CCIE certification.
  • Experience with ThousandEyes.
  • Experience with high-quality, real-time audio and video over IP networks, such as SMPTE ST 2110 and NDI, particularly in a IP broadcast environment.
  • Working knowledge of PTP, SMPTE ST 2110, multicast, and QoS.
  • Experience with large-scale or multi-site enterprise environments.
  • Experience with network automation / Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with managing on-prem and hosted Telephony and AV systems.
  • Experience supporting audio/video transmission or production workflows.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location as assigned. On-site assignments are determined by a monthly rotation schedule. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia Metro Area.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $158,500 - $180,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

As our Mobile Software Engineering Manager on the Audience Technology team, you will lead a highly collaborative team of mobile software engineers building, testing, and delivering award-winning features for NPR's flagship mobile applications. You will partner closely with our Product, Design, Data, and Editorial teams to identify priorities, architect new features, and continuously improve existing applications. In this role, you will act as a primary champion of team health, career progression, and technical excellence.

  • Agile Delivery Management: Lead the technical planning, scoping, and execution of future software projects, facilitating Agile ceremonies (stand-ups, backlog refinements, sprint planning, and retrospectives) as needed.
  • Technical Quality & Code Review: Conduct thorough software design and code reviews, providing constructive and substantive feedback to maintain code health, architectural integrity, and security standards.
  • Continuous Process Improvement: Analyze, propose, and implement engineering workflow improvements to enhance the speed, safety, and quality of software delivery.
  • Developer Experience Automation: Identify common engineering blockers and pain points, writing helper tools or automation scripts to optimize team developer experience (DX).
  • Incident & Production Support: Oversee and coordinate the team's response to critical mobile production bugs or infrastructure incidents.
  • Vendor & Contributor Management: Coordinate workflows, code standards, and deliverables for external contributors and specialized development vendors.

  • Strong working knowledge of native mobile release infrastructures (such as Apple App Store Connect/provisioning profiles or Google Play Console/staged rollouts).
  • Hands-on experience working with modern version control systems (primarily Git).
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating within cross-functional Agile/Scrum product teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience managing both internal employees and external agency vendors/contractors.
  • Experience with native mobile media streaming frameworks (such as AVKit/AVFoundation for iOS, or Media3/ExoPlayer for Android).
  • Familiarity with modern responsive design architectures (SwiftUI/Combine or Jetpack Compose/Coroutines), design patterns (MVVM), and automotive platforms (CarPlay/Android Auto).

Required Skills/Competencies

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. Application Deadline: Please submit your application materials by 11:59 pm EST Sunday September 13th, 2026

Intro to Position

We are seeking a data-driven and highly creative marketing strategist to grow our audience for NPR’s owned platforms, with a focus on The NPR app. You will act as a guiding force behind NPR’s mobile growth, leveraging data and insights to inform strategies and tactics that migrate audiences to the core digital experience that will define NPR for years to come. 

You will manage a dedicated advertising budget, and will also be expected to make the most of NPR’s own channels like our podcasts, broadcast, website, and of course the NPR app’s messaging and UX. You will work closely with the app and web product teams, the audience insights and analytics teams, the content teams and the Network growth teams, and many others while you seek to find loyal users, keep them engaged, and transform this platform into an indispensable daily habit that sustains our journalism and mission. 

You will lead test-and-learn campaigns, making data-informed decisions on where we should invest our resources next. Your goal is to understand our audience’s needs, deepen their engagement with our content, and identify exactly where NPR’s app stands out in a crowded landscape, ultimately shaping how public media thrives in a mobile-first world. 

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with: NABET-CWA DMU. 

Responsibilities

  • Execute Marketing Campaigns: Plan the strategy and messaging for campaigns that give people a clear, compelling reason to download and use the NPR app, translating our trusted journalism into a dynamic, modern mobile experience.
  • Manage Paid and Free/Owned Media: Run ads across social media, search, and video platforms, while also creating promotions for NPR's own radio broadcasts, podcasts, and newsletters to ensure our public service journalism reaches audiences wherever they are.
  • Manage the Budget: Decide how to spend our advertising money effectively to get the best return on investment and the lowest cost per download, helping build a sustainable, digital-first growth engine for the network. 
  • Lead Across Teams: Bring together people from the product, analytics, content, and broadcast teams in order to execute campaigns that feel cohesive and true to NPR.
  • Keep Users Coming Back: Build plans (using tools like push notifications, in-app-messages, and emails) to turn first-time downloaders into dedicated returning users, elevating our listeners’ daily routines by making the app an indispensable companion.
  • Understand Our Audience: Research the app landscape to see trends, what others are doing right, figure out where NPR stands out, and make sure our marketing speaks directly to what our audience needs.
  • Test and Improve: Always approach projects with a testing mindset and determine what strategies drive new installs and deeper engagement. 
  • Track Success: Track conversions in actionable ways that can help drive near and long-term marketing decisions. You will work closely with our Audience Insights and Product teams to track all your promotional strategies, but especially digital ads and even terrestrial radio promo.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

  • 5+ years of experience in a data-driven marketing role, preferably at a media or tech company

  • An execution-focused collaborator who thoughtfully balances team input while maintaining a strong bias for action. You know when to align, but also when to roll up your sleeves and keep things moving.
  • Ability to turn complex numbers into clear, simple stories that inform leadership decisions.
  • A talent for competitive analysis and a deep curiosity about audience behavior.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • A proven track record in both creative marketing campaign management and data-driven performance analysis.
  • Proven ability to manage paid advertising budgets efficiently, especially for mobile app growth.
  • Experience using tracking software, pixels, UTMs, etc. to identify which specific promotions lead to new app users.
  • Substantial experience & comfort building campaigns for a wide variety of marketing messaging channels including but not limited to: email, social media, in-app messaging, display, audio, push notifications, SMS, web notification/pop-ups, in-product UX, etc. (experience with enterprise level cross-channel messaging tools like Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Iterable, or Adobe Campaign/Marketo is a plus)

job.title: Senior Video Editor, Wild Card
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline: Please submit your application by 11:59 pm EST September 14th, 2026 

About the Position 

Wild Card with Rachel Martin is an interview show that serves as an antidote to the cynicism and chaos of modern life. Rachel’s soulful conversations with some of the most influential and thoughtful minds of our generation reminds people of the things that matter most.

In 2025, Wild Card launched as NPR’s first-ever video podcast. Since then, Rachel’s interviews with everyone from Oprah to Michelle Obama have reached millions of views on YouTube and clips from the show regularly go viral on Instagram. NPR is looking for an experienced video editor to help Wild Card further develop its video presence and reach new audiences. 

We’re looking for a creative and organized video editor with experience booking, producing and editing longform interviews. You’ll produce, edit, and publish long- and short-form video for Wild Card. You have a strong understanding of how distribution and virality works on platforms like Spotify, YouTube and Instagram. You will support showrunners, podcast hosts, and work closely with NPR’s Visuals team. You will innovate new formats and design approaches to help Wild Card reach bigger audiences.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with SAG-AFTRA. 

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with producers and editors on Wild Card to conceive, generate, edit and publish video podcast episodes and short-form vertical video. 
  • Collaborate with Wild Card editors on managing Instagram, YouTube and other visual platforms. 
  • Manage production schedule for multiple video editors working on weekly Wild Card video deliverables.
  • Produce, edit and publish audio deliverables for radio and other audio-only platforms
  • Direct remote and in-person Wild Card tapings
  • Pitch and book guests who have the right mix of thoughtfulness, vulnerability and humor to match Wild Card’s tone.
  • Take responsibility for video tasks, including multiple layers of coordination, logistics, creativity and sensitivity in the storytelling.
  • Work with the Wild Card and visuals teams to figure out new formats for Wild Card content that will help reach new audiences.
  • Help refine Wild Card’s presentation on major video platforms, including thumbnails, titles, landing pages, etc.
  • Excel at directing and executing visual storytelling forms such as cinematography, photography and lighting, as well as be proficient at executing motion graphics, where applicable.
  • Clearly communicate the vision, project goals, narrative scope and timeline for each production.
  • Function as a key decision maker on the shape and look of regular content and important projects.
  • Maintain NPR editorial and ethical guidelines in all production.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years video production experience, preferably with a major network or newsroom, studio or creative agency.
  • Mastery of Riverside, Descript, Premiere, and other programs related to video, photo and design, including Canva.
  • Experience producing video interviews
  • Experience with social media engagement is a plus.
  • Demonstrated commitment to increasing audience diversity.
  • Be well-versed in copyright and ethical journalism practices.
  • Excellent communication and writing skills.
  • Strong editing skills.
  • Must be able to lift video equipment weighing up to 30 pounds.
  • Ability to contribute to and carry out a comprehensive, cross-platform social strategy.
  • Ability to handle multiple and complex projects simultaneously under tight deadlines and changing priorities/conditions.
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and to consistently work well with others and as part of a team, demonstrating at all times respect for the diverse constituencies at NPR and within the public radio system.
  • Ability and willingness to work varied shifts.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, DC or New York City location at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in DC/Maryland/Virginia or the New York City area, depending on which office location is applicable.

Job Type

  • This is a permanent full-time position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $127,500 - $140,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees. 

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.

#LI-HYBRID

job.title: ONErpm Brasil | BU Lead - Samba
job.description:
Sobre a ONErpm

  • Liderança estratégica: Participar da criação de estratégias junto à diretoria e transformar planos em ações que aceleram o crescimento da unidade.
  • Gestão multidisciplinar: Supervisionar e inspirar equipes diversas, garantindo entregas de alto impacto e prazos cumpridos.
  • Especialista musical: Ser referência no gênero musical Samba, promovendo o branding da ONErpm em comunidades artísticas e na indústria.
  • Visão de negócios: Identificar oportunidades, analisar tendências, criar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho.
  • Relacionamento: Manter e fortalecer parcerias com clientes, artistas, associações e mídia, representando a ONErpm em eventos e conferências.
  • Mentoria: Desenvolver talentos, promovendo feedbacks construtivos e crescimento do time.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

  • Pesquisar o mercado e mapear oportunidades de expansão.
  • Elaborar e implementar estratégias para crescimento do BU de Samba
  • Medir resultados, interpretar dados e apresentar relatórios claros.
  • Coordenar insights de negócios, marketing e tendências musicais.
  • Suportar A&Rs e Label Managers em negociações, marketing e comunicação.
  • Garantir recursos e operações eficientes para o time.
  • Manter relacionamentos próximos com clientes e parceiros estratégicos.
  • Representar a ONErpm em eventos do setor musical.
  • Assegurar conformidade com diretrizes jurídicas.

O Que Procuramos

  • Perfil orientado a resultados, com habilidades de negociação e comunicação;
  • Liderança inspiradora, com capacidade de engajar e motivar times diversos;
  • Paixão e conhecimento sobre a cultura musical brasileira, especialmente o gênero Funk;
  • Perfil empreendedor e proativo.

Habilidades Técnicas

  • Domínio de estratégias de negócios e crescimento de market share (streams/faturamento).
  • Proficiência em análise de dados (Power BI, Tableau, Excel).
  • Conhecimento em processos de liberação de fonogramas/obras.
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos multidisciplinares.
  • Conhecimento em inglês e/ou espanhol será considerado um diferencial.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens quando necessário.

Diferenciais

  • VT
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (sem coparticipação)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio creche
  • Sistema de trabalho híbrido

job.title: 403g Media Maintenance Technician
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

Overview and Responsibilities:

 

Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Media Maintenance Technician in Production Technology and Operations. This position is responsible for performing engineering maintenance and technical support for video editors, graphic designers, social media producers, content ingest operators, QC operators, and other content creators, ensuring minimal disruption to production workflows which support the CBS Network and affiliated production units. This role will design, implement, and support next-generation media systems and infrastructure, both on-premises and in the cloud, and provide proactive monitoring and maintenance to ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of systems in a 24x7 critical broadcast environment.

This role is responsible for a wide range of broadcast and media production systems, including (but not limited to): SDI and SMPTE ST 2110 video routing systems, Avid editorial systems, Pro Tools audio production environments, JAMF-based endpoint management, media transcoding and automated QC platforms, Windows and Linux system administration, application servers and SQL databases, on-premises NAS and cloud storage systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud), high-speed file transfer systems (Aspera, Signiant), internet streaming and encoding platforms, identity and authentication systems (Active Directory / SSO), and monitoring/observability platforms (Zabbix, New Relic).

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

• 5+ years' experience supporting and optimizing end-to-end media workflows (ingest, transcoding, QC, delivery) across on-prem and cloud environments, with strong knowledge of video/audio formats, codecs, and containers.

• Experience supporting professional post-production environments, with hands-on expertise in Avid (Media Composer, Interplay, MediaCentral) and Pro Tools, including troubleshooting, system maintenance, and workflow optimization

• Advanced knowledge of Windows and Linux administration in production environments (on-prem and public cloud), including deploying and supporting complex media processing applications. Must include experience with identity and access management (e.g., Active Directory integration), configuring networked services (e.g., shared storage, databases, or clustered applications), and troubleshooting distributed system issues in complex environments.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

• Deep understanding of professional video and audio standards, including:

· Resolutions and formats (1080i, 1080p, HDR)

· Color science (color space, rec.709, HLG, PQ)

· Timecode and frame rates

· Codecs and compression

· Audio formats (PCM, 5.1 surround, Dolby Atmos)

· Container formats (MXF, transport stream)

• Ability to diagnose and resolve workflow issues across multi-vendor media systems and distributed processing environments.

• Familiarity with color space conversion and HDR/SDR interoperability.

• Ability to diagnose and resolve HDR pipeline issues.

• Hands-on experience supporting media processing and workflow orchestration platforms such as Telestream Vantage and Interra Baton.

• Experience supporting high-performance file transfer and delivery systems such as IBM Aspera and Signiant.

• Hands-on experience administering and supporting JAMF in an enterprise Mac environment.

• Advanced technical expertise with Avid Media Composer, Interplay, and MediaCentral (ACSR certification or equivalent experience preferred).

• Experience supporting or working within Dolby Atmos production environments in Pro Tools-based workflows.

• Experience with scripting and automation using tools such as Bash, PowerShell, or Python.

• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools and best practices, such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

• Experience implementing and maintaining monitoring and observability solutions such as Zabbix, Splunk, or New Relic.

• In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and secure system design.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence across engineering, operations, and creative stakeholders.

• Strong documentation discipline, including the ability to produce and maintain clear, accurate technical documentation.

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $136,281.60 - 136,281.60. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York City, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement.   

 

What We Offer:
  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here: https://www.paramount.com/careers/benefits
  • Generous paid time off.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.
  • Opportunities for both on-site and virtual engagement events.
  • Unique opportunities to make meaningful connections and build a vibrant community, both inside and outside the workplace.
  • Explore life at Paramount: https://www.paramount.com/careers/life-at-paramount

 

Paramount is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) including disability/vet.

 

At Paramount, the spirit of inclusion feeds into everything that we do, on-screen and off. From the programming and movies we create to employee benefits/programs and social impact outreach initiatives, we believe that opportunity, access, resources and rewards should be available to and for the benefit of all. Paramount is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, and Veteran status.

 

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access https://www.paramount.com/careers as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by calling 212.846.5500 or by sending an email to paramountaccommodations@paramount.com. Only messages left for this purpose will be returned.

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as 10 Streaming and on SVOD with Paramount+. 

 

 

 

 

We now have a rare opportunity for an experienced Ad Sales Account Manager to join our industry-recognised team in SYDNEY on a leave cover contract.   

 

What you’ll do as an Account Manager- Ad Sales:   

As an Account Manager you will work within Paramount’s high performing Ad Sales team representing and selling advertising across the Paramount ecosystem including Network Ten. You will be a champion of TV/Streaming and display a firm understanding of the role it plays in delivering effective outcomes for your portfolio of clients. You will act as the face of the Paramount brand in market, representing with passion, maximising revenue opportunities, creating best-in-class strategic solutions, and building meaningful relationships with your partners. 

 

Some of the key responsibilities include:  

  • Leading a dynamic portfolio of Agency/Direct clients with accountability for achieving revenue, increasing market share and yield targets across the wider Paramount playground (TV, BVOD, SVOD).  
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with key clients, understanding their business objectives and providing tailored solutions. 
  • Proactively engage with media agencies via regular in person meetings and presentations to pitch creative opportunities and integrated cross-platform solutions. 
  • Mentoring and guiding Account Executives, fostering a positive team culture by providing training and support to enhance the skills and performance of the overall team. 
  • Educating yourself on the evolving media landscape by staying informed on industry trends, competitors and market conditions to identify any potential risks or opportunities for growth.  
  • Collaborating with all internal stakeholders within the business ie: Digital, Regional, Commercial Data & Innovation, Paramount Brand Studio, Sport, Revenue etc to provide seamless sales strategies for your clients and content led partnership opportunities.  
  • Driving new business growth by proactively prospecting and qualifying new clients 
  • Champion internal process improvements, identifying opportunities to streamline workflows and enhance productivity in campaign delivery and client service. 

 

What are the benefits?  

  • Representing some of the world’s most powerful media & entertainment brands and content  
  • Ability to thrive in a highly successful Sales team who work hard and celebrate success regularly.  
  • Free subscription to Paramount + amongst other benefits 

  

What are we looking for in an Account Manager? What’s important?    

  • Account management experience in advertising and/or media sectors  
  • Demonstrated experience in a sales-focused role and pitching solutions to clients  
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills  
  • First-rate presentation skills   
  • A passion for content, streaming, advertising innovation and audience behaviour 
  • Understanding of the broader media landscape  
  • Strong agency/buyer relationships highly regarded 
  • Bachelor’s degree in media, Communications, Business, Marketing or related field highly regarded but not essential.

job.description:
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.  

 

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as 10 Streaming and on SVOD with Paramount+. 

 

 

We now have a rare opportunity for an experienced Ad Sales Account Manager to join our industry-recognised team in MELBOURNE.

 

What you’ll do as an Account Manager- Ad Sales:   

 

As an Account Manager you will work within Paramount’s high performing Ad Sales team representing and selling advertising across the Paramount ecosystem including Network Ten. You will be a champion of TV/Streaming and display a firm understanding of the role it plays in delivering effective outcomes for your portfolio of clients. You will act as the face of the Paramount brand in market, representing with passion, maximising revenue opportunities, creating best-in-class strategic solutions, and building meaningful relationships with your partners. 

 

Some of the key responsibilities include:  

 
  • Driving revenue growth across an allocated agency portfolio to meet and exceed targets
  • Market presence - regularly out in market presenting to, and meeting with, clients to provide advertising solutions and respond to their advertising briefs.
  • Facilitating and supporting the sale of cross platform sponsorships across general entertainment, sport, and social packages 
  • Providing accurate forecasting data on revenue for portfolio. 
  • Lead and mentor an Account Executive as an indirect report.  

  

What are the benefits?  

  •  Representing some of the world’s most powerful media & entertainment brands
  • Working for a Global brand, you will have career development opportunities which can expand to countries all over the world 
  • Ability to thrive in a highly successful Sales team who work hard and celebrate success regularly.  
  • Free subscription to Paramount + amongst other benefits 
     

  

What are we looking for in an Account Manager? What’s important?    

  • Account management experience in advertising and/or media sectors

  • Demonstrated experience in a sales-focused role and pitching solutions to clients  

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills  

  • First-rate presentation skills   

  • Genuine passion for television, streaming and video content  

  • Understanding of the broader media landscape  

  • Strong agency/buyer relationships  

 

   

Paramount ANZ is proud to be recognised by Diversity Council Australia as a 2024-2025 Inclusive Employer.  

 

Paramount embraces differences and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds regardless of factors such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property or birth. These grounds also include age, nationality, marital status, disability, place of residence and sexual orientation.   

Paramount acknowledges and respects Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as the first peoples of the lands where we live, learn and work, and honours their continuing connection and care for Country and storytelling.   

 

#LI-LG1  

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, Pluto TV, Network 10 (Australia) and Channel 5 (UK).

job.title: Account Manager, Local Ad Sales, Miami WFOR
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

The Account Manager (AM) is a developmental sales-focused role responsible for supporting day-to-day revenue efforts while developing the skills and experience needed to become a future Account Executive. This role touches all facets of the sales process—from proposal development and client support to campaign execution and stewardship—while partnering closely with Account Executives and internal teams.

 

This is a position designed for high-potential candidates who want to learn the business, build selling skills, and grow into a full-cycle seller with direct ownership of accounts and revenue.

 

Overview & Responsibilities

  • Sales & Revenue Support
    • Partner closely with Account Executives to support active accounts, proposals, and revenue opportunities
    • Assist in selling cross-platform campaigns across linear and streaming inventory
    • Participate in sales calls (virtual and in-person) to gain exposure to client conversations, needs discovery, and selling strategies
    • Support, develop and/or cultivate new business and smaller account opportunities as part of the broader AE pipeline
  • Client & Campaign Execution
    • Coordinate campaign execution from pre-sale through post-sale, ensuring flawless delivery and stewardship
    • Arrange make-goods for program changes on all deals
    • Prepare and update stewardship reports for guaranteed and non-guaranteed campaigns
    • Serve as a client support resource for inbound questions and requests
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work with Marketing, Research, Promotions, Traffic, and Operations teams to develop tailored sales presentations and solutions
    • Project-manage all elements needed for campaign launch, including creative assets, tags, approvals, and timelines
    • Ensure accurate communication and information flow between internal teams, Account Executives, and leadership
  • Sales Development & Learning
    • Build foundational selling skills including proposal development, account support, pricing concepts, and inventory management
    • Learn media planning fundamentals and the end-to-end advertising sales lifecycle
    • Gain exposure to systems, processes, and tools critical to future Account Executive success

 

Work Schedule: This role is currently hybrid (3 days/week in office) and will return to fully in office (5 days/week) this September.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience in advertising, media, or sales support (Ad Sales, planning, buying, or agency experience preferred)
  • Bachelor’s degree required; equivalent combination of education and experience considered

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong desire to build a career in advertising sales and grow into a revenue-owning seller
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, team-oriented sales environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Self-motivated, driven, and eager to learn
  • Experience with sales and ad-tech platforms such as FreeWheel, Salesforce, Operative, and/or WideOrbit is a plus
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Excel, and Google Workspace

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

Organizations that wish to receive job vacancy notices from this posting’s television station should contact sf_recruitingsupport@paramount.com.

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $60,000.00 - 70,000.00 plus sales incentive bonus. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement.  This position is eligible to earn sales incentive compensation. 

 

What We Offer:
  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here: https://www.paramount.com/careers/benefits
  • Generous paid time off.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.
  • Opportunities for both on-site and virtual engagement events.
  • Unique opportunities to make meaningful connections and build a vibrant community, both inside and outside the workplace.
  • Explore life at Paramount: https://www.paramount.com/careers/life-at-paramount

 

Paramount is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) including disability/vet.

 

At Paramount, the spirit of inclusion feeds into everything that we do, on-screen and off. From the programming and movies we create to employee benefits/programs and social impact outreach initiatives, we believe that opportunity, access, resources and rewards should be available to and for the benefit of all. Paramount is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, and Veteran status.

 

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access https://www.paramount.com/careers as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by calling 212.846.5500 or by sending an email to paramountaccommodations@paramount.com. Only messages left for this purpose will be returned.
