job.title: Analyst
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

  Overview We are the Global Marketing Analytics team supporting Paramount Streaming. The Analyst, Marketing Data Operations will provide day-to-day operational support for the marketing data ecosystem, with a primary focus on monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines that ingest and transform performance data from paid media platforms such as Meta, Google, and TikTok. This role is well-suited for an analytically minded, technically curious individual who is keen to develop hands-on experience across modern data tools and infrastructure. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, forward-thinking in resolving data issues, and enthusiastic about integrating AI-assisted tools into their daily workflow to work smarter and transition faster. A comfort with ambiguity, a bias toward action, and a willingness to learn on the job will be key ingredients for success.   Responsibilities
  • Support the identification, investigation, and resolution of data discrepancies across marketing platform data sources including Meta, Google, TikTok, and others
  • Monitor data pipelines for anomalies, failures, and latency issues; escalate and help address incidents in a timely manner
  • Write and maintain SQL-based queries and transformation logic to support consistent marketing data across reporting layers
  • Assist with orchestration workflows using tools such as Apache Airflow, including helping to diagnose DAG failures and flag scheduling issues
  • Develop and maintain Python scripts to support data quality checks, recurring ingestion processes, and operational automation
  • Use GitHub for version control and collaborate with teammates on code reviews and deployment of data logic updates
  • Work within development environments including Visual Studio Code and Cursor to build, test, and iterate on data and automation workflows
  • Actively incorporate and help develop AI-assisted workflows leveraging tools like Claude to support day-to-day tasks: writing and debugging code, drafting documentation, and accelerating data investigations
  • Support broader AI initiatives and projects across the team as needs evolve
  • Maintain clear documentation of pipelines, data definitions, and troubleshooting processes to support team continuity
  • Partner with marketing analysts and reporting teams to understand data needs and surface issues that may impact downstream reporting
  • Support ad hoc data investigations and analyses as needed

 

 

Basic Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a data analyst, marketing analytics, or data operations role
  • Intermediate SQL proficiency — comfortable writing complex queries, joining and transforming datasets, and debugging transformation logic
  • Foundational knowledge of Python for data tasks, automation, or scripting
  • Robust attention to detail and a methodical approach to diagnosing data issues
  • Experience using GitHub or other version control systems for code management and collaboration
  • Comfort working in modern development environments such as Visual Studio Code or Cursor
  • Experience integrating AI tools, including large language models like Claude, into daily work for tasks like code generation, debugging, documentation, and analysis
  • Exposure to or curiosity about workflow orchestration concepts; awareness with tools like Apache Airflow is a plus but not required

 

 

Additional Qualifications
  • Exposure to Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery
  • Comprehension with paid media platforms (eg Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok for Business) and their data structures
  • Experience with Tableau or other BI and visualization tools
  • Insight with dbt or similar data transformation frameworks
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve personal development efficiency
  • Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Confluence
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical teammates

 

#LI-JJ1

 

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

 

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $85,600.00 - 128,400.00. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement. This position is bonus eligible.

  • Generous paid time off.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.

job.title: Analyst RTR General Ledger
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

Join Our Team

 

Paramount is seeking a Senior Analyst to join our OPEX/G&A Expense Accounting team in Budapest. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to corporate finance while supporting critical accounting, reporting, and analysis activities across the organization.

As a Senior Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate financial reporting, supporting business stakeholders, driving process improvements, and contributing to a high-performing finance organization.

 

 

What You'll Do

 

  • Prepare and review monthly journal entries, including accruals and prepayments
  • Perform account reconciliations and ensure accurate ledger maintenance
  • Analyze financial data and provide meaningful insights to business partners
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing activities
  • Collaborate with Finance and Operational teams on accounting matters and reporting requirements
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to automation and standardization initiatives
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, company policies, and SOX requirements
  • Support external and internal audit activities
  • Participate in finance transformation and process improvement projects
  • Mentor and support junior team members when required
  • Assist with ad hoc financial analysis and management reporting requests

 

 

What We're Looking For

 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 2–3 years of experience in accounting, finance, or a related area
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial processes
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Advanced English communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and process improvement focused mindset

 

 

Nice to Have

 

  • Experience in a multinational or shared services environment
  • Exposure to financial reporting, month-end close, and audit support activities
  • Experience working with ERP systems and financial reporting tools

 

 

Why join us?

 

We believe you will enjoy working with us because:

  • Our private health insurance program provides access to private clinics with a screening package
  • Our monthly cafeteria package includes SZÉP card, nursery, and home loan support
  • We have a dog-friendly office, so you can bring your furry friend to work

job.title: Analyst TandE
job.description:
Are you detail-oriented, analytical and interested in working with Travel & Expense processes in an international environment?

As a T&E Analyst / Auditor, you will play an important role in reviewing and analyzing employee expense reports processed through Concur Travel & Expense and Oracle Fusion Expenses. You will help ensure that expenses are accurate, compliant with company policies and properly supported, while also identifying opportunities to strengthen controls and improve the overall expense management process.

The role combines audit, analysis, stakeholder communication and process improvement, making it a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data while also supporting employees and business stakeholders.

 

This is a fixed term position.

 

 

What you'll do

 

  • Review and audit employee travel and expense reports to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures
  • Verify the accuracy, completeness and validity of expense claims and supporting documentation
  • Identify and investigate non-compliant, duplicate, fraudulent or excessive expense claims
  • Assess risks and prioritize audit findings and exceptions
  • Ensure expenses comply with internal controls, accounting standards, tax regulations and corporate guidelines
  • Process expense reports within agreed service levels and quality standards
  • Communicate audit findings and policy violations to employees, managers and relevant stakeholders
  • Work directly with employees to explain T&E policies and help prevent future policy violations
  • Provide guidance and support to employees using Concur and Oracle Fusion Expenses
  • Monitor high-risk transactions and spending trends to identify potential control weaknesses and improvement opportunities
  • Prepare management reporting on T&E policy findings, compliance issues and trends
  • Analyze expense data to identify spending patterns, cost-saving opportunities and areas for improvement
  • Support internal and external audits by providing documentation and responding to audit requests
  • Maintain accurate audit records and ensure appropriate documentation retention
  • Recommend and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, compliance and user experience
  • Support expense management system administration, testing and process enhancements
  • Escalate exceptions, potential fraud cases and control breaches to management
  • Prepare ad hoc reports and analyses for Concur and Oracle Fusion Expenses
  • Participate in special projects and other initiatives as required

 

 

 

What we're looking for

 

  • 2+ years of experience with Concur or Oracle, with experience in Oracle Fusion Expenses being an advantage
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Advanced proficiency in Concur, Oracle Fusion Expenses, Microsoft Word and Excel
  • Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail
  • Excellent documentation and organizational skills
  • A solutions-oriented, proactive and self-motivated approach
  • Ability to communicate quantitative and qualitative information clearly to stakeholders at different levels of the organization
  • Strong internal customer focus and a service-oriented mindset
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to interact confidently with employees and stakeholders at all levels

 

 

It would be a plus if you have

 

  • Experience working with SAP, Oracle Fusion or other ERP systems
  • Knowledge of finance, procurement/sourcing or information technology processes
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams throughout a project lifecycle
  • Strong data analysis and problem-solving skills
  • Experience identifying process improvement and control enhancement opportunities

 

 

Why join us?

We believe you will enjoy working with us because:

KPIX-TV is looking for a true weather enthusiast who’s passionate about telling weather stories in groundbreaking ways.   The kind of person who thrives in an innovative, trail-blazing environment, with the confidence to take risks and break outside traditional weather presentation.  Our meteorologists work in a state-of-the-art immersive, 3D weather presentation system.  This position is for someone who truly wants to be a pioneer, and very serious about the science of meteorology.  

 

The meteorologist will provide weather reports for KPIX-TV, PIX+, and 27/7 streaming and digital platforms.
Must be comfortable learning new graphic and presentation software and systems.
Must be able to utilize graphics, NWS sources, and live radar to convey urgent information for storms and severe weather ensuring KPIX fulfills the mission of First Alert Weather.
Must have knowledge of earthquakes and plate tectonics to present breaking news information on earthquakes and their potential impacts. 
 Occasionally may be assigned to cover stories outside the station - on location. Write clearly and interestingly and use video and graphics to illustrate facts and ideas in the story.  Will also be available to make personal appearances to promote the station.  This position is represented by SAG-AFTRA.

 

Basic Qualifications:
•      Must have at least five years of television experience, with a minimum of 3 years as a meteorologist, working in local market or network television news.
•    Must have an in-depth presentation and oral communication skills.
 •    Proven success in digital content development and engagement is key.
•    Ability to collaborate effectively with a wide range of personnel.
•    Do live reporting engagingly and effectively.
•    Familiarity with the Bay Area is very helpful.
•    College degree preferred or equivalent experience.
•    Weather computer and graphics skills are required.

•    A valid driver’s License is required.

 

Physical Demands:
Must be able to operate the technology with accuracy and speed.  Must be able to perform in a virtual reality environment, which requires a lot of movement through the space. 
Must have valid driver’s license

WBBM-TV, the CBS Owned & Operated station in Chicago, is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking Anchor/Reporter (Sports) to help lead and shape our sports coverage across all platforms.


Local newsrooms and sports journalism are evolving rapidly, and this role is built for the modern era of media. The ideal candidate will be an anchor and multi-platform storyteller who actively drives engagement across digital channels, social media, and our 24/7 streaming network. Beyond the studio anchor desk, you will host key sports specials, anchor and report live remotely from major events, and enterprise compelling stories that connect with Chicago’s passionate sports community.
We are looking for an engaging, relatable personality and insightful expert who looks far beyond basic scores and stats and must be an exceptional writer capable of scripting concise, creative, and platform-tailored content for linear television, streaming broadcasts, and digital platforms.

 

Chicago is one of the greatest, most intense sports towns in the world. From legendary professional franchises to regional college sports and historic high school programs, our audience demands deep market knowledge, authentic connection, and modern storytelling that meets viewers wherever they consume news.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Anchor & Host: Lead energetic, authoritative sports segments on linear broadcasts; host high-profile station sports specials and digital/streaming original programming.
•    Multi-Platform Content Generation: Actively write, produce, and adapt sports content tailored specifically for linear TV, CBS News Chicago Streaming, CBSChicago.com, and key social platforms (Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube).
•    Remote & Field Reporting: Anchor and report live on location from marquee sporting events, breaking sports news, and deep-dive feature assignments.
•    Modern Storytelling & Enterprise: Move beyond traditional game recaps to enterprise original, character-driven stories; contribute consistently to daily editorial meetings with ideas built for a modern, digital-first newsroom.
•    Digital & Social Strategy: Execute a proactive social media strategy to engage Chicago sports fans in real time, build community, break news, and drive audience tune-in across platforms.
•    Linear Writing & Segment Scripting: Write sharp, conversational copy and craft well-structured segments and package scripts designed for high-impact linear and streaming broadcasts.
•    Journalistic Integrity: Maintain strict journalistic standards, accuracy, and strong editorial judgment in a fast-paced, rapidly shifting multi-platform newsroom.

 

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Experience: Proven experience as a Sports Anchor/Reporter in a major market (Top 10 preferred), with a demonstrated track record of success across linear and digital platforms.
•    Modern Journalism Mindset: Strong understanding of how sports consumption habits are shifting and a passion for experimenting with new digital, streaming, and social storytelling formats.
•    On-Air & On-Screen Presence: Commanding, authentic, and versatile presentation style suited for linear studio anchoring, streaming coverage, and digital video content.
•    Market Expertise: Deep knowledge of Chicago and national sports—including professional leagues, regional college athletics, and high school sports culture.
•    Writing Excellence: Superior writing skills with the ability to adjust tone and format effectively for linear television, digital articles, streaming scripts, and social copy.
•    Collaboration & Adaptability: Ability to thrive under live pressure, multi-task, and collaborate seamlessly with newsroom producers, digital team members, photojournalists, and editors.
•    Schedule Flexibility: Willingness and availability to work a flexible schedule that regularly includes evenings, weekends, holidays, and travel for major sports coverage.
•    This is a SAG/AFTRA position

Overview:

The ideal candidate for this position will be an initiative-taking, highly creative proactive individual who possesses robust people skills and has 5+ years’ experience in sports graphics creation and execution environment. The Art Director will be a part of a robust, multi-faceted network sports on-air graphics department that supports both remote events and live studio programming.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee day to day creative output of the graphics department

  • Develop concepts and ideas for a variety of on-air productions

  • Direct, guide and mentor junior artists and animators

  • Expert design skills utilizing the Adobe Creative Suite

  • 3D design skills, including modeling, lighting and animating

  • Ability to communicate concepts and design expectations to third party design houses

  • Ability to integrate graphics and animations into complex production environments

  • Creative leader for both CBS Network, Sports Network Cable and Digital

  • Work with the department head in improving efficiency of the team and the overall department through technological improvements

  • Collaborate with outside graphics to unify our graphics look and the CBS Sports brand

  • Consult on the design direction of our expanded brand CBS sports.com, CBS Sports HQ and create a unified voice for the CBS Sports brand

  • Collaborate with CBS interactive on shared properties

  • Work with outside agencies and freelancers to build out show packages

  • Ability to communicate concepts and design expectations to third party design houses

  • Ability to integrate graphics and animations into complex production environments



Basic Qualifications:

  • 4–5+ years of professional experience in a media, sports, broadcast, entertainment, or agency environment, with a solid knowledge of the dynamic nature of live sports production

  • Experience designing a show package using motion design/3d graphics from start to finish
    • Concept design to execution
  • Advanced 3D graphics skills, including c4d, Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, and Adobe AFX

  • Solid communication skills

    • Clear in sharing creative ideas and helpful feedback

    • Collaborative with designers, producers, management, and partners from other teams

  • Hands-on creative ability — someone who is comfortable jumping into the work, designing, developing concepts, and problem-solving alongside the team rather than solely managing from a distance

  • Ability to take creative direction from senior leadership, particularly the VP of Graphics/Creative, and translate high-level vision into compelling, executable creative solutions

  • Proven ability to provide creative direction to designers and artists, helping establish visual direction, elevate concepts, and maintain a consistent creative standard across projects

  • Collaborative team player who thrives in a highly collaborative environment and can work closely with producers, directors, editors, animators, technologists, and other creative teams

  • A solid insight of sports storytelling and visual communication is required

    • Ability to create engaging visuals from complex sports stories, statistics, personalities, and moments

  • Ability to work proficiently under tension and within tight deadlines, particularly in a live sports environment where priorities can shift quickly and decisions need to be made in real time

  • Deep conceptual and visual design skills, with a sophisticated knowledge of typography, composition, motion, branding, visual systems, and contemporary design trends

  • Adjustable and focused on finding solutions

    • Curious about new technologies and creative tools

    • Open to exploring new workflows and storytelling methods, with the goal of helping CBS Sports improve sports graphics and visual design


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

The CBS Weekend News Broadcast Associate is an entry-level journalism position which supports all members of the broadcast while providing excellent opportunities to learn the basics of reporting and production at a major network news operation. This role is for both the CBS Evening News and CBS Weekend News.

 

The ideal candidate is a team player who has excellent interpersonal skills, exceptional organizational skills, is detail oriented and has a passion for current events.  The role requires keeping a calm head under pressure while maintaining a positive attitude.


Work Schedule:

  • Wednesday – Sunday: 10AM – 7PM
  • Wednesday, Thursdays, and Fridays will be focused on CBS EVENING NEWS’ activity
  • Saturdays and Sundays will be CBS WEEKEND NEWS’ activity

 

Onsite Role: This position requires in-person, 5 days/week, attendance at our Washington Bureau in D.C.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Assist producers in various capacities (transcribe tape, retrieve archive tape, feed tape, research stories, clear video/photos for air).
  • Perform administrative, operational, and editorial tasks as directed by the Executive Producer of Weekend News and Senior Director of CBS News Operations.
  • Produce voiceovers, SOTs and teases for a Weekend News’ broadcast, including gathering and coordinating incoming video.
  • Set up logistics for Zoom interviews and log interviews for producers.
  • Potential to field-produce coverage of news events or elements for news reports.
  • Attend daily editorial meetings and pitch stories that demonstrate a sound news judgment.
  • Prepare daily Rights Manager file (Details of all outside footage/photos used in the night’s broadcast).
  • Compile weekly social statistics for Weekend News postings on all social media
  • Search CBS News affiliate postings weekly for Weekend Journal pitches

Qualifications:

  • College degree preferred.
  • Internship or comparable proven experience working on a news broadcast.
  • Prior work in a newsroom setting is preferred.
  • Able to work under pressure and under strict deadlines.
  • Strong communication (written and verbal) and organizational skills.
  • Ability/willingness to work weekends (Wednesday through Sunday schedule), overtime, and holidays - often with short notice.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

 


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU!   *This role will be on-site in Hauppauge, NY. Hours will be Tuesday - Friday 7pm to 3am and Saturday 3pm to 11pm.   Overview   The Broadcast Media Operations Specialist ensures Paramount's broadcast and digital media assets are operationally ready for linear television, streaming, video-on-demand (VOD), and global distribution. Operating within the Cloud Control Center (CCC), this role manages media workflows from live acquisition through broadcast readiness, enterprise Media Supply Chain processing, content fulfillment, and downstream distribution. This role supports scheduled programming, live events, sports, news, premium entertainment, and other rapid-turnaround productions. Working closely with Broadcast Operations, Engineering, Product, Media Supply Chain, the Global Media Center (GMC), and other business partners, this person ensures content is processed accurately, delivered efficiently, and meets Paramount's standards for quality, reliability, and customer service.   Responsibilities     Live Media Operations  
  • Capture, monitor, and process live media using Rohde & Schwarz Venice Ingest Servers, the Evertz Deferred Recording System, and other enterprise broadcast technologies supporting scheduled programming, live events, sports, breaking news, and rapid-turnaround broadcast operations
  • Support live productions by participating in operational conference bridges and communicating workflow status, production updates, and issue resolution
  Media Processing & Quality Control  
  • Verify media assets meet Paramount technical delivery specifications by performing technical QC of video, audio, captions, metadata, timecode, and file integrity prior to distribution
  • Perform basic media editing, rendering, file reconstruction, and closed caption validation using Adobe Premiere Pro, CaptionMaker, MacCaption, Oona Tools, or comparable applications
  Media Supply Chain Operations  
  • Manage automated media processing workflows using Evertz Mediator across multiple locations; ensure media is successfully ingested through the Media Ingest Portal (MIP) into Paramount's enterprise Media Asset Management (CRMAM) system
  • Support FastTrack and other quick-turnaround fulfillment workflows
  • Monitor workflow dashboards and operational tools (e.g., Airtable); ensure ingest, transcoding, packaging, fulfillment, and downstream processing complete successfully, and investigate/resolve exceptions
  Broadcast Readiness  
  • Verify scheduled linear broadcast content is processed, validated, and available for playout across Trident, Evertz Cloud Playout (ORT), and other supported platforms
  • Identify missing media, quality issues, metadata discrepancies, and scheduling conflicts; work with On-Air Operations and other stakeholders to resolve quickly
  Operational Excellence  
  • Coordinate operational issues by following established escalation procedures; partner with Engineering, Product, Media Supply Chain, GMC, On-Air Operations, and vendor support teams to restore service
  • Follow established SOPs while proactively identifying opportunities to improve workflows, increase automation, and enhance efficiency
  Basic Qualifications  
  • Experience supporting broadcast operations, media processing, media asset management, or digital encoding/related media technology
  • Strong understanding of professional broadcast video and audio formats, codecs, containers, frame rates, aspect ratios, color spaces, and technical file delivery specifications
  • Ability to recognize, diagnose, and troubleshoot issues involving video, audio, captions, metadata, file integrity, and automated media workflows
  • Experience using professional QC tools, including waveform monitors, vectorscopes, audio metering, and related broadcast analysis equipment
  • Working knowledge of closed caption formats including SCC, STL, SRT, or comparable sidecar caption files
  • Understanding of enterprise media workflows, automated processing, transcoding, media asset management, and downstream distribution
  • Familiarity with enterprise file transfer technologies such as Aspera, Signiant, or comparable solutions
  • Experience using Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable non-linear editing software
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex operational workflows and make sound decisions in time-sensitive broadcast environments
  • Excellent communication, organizational, customer service, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while remaining calm under pressure
  • Ability to work flexible schedules including evenings, weekends, holidays, and live event coverage
  • Ability to work on-site within Paramount's Broadcast Operations and Cloud Control Center
  Additional Qualifications  
  • Experience supporting enterprise broadcast operations for linear television, streaming platforms, or digital media
  • Experience with Evertz Mediator, Rohde & Schwarz Venice, Colorfront, Telestream, AWS-based media workflows, enterprise Media Asset Management systems, and workflow automation technologies
  • Experience supporting live sports, entertainment, news, awards shows, or other time-sensitive broadcast productions
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Engineering, Media Technology, Communications, Computer Science, or related discipline (equivalent experience/certifications considered)

job.title: Data Engineer Data Pipelines and ETL
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Summary
The Data Engineering team is hiring a Data Engineer – Data Pipeline & ETL. You will help build and maintain scalable data platforms and ETL/ELT pipelines in a fast-moving environment. In this role, you will build and support batch and real-time data systems powering analytics, ML, and AI applications. You will also grow your expertise in modern data architecture and cloud-native best practices.


Key Responsibilities

Build and Maintain Scalable Data Pipelines

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines for large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Build robust ETL/ELT frameworks supporting analytics, BI, experimentation, and machine learning use cases.
  • Optimize pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Implement advanced ingestion patterns including CDC, incremental loads, and event-driven processing.

Data Modeling & Data Warehouse Architecture

  • Design scalable, dimensional, and hybrid data models optimized for analytics and ML use cases.
  • Develop reusable transformation layers (semantic layers) that serve BI, ML, and AI applications.
  • Write optimized, production-grade SQL for large-scale analytics workloads.
  • Contribute to query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and performance tuning across distributed systems and cloud warehouses.

Modern Data Pipeline Development

  • Build and maintain modular data components following established framework patterns.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions across streaming systems, data lakes, and warehouses.

The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking a Data Engineering Manager to lead the design, delivery, and operational excellence of large-scale batch and real-time data platforms. This role will oversee high-performance data engineering teams that power analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and mission-critical data services across the organization. You will guide the design and execution of distributed data systems. This includes ETL and ELT pipelines. It also includes streaming platforms, warehouse ecosystems, and cloud-native infrastructure. As a manager, you will shape technical direction, develop engineering talent, and ensure production-grade reliability, scalability, and operational rigor across data platforms.

This role requires expertise in modern data architectures and distributed systems. You should also have knowledge of cloud-native engineering. It is essential to have proven experience in leading high-performing engineering teams. 


Key Responsibilities


Lead & Scale Data Engineering Teams
● Manage and develop a team of data engineers responsible for batch and streaming data systems.
● Drive technical execution across ingestion, transformation, modeling, and serving layers.

● Mentor engineers in distributed systems design, performance optimization, and production reliability.


Architect Scalable Data Platforms
● Ensure scalable data modeling standards and efficient query performance across analytical workloads.
● Guide decisions about architecture. This includes orchestration and schema evolution. It also covers partitioning strategies and storage optimization. 
● Partner with streaming engineers to align batch and real-time data patterns into cohesive platform designs. 


Cross-Functional Collaboration
● Partner closely with Data Product Management to align roadmap priorities, SLAs, and platform KPIs.
● Collaborate with software engineers to integrate streaming systems, APIs, and microservices into the broader data ecosystem.
● Clearly communicate architectural tradeoffs to stakeholders. Share delivery risks and operational constraints as well. 


Technical Leadership
● Lead architectural reviews and drive long-term platform strategy.
● Foster a culture of ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement.

 


Required Skills & Experience


Modern Data Architecture
● Strong expertise in data lakes, warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.
● Deep understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, orchestration platforms, and distributed data processing systems.
● Solid understanding of Kafka-based architectures and event-driven data patterns.

 

Team Development & Coaching
● Proven experience hiring, onboarding, and retaining high-performing engineers across varying seniority levels.
● Commitment to building an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable team culture.

 

Execution & Delivery Leadership
● Strong sprint planning, capacity modeling, and roadmap sequencing skills.
● Ability to manage competing priorities across reliability, feature delivery, and technical debt reduction.
● Experience establishing engineering KPIs such as reliability, latency, throughput, and deployment frequency.

 


Qualifications


● Proven experience leading engineering teams delivering large-scale production data platforms.
● Strong foundation in distributed systems engineering and cloud-native architecture.
● You should have great communication skills. You also need to collaborate with different teams. 
● You should be self-motivated. Focus on quality. A commitment to engineering excellence and operational discipline is essential.

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED, TO:

job.title: Director
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

CBS News 24/7, the digital streaming operation from CBS News is looking for a San Francisco based freelance AR/VR ELC Director.

The ideal candidate is a great communicator, has current experience directing in active breaking news environments, has strong organizational skills and can break out of the mold of a coded newscast and pivot to breaking news when the moment happens. 

 

As an ELC director you’ll be working with show producers creating dynamic visual newscasts in a virtual space You’ll be verbally calling the shots as the anchor works the virtual studio environment with the jib camera following along as you trigger augmented reality objects to help enhance the storytelling. 

 

The Gear:

Zero Density Virtual Production 

Sony ELC Automation

Sony XVS Switchers

Chyron Prime / ISQ 

Calrec Audio

Studio Jibs

 

Job Function:

The main responsibility is to provide leadership in and out of the control room fulfilling production needs as assigned. You’ll works with the 24/7 editorial and production teams to execute an error-free production in an ELC automated control room environment. Director’s code their assigned newscast and run through portions of the show with crew and talent before going to air to help ensure a crisp production is delivered.  A successful candidate must have sound technical skills, collaborate before each show with producer and jib operator to ensure smart, effective use of virtual studio space and bring a “can-do” approach to problem solving in a fast-paced, high-energy environment. 

 

Candidate must be willing to work a flexible work schedule that may include early mornings and holidays. You must be open to implementing new technologies and/or methods to accomplish future assignments. 

  

Required:

  • Demonstrated experience in live news production is required.
  • Previous Control Room Automation use is desired, Sony ELC experience is preferred.
  • Knowledge of iNews preferred.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Must be a self-starter with excellent organizational skills.
  • Strong work ethic, positive attitude & leadership qualities with the ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities a must.

OVERVIEW & RESPONSIBILITIES
The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) is a key finance leader supporting the global content licensing business, with primary responsibility for the financial planning and analysis of TV titles. Reporting to the Vice President of FP&A and managing a one staff in the US, this role partners with finance and business leadership to provide financial insights that support strategic decision-making. The Director is tasked with leading the annual budget, monthly forecasting, and Long-Range Planning (LRP) processes. The role also develops financial estimates supporting television series greenlight decisions and maintains 10-year Ultimate revenue forecasts for the assigned portfolio. This position regularly interfaces with senior management and collaborates across Finance, Sales, Strategy, Business Affairs, and Content teams.
 

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
•    Lead the annual budget, monthly forecast, quarterly outlook, and Long-Range Plan (LRP) processes.
•    Analyze forecast variances, identify key business drivers, and communicate risks and opportunities to the executive team.
•    Partner with Accounting and Corporate FP&A to ensure alignment between forecasts, financial reporting, and planning assumptions.
•    Develop financial analyses supporting television series greenlight decisions, including revenue estimates and long-term profitability projections.
•    Own the development and maintenance of 10-year Ultimate revenue forecasts.
•    Partner with Sales, Distribution, Content Strategy, and Studio Finance to update long-term licensing assumptions throughout a title’s lifecycle.
•    Ensure Ultimate forecasts reflect current market dynamics, contractual changes, and performance trends.
•    Collaborate closely with Content Licensing executives, Sales, Business Affairs, Distribution, Production Finance, Strategy, Controllership, and Corporate FP&A.
•    Present forecasts, financial analyses, and business recommendations to senior leaders.
•    Translate complex financial information into actionable insights for business partners.
•    Assist in the preparation of management presentations including monthly forecasts, quarterly business reviews, and quarterly earnings preparation.
•    Provide coaching, mentorship, and oversight to ensure high-quality financial analysis and planning deliverables.
•    Identify and implement improvements to the forecasting methodologies, reporting processes, and financial planning tools.
 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
•    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
•    10+ years of progressive experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Finance, or Strategic Finance.
•    Strong background in budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and financial modeling.
•    Experience supporting executive decision-making through financial analysis and business partnership.
•    Advanced Excel skills and experience with enterprise planning systems (SAP, Anaplan, Hyperion, Oracle EPM, Longview or similar).
 

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
•    Deep familiarity with TV programming and industry trends.
•    MBA or CPA preferred.
•    Experience within the media, entertainment, television, or content licensing industry strongly preferred.
•    Previous people management experience preferred.
•    Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

Overview:

We are seeking a top-tier IT Audit Director to join the Paramount team! This person will be tasked with implementing a comprehensive program of Information Technology (IT) internal auditing throughout the Company. They are primarily in charge of defining the scope of audits to identify control deficiencies, security weaknesses, opportunities to streamline and improve operations, and promote best-in-class business practices.
The Director will lead a team of audit professionals. They will assess risks related to technology, operations, and compliance throughout the organization; this includes evaluating applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and strategic technology initiatives. The Director will also conduct administrative tasks to support an elite internal audit function. They will oversee multiple audits and special projects. They will present findings to management. Additionally, they will build solid partnerships with business and technology leaders across the Company.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Conduct audit planning and risk assessments to establish audit scope, resource allocation, and audit priorities across technology and operational audit engagements

job.title: Director, Oracle Fusion Financials
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Director, Oracle Fusion Financials (ERP Technology)
Location: [New York/Los Angeles]

    As the Director of Oracle Fusion Financials, you will be the technical cornerstone of our financial ecosystem. You will lead the strategy, implementation, and optimization of our Oracle Cloud ERP, ensuring a seamless flow of data across General Ledger (GL), Cash Management, AGIS, Payables (AP), and Receivables (AR). Your goal is to move beyond simple maintenance, transforming our financial systems into a scalable, high-performance platform that empowers our global finance teams.   Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Strategy & Roadmap
  • Architectural Oversight: Oversee the technical architecture of the Oracle Fusion Financials suite. Make sure the system configurations meet global business needs. Ensure they follow technical best practices.
  • Release Management: Lead the strategy for Oracle’s quarterly update cycles, overseeing impact analysis, regression testing, and the rollout of new features to minimize business disruption.
2. Domain Leadership (Module Expertise) General Ledger (GL) & Financial Architecture
  • Hierarchies & COA: Hands-on experience designing and maintaining Value Sets, Flexfield structures (KFF/DFF), and Tree Hierarchies. Must be able to manage the impact of hierarchy changes on reporting cubes (Essbase).
  • Ledger Engineering: Expertise in configuring Primary/Secondary Ledgers, Reporting Currencies, and Ledger Sets. Must understand the technical logic behind "Subledger Accounting" (SLA) to customize how data flows from AP/AR/CM/PPM into the GL.
  • Expertise in configuring cross validation rules, data access sets, segment value security.
Financial Accounting Hub (FAH)
  • Account Rules & Mapping Sets: Designing rules to dynamically derive Chart of Accounts (COA) segments based on source data attributes, Defining journal line and description rules.
  • Subledger Accounting Methods (SLAM): Grouping all rules together into a cohesive accounting method assigned to the ledger.
  • Transaction Types: Identifying and categorizing the different business events coming from the legacy system.
  • Source Data Definition: Defining the header and line-level data elements (sources) that need to be captured from the external system to drive accounting rules and reporting.
Cash Management & Banking
  • Bank Integration (Host-to-Host): Technical mastery of the bank transmission and secure file transmission (SFTP/PGP) for automated statement retrieval.
  • Reconciliation Engines: Expert knowledge of Manual and Automated Reconciliation Rule Sets, including the use of "Tolerance Rules" and "Mapping Sets" to handle high-volume bank statement lines.
  • External Transactions: Ability to develop automated "sweep" or "zero-balance" technical logic for global liquidity management.
  • Embedded banking: Knowledge of embedded banking feature in Fusion Cash Management.
  • Configuration and maintenance of cash posting rules.
Payables (AP) & Payments
  • PTP: Experience in Oracle Supplier Portal, IDR or DocIO for vendor onboarding and invoice processing
  • Payment File Formatting: Hands-on development of ISO 20022, NACHA, and SWIFT payment templates using BI Publisher (eText/XSL-FO) to facilitate direct integration with global banks.
  • Tax & Withholding: Technical configuration of tax engines, including tax rules, regimes, and automated tax calculation logic for cross-border transactions.
Fixed Assets (FA)
  • Asset Lifecycle Automation: Technical expertise in configuring Asset Books (Corporate/Tax), Depreciation Methods (STL, DB), and Prorate Conventions.
  • Mass Additions Logic: Hands-on experience with the FA Mass Additions process, specifically troubleshooting the technical interface between AP/Projects and the FA module.
Accounts Receivable (AR) & Collections
  • Auto-Invoice Architecture: Mastery of the Auto-Invoice Master Program; must be able to debug interface table errors and design custom validation logic for high-volume billing imports from external CRMs (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Lockbox & Receipt Processing: Experience designing and building Auto-Lockbox transmission formats and "Auto-Match" rule sets for high-accuracy receipt application.
Integration & Data Engineering
  • Ecosystem Connectivity: Partner with the Data Engineering team to ensure seamless data flow between Oracle Fusion and ancillary systems.
  • Reporting Strategy: Direct the development of advanced reporting using OTBI, BI Publisher, FRS and FDI to provide real-time visibility into global financials.
Team & Partner Leadership
  • Talent Development: Manage a team of Oracle Functional Analysts and Technical Developers, fostering a culture of agile delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Vendor Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for 3rd-party implementation partners, ensuring high service levels and project accountability.
Required Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Finance. MBA or CPA is a significant plus.
  • Experience: 10+ years in ERP management, with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud.
  • Full Lifecycle Mastery: Proven track record of leading at least two global, full-lifecycle Oracle Cloud Financials implementations.
  • Deep Functional Knowledge: Expert-level understanding of GL, FAH, Cash Management, AGIS, AP, and AR modules.
  • Technical Literacy: Familiarity with FBDI, ADFDI, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), and SOAP/REST APIs as they relate to financial data.
Preferred Qualifications
  • The Bridge-Builder: You can explain complex SQL queries to a Controller and the nuances of Intercompany accounting to a Software Engineer.
  • The Optimizer: You aren't satisfied with a "working" system; you are constantly looking for ways to reduce "Time-to-Close" and automate manual journal entries.
  • The SOX Lookout: You understand the critical importance of controls, audit trails, and segregation of duties in a global financial environment.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

Director Oracle Fusion Project & Portfolio Management (PPM)   Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Oracle Fusion PPM Subject Matter Expert (SME) to join our Enterprise Solutions team. In this critical role, you will be the ultimate authority on our Oracle Fusion Project and Portfolio Management and and its deep integration with the Fixed Assets and Oracle EPM Project Financials Planning modules.   You will lead the functional design, configuration, optimization, and continuous improvement of the Oracle PPM suite. The ideal candidate has expertise in Project Financial Management. This includes Costing, Billing, and Contracts. They also have experience in Project Financial Planning Management, which covers Budget and Forecast. Additionally, they are informed about Capital Projects, such as CIP and Depreciation. They must also understand how PPM integrates with core Financials, Procurement, and HCM.   Key Responsibilities System Configuration & Design
  • Act as the lead functional architect and configurator for Oracle Cloud PPM modules. Your responsibilities include Project Costing. You will also oversee Project Billing, Project Contracts, Project Control, Project Management, and Project Resource Management.
  • Translate complex business requirements from the PMO and Finance teams into scalable, efficient system configurations using the Functional Setup Manager (FSM).
  • Lead the design of Project/Task hierarchies, cost breakdown structures, capitalization rules, and complex project billing/revenue recognition rules.
  • Design and set up the financial planning processes for projects in EPM. This involves project approvals. It also includes budgeting based on key drivers, forecasting, and scenario modeling.
  • Translate complex business requirements from the PMO, FP&A, and Finance teams into scalable system configurations using the Functional Setup Manager (FSM) and EPM workspace.
  • Manage the configuration of Capital Projects. This includes setting up rules for asset generation and capitalization (CIP). You will also handle retirement costs and set up Fixed Assets, including Asset Books, Categories, and Depreciation Methods.
  • Manage the configuration of Capital Projects. This includes setting up rules for asset generation and capitalization (CIP). You will also oversee retirement costs and Fixed Assets. This involves managing Asset Books, Categories, and Depreciation Methods.
  Cross-Functional Integration
  • Design and troubleshoot critical integrations between PPM and other Oracle Cloud modules, specifically Financials (GL, AP, AR, FA), Procurement (PO, Requisitions), and HCM (Oracle Time & Labor - OTL).
  • Manage the technical and functional data pipeline across the project ecosystem: pushing budgets from EPM to PPM, feeding actuals from PPM back to EPM, and transferring capitalized project costs from PPM to Fixed Assets.
  • Ensure seamless data flow for project-related expenses, timecards, supplier invoices, and accounting lines.
  • Manage data migrations, mass updates, and project conversions using File-Based Data Import (FBDI) and ADFdi.
  Business Partnership & Advisory
  • Partner closely with project managers, project accountants, and finance leadership to establish best practices for project tracking, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Conduct workshops and gather requirements. Identify process bottlenecks. Suggest solutions using Oracle.
  • Drive user adoption by creating functional documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and delivering targeted training to end-users.
  Support, Testing & Continuous Improvement
  • Lead System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements and rollout phases.
  • Evaluate Oracle’s quarterly patch updates, test new PPM features in lower environments, and advise the business on adopting new capabilities to drive efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain custom project reports and dashboards using OTBI (Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence) and BI Publisher.
  Required Qualifications Experience & Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience working with Oracle ERP systems, with a minimum of 3-5 years specifically focused on Oracle Fusion PPM.
  • Proven track record of acting as the primary functional lead or SME on at least one (1) full-lifecycle Oracle Cloud PPM implementation.
  Technical & Functional Skills
  • Deep, hands-on configuration expertise across the entire Oracle Fusion PPM suite (Project Financials and Project Execution).
  • A strong understanding of project accounting principles is essential. You must know about revenue recognition, capitalization (CIP), cross-charge setups, and overhead allocations.
  • Extensive experience with Oracle Subledger Accounting (SLA) as it pertains to project transactions.
  • Proficiency in building reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher.
  • Familiarity with Agile project methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for system dependencies and data integrity.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to articulate complex system mechanics to non-technical business leaders.
  • Ability to work autonomously, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  Preferred Qualifications
  • Active Oracle Project Portfolio Management Cloud Implementation Professional certification.

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

We are searching for individuals who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees. You fuel our culture of purpose, passion, and collaboration. We’re in this together.

Director, Product Management
247Sports
Department: 247Sports
Reports to: VP & Head of 247Sports
Location: Nashville, TN (on-site)
Employment type: Full-time
Level: Director


About 247Sports:
247Sports is a leading destination for college sports recruiting coverage, player rankings, and team-focused fan communities. We combine deep evaluation data and expert analysis with a premium VIP subscription experience for the most dedicated fans in college sports.
Position summary


247Sports is hiring a Director of Product Management to own the product strategy and roadmap for our web and data experiences. This is a results-driven leadership role centered on turning the deep evaluation data 247Sports collects into premium, subscriber-facing products that make our VIP membership materially more valuable. The Director will lead product development across the recruiting database (RDB), scouting and evaluation tooling, and subscriber growth, and will partner closely with editorial, scouting, engineering, and site publishers to drive measurable results.
This is a full-time, on-site role based in our Nashville office. We are open to discussing relocation timing for the right candidate.


Key responsibilities:


Product strategy & VIP subscriber value
●    Own the product vision and roadmap for 247Sports web and data products, with a focus on driving VIP subscription value, retention, and acquisition.
●    Lead the flagship initiative to productize proprietary evaluation data, including scouting reports, verified and unverified measurables, track times, and cross-sport intel, into front-facing content and interactive tools that show subscribers how and why players are ranked.
●    Define and prioritize premium features such as player evaluation profiles, searchable and sortable measurables and testing data, cross-sport intel, and scout-grade comparison tools.


Scouting & recruiting product partnership
●    Partner with the scouting and recruiting teams to build and expand the internal evaluation tooling they rely on day to day, including the scouting-information repository, evaluation tracking, and rankings workflows.
●    Lead development of depth charts and impact ratings, connecting scouting data directly to consumer-facing products.


Recruiting database (RDB)
●    Own the roadmap to elevate the RDB product experience and establish it as the primary destination for premium evaluation data.


Product marketing & growth
●    Partner with site publishers on strategies that drive traffic, engagement, and subscriptions.
●    Tie data-driven product initiatives directly to measurable subscriber acquisition and retention outcomes.


Cross-functional leadership
●    Lead product initiatives across engineering, editorial, scouting, and design, setting direction, prioritizing the roadmap, and driving execution.
●    Provide QA, project management, and site-production oversight as needed across product areas.
●    Support the 247Sports app roadmap, contributing on the web, backend, and data components that feed it, including Player Rankings.


Qualifications


Required
●    10+ years of product management experience, including roadmap ownership.
●    Demonstrated track record of building and shipping complex, data-driven products from the ground up.
●    Proven ability to translate large or complex data sets into consumer-facing products and tools.
●    Strong background in subscription or membership products, with a focus on driving retention and growth.
●    Experience leading cross-functional teams and partnering with editorial, engineering, and business stakeholders.
●    Excellent product judgment, prioritization, and communication skills.


Preferred
●    Deep familiarity with college sports, recruiting, and player evaluation.
●    Experience founding or leading a product or business built on sports data or recruiting tools.
●    Background working directly with scouting or evaluation data and the teams that produce it.

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

    Entertainment Tonight is looking for a sharp, pop-culture-obsessed Production Assistant to join our team. This is an entry-level role built for someone who's ready to work hard, learn fast, and grow inside the #1 entertainment news brand in the world.  

Overview:

This PA will be assigned to one of ET's Supervising Producers in the NYC bureau, supporting a mix of exclusives, features, red carpet coverage, set visits, and news. One day you might be building a folder off breaking news, the next you're on the ground at a red carpet or a set visit. The best PAs bring editorial instincts to all of it. If you're deep in a folder on a breaking story and you spot a vault clip that just became gold, we need you to recognize it and flag it. That awareness is what separates a good PA from a great one.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

You'll work directly with a Supervising Producer across ET's NYC bureau coverage, serving as the link between raw footage and finished stories.
  • Media management — ingest shoot footage, log and label assets, and build organized folders that segment producers can write directly from
  • Transcription — turn celebrity interviews and field shoots into accurate, usable transcripts on deadline
  • Morning show & podcast monitoring — watch and transcribe morning news broadcasts and podcasts to flag newsworthy moments before the rest of the day catches up
  • Exclusives & features support — help prep and execute interviews, shoots, and packages tied to ET exclusives and features
  • Asset coordination — pull b-roll, photos, social clips, and archival material; track rights and credits
  • Producer support — research, fact checks, and content prep across broadcast, digital, and social
  • Field and studio assistance — crew support, errands, and on-the-ground help when shoots need an extra set of hands
  • Cross-department coverage — pitch in where the show needs you

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • You live and breathe pop culture — you can name every famous face in a crowded shot
  • You're fast, accurate, and organized under pressure
  • You communicate clearly and work well with a team
  • You have sharp editorial instincts — you know the difference between a great sound bite and a throwaway line

Additional Qualifications:

  • Degree or internship in TV, film, or a related field is a plus, not a requirement

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Come join the Strategy and Insights team at Paramount Pictures and be part of a dynamic group who work across the entire lifecycle of the theatrical movie experience! Unlike traditional marketing, our insights team is involved from concept to release, ensuring the consumer’s voice is at the heart of every decision from brand development to fan engagement, to the actual movie in its final editorial stage, to identifying messaging for creative marketing materials that truly resonate. The Insights team drives impactful, data-driven decisions through audience surveys, focus groups, ethnographies, and screenings. Our global insights inform production and tailor marketing campaigns that excite moviegoers worldwide. 


This role sits at the center of the department, supporting its senior leadership and working closely with the wider team. It also offers a spectacular view of the movie lifecycle from pre-greenlight to release, and of how research shapes both the film itself and the campaign that sells it. 

 

This is an on-site role based on the Paramount Pictures Studio Lot requiring (5) days in office. 


Responsibilities Overview
We’re looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive person who takes real satisfaction in keeping a fast-moving global team running while participating in research that supports the studio’s strategy. The ideal candidate takes iniative, handles confidential material with complete discretion, and communicates clearly with everyone from assistants to senior executives. This role divides time between administrative responsibilities and hands-on primary research work, and is a great opportunity for someone stepping into the insights space for the first time. A love of movies and genuine curiosity about how audiences respond to them will serve you well here: this role has a front-row seat to the research and strategy work behind every Paramount release, and a real opportunity to contribute to it.


The Executive Assistant, Strategy and Insights will provide administrative support to the EVP and SVP of Global Strategy and Insights, as well as the wider department, while gaining exposure to entry-level research work.

Responsibilities Include:
•    Maintain the overall department calendar and that of the Executive Vice President and Senior Vice President, scheduling key meetings across the studio. 
•    Compile and maintain files with relevant materials for meetings, reading the calendar ahead to anticipate what will be needed
•    Arrange travel plans and submit expenses for the EVP and SVP, and compile documents for travel-related meetings
•    Answer and screen phone calls and email, taking action when appropriate and following up as needed
•    Maintain high levels of discretion when dealing with confidential research documents, reports, meetings, and expenses
•    Contribute to entry-level research work, including:
•    Reading scripts and contributing to early pre-greenlight analysis 
•    Analyzing long-lead tracking reads and distributing results within the studio 
•    Analyzing and distributing box office projections 
•    Contributing to the development of deliverables and presentations for departments across the studio
•    Landscape research to understand trends within the broader moviegoing industry 
•    Be a vocal and active contributor to brainstorming sessions and meetings
•    Be excited by movies and in tune with current releases

 

Basic Qualifications and Skills
•    BA or BS with a track record of high achievement 
•    1+ years of related experience
•    Good language and problem-solving skills 
•    Solid comfort with numbers and spreadsheets
•    Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interface with staff, other administrators, internal and external partners, and senior management
•    Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy
•    Proficiency with Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

NEWS PRODUCTION ASSISTANT

Position Overview
This entry-level role provides essential clerical and technical support to the news production team. Freelance Production Assistants operate the teleprompter during live newscasts, manage and organize archival materials, and assist with daily newsroom communications. Successful candidates show drive, curiosity, and enthusiasm for journalism and local news while upholding high standards of professionalism.

Responsibilities

  • Operate teleprompter and assist technical staff during live or recorded broadcasts
  • Locate, catalogue, and retrieve file video and archival material
  • Answer phones, relay information, and handle general office tasks
  • Run newsroom errands and assist with set logistics as needed

Cross-training and advancement opportunities may be available for freelance Production Assistants who excel but are not guaranteed parts of this position.  Our goal is to help freelance Production Assistants expand their skills and grow into other newsroom roles through cross-training. Those who consistently demonstrate drive, initiative, and enthusiasm will be considered for advancement opportunities as they develop professionally.

  • Writing news copy for broadcast and digital platforms
  • Managing and creating posts for social media accounts
  • Editing video and audio for broadcast
  • Operating technical production equipment
  • Supporting the Assignment Desk: story research, pitching, and newsroom coordination

Desired Qualities

  • Demonstrated enthusiasm, initiative, and excitement for new opportunities
  • Strong curiosity about news, journalism, and broadcast media
  • Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving abilities

job.title: Lead Data Scientist
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

 

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG)! DIG is a key connector across the Paramount Streaming verticals. Our group is made up of subject matter experts who prototype, build, and scale data infrastructure and products. We also assess, aggregate, and analyze data, and we shape both qualitative and quantitative stories and insights. In short, we give our stakeholders decision support, clear performance views, and recommendations that help the business grow!

 

The User Lifecycle Analytics team works closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Finance, and DTC Executives to drive subscriber growth and retention.

 

The Lead Data Scientist reports to the Senior Director of Data Science. You'll support a wide range of projects, partnering with the Lifecycle Marketing and Product teams, DTC executives, and Finance. This role calls for a solid analytical foundation, real curiosity about subscriber behavior, and the skill to run careful analysis that feeds straight into strategy!

 

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, communicates clearly, and has hands-on experience (or eagerness to grow) in causal inference and experimentation.

 

This role supports two core business questions:

 

  1. What drives long-term subscriber health, and how do we use our levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promotions) to grow it?
  2. How do our optimization efforts across content and the subscriber journey affect the bottom line?

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Run causal inference analyses (e.g., diff-in-diff, matching, uplift modeling) under the Sr. Director's guidance. You'll find which subscriber behaviors truly drive retention and long-term value, while correcting for known biases in streaming data.
  • Help map the subscriber journey to pinpoint where lifecycle, product, pricing, and promo levers have the most impact.
  • Help design, set up, and analyze A/B tests across the subscriber journey (acquisition, onboarding, engagement, win-back), including power analysis, monitoring, and read-outs.
  • Build and maintain reporting and models that turn journey optimization into ARPU, survival, and LTV metrics for stakeholders.
  • Own the SQL/Python data pulls, cleaning, and analysis pipelines behind the team's causal and LTV modeling.
  • Prepare clear, well-organized presentations and summaries of your findings for stakeholders.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Product Analytics to check data quality and fix issues in our experimentation and behavioral data pipelines.
  • Stay current on causal inference and experimentation best practices and help promote sound methods across the team.
  • Mentor junior analysts on SQL, statistical methods, and analytical best practices as the team grows.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, or related).
  • 5+ years in data science/analytics, with hands-on use of causal inference or experimentation methods (e.g., A/B testing, diff-in-diff, propensity score matching) — not just predictive modeling.
  • Experience designing or analyzing A/B tests, including an understanding of common pitfalls (novelty effects, selection bias, sample ratio mismatch).
  • Solid SQL skills and proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis.
  • Experience working with or building LTV, survival, or churn-related metrics.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to turn analytical results into clear takeaways for non-technical stakeholders.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Experience in subscription/DTC streaming, media, or another subscription business (e.g., SaaS, telecom).
  • Familiarity with subscriber/customer journey mapping.
  • Exposure to advanced causal techniques (e.g., instrumental variables, double machine learning, causal forests).
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks, Looker, Tableau).
