job.title: Director, Journalism Strategies
job.description:
The Scripps Howard Foundation is seeking a Director of Journalism Strategies to direct, develop and coordinate an array of journalism education programs and philanthropic strategies for the Scripps Howard Fund and Scripps Howard Foundation as outlined in the strategic plan. This position serves as the national journalism leader for the organization, cultivating and maintaining relationships with leaders in the journalism industry, journalism education and funding communities.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead the development and execution of journalism education programs, philanthropic initiatives, and strategic priorities that advance the mission of the Scripps Howard Fund and Foundation.

  • Build and maintain strategic partnerships with journalism organizations, academic institutions, funders, donors, and industry leaders to strengthen journalism talent pipelines and expand program impact.

  • Serve as a recognized leader and subject matter expert in journalism education and philanthropy, providing insights, recommendations, and thought leadership on industry trends, opportunities, and emerging needs.

  • Collaborate with internal, board, and external stakeholders to develop and implement innovative initiatives that support current and future journalists and advance the profession.

  • Represent the Fund and Foundation in industry associations, conferences, and external partnerships, promoting the organization's leadership in journalism and journalism education.

  • Develop and execute fundraising and donor engagement strategies, including cultivation, stewardship, and identification of new funding opportunities to expand mission impact and diversify revenue sources.

  • Direct journalism grantmaking activities, including evaluation, award administration, grantee relationship management, outcomes assessment, and continuous improvement of the grant portfolio.

  • Monitor and evaluate program and grant performance by reviewing outcomes, impact metrics, and grantee reports, and provide recommendations to enhance effectiveness and alignment with strategic objectives.

  • Oversee key journalism programs and special initiatives, including the Scripps Howard Journalism Awards, internships, experiential learning opportunities, and other mission-driven projects.

  • Lead and develop the journalism education team by providing strategic direction, coaching, performance support, and resource planning to ensure high-quality program execution and achievement of organizational goals.

  • Prepare comprehensive board reports and present key updates, outcomes, and strategic recommendations during board meetings.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred.

  • Generally, 8+ years of experience in journalism, journalism education, philanthropy, fundraising, program leadership or a related field preferred.

  • Prior people management experience preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Passion for journalism and journalism education.

  • Strategic, innovative and future-oriented thinker and planner.

  • Ability to collaborate, influence and build effective partnerships across institutions, organizations and associations.

  • Demonstrated ability to design, organize, manage and evaluate programs, projects and events.

  • Ability to understand and communicate trends affecting journalism, journalism education and journalism funding.

  • Understanding of the critical role of fundraising in advancing journalism education initiatives, with demonstrated support of donor engagement, stewardship and revenue-generating opportunities.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare board-level materials and present strategic recommendations.

  • Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder service skills.

  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail.

job.title: End User Computing Technician II
job.description:
Are you passionate about technology and helping people solve problems? Join Scripps as an End User Computing Technician II, where you'll play a vital role in ensuring our employees have seamless access to the technology they need to excel in their work. In this hands-on position, you'll provide critical technical support across a wide range of technologies from desktops and laptops to printers, scanners, and mobile devices. You'll work with diverse operating systems including Windows, MacOS, and Linux, while collaborating with talented teams to implement innovative solutions.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love making a difference through technology, this is your opportunity to shine!


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Provide technical support: Respond to service desk tickets, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and providing technical assistance to end-users.

  • Install and configure hardware and software: install, configure, and maintain hardware and software on end-user devices such as desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, and other peripherals.

  • Maintain and update system, ensure that software and operating systems are up to date and free from bugs and malware.

  • Diagnose and repair hardware issues. Identify hardware problems and make necessary repairs, such as replacing hard drives, motherboards, and memory.

  • May provide training and support to employees on how to use hardware and software effectively.

  • Document support activities: Keep detailed records of support activities, including issues resolved, hardware and software installed, and troubleshoot steps taken via the Scripps incident management system.

  • Maintain an inventory of all hardware and software assets and ensuring that they are up to date.

  • Collaborate with other Scripps Technology teams to resolve complex issues and implement new technologies.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • High School Diploma preferred

  • Generally 1-3 years of desktop experience

  • Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician (MCDST), or similar certifications desired


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Working knowledge of hardware, software, and operating systems such as Windows, macOS, and Linux

  • Working knowledge of Azure, Entra, Intune, Jamf, and similar enterprise tools is desired.

  • Familiarity with Dell/HP and Mac laptops

  • Familiarity with network protocols, troubleshooting techniques, and diagnostic tools

  • Strong communication skills and working effectively with employees to understand and resolve technical issues

  • Strong customer service skills

  • Attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and in a team environment

  • Ability to document technical support activities and maintain accurate records.

  • Requires the ability to sit for long periods of time, listen and converse over the telephone and frequently type on a computer (4 or more hours per day).

  • Requires the ability to work shifts outside of normal working hours including holidays, weekends, and evenings.

  • Ability to be on call and support a 24-hour/ day and 7-day/ week operations environment as needed.

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY
​

Atlanta, Georgia, is a vibrant and dynamic city that perfectly blends Southern charm with big-city energy. As the capital of Georgia and a major hub for business, culture, and innovation, Atlanta offers an unbeatable quality of life. The city is home to world-class attractions including the Georgia Aquarium, the World of Coca-Cola, and the historic Martin Luther King Jr. National Historical Park. Sports fans can cheer on the Braves, Falcons, Hawks, and Atlanta United, while foodies will delight in the city's thriving culinary scene—from authentic Southern cuisine to international flavors.

Atlanta's neighborhoods each have their own unique character, from the trendy shops and restaurants of Midtown to the historic charm of Virginia-Highland and the artistic vibe of East Atlanta Village. The city boasts an extensive park system, including the beloved Piedmont Park and the Atlanta BeltLine, a former railway corridor transformed into a multi-use trail connecting neighborhoods and offering green space, public art, and community events.

With a thriving job market, affordable cost of living compared to other major metros, and Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport—the world's busiest airport—providing easy access to destinations worldwide, Atlanta is an ideal place to build your career and your life. Whether you're exploring the city's rich civil rights history, catching a show at the Fox Theatre, or enjoying the beautiful Georgia weather, Atlanta offers endless opportunities for work, play, and everything in between.

job.title: Executive Reporter, WTKR
job.description:
WTKR, The E.W. Scripps Company CBS affiliate in Norfolk, Virginia, is seeking an Executive Reporter who will lead our mission to enhance storytelling across all platforms. This is your opportunity to combine your passion for impactful journalism with mentorship, helping shape the next generation of reporters while continuing to tell the stories that matter most to our community.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead, develop, and enhance the storytelling skill and abilities of all reporters and MMJs in the station

  • Collaborate with other newsroom leaders to consistently execute the content strategy through authentic, meaningful storytelling

  • Oversee the writing of stories for all platforms; provide timely feedback to foster continuous improvement

  • Develop and supervise effective workflow strategies and procedures for multiple news programs and outlets

  • Ensure that all content adheres to journalistic standards and ethical guidelines

  • Deliver a vision and create trust among reporters, photographers and newsroom staff

  • May provide on-air, multi-platform coverage for breaking news as needed

  • Perform other duties as assigned

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience

  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling

  • Knowledge and demonstration of editorial judgment, journalistic ethics and libel laws

  • Curiosity for the community, city, state and world we report on daily

  • Deep understanding of the content strategy

  • Ability to work a variety of shifts including nights, weekends, early morning, and holidays

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Norfolk, Virginia, sits at the heart of Hampton Roads, one of the most dynamic regions on the East Coast. As part of the largest naval installation in the world, Norfolk offers a unique blend of military heritage, maritime culture, and coastal living. The city boasts a revitalized downtown waterfront featuring world-class museums like the Chrysler Museum of Art, vibrant dining and entertainment districts, and the beautiful Elizabeth River.

Residents enjoy easy access to miles of beaches, the Chesapeake Bay, and outdoor recreation year-round. The region's moderate climate means you can explore the Virginia Beach Boardwalk, kayak through the Great Dismal Swamp, or catch a show at the historic Attucks Theatre any time of year. With affordable housing, no state tax on groceries, and a thriving arts scene that includes the Virginia Opera and Virginia Symphony Orchestra, Norfolk offers an exceptional quality of life. Plus, you're just a short drive from the Blue Ridge Mountains, Washington D.C., and the Outer Banks of North Carolina.

job.title: Game Analyst/Color Commentator, WMYD
job.description:
Scripps Sports is seeking a knowledgeable and engaging Game Analyst/Color Commentator for a full-time temporary position. In this role, you will provide expert commentary and analysis on sporting events, teams, and athletes in the studio and during live broadcasts. You will use your deep understanding of sports, strong analytical skills, and on-air presence to make complex information engaging and accessible for television, radio, and online audiences.

You will deliver detailed live commentary, provide expert analysis alongside play-by-play talent, explain key plays and strategies, and help audiences better understand the athletes, teams, and storylines shaping each event.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Provide in-depth analysis and commentary on sporting events, games, tournaments, and championships.
  • Serve as the color commentator during live broadcasts, offering insight, perspective, and analysis alongside play-by-play announcers.
  • Narrate key plays, strategies, turning points, and momentum shifts during live broadcasts.
  • Break down player performance, team strategies, advanced statistics, and game dynamics in a clear and compelling manner.
  • Provide pre-game, in-game, halftime, and post-game analysis, highlighting key moments and factors influencing the outcome.
  • Collaborate with producers, hosts, reporters, and other analysts to develop segment ideas, storylines, and cohesive broadcast coverage.
  • Conduct research and prepare detailed information on teams, athletes, matchups, and upcoming events to support accurate and informed analysis.
  • Leverage advanced statistics, analytics, and other research tools to provide deeper insights and context.
  • Appear across network programming, including pre-game shows, halftime reports, post-game analysis segments, and special coverage.
  • Participate in special features, documentaries, and other sports-related programming as needed.
  • Engage with viewers through social media, live chats, question-and-answer sessions, and other interactive platforms.
  • Stay current on sports news, industry trends, league developments, historical context, and emerging storylines.
  • Maintain accuracy, professionalism, and composure while responding to the fast-paced and unpredictable nature of live sports coverage.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, broadcasting, sports management, or a related discipline preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Generally, five or more years of experience in sports broadcasting, sports journalism, on-air analysis, color commentary, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience providing live color commentary or game analysis for television, radio, streaming, collegiate, professional, or digital sports broadcasts preferred.
  • Experience using advanced sports analytics, statistics, and research to support commentary and analysis.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast equipment and production software.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Exceptional knowledge of sports, including current events, historical context, leagues, teams, athletes, and key industry developments.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to quickly interpret game developments and explain their significance.
  • Excellent verbal communication, storytelling, public speaking, and presentation skills.
  • A confident, engaging, and credible on-air presence.
  • The ability to provide insightful commentary that enhances the viewer experience before, during, and after live sporting events.
  • The ability to translate complex strategies, statistics, and performance information into clear and accessible commentary.
  • Strong research, preparation, and fact-checking skills.
  • The ability to think quickly, adapt commentary, and remain composed during live broadcasts.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with play-by-play announcers, producers, hosts, reporters, analysts, and production teams.
  • Sound editorial judgment and a commitment to accuracy, fairness, and professional broadcast standards.
  • The ability to engage audiences across broadcast, digital, and social media platforms.
  • Familiarity with video editing and sports production processes preferred.
  • Multilingual communication abilities, particularly in languages relevant to the sports or audiences covered, are a plus.

job.title: Game Reporter, Scripps Sports - WMYD
job.description:
WMYD Detroit is seeking an experienced and dynamic Sideline Reporter / Host, Sports to lead sideline reporting efforts during live sports events, provide comprehensive analysis, conduct engaging interviews, and host studio segments across Scripps Sports programming. This role plays a critical part in shaping Scripps Sports journalism while building and maintaining our reputation as a trusted sports news and information provider.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional reporting skills, on-air presence, sports expertise, and journalistic integrity to deliver compelling coverage that informs and connects with audiences across broadcast, digital, and social platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Provide live coverage from the sidelines during sporting events, delivering real-time updates, analysis, and exclusive interviews with athletes, coaches, and officials.
  • Deliver clear, engaging, and informative commentary that enhances the viewer experience and provides context to game action.
  • Conduct high-profile pre-game, halftime, and post-game interviews, developing relationships with key sports figures to secure compelling content and perspectives.
  • Collaborate with analysts, guest commentators, and production teams to deliver balanced, insightful, and engaging sports discussions.
  • Host a magazine-style sports program featuring major league teams, athletes, storylines, and league developments.
  • Research and gather timely information regarding teams, players, standings, statistics, recent games, and upcoming matchups.
  • Develop talking points, interview questions, and discussion topics for broadcasts, interviews, and panel discussions.
  • Stay informed on major sports news, trades, injuries, league developments, and other events impacting coverage.
  • Maintain the highest standards of journalistic integrity, accuracy, fairness, and professionalism.
  • Mentor and support junior reporters and hosts by sharing best practices and fostering professional development.
  • Engage audiences through social media, live chats, community events, and interactive digital platforms.
  • Utilize social media to promote coverage, build audience engagement, and extend storytelling opportunities beyond game broadcasts.
  • Collaborate closely with producers, directors, and newsroom leadership to identify and develop compelling sports content.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, broadcasting, sports media, or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience.
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in sports reporting, hosting, sports broadcasting, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience with live reporting, high-profile interviews, panel discussions, and on-air hosting.
  • Demonstrated experience covering live sporting events in a fast-paced broadcast environment.
  • Ability to travel and work evenings, weekends, holidays, and non-traditional schedules based on sports programming requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional communication, interviewing, storytelling, and public speaking skills.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of sports and a strong passion for sports journalism.
  • Strong on-air presence with the ability to connect authentically with viewers and guests.
  • Ability to remain poised, professional, and accurate in high-pressure live reporting situations.
  • Strong news judgment and the ability to identify compelling storylines and interview opportunities.
  • Proficiency with broadcasting technology, social media platforms, and digital content tools.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Deep understanding of sports analytics and the ability to interpret and communicate statistics effectively.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with production teams, analysts, executives, and league partners.
  • Commitment to journalistic ethics, accuracy, and credibility.
  • Existing relationships with key figures within the sports industry preferred.
  • Multilingual abilities that enable engagement with diverse audiences are a plus.

job.title: Meteorologist, KIVI
job.description:
KIVI, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Boise, Idaho, is seeking a Meteorologist who will deliver accurate, engaging weather forecasts that matter to our community. As the trusted voice that keeps the Treasure Valley informed and safe, you'll be at the forefront of weather coverage in one of the most dynamic and growing markets in the Mountain West.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.

  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.

  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to: TV, radio, streaming, and digital platforms.

  • Assist management in evaluations of potential new weather data gathering and presentation computers.

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.

  • Report live from event sites or mobile broadcast unit.

  • May write and produce quality news and weather stories for multiple media platforms.

  • May report, write, capture visual content, edit, and produce stories for multiple platforms on deadline, such as Internet and digital channels.

  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.

  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.

  • Perform other duties as needed and assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in meteorology preferred or equivalent years of experience

  • Generally 5+ years of experience preferred

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including weather and newsroom computer systems

  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment

  • Knowledge of editing systems

  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills

  • Proficient at posting content to various websites

  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Boise, Idaho offers an unbeatable quality of life where outdoor adventure meets urban sophistication. As one of the fastest-growing cities in America, Boise combines small-town charm with big-city amenities. The city sits at the base of the stunning Boise Foothills, offering immediate access to world-class hiking, mountain biking, and skiing at Bogus Basin—just 16 miles from downtown. The Boise River Greenbelt winds through the heart of the city, providing 25 miles of scenic pathways perfect for running, cycling, or leisurely strolls.

Downtown Boise boasts a thriving food and craft beer scene, vibrant arts and culture including the Boise Philharmonic and Idaho Shakespeare Festival, and professional sports with the Boise State Broncos. The city enjoys four distinct seasons with over 200 days of sunshine annually, making it perfect for year-round outdoor recreation. With a growing tech sector, affordable cost of living compared to other Western cities, and a welcoming community atmosphere, Boise truly offers the best of both worlds—urban energy and natural beauty at your doorstep.

job.title: Meteorologist, KNXV
job.description:
Bring weather to life for Phoenix audiences as a meteorologist for KNXV, The E.E. Scripps ABC affiliate. We're looking for someone who can deliver accurate, urgent and engaging forecasts across every platform. In this role, you’ll analyze weather data, track rapidly changing conditions and help viewers plan their day with clear, confident reporting that reflects the needs of a fast-growing, weather-aware community.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.

  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.

  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to: TV, Radio, Internet.

  • Assist management in evaluations of potential new weather data gathering and presentation computers.

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.

  • Report live from event sites or mobile broadcast unit.

  • May write and produce quality news and weather stories for multiple media platforms.

  • May report, write, capture visual content, edit, and produce stories for multiple platforms on deadline, such as Internet and digital channels.

  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.

  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.

  • Perform other duties as needed and assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelors degree in Meteorology preferred

  • Generally 3+ years experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy, including weather and newsroom computer systems

  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment

  • Knowledge of editing systems

  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills

  • Proficient at posting content to various websites

  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

Where you’ll live, work and play: Phoenix offers a dynamic mix of big-city opportunity, stunning desert scenery and year-round outdoor living. From hiking Camelback Mountain and exploring the Sonoran Desert to enjoying a growing food scene, major league sports, arts, culture and quick weekend getaways across the Southwest, the Valley gives you plenty of ways to connect with the community you’ll serve on air.

job.title: Multi-Media Managing Editor, WMAR
job.description:
WMAR, The E.W. Scripps ABC Station in Baltimore, MD, is searching for a Multi-Media Managing Editor to help lead a new era of local news. We're looking for a newsroom leader who understands that today's audiences expect news wherever they are, whether that's on a streaming channel, a phone, social media, or television.

You'll be at the center of our operation, helping drive a 24/7 news stream while ensuring the newsroom stays connected, informed, and focused on the stories that matter most. This role is part coach, part editor, and part conductor. You'll help reporters and MMJs tell stronger stories, make smart decisions in the moment, and find creative ways to connect our journalism with the communities we serve.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead the daily execution of WMAR's streaming and digital news coverage, ensuring audiences have access to timely, relevant content around the clock.

  • Serve as the newsroom's central information hub, helping coordinate coverage plans, breaking news response, and content priorities.

  • Coach and develop reporters and MMJs to elevate storytelling across digital, streaming, social, and broadcast platforms.

  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership to execute audience-focused content strategies that drive engagement and community impact.

  • Oversee the writing, editing, and publishing of stories across all platforms while maintaining quality and consistency.

  • Provide timely and constructive feedback that helps journalists strengthen their reporting, writing, and presentation skills.

  • Develop and refine workflows that support multiple news products, including streaming, digital, social, and broadcast content.

  • Ensure all content meets the highest standards of journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, and legal compliance.

  • Help identify opportunities for enterprise and accountability reporting that resonate with local audiences.

  • Support breaking news coverage and provide multi-platform content leadership when news demands immediate action.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Seven or more years of experience in journalism, digital content, newsroom leadership, streaming, or a related field preferred.

  • Proven experience managing content in a fast-paced newsroom environment and making sound editorial decisions under deadline pressure.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Deep roots in digital journalism, streaming content, and audience engagement strategies.

  • Strong understanding of broadcast-style storytelling and how to adapt stories across platforms.

  • Demonstrated expertise in coaching journalists and helping teams produce stronger, more impactful work.

  • Exceptional editorial judgment and knowledge of journalistic ethics, media law, and libel standards.

  • Curiosity about the communities, issues, and people that shape the stories we cover every day.

  • Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • A collaborative leadership style that builds trust and encourages innovation throughout the newsroom.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment where priorities can shift quickly.

  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including nights, weekends, early mornings, and holidays when news coverage requires it.

OUR TEAM:

WMAR is home to journalists who care deeply about serving Baltimore and Central Maryland. We're a collaborative team of reporters, photographers, producers, digital content creators, and newsroom leaders who believe local journalism should inform, connect, and strengthen the communities we serve. Our team is committed to impactful storytelling, breaking news excellence, accountability journalism, and meaningful community engagement. We embrace innovation, encourage new ideas, and support one another as we evolve for the future of local news.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Baltimore offers the energy of a major metropolitan area with the accessibility and character of a close-knit community. Located along the Chesapeake Bay and within easy reach of Washington, D.C., Baltimore is a city rich in history, culture, and opportunity. The region features vibrant neighborhoods, world-class healthcare and education institutions, thriving arts and entertainment districts, and some of the most diverse communities in the country.

Whether you're exploring the Inner Harbor, attending Orioles or Ravens games, enjoying the city's renowned food scene, spending time on the waterfront, or discovering the unique stories that define Maryland's communities, Baltimore offers endless opportunities for both professional growth and personal enjoyment. It's a market where local journalism matters and where impactful storytelling can make a meaningful difference.

At WMAR, you'll have the opportunity to lead coverage in a market known for passionate audiences, diverse communities, and stories that shape conversations across Maryland.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KKCO
job.description:
KKCO, the NBC affiliate in Grand Junction, Colorado, is looking for a multimedia journalist who is ready to own stories from idea to air and publication. The MMJ will be able to connect with audiences across every platform. This is an opportunity for a strong, curious storyteller to cover the issues, people and moments that matter across western Colorado — from breaking news and enterprise reporting to compelling video, digital and social content that helps our communities stay informed.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.

  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.

  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.

  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.

  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.

  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration

  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.

  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.

  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.

  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred

  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems

  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred

  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment

  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment

  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills

  • Proficient at posting content to various websites

  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

Where You’ll Live, Work and Play

Grand Junction offers the best of Colorado living without the big-city pace. Set in the heart of the Grand Valley, the community is surrounded by red rock canyons, mesas, rivers and endless access to hiking, biking, climbing, skiing and more. You’ll find a strong sense of community, a growing downtown, nearby wineries and year-round outdoor adventure — including the rare chance to ski and golf in the same day during parts of the year. It’s a place where journalists can build meaningful local connections while enjoying an active, scenic lifestyle outside of work.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WCPO
job.description:
Multimedia Journalist, WCPO

WCPO 9, the E.W. Scripps ABC station in Cincinnati, Ohio, is looking for a Multimedia Journalist to join our award-winning newsroom. This is not an entry-level position. We are looking for a journalist who can separate us from the competition through exceptional source-building, enterprise reporting, and compelling storytelling. We want someone who knows how to uncover stories that no one else has and deliver them in a way that informs, engages, and serves our community.

Cincinnati is a vibrant and growing city with a rich culture, passionate sports fans, distinctive neighborhoods, and a strong sense of community. From the revitalized riverfront and thriving arts scene to world-class parks, festivals, and restaurants, Cincinnati offers an exceptional quality of life. WCPO is known for its commitment to impactful journalism, innovation, and community service, supported by strong newsroom leadership that is invested in helping journalists grow and succeed. If you're ready to make a difference and tell stories that matter, apply today.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and tips to develop original story ideas.

  • Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and research.

  • Organize material, determine story emphasis, and write content according to editorial standards and AP style.

  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.

  • Edit, or assist in editing, video for television, digital, social, and streaming platforms.

  • Appear on television programs while conducting interviews or providing narration.

  • Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news and community events.

  • Work collaboratively with photographers and other newsroom staff when assigned.

  • Assist producers in preparing newscasts and coverage plans.

  • Partner with digital teams to create compelling multimedia content for all platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience.

  • Generally, 3+ years of professional reporting experience preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong journalism skills, including enterprise reporting, source development, and storytelling.

  • Proven ability to develop exclusive stories through relationship-building, public records research, and enterprise reporting that delivers meaningful impact for local communities.

  • Computer literacy, including experience with newsroom content management systems.

  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred.

  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment.

  • Ability to edit video using Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere, or similar editing systems.

  • Strong broadcast writing and AP style skills.

  • Experience publishing content across digital, social, and streaming platforms.

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong news judgment and a commitment to accurate, ethical journalism.

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with company-required limits.

WEWS News 5 has a long-standing reputation for trusted journalism, investigative reporting, innovation, and community engagement. Our newsroom is committed to helping journalists grow, develop their skills, and make a difference in the communities they serve. If you're ready to tell stories that matter and be part of a team dedicated to impactful journalism, apply today.

job.title: Network Broadcast Operator
job.description:
Are you passionate about broadcast excellence and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment? Scripps Networks is seeking a Network Broadcast Operator to join our team in Clearwater, FL. In this vital role, you'll be the eyes and ears of our national network operations facility, ensuring that every signal we broadcast meets the highest quality standards. Your vigilance and quick response will directly impact the delivery of Scripps's trusted content to audiences nationwide.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Watch all of SCRIPPS's "Send and Return" signals to ensure technical transmission and quality of broadcast.

  • Effectively communicate and troubleshoot all outages/issues per the company SOP's.

  • Cross-reference logs against on-air playlists to ensure accuracy and timing.

  • Modify on-air playlists as needed to ensure setup and execution of on-air elements through automated commands.

  • Monitor local weather (re: transmitter adjustments or need for generator).

  • Answer, report, and troubleshoot incoming calls from external companies about satellite receiver issues.

  • Ensure that all on-air equipment is operational and follow necessary procedures to correct any issues.

  • Enforce and adhere to company policies and procedures including corporate guidelines and best practices.

  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or 1-3 years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Must have strong computer skills and be comfortable in a Windows environment; Proficiency in Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint is required.

  • Ability to work well under pressure.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication/documentation skills.

  • Organized and self-motivated.

  • Knowledge of all related origination equipment, or the ability to learn.

  • Ability to follow instructions and work independently.

  • Ability to troubleshoot minor operational problems.

  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.

  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

  • Ability to deal with problems involving variables in standardized situations.

  • Ability to work well as part of a team.

  • Ability to proactively identify problems and troubleshoot before affecting on-air.

  • Must have a flexible work schedule to work anytime in a 24/7 operation (nights, weekends, holidays).

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY

Clearwater, Florida, offers the perfect blend of coastal living and career opportunities. Located on the stunning Gulf Coast, Clearwater is famous for its pristine white-sand beaches, including the award-winning Clearwater Beach, consistently ranked among America's best beaches. The city enjoys year-round sunshine, making it ideal for outdoor enthusiasts who love water sports, fishing, boating, and beach volleyball.

Beyond the beaches, Clearwater boasts a vibrant downtown area with eclectic shops, waterfront dining, and the famous Clearwater Marine Aquarium, home to Winter the dolphin. The city is part of the Tampa Bay metropolitan area, providing easy access to professional sports, world-class museums, and diverse entertainment options. With its affordable cost of living compared to other coastal cities, excellent schools, and welcoming community atmosphere, Clearwater offers an exceptional quality of life where you can truly enjoy the Florida lifestyle.

job.title: Regional Digital Sales Manager, Hybrid
job.description:
Are you a dynamic sales leader ready to drive digital revenue growth and shape the future of local media advertising? We're seeking an experienced Digital Sales Manager who will lead our digital sales strategy, develop our sales team, and deliver innovative advertising solutions that help local businesses thrive. This is your opportunity to make a significant impact on our station's success while building a high-performing team.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Collaborate with DOS and other sales managers and departments to accomplish the objectives of each assigned station.

  • Full responsibility for digital revenue, including establishing and achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual digital sales goals.

  • Develop and execute local digital sales strategy and revenue plan.

  • Make business decisions regarding the profitability of the sales organization as well as specific sales proposals and offerings.

  • Serve as the local digital product, process, and sales strategy expert.

  • Collaborate with the sales managers to train, develop and motivate the local sales team so that revenue goals are achieved.

  • Collaborate with the sales managers to foster career growth and development of the local sales team so that a pipeline of talent for future Scripps sales management openings is ready.

  • Interpret and utilize market and advertiser research to develop solutions, marketing materials, and presentations.

  • Establish and monitor key pacing metrics and conduct frequent pipeline review to effectively forecast results.

  • Develop, recommend and execute actions to gain market share.

  • Provide input to local leadership regarding market conditions, competition, and effectiveness of the digital sales plan.

  • Ensure successful execution of each campaign.

  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience

  • Generally 8+ years of experience in related field preferred

  • Prior managerial experience preferred

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Excellent leadership skills and experience managing sales staff to achieve revenue goals and high performance

  • Superior digital product knowledge, local market analytic and personal selling skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Ability to share vision, gain buy-in, and build loyalty

  • Performance oriented leader with sound ability to manage team to daily outcomes, and achieve goals through his/her team

  • Ability to manage escalated difficult or emotional customer situations

  • In depth knowledge to pull reports needed to ensure proper pacing of their team and the canvass

  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills, including proficient PC skills in Microsoft Office applications

  • Exceptional coaching skills

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Cincinnati, Ohio offers an unbeatable combination of big-city amenities and Midwestern charm. Known for its rich history, vibrant arts scene, and passionate sports culture, Cincinnati is home to world-class museums, a thriving culinary scene featuring the famous Cincinnati chili, and beautiful riverfront parks along the Ohio River. The city boasts diverse neighborhoods, each with its own unique character, from the historic Over-the-Rhine district with its stunning architecture and trendy restaurants to the family-friendly suburbs. Sports fans can cheer on the Reds and Bengals, while outdoor enthusiasts enjoy easy access to hiking, biking, and water activities. With a lower cost of living than many major metros and a growing job market, Cincinnati provides an exceptional quality of life for professionals and families alike.

job.title: Specialist, Program Operations - Scripps Howard Foundation
job.description:
The E.W. Scripps Company is seeking Specialist, Program Operations responsible for providing comprehensive administrative and program operations support to the President/CEO and the entire Scripps Howard Fund team. Key support areas include but are not limited to general administration, calendar and meeting coordination, communications, event planning, project planning support, preparation of board reports and other materials, customer service, data management, expense and invoice coordination, donor and partner support and other day-to-day administrative duties that help advance the Fund’s priorities.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Answer telephones and route calls; open and route mail.

  • Respond to detailed inquiries from outside the organization.

  • Implement large mailings (organize, gather materials and information, make copies, stuff/pack, label and ship).

  • Prepare, update and proofread event materials and documents (name badges, signs, flyers, brochures and placards).

  • Schedule meetings; take and distribute meeting minutes.

  • Perform a variety of program support duties including complex travel arranging, supply ordering, file maintenance, preparation of promotional items and packing/unpacking and inventorying of materials.

  • Provide program support to management team on an as-needed basis.

  • Handle payment processing functions.

  • Handle accounts payable and accounts receivable functions on an as-needed basis.

  • Work on special projects in communications, event planning and customer service on an as-needed basis.

  • Maintain reports and schedules as needed for the department

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

  • 3-5 years of support experience that includes duties such as word processing, data entry and arranging travel

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Driven by philanthropic work and dedicated to maximizing community impact 

  • Energetic self-starter with the ability to manage multifaceted projects and a capacity to perform well in a dynamic, multi-tasking environment

  • Able to anticipate needs and resolve problems in a timely manner

  • Experience in monitoring and communicating dynamic project factors such as deadlines, budget and scope to ensure targets are achieved

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (both verbal and written)

  • Ability to identify and work through challenges, underscored by strong judgment and emotional intelligence

  • Self-motivated and organized

  • Experience with fundraising/donor management software

  • Thrives in a collaborative environment

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel

  • Strong written communication skills, including excellent spelling and grammar

  • Strong problem-solving ability

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

  • Highly organized

  • Ability to gather information and recommend solutions to challenges

  • Ability to rapidly learn a myriad of program policies and procedures

  • Ability to multi-task and work on multiple assignments simultaneously

job.title: Studio Analyst, Scripps Sports - WMYD
job.description:
WMYD Detroit is seeking a knowledgeable and engaging Studio Analyst, Sports to provide expert commentary and analysis on sports events, teams, and athletes in studio and during live broadcasts. This role is responsible for delivering detailed, insightful, and engaging commentary that enhances the audience experience across television, streaming, radio, and digital platforms.

The ideal candidate combines deep sports knowledge, strong analytical skills, and exceptional communication abilities to explain game action, player performance, and strategic developments in an informative and entertaining manner while helping shape Scripps Sports programming and coverage.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Provide in-depth analysis and commentary on sports games, tournaments, championships, and other sporting events.
  • Deliver live, detailed, and engaging commentary across television, streaming, radio, and digital broadcasts.
  • Narrate key plays, game strategies, and momentum shifts to provide additional context and insight for viewers.
  • Break down player performance, team strategies, and game dynamics in a clear, engaging, and easy-to-understand manner.
  • Provide pre-game, in-game, halftime, and post-game analysis, highlighting critical moments and factors that influence outcomes.
  • Collaborate with producers, hosts, commentators, and fellow analysts to develop segment ideas, storylines, and engaging broadcast content.
  • Conduct research and prepare detailed reports on teams, athletes, statistics, trends, and upcoming games to support informed analysis.
  • Engage with viewers through social media platforms and interactive digital experiences, providing insights and responding to audience questions.
  • Participate in live chats, Q&A sessions, and other audience engagement initiatives to strengthen viewer connection and interaction.
  • Appear on network programs including pre-game shows, halftime reports, post-game analysis segments, and other sports programming.
  • Participate in special features, documentaries, and sports-related content initiatives as assigned.
  • Stay informed of sports news, league developments, industry trends, player movement, and emerging storylines.
  • Leverage advanced statistics, analytics, and research tools to provide deeper insights and enhance audience understanding.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, broadcasting, sports media, or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience.
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in sports broadcasting, sports journalism, commentary, analysis, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience with advanced sports analytics and statistical analysis.
  • Experience providing live commentary, sports analysis, or expert opinions in a broadcast, streaming, or digital environment preferred.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and non-traditional schedules based on sports programming requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional knowledge of sports, including current events, historical context, athletes, teams, leagues, and key storylines.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, interviewing, and public speaking abilities.
  • Strong on-air presence and the ability to connect with diverse audiences.
  • Ability to communicate complex concepts, statistics, strategies, and trends in a compelling and accessible manner.
  • Proficiency with broadcasting equipment, production software, and digital media tools.
  • Strong research and preparation skills with a commitment to accuracy and credibility.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with talent, producers, directors, and production personnel.
  • Adaptability and confidence in fast-paced live production environments.
  • Commitment to journalistic integrity, professionalism, and high-quality sports coverage.

job.title: Studio Host, Scripps Sports - WMYD
job.description:
WMYD Detroit is seeking a dynamic and engaging Studio Host, Sports to serve as the face of Scripps Sports programming. This role is responsible for leading compelling sports discussions, providing insightful analysis, conducting high-profile interviews, and delivering high-quality content that informs, entertains, and engages audiences across broadcast, digital, and social platforms.

The ideal candidate will bring exceptional on-air presence, deep sports knowledge, strong interviewing skills, and the ability to connect with viewers while representing the Scripps Sports brand with professionalism and credibility.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead live studio broadcasts, including pre-game shows, halftime reports, post-game analysis, and special sports programming.
  • Facilitate discussions with analysts, guest commentators, athletes, and sports personalities, ensuring conversations are engaging, informative, and balanced.
  • Provide insightful commentary and analysis on sporting events, teams, athletes, and key storylines.
  • Research and gather current information on teams, players, standings, statistics, recent performances, and upcoming matchups.
  • Prepare talking points, interview questions, and discussion topics for broadcasts, interviews, and panel discussions.
  • Stay informed on major sports news, trades, injuries, league developments, and other events impacting coverage.
  • Collaborate with producers, writers, and editorial teams to develop compelling content, programming concepts, and segment ideas.
  • Ensure all content meets Scripps Sports standards for journalistic integrity, accuracy, professionalism, and quality.
  • Conduct in-depth interviews with athletes, coaches, executives, and other key figures in the sports industry, both in-studio and remotely.
  • Research interview subjects and develop thoughtful questions that generate meaningful and informative conversations.
  • Engage with viewers through social media, live chats, audience outreach initiatives, and other interactive platforms.
  • Promote upcoming broadcasts, special programming, and original content across multiple channels to strengthen audience engagement.
  • Participate in live coverage of major sporting events when needed, providing on-location reporting, interviews, and analysis.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, broadcasting, sports media, or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience.
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in sports broadcasting, hosting, reporting, sports journalism, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience hosting live broadcasts, conducting interviews, moderating discussions, and engaging audiences across multiple platforms.
  • Experience with social media engagement and audience interaction.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and non-traditional schedules based on sports programming requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional communication, interviewing, storytelling, and public speaking skills.
  • Deep knowledge of sports, including current events, key players, teams, leagues, and historical context.

  • Ability to work under pressure and handle live broadcasting situations with professionalism and confidence.

  • Proficiency with broadcasting technology, production systems, and media software.
  • Strong organizational and preparation skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with producers, analysts, writers, and production teams.

job.title: Weekend Meteorologist/MMJ, KMVT
job.description:
KMVT in Twin Falls, Idaho is seeking a Weekend Meteorologist/MMJ who will be the trusted voice our community turns to for accurate forecasts and compelling weather stories. This role offers a unique opportunity to combine meteorological expertise with multimedia journalism, delivering critical weather information across multiple platforms while also reporting on the stories that matter most to Southern Idaho.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.

  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.

  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to TV, streaming, and digital platforms.

  • Assist management in evaluations of potential new weather data gathering and presentation computers.

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.

  • Report live from event sites or mobile broadcast unit.

  • May write and produce quality news and weather stories for multiple media platforms.

  • May report, write, capture visual content, edit, and produce stories for multiple platforms on deadline, such as Internet and digital channels.

  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.

  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research/

  • Perform other duties as needed and assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology preferred

  • Generally 3+ years of experience preferred

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy, including weather and newsroom computer systems

  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment

  • Knowledge of editing systems

  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills

  • Proficient at posting content to various websites

  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Twin Falls, Idaho offers an exceptional quality of life in the heart of the Magic Valley. Known for its stunning natural beauty, the city sits along the dramatic Snake River Canyon, home to the iconic Shoshone Falls - often called the "Niagara of the West." Outdoor enthusiasts will find endless recreation opportunities, from world-class fly fishing and whitewater rafting to hiking, mountain biking, and skiing at nearby Sun Valley. The area's agricultural heritage creates a strong sense of community, while the growing downtown features local restaurants, breweries, and cultural events. With affordable housing, low crime rates, and proximity to both wilderness areas and urban amenities, Twin Falls provides the perfect balance of small-town charm and outdoor adventure. The region's diverse weather patterns - from dramatic thunderstorms to beautiful four-season changes - make it an exciting market for meteorologists who love tracking dynamic weather systems.

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

Job Description:

Semafor is seeking a Senior Accountant to join our Accounting & Finance team and take ownership of core general ledger and month-end close activities as we build out our in-house accounting function. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented accounting professional with a solid foundation in month-end close, journal entries, and account reconciliations, who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance environment. This role will work closely with the Controller to strengthen processes, internal controls, and documentation, and will partner with FP&A on cost analysis and reporting. The successful candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, working independently and as part of a team, and adapting to shifting priorities within a rapidly growing media company. Prior experience in the media industry is a plus. This position offers meaningful growth potential as the accounting & finance team continues to scale.

What You’ll Do:

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end close process, ensuring all close deliverables are completed accurately and on a timely basis.
  • Prepare and post journal entries in accordance with GAAP, ensuring transactions are properly recorded and supported.
  • Prepare and analyze monthly account reconciliations for assigned balance sheet and income statement accounts, researching and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations across entities, ensuring balances tie out and are properly eliminated in consolidation 
  • Review the general ledger for accurate coding across all financial dimensions (department, project, entity, etc.), proactively identifying and correcting miscoded transactions.
  • Assist with accounts payable tasks as needed, including invoice coding, vendor inquiries, and payment support.
  • Partner with FP&A on analysis and reporting, including cost analysis, variance analysis, and ad hoc reporting requests.
  • Assist the Controller in further developing accounting processes, internal controls, and documentation.
  • Support the Controller with audits, special projects, and ad hoc analyses as needed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows and month-end close efficiency, and assist in implementing process improvements.
  • Comfortable wearing many hats and adapting to shifting priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance environment.

What You Offer

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field from an accredited university or college; CPA or CPA candidate a plus.
  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience, including month-end close, journal entries, and account reconciliations.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and general ledger accounting principles.
  • Excellent Microsoft Office skills with a strong emphasis on Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial modeling).
  • Experience with a general ledger/ERP system (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks) required; Bill.com or similar AP platform experience is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with proven organizational and time management skills and a strong sense of ownership and accuracy.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven corporate finance role, with the ability to manage competing priorities under tight timelines.
  • Experience in the media, publishing, or entertainment industry is a plus.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and works well in a team environment.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

Compensation:
The base salary for this position at the time of posting will range from $110,000 - $145,000 in addition to an annual bonus incentive. Individual compensation varies based on job related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications. 

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Senior Creative Strategists develop original media strategies, brand narratives, and strategic platforms and ideas, codified into thoughtful proposals to share with partners across industries and markets, focusing on New York, DC, Africa, and Gulf regions. In this role, you will be expected to understand your clients’ priorities and challenges, and authoritatively operationalize cross-functional processes to develop best-in-class presentations and proposal deliverables. This role will work closely with other Creative Strategists on the team as well as the Sales team, Revenue Operations team, and broader marketing teams. 

Your Responsibilities

  • Create and visually design thoughtful, strategic, and engaging proposals, typically in visual presentation format, that clearly and concisely communicate ideas/concepts that map back to key advertiser objectives and KPIs.
  • Be a subject matter expert on Semafor’s brand and products. Understand and build on Semafor’s brand story on behalf of clients.
  • Engage with genuine curiosity and interest in deeply understanding clients’ brand challenges, priorities, and objectives.

What makes you qualified

  • Demonstrated ability to generate revenue through marketing strategies.
  • Approaches revenue opportunities with curiosity, ingenuity, and originality.
  • Feels deep ownership of their work.
  • This is an in-person role, with 4 days a week expected in our New York or Washington D.C. office. There may be some travel on an as-needed basis. 
  • Must have advanced skills with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Google Slides/Powerpoint.

This position is based in New York, NY or DC. Candidates must be willing to work flexible hours and travel domestically and internationally on an as-needed basis.

job.title: Customer Service Rep- CCLI (Vancouver)
job.description:
Christian Copyright Licensing International (CCLI) is seeking a Customer Service Representative to join our team in Vancouver, Washington. In this role you will be responsible for supporting customer needs by answering questions, providing information on CCLI licenses and services, as well as first level technical support. In addition, the Customer Service Representative contacts existing customers to ensure retention, processes orders for new and renewing licenses and services, and performs outbound calling to prospective customers gained from marketing campaigns.

 

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Responds to large volumes of incoming calls and written communications to ensure timely and accurate responses to customer needs.
  • Asks qualifying questions to properly identify the needs of current and prospective customers, educates and recommends appropriate products and services as solutions, answers questions, resolves objections in order to successfully renew or issue new license.
  • Follows up on leads, responds to inquiries and performs outbound calling to prospective customers gained from marketing campaigns.
  • Demonstrates knowledge and expertise to license holders/customers by confidently and accurately providing information about CCLI’s suite of product offerings and services (including CVLI and ScreenVue), terms and conditions, church music offerings, rights owner information, and copyright law.
  • Assists customers with license renewals, identifies and fulfills product and service needs.
  • Instructs customers in the proper application of CCLI licenses, completion of responsibilities and the use of tools to access song, publisher and resource information.
  • Answers questions regarding licensees’ activity reporting and clarifies procedures, and assists IP department on reporting accuracy for royalty payouts.
  • Ensures customer accounts and profile information is properly updated in computer databases/software systems.
  • Maintains current knowledge of products and services, and customer service best practices through ongoing training and education in areas of responsibility.
  • Provides first level technical support to customers for CCLI’s online services.
  • Informs supervisor about customer concerns and escalates difficult customer contacts as needed. 
  • Special project and duties as assigned.

 

What Makes You Qualified:

  • High School diploma or two years of equivalent work experience in customer service.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
  • Fluency in Spanish or a territorial second language desired.
  • Critical thinking skills with ability to apply sound judgment.
  • Highly organized, ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively.
  • Solutions oriented approach to problem solving.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; able to work professionally with coworkers and customers. 
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite. Confident working with and learning new technologies. Ability to adjust to varying workloads.
  • Basic knowledge of copyright law, Christian music, and related terminologies is helpful.

 

The duties listed above are not all inclusive. This job description is not intended to cover all aspects of the responsibilities of the job. The position is expected to perform other work-related duties as assigned even though they may not be considered essential functions or specifically identified in this description.

 

This is currently a hybrid role that will require you to commute to our Vancouver, Washington office a minimum of three days a week.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Digital Remedy is a Performance Marketing Partner for brands & agencies, headquartered in New York City, that specializes in helping marketers deliver better outcomes and higher ROI on their media investments.

Digital Remedy offers access, measurement, and optimization across all major media channels with a speciality in Performance CTV. Our proprietary platform has been recognized by the Drum and Digiday for product excellence and was recently named Digiday’s Best New Streaming Advertising Platform. We have seen exponential growth and adoption across Tier 1 brands and agencies, including several Fortune 500 companies and Big 6 agency holding companies. We’ve spent over 20 years investing in performance solutions and we are well positioned to continue offering our clients a way to anchor their campaigns in real world business outcomes.

We are looking for a top Account Executive to join our fast growing sales team. As an Account Executive you will play a critical role with our energetic and talented sales & customer team. The Account Executive will lead all stages of the life cycle of a customer in order to secure, retain, and grow digital ad revenue with our customers and partners. The ideal candidate must be able to develop and execute a focused solution based strategy in order to maximize our value back to the customer.

We are looking for a person with a passion for digital media, a desire to be at the leading edge of technological change in the digital media industry and the ability to learn and contribute quickly.

  • Engage in new, and developing existing, relationships at the C-suite, VP, Director level across brands, independent agencies, and holding companies within a dedicated account list.
  • Create narratives with a beginning, middle, and end to explain complex processes, ideas, or events.
  • Prepare, present and close new business through in person meetings, industry events, virtual meetings, and conferences.
  • Identify and sell new media solutions to businesses and agencies, helping them connect with their customers/users. 
  • Enter daily sales activity, meeting, calls, email opportunities, pipeline, and deals into Digital Remedy CRM. 
  • Show consistency in exceeding sales targets and key performance indicators. 
  • Manage client relationships inclusive of strategy recommendation and up-selling.

 

Our Ideal Candidate 

  • Have a strong set of existing relationships with independent agencies, holding companies, and brands directly. 
  • At least 3 years of experience working at a media sales organization selling brand & performance based advertising campaigns, strong OTT experience a plus! Experience working in a SaaS, MarTech, AdTech, Advertising or startup preferred.
  • Proven track record of success in exceeding sales targets and key performance indicators. Knowledge of all facets of digital media, OTT/CTV industry landscape a plus.
  • Skilled in new business development while communicating effectively with senior management.
  • Excellent customer facing skills specifically with regards to negotiation.
  • Experience with CRM management is a plus.
  • Hard-working and pleasantly persistent, ensuring delivery of great results, go-getter attitude.
     

 


Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

Why Digital Remedy?

We are in a high-growth phase, integrating innovative tech from recent acquisitions. You will have a seat at the table to influence our long-term technical strategy and help us "build and scale" for the future.

job.title: Assistant Content Manager
job.description:
The Assistant Content Manager plays a critical role in breaking down newsroom silos, driving real-time content strategy, and ensuring consistent, high-quality storytelling that maximizes audience reach and engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily content strategy and execution across all platforms, including broadcast, digital, and social 
  • Lead multiplatform storytelling by ensuring content is created and adapted intentionally for each platform 
  • Serve as the central point of coordination between the assignment desk, producers, reporters, and digital teams 
  • Make real-time editorial decisions on story placement, prioritization, publishing, and distribution 
  • Manage and coordinate breaking news coverage across platforms, including alerts, streaming, and on-air integration 
  • Ensure editorial consistency in messaging, tone, and brand voice across all content channels 
  • Monitor audience analytics and apply insights to inform editorial decisions and optimize content performance 
  • Identify opportunities to extend the life and reach of high-performing content 
  • Coordinate newsroom workflows to reduce duplication of effort and improve operational efficiency 
  • Support a continuous publishing model, ensuring timely and consistent content updates 
  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership to align content strategy with organizational goals and initiatives 

 

Qualifications

  • Strong editorial judgment and understanding of news values 
  • Demonstrated experience with multiplatform content production 
  • Proven ability to make quick, effective decisions in high-pressure and breaking news environments 
  • Deep understanding of digital platforms, social media, and audience engagement strategies 
  • Experience using analytics tools to guide content decisions 
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to coordinate across multiple teams 
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously 

 

 Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a leadership or supervisory newsroom role 
  • Background in integrated or converged newsroom environments 

 

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Seamless coordination of content across all platforms 
  • Faster, more effective breaking news coverage 
  • Increased audience engagement and content reach 
  • Strong editorial consistency and brand alignment 
  • Improved newsroom efficiency and collaboration
