job.description:
Department Sales Location Sydney (NS)

Stingray is a leading global music, media and technology company, and Canada’s premier radio broadcaster.  At Stingray, creativity, collaboration and innovative technology are the pillars of our DNA.

As a valued team members prepares for retirement, we are currently looking for a Media Sales Strategist to join our Sydney team and cover the Cape Breton Regional Municipality! This position reports to the Retail Sales Manager for Hot 101.9 and New Country 103.5/Sydney.

Stingray offers one of the most robust multimedia platforms for businesses to market and sell their products and services, locally, nationally or globally. Our ideal candidate has a strong multimedia marketing and sales background, and has demonstrated the ability to manage and grow an active client list, while understanding the importance of a team mentality with a desire to be part of the fabric of the community.

Located on beautiful Cape Breton Island, Sydney serves as the gateway to the Cabot Trail, the Cape Breton Highlands National Park, and several other cultural attractions.  With a diversified economy, it’s the largest urban centre on the island with a population of approximately 100,000 and serves as its healthcare, educational, and transportation hub.

Your day-to-day

  • Be a local sales leader of the Hot 101.9 and New Country 103.5, Stingray-owned radio stations.    You will have the opportunity to harness the power of these popular stations while also representing all Stingray Radio Stations from Vancouver to St. John’s, unlocking vast sales potential across a nationwide network.
  • Leverage a diverse range of media solutions including radio, programmatic display, programmatic video, connected TV, digital out-of-home, YouTube, search, social, and our proprietary retail media platform – to help clients grow and succeed.
  • Own the full sales process from lead generation and prospecting to client needs analysis, solution presentation, negotiation, and closing.
  • Drive revenue growth and achieve revenue targets through consultative sales and development of strategic proposals.  Manage and grow your client base while identifying new business opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (promotions, programming, creative, production, digital campaign managers) to deliver impactful, multi-platform advertising campaigns.
  • Help handle the administrative responsibilities of the Sydney Sales Department, including building client/station proposals; coordinating the remote booking process/wrap-up reports (for both local and national opportunities); and representing the stations at client and community partner events.

Your qualifications

  • You have 2+ years of in-person, consultative sales or account management experience (experience in multi-media advertising or digital media is a plus).
  • Ability to self-manage, proven high-achieving performer in all facets of life with a track record of consistently achieving and exceeding sales targets.
  • You are comfortable building ground-up ideas and presenting your strategies to business owners and operators.
  • You are an excellent communicator, presenter, and negotiator with a history of building strong, lasting, business relationships.
  • You are well-organized, accountable, and skilled at managing time and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment with a team-focused mindset.
  • You live in or would relocate to Sydney, NS; have a valid driver’s license; access to a vehicle; and valid vehicle insurance.

Life at Stingray

  • A positive, team-oriented work environment
  • An opportunity to work with and learn from the best in the business
  • Pension Plan and Share Purchase Plan (with a contribution from Stingray)
  • Comprehensive benefits plan and Employee and Family Assistance Plan
  • Hybrid work policy (for positions that qualify)
  • And much more!

If you are looking for an exceptional workplace and have what it takes to fill this position send your resume to Hot 101.9/New Country 103.5 Retail Sales Manager, Daryl Matheson at: dmatheson@stingray.com

About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

If you’ve spent your career building world-class support organizations and you’re itching to rebuild one from the ground up — AI-first, data-driven, and at real scale — this is the role. As Director of Customer

Experience

(Support) at Suno, you’ll own our customer support function end-to-end: setting and managing SLAs, running a lean P&L, and ensuring every user who needs help gets a high-quality experience. You’ll lead a team of 6–8 support ICs and partner closely with Trust & Safety, Product, Billing, Legal, and Policy to solve some of our hardest customer-facing problems. You’ll report to the Sr. Director of Customer

Experience

& Safety.

job.title: Trending News Producer - Business and Sports
job.description:
Position Summary

The Tampa Bay Times is hiring a Trending News Producer focused on business and sports who will join a new high-metabolism digital-first Bay Now team working to produce multiple breakouts, explainers, aggregations each day that boil down interesting news developments. Trending News Producers work quickly and nimbly to make sense of bigger stories or hone in on high-interest topics and trends that speak to our readers. They will put in context various rankings and lists – and Tampa Bay and Florida’s place in it. The work should be fast, sharp and fun when appropriate. A fair number of posts will be aggregations and listicles, providing nuggets of news and information. Though their focus will be on business and sports topics, they may occasionally write trending posts on other subjects. This role will also entail some podcast production. Filming, video editing, and audio recording/editing skills are required for this role accordingly in addition to sharp news judgment and demonstrated ability to write with speed and attention to detail. This role will report in to the Assistant Managing Editor, Digital Engagement and be located in our St. Petersburg, FL office.


Key Responsibilities

  • Write two articles a day five days a week on primarily sports or business topics, but other topics as required.
  • Be constantly searching for news to cover and find engaging, locally-centered ways angles on stories.
  • Get on publicists’ email blast lists to find news to aggregate.
  • Receive assignments from across the newsroom.
  • Track the traffic on your stories to assess performance and then brainstorm follow-ups.
  • Produce, record, film, and edit podcasts of at least 15 minutes in length or more up to several times per week.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, English, or related field.
  • Relevant experience writing for a journalistic outlet, including a student newspaper.
  • A combination of speed and attention to detail.
  • A constant hunger to find new stories and generate traffic.
  • A demonstrated track record of producing, recording, filming, and editing podcasts of at least 15 minutes.


Why Work at the Tampa Bay Times

  • Be part of an organization committed to public service and journalistic excellence
  • Support a diverse workforce that includes newsroom, production, and corporate teams
  • Work in a collaborative, mission-driven environment
  • Health coverage for you and your family through medical, dental, and vision plans.
  • 100% employer-paid short-term and long-term disability.
  • 100% employer-paid basic life insurance.
  • Supplemental life insurance.
  • Tax advantages through flexible spending accounts that allow you to pay for specific health care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars.
  • Tax-deferred savings plan for retirement.
  • A generous PTO program and much more.


Equal Opportunity Employer

The Tampa Bay Times is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

job.title: Account Coordinator
job.description:
The Local Sales Team at TelevisaUnivision is looking for an Account Coordinator to join our team! We seek an enthusiastic and aggressive self-starter to assist Account Executives in their transactional efforts. This is a data entry and numbers intensive position demanding extensive computer competence in various order processing software’s. We strongly focus on being detail oriented and communicative as we are in contact with all TV stations across the country. You will work hand in hand with our TV sales team, traffic department, finance and collections team. You will report directly to the Regional Account Coordinator Supervisor.

ABOUT YOU:

The ideal candidate must be able to deal with a variety of strong and dynamic personalities. This is a demanding position in a high pressure and fast-paced environment. We are looking for someone who can work independently while also being part of a team environment. Important traits include: communicative, resourceful, innovative, collaborative and detail oriented.

YOUR DAY-DAY:

• Entering orders into WideOrbit and Strata systems and verifying accuracy.

• Pull preemptions daily and send makegood offers.

• Assisting AEs with pulling avails with correct rates and programming.

• Creating historical rate sheets and trackers in Excel for AEs to cross reference and approve orders and avails.

• Posting, pre-posting on accounts and creating ADU schedules as necessary to ensure deliverables.

• Coordinating ad copy and verifying quality with traffic.

• Serving as main point of contact in the department for the agency, stations and traffic.

• Following up on collections and outstanding invoices by contacting agency and collections department.

• General administrative tasks such as answering calls, preparing reports, etc.

YOU HAVE:

• BA/BS required and related sales/advertising experience.

• Ability to handle multiple tasks successfully; be organized; detail oriented; have demonstrated time management skills.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills are required.

• Customer service experience.

• Exposure to order entry systems and any other media research tools.

• Proficiency with MS Word, Excel and Outlook

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. Please note the national salary range listed in the job posting reflects the new hire salary range across levels and U.S. locations that would be applicable to the position.

TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Anchor & Multimedia Journalist
job.description:
The News Department at TelevisaUnivision in Chicago is looking for an Anchor/MMJ to join our team! The successful candidate should be proud of the commitment to serving our local community. This role will anchor weekend newscast and work as MMJ during the week, gathering, shooting, and editing own material.

ABOUT YOU:

The Anchor/MMJ will research, enterprise, develop, write, shoot and edit stories on deadline for recorded or live newscasts. MMJ will be responsible for reporting, and at times anchoring, for Sunday 5pm/10pm newscast as well as any other assigned newscast as needed. MMJ contributes to special features and stories as well as participates in coordinating coverage of major stories, breaking news, and specials. You will be responsible for generating story ideas, as well as making and maintaining contacts with community leaders, government officials, and local authorities. You will present reports in a clear, concise, objective manner; as well as present enterprising stories and sweeps series ideas. You are a team player with solid news judgment and must be a “one-person band” to complete a story from beginning to end. You must be able to work independently with the camera, write, edit your own story, and interact with the viewers through all the Univision media platforms. You will report to VP of News.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Gather information, conduct interviews, shoot videos, produce, report, and edit assigned stories daily and establish Live shots as needed.
  • Post videos, pictures and stories to websites, Facebook, and other social media outlets or streaming platforms.
  • Maintain strong familiarity with local, state, and national news and events across our coverage area.
  • Establish and maintain news contacts in the community.
  • Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in a manner that works well with coworkers, supervisors, and the community at large.
  • Work independently while out in the field and under various weather elements.
  • As an anchor participate in editorial meetings and editorial decisions.
  • Write and edit stories written for the newscast.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • A bachelor’s degree is preferred (i.e., multimedia, journalism, television broadcasting).
  • 2-year newsroom experience required; or equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  • Excellent command of Spanish and English both written and verbal.
  • Previous experience as an anchor highly preferred.
  • Applicants must be able to use newsroom computer systems and applications (both hardware/software).
  • Knowledge of iNews, video editing (Adobe Premiere and Adobe creative cloud preferred), and file sharing systems preferred.
  • High ethical and journalistic standards.
  • Advanced knowledge in the use of field cameras, gear and editing systems.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • A valid driver’s license with a good driving record.
  • Ability to sit, stand and walk for up to (8) hours without restrictions.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 30 pounds for extended periods of time.

*This position will require the employee to be a member or join SAG-AFTRA.


Base pay Range: $82,000 - $87,500

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Assistant Director
job.description:
Production Operations at TelevisaUnivision is looking for an Assistant Director to join our team! Responsibilities include supporting Director and Line Producer in every aspect of the production.  The Assistant Director will provide a key link between Director, Producers, Technical Director, production.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Oversee and facilitate production elements, including graphics, music, and all other related show elements at the Director’s request.
  • Assist Director and Technical Director with pre and postproduction of the show.
  • Back time show and time video clips and packages.
  • Knowledge of iNews and basic computer skills (i.e., Microsoft Office and Outlook)
  • QC videos & GFX’s with TRT for all respective shows.
  • Distribute rundowns to technical staff.
  • Ensure break formats and logs are cross checked with show.
  • Call cues for GFX and server playbacks.
  • Communicate with NOC.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Associate’s degree in television production or equivalent work experience.
  • Knowledge of equipment utilized in production, TV studio, and control room.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize.
  • Perform well under pressure and live event situations.
  • Ability to train new employees and co-workers.
  • Work effectively with others in a team environment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively.
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills.
  • Ability to comply with a variable work schedule.
  • Bi-lingual (English and Spanish) preferred.
  • Employees will be expected to commit to a specific schedule in the time period indicated.

  • As this position supports 24x7 operation, candidate must, in addition to being able to work regular hours, have on-call availability and flexibility to work days, nights, overnights, weekends and holidays as needed and without advance notice.  Additionally, candidate may be required to work on site for extended periods of time to provide coverage in special circumstances, such as during tropical storms/hurricanes

This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

job.title: Coordinador Jurídico
job.description:
Coordinador Juridico

Ubicación: Ciudad de México – Santa Fe
Modalidad: 100% presencial

Sobre el rol y el equipo

En TelevisaUnivision estamos buscando un Senior Manager Jurídico – Corporativo y de Funciones Empresarialespara integrarse a nuestra Dirección Jurídica Corporativo y de Funciones Empresariales.

Esta posición tendrá un rol estratégico en la administración y supervisión de los asuntos societarios de las subsidiarias mexicanas y extranjeras del grupo, asegurando el cumplimiento de las obligaciones legales aplicables y la actualización permanente de los registros societarios.

Asimismo, será responsable de brindar asesoría legal estratégica en materia corporativa, societaria, bancaria, contractual, fusiones y adquisiciones y otros asuntos que impacten directamente en la operación y desarrollo del negocio.

La persona que ocupe esta posición tendrá la oportunidad de liderar y desarrollar a abogados corporativos y/o paralegales, asegurando la correcta ejecución de las actividades del área y acompañando a diferentes líderes y áreas estratégicas de la organización.

Sobre la posición

Como Senior Manager Jurídico – Corporativo y de Funciones Empresariales, tendrás un rol clave dentro de la Dirección Jurídica, participando en operaciones y proyectos estratégicos para el grupo.

Trabajarás de manera cercana con áreas como Tesorería, Finanzas, Contraloría, Sourcing & Procurement, IT, Real Estate, Fiscal, Negocio y Ventas, proporcionando asesoría legal estratégica y acompañando operaciones corporativas nacionales e internacionales.

Serás responsable de supervisar y fortalecer las prácticas de gobierno corporativo y administración societaria, así como de liderar y estructurar proyectos de fusiones y adquisiciones, reestructuras corporativas, financiamientos y otros asuntos corporativos complejos.

Esta posición requiere una sólida visión estratégica y de negocio, así como la capacidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos y prioridades, interactuar con niveles ejecutivos y participar en la toma de decisiones de alto impacto para la organización.

Tu día a día

Gobierno corporativo y administración societaria

  • Coordinarás la implementación y actualización de políticas y mejores prácticas de gobierno corporativo.

  • Definirás los criterios que rigen la administración de la secretaría corporativa de las sociedades a cargo.

  • Supervisarás la administración y actualización permanente de los registros societarios de las subsidiarias mexicanas y extranjeras del grupo.

  • Aprobarás y validarás la elaboración de documentos societarios, incluyendo actas de asamblea, actas de consejo de administración y libros corporativos.

  • Asegurarás el cumplimiento de las obligaciones legales aplicables en materia societaria.

  • Definirás y supervisarás los criterios para el otorgamiento y revocación de poderes.

  • Mantendrás el control sobre las facultades conferidas para la correcta administración y funcionamiento de las sociedades del grupo.

  • Liderarás la revisión y actualización de las políticas internas de delegación de facultades a funcionarios de la empresa.

Fusiones, adquisiciones y desarrollo corporativo

  • Liderarás y estructurarás proyectos de fusiones y adquisiciones, tanto internas como con terceros.

  • Acompañarás proyectos estratégicos relacionados con el desarrollo corporativo del grupo.

  • Trabajarás de manera conjunta con las áreas de Fiscal, Contraloría, Negocio, Ventas y Tesorería para definir estrategias relacionadas con posibles reestructuras corporativas.

  • Analizarás y estructurarás los aspectos legales de operaciones corporativas complejas.

  • Participarás en operaciones de mercado de capitales en México y en el extranjero.

  • Coordinarás los aspectos legales relacionados con operaciones y proyectos internacionales y cross-border.

Contratos, financiamiento y asuntos civiles y mercantiles

  • Negociarás y aprobarás contratos en materia financiera, civil y mercantil.

  • Participarás en la negociación y revisión de contratos relacionados con compraventa de acciones, préstamos y créditos, factoraje financiero, prestación de servicios, fideicomisos e inversiones, licencias y arrendamientos, entre otros.

  • Brindarás asesoría legal estratégica a las áreas de Tesorería, Finanzas, Contraloría, Sourcing & Procurement, IT y Real Estate.

  • Analizarás los riesgos e implicaciones legales de operaciones potenciales y proyectos estratégicos.

  • Revisarás contratos con terceros, partes relacionadas y afiliadas necesarios para la operación diaria de la empresa.

  • Asegurarás que las estructuras y documentos contractuales protejan adecuadamente los intereses del grupo.

  • Gestionarás y coordinarás la relación con despachos externos cuando sea necesario.

Liderazgo y gestión

  • Liderarás, desarrollarás y acompañarás a abogados corporativos y/o paralegales.

  • Supervisarás la correcta ejecución de las actividades y proyectos del equipo.

  • Gestionarás prioridades y recursos para asegurar el cumplimiento oportuno de los compromisos del área.

  • Proporcionarás asesoría y acompañamiento a líderes y stakeholders estratégicos de la organización.

  • Participarás en la toma de decisiones relacionadas con asuntos corporativos y legales de alto impacto.

  • Gestionarás la relación y coordinación con despachos externos y otros asesores especializados.

Sobre ti

Buscamos a un profesional con una sólida trayectoria en derecho corporativo, gobierno corporativo y operaciones estratégicas, con capacidad para liderar proyectos legales complejos y desenvolverse en un entorno corporativo dinámico y de alta exposición.

Deberás contar con una visión estratégica y de negocio, así como con sólidas habilidades de negociación, comunicación y liderazgo. Esta posición requiere la capacidad de gestionar múltiples proyectos y prioridades simultáneamente, interactuar con diferentes niveles de la organización y proporcionar asesoría clara y estratégica para apoyar la toma de decisiones.

Buscamos a alguien con capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma, tomar decisiones bajo presión y construir relaciones sólidas con stakeholders internos y externos.

Deberás tener

  • Licenciatura en Derecho.

  • Título y cédula profesional indispensables.

  • Deseable maestría en Derecho Corporativo, Mercantil o un área afín.

  • Experiencia mínima de 8 a 10 años en derecho corporativo, societario y fusiones y adquisiciones.

  • Experiencia sólida en gobierno corporativo y administración societaria.

  • Conocimiento profundo en derecho societario, notarial y gobierno corporativo.

  • Experiencia en fusiones, adquisiciones y reestructuras corporativas.

  • Conocimiento en mercado de capitales y financiamiento corporativo.

  • Conocimiento sólido de derecho mercantil, civil y bancario.

  • Deseable conocimiento del marco regulatorio de Estados Unidos aplicable a operaciones cross-border.

  • Inglés avanzado.

  • Experiencia en liderazgo, gestión y desarrollo de equipos de abogados y/o paralegales.

  • Capacidad para comunicarse e interactuar con niveles ejecutivos y órganos de gobierno.

  • Experiencia en la gestión y coordinación de despachos externos.

  • Pensamiento estratégico y orientación al negocio.

  • Sólidas habilidades de negociación y comunicación.

  • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y gestionar prioridades bajo presión.

  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera transversal con múltiples áreas y stakeholders.

Beneficios

En TelevisaUnivision ofrecemos la oportunidad de formar parte de una compañía líder en el mundo de los medios y el contenido en español, en un entorno dinámico, global y en constante evolución.

Además, podrás disfrutar de beneficios competitivos y oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, colaborando con equipos multidisciplinarios y participando en proyectos estratégicos con impacto en la organización.

Inclusión

En TelevisaUnivision creemos que la diversidad y la inclusión fortalecen a nuestros equipos y nos permiten construir una organización más innovadora, creativa y representativa de las audiencias a las que servimos.

Estamos comprometidos con brindar igualdad de oportunidades y construir un entorno de trabajo inclusivo, donde todas las personas puedan desarrollarse profesionalmente y aportar sus diferentes perspectivas, experiencias y talentos.

job.title: Digital Account Manager
job.description:
We are looking for a Digital Account manager to join our team!

As an integral member of our team, you will partner with the Sales Account Executives from inception to execution of digital & cross platform ad campaigns that meet our clients’ objectives. Our team plays an essential role in driving ad sales revenue across our multimedia - digital, streaming, linear, social, experiential, and audio properties. You will collaborate with cross functional teams internally including planners, Operations, Marketing & Research. You will also work directly with clients to ensure the success of sponsorship programs and customized marketing initiatives.

YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Main point of contact for key accounts for digital campaigns post sale
  • Attend sales calls & internal brainstorming sessions.
  • Coordinate all sponsorship executions across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop strategic analysis and reporting during Upfront seasons and scatter markets
  • Monitor all campaigns’ performance, and suggest improvements throughout the process
  • Upsell clients on additional impressions and/or programs based on performance
  • Partner with revenue management, inventory, research and analytics teams to create recap reports for key clients
  • Collaborate with Ad Ops and trafficking teams to ensure flawless campaign launches and minimize setup issues.

 

YOU HAVE:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 2+ years of relevant experience with an agency, brand, and/or publisher
  • Knowledge of advertising solutions across social, audio, display, streaming video, experiential and sports sponsorship platforms
  • Must have knowledge and understanding of digital video and advanced audience targeting
  • Proficiency in Excel and advanced data tools is a plus
  • Must have knowledge and understanding of all client campaign strategies, brand messaging, and integration expectations
  • Media math experience is preferred
  • Strong problem-solving and reporting skills to address distribution, delivery, data and measurement needs
  • Excellent presentation skills and ability to address both small and large groups.
  • Deep understanding of media landscape, services, and technologies

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Employment/education will be verified

job.title: Finance Manager, Digital, Record to Report
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a highly motivated Manager, Record to Report (Digital) to support the Digital Finance organization. This role is responsible for overseeing key accounting activities related to the monthly close process, general ledger management, account reconciliations, and financial reporting for the Digital business. The position partners closely with Digital Finance leadership to ensure accurate and timely financial results while driving process improvements, maintaining strong internal controls, and leading a team of accounting professionals. The position reports to the Vice President, Record to Report.

ABOUT YOU:

You are a collaborative and detail-oriented accounting professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You excel at managing competing priorities, solving complex problems, and partnering with leaders across the organization to deliver accurate financial results, strengthen internal controls, and drive continuous process improvements. You are an effective communicator and team player who can build strong relationships and lead accounting professionals to achieve shared goals.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

Financial Close and Reporting

  • Oversee the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
  • Review and approve journal entries, ensuring compliance with company accounting policies and close calendar deadlines.
  • Review account reconciliations and ensure they are prepared, reviewed, and certified in accordance with company policies and internal control requirements.
  • Prepare and review quarterly flux analysis packages, providing meaningful explanations of financial results and variances.
  • Partner with the Digital CFO and Finance team to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial statements.

Accounting and General Ledger Management

  • Manage day-to-day general ledger activities for the Digital business.
  • Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, company accounting policies, and internal control requirements.
  • Oversee accounting for specialized contractual arrangements and obligations.
  • Review accounting treatment related to digital content licensing, produced content, programming rights, obligations, and related cash flow schedules.
  • Interpret and analyze contracts to determine appropriate accounting treatment and financial impact.
  • Lead Oracle ERP Record-to-Report processes, including financial consolidations, allocations, data interfaces, journal posting, period open/close activities, foreign currency exchange rate maintenance, revaluation and translation processes, cash management, subledger-to-ledger reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and governance of cross-validation rules to ensure accurate and compliant financial reporting.

Team Leadership and Process Improvement

  • Lead, develop, and mentor accounting staff, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor team performance and service levels, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Escalate significant issues, disputes, and risks to management in a timely manner.
  • Maintain and enhance accounting procedures, process documentation, and internal controls.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) and cross-functional stakeholders to identify and implement process and system improvements.

Audit and Compliance

  • Coordinate and support internal and external audit requests, ensuring timely delivery of required documentation and analysis.
  • Assist in maintaining compliance with SOX and internal control requirements.
  • Ensure supporting documentation is complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

Projects and Initiatives

  • Support system implementations, integrations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
  • Participate in special projects and ad hoc analyses as requested by Finance leadership.
  • Drive automation and standardization efforts to improve the efficiency of Record-to-Report processes.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting
  • 5+ yrs. accounting experience
  • Strong PC Skills with moderate knowledge of Excel
  • Certified Public Accountant is a plus
  • Ability to speak/write/understand Spanish is preferred.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, as there will be work weeks that require more than 40 hours to ensure the Company’s reporting requirements are met.

New Jersey Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000.Salary ranges for other locations may differ based on local market conditions and candidate qualifications

job.title: Senior Director, Legal Operations
job.description:
The Legal Department at TelevisaUnivision is looking for a Senior Director of Legal Operations to join our team!

The Senior Director of Legal Operations is the operational, technical and business management leader for the Legal department, partnering with Legal leadership to establish and execute the department’s operating strategy and drive efficiency, scalability, financial discipline and continuous improvement. 

In this position you will help develop, refine and promote the legal department’s short and long-term operations plan, including managing law firm and third-party vendor management programs, optimizing financial resources leveraging technology and supporting the development and implementation of a sound annual plan.

The role will report to the SVP, Chief Privacy Officer and Head of Legal Operations, and will serve as key business partner to Legal team leadership.  This position will interface with Finance, HR and other cross-functional partners across the team and company to drive meaningful operational improvements.

ABOUT YOU:

You are a strategic Legal Operations leader who combines strong business acumen with deep operational and technical expertise. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations, independently identifying opportunities for improvement, and translating strategy into practical execution.

You bring strong project and relationship management skills and have a demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, manage complex initiatives, negotiate with external partners, and build scalable processes. You are data- and technology-savvy, curious about emerging AI capabilities, and able to identify where technology can meaningfully improve the effectiveness and efficiency of a Legal department.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Provide creative thinking to help identify and develop cutting-edge strategies for increasing value and reducing outside legal spend, while maintaining excellent legal representation and optimizing engagement practices with our law firms.
  • Manage other strategic plans or initiatives to make the legal department more efficient, as delegated by the SVP, Chief Privacy Officer and Head of Legal Operations, and other Legal team leadership.
  • Create metrics and monitor progress to measure success against strategic plans.
  • Benchmark both internally and externally to stay on top of current trends and emerging and best practices and opportunities to improve the team’s operating model and performance.

Finance and Budget Management

  • Partner with Legal leadership, finance and procurement to develop and manage the legal annual operating plan and all department budgets. Work as primary interface between the legal department and finance.
  • Identify, collect, and report on key performance indicators and metrics on a global basis that are meaningful and relevant in ascertaining the legal team’s budget management performance, including spend analysis, efficiency initiatives and technology.
  • Manage and develop Billing Supervisor and oversee Legal billing operations and related processes.

Legal Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence

  • Lead the Legal department’s technology and AI strategy, identifying opportunities to leverage existing and emerging technologies to improve productivity, automate processes, enhance knowledge management, reduce costs and mitigate risks.
  • Assess and implement technology (e.g., matter management, knowledge management, Evisort, ethics and compliance, document management, electronic billing and compliance systems), including tools with AI-enable functionality, to streamline operations, improve cost effectiveness and implement best in class systems and processes.
  • Lead continuous process improvement initiatives and work with IT on automation as needed.
  • Work closely with selected electronic billing provider to implement system enhancements, run detailed reports within the software tool and create spend dashboards.

Outside Counsel and Legal Vendor Management

  • Update and manage master retention agreements, billing guidelines, and pricing models for outside counsel.
  • Develop tracking and reporting systems to monitor pricing performance and savings across engagements.
  • Manage relationships with outside counsel and vendors, including conducting RFPs and negotiating fee arrangements.

Communications & Administration

  • Align legal workflows with department priorities to increase efficiency, leveraging technology.
  • Manage new hire onboarding in collaboration with HR, training, and policy implementation for the legal team.
  • Collaborate with HR, IT, and other departments on company-wide initiatives.

Talent Management and Education

  • Track and maintain records for Continuing Legal Education (CLE) requirements for all lawyers
  • Manage and provide regular CLE programming, both live and asynchronously, for Department lawyers.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferably in Business, Finance or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • 15 plus years of total work experience in operations or law firm management, ten years in legal operations.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic and operational plans and delivering measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, quality, and service.
  • In-depth understanding of law firm billing, pricing and compensation practices
  • Demonstrated experience with alternative fee arrangement cost modeling
  • At least two years' experience evaluating, implementing and using legal technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions (including contract lifecycle management, electronic billing and ediscovery), with a demonstrated ability to translate technology capabilities into meaningful business improvements and cost efficiencies.
  • Technology- and AI-savvy; proficient in all Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel; expertise with electronic billing and contract management software.

Job Description

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for an Ads Solutions and Campaign Management Intern to join the team. As an Ads Solutions and Campaign Management intern, you will support the post-sale creative production, trafficking, delivery and reporting of digital campaigns across The New York Times portfolio. You will work closely with Campaign Managers and Producers to ensure that advertiser creatives align with client expectations and that campaigns are set up accurately, deliver on schedule and meet our quality standards.


About The Role

This internship is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience and training in digital creative production and ad operations within a global, premium publisher environment. This is a hybrid role based in our Paris headquarters, reporting to the Director, Ad Solutions & Operations. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week. The position will start from September for a duration of 6 months, based in Paris. Candidates must have the right to work in France for the full duration of the internship.

  • This internship is intended for students or recent graduates who meet the legal requirements for an internship (stage) in France with a mandatory “Convention de stage”.

    • Your CV
    • A short cover letter explaining your interest in digital advertising and this specific role

Responsibilities:

  • Support Ad Solutions in the creative production process:
    • Helping compile specs and example executions for clients based on signed media plans
    • Reviewing assets for technical specification compliancy
    • Customising units according to client guidelines using CSS3
    • Testing ads across browsers, screen sizes and devices
  • Support Campaign Managers with the end-to-end setup of digital campaigns, including:
    • Collecting and validating creative assets and tracking tags
    • Trafficking campaigns in GAM, AdSwizz and LiveIntent 
  • Assist in monitoring live campaigns:
    • Reviewing pacing and delivery reports
    • Flagging under-delivery or issues to the Campaign Manager in a timely manner
    • Supporting optimisations based on performance and client objectives
  • Contribute to campaign reporting:
    • Pulling performance data from ad servers and other platforms
    • Assisting in the preparation of client-facing reports and post-campaign summaries
  • Support day-to-day operations:
    • Collaborating with Sales, Planning and other internal stakeholders on campaign-related tasks
    • Maintaining internal dashboards and trackers as required
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Interest in digital advertising
  • Experience working with numbers and spreadsheets (e.g. basic formulas, filtering and pivot tables in Excel/Google Sheets) 
  • Experience with a detailed and structured working style
  • Experience prioritizing competing programs, responsibilities, and projects
  • Professional proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Basic understanding of digital advertising concepts (impressions, clicks, CTR, viewability, targeting, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3 and JS. 
  • Exposure to or interest in ad serving, analytics or marketing platforms (e.g. Google Ad Manager, campaign management tools, web analytics)

The New York Times Advertising is hiring for an Art Director to join our T Brand Studio. As an Art Director, you will lead the visual execution of assigned projects. Art Directors do the following: they imagine ways to tell stories visually. They present visual ideas and recommendations internally and to our clients. They find visual reference, specifically relevant to each idea, project, and opportunity. They contribute to and oversee the creation of great mood boards, inspired type treatments, exceptional color palettes, and page layouts.

About the Role

You will oversee the design of presentations which enhance our work, the assembly of excellent paid posts in webflow, the design of impactful print ads, and work with developers internal and external on complex custom projects. You will mentor Designers and Senior Designers, and collaborate with external partners, building relationships and guiding them through insightful feedback to create their best work. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Design. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to and oversee excellent design work on client and internal projects, with guidance from Design Directors, and Creative Directors.
  • Translate conceptual and strategic ideas into impactful visual solutions.
  • Contribute creative concepts to client and internal projects, brainstorming with other teams.
  • Design iteratively with an easy command of typography, composition, messaging hierarchy, layout, and other fundamental principles of graphic design, and give pointed feedback to designers which directly improves their work.
  • Research and oversee selection of visual reference that inspires (Design, Page Animation, Illustration, and Photography), and build a mental reference library of styles, approaches, creators, and projects.
  • Manage Designers, delegate work to resourced Designers and Senior Designers based on workload, capabilities, and experience. Contribute to the professional growth of direct reports through mentorship, and feedback.
  • Select, brief, and direct outside collaborators to create their best work.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional work experience in the art industry
  • 5+ years of experience with Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma) and modern digital publishing platforms such as Webflow.
  • An experienced creative portfolio demonstrating mastery of design principles - specifically typography, grid systems, layout hierarchy, color theory, and art direction for both digital and print media
  • Experienced managing designers including delegating tasks, giving constructive feedback, and overseeing visual quality.
  • Experience commissioning and directing external creative partners including photographers, illustrators, animators and external development teams
  • Experience presenting visual strategies and creative direction to executive-level clients and company partners.
  • Visual research skills, with a rich, active mental library of contemporary and historical art, design, photography, and interactive digital trends.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of front-end web technologies (HTML/CSS) and an understanding of dynamic layout capabilities, responsive design, and digital motion/animation principles.
  • Experience in luxury, editorial, or prestige brand storytelling, with a deep appreciation for high-end aesthetic stewardship and cultural context.
  • Experience prioritizing competing programs, responsibilities, and projects
  • Experience working in a collaborative design space/team

job.title: Assistant Editor, Fine Arts
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times Culture desk covers the arts and culture to help people understand the world. Through our reporting, criticism and service journalism, we provide trusted guidance to help people live fuller, more considered lives.

We are seeking an Assistant Editor, Fine Arts to help shape and elevate our coverage of visual art, architecture and design; museums and other art institutions; and auctions, with an eye toward ambitious, distinctive journalism that reaches a broad, curious audience. You should have expertise that will produce stories that lead readers into the boardrooms and the studios of today's cultural influencers and will also develop stories about the intersection of art and new media, including artificial intelligence.

You will work closely with the art discipline editor, critics and reporters to determine coverage, assign, edit and second edit news, features, reviews and visual story forms.

You'll also manage a critic and assign and oversee the work of freelancers. You should have a deep understanding of fine arts and art institutions, strong editing skills across formats and platforms and a track record of guiding world-class journalism.

This is a hybrid position, based in New York City, and includes regular attendance in the office at least four days each week.

Responsibilities:

  • Help identify and prioritize key fine-arts storylines, from breaking news to longer-term investigations, profiles and criticism that illuminate how the arts intersect with politics, power and the broader culture
  • Assign, shape and edit daily art stories, including news, features, criticism, service pieces, visual pieces and enterprise projects
  • Assign and edit news of institutions, including museums, art galleries, auction houses and non-profits, throughout the U.S. and Europe
  • Respond to news events in the art world by assigning and editing timely stories, explainers and off-the-news pieces that give readers essential context and insight
  • Plan and assign advance obituary coverage of notables in art

job.title: Associate Creative Director, Earned Marketing (Temporary)
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. In service of that mission, we have a journalism operation that includes thousands of people reporting on the ground from most countries around the world, producing journalism with the independence, accuracy, depth and authority for which The Times is famous.

Marketing plays a key part in extending this journalistic legacy into the future. Our job is to answer the question, “Why is quality journalism worth paying for?” We create award-winning marketing that builds our brand and deepens affinity for our journalistic offering. Above all, we strive to be timely, straightforward and relevant — illustrating in new and creative ways how The New York Times can enrich the lives of our readers.

We are seeking an Associate Creative Director, Earned Activations (Contract) to lead the creative vision for our specific “earned” marketing initiatives. This is a critical leadership role for a creative strategist who can move beyond traditional advertising to produce culturally resonant work that drives organic press and social conversation.

Reporting to the Creative Director, Design, with a dotted line to the Executive Director, Brand Marketing, you will serve as a creative partner to our marketing, editorial, comms, commerce, photo, external agency partners, Games and The Athletic creative teams. You will be responsible for dreaming up and executing ideas that turn the value of our world-class journalism and lifestyle products into shareable experiences. You will focus exclusively on creating a cohesive but distinct earned lens for our core products: News, The Athletic, Games, and Cooking.

We will look to you to bring unexpected, deeply resonant thinking to how we market our journalism, championing creative ideas that can break through the noise of the modern media landscape.

This is a temporary hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters, reporting to the the Creative Director, Design. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Concept and lead the development of brand-building activations, partnerships, and communications content designed specifically to generate earned media and social sharing.

  • Direct the day-to-day work of a Senior Designer, Earned providing clear conceptual vision to guide projects from strategy to launch. You will oversee the translation of earned media concepts into high-quality design solutions, ensuring that every deliverable—from seeding kits to social assets—upholds The New York Times's rigorous brand standards.

  • Translate marketing strategies into clear, provocative creative directives that excite internal teams and external partners.

  • Develop creative ideas tailored to the unique audiences of our core products, ensuring a cohesive visual and conceptual narrative for News, The Athletic, Games, and Cooking.

  • Create work that natively integrates celebrities, influencers, and culturally noteworthy subscribers to amplify our mission in ways that feel authentic and newsworthy.

  • Guide the creation of "social-first" activations designed to thrive on digital platforms and spark community engagement without relying solely on paid media or editorially motivated social media handles.

  • In partnership with the Director, Creative Strategy and Earned Production and Director, Brand Earned Activations, guide external agency relationships to ensure top-notch quality and brand/product standards are enforced.

  • Work closely with the Executive Director of Brand Activations and Talent to ensure earned ideas align with broader business goals.

  • Act as an ambassador for earned thinking across the organization, engaging the right stakeholders in productive conversations to build alignment.

  • Execute high-concept ideas, balancing quality with the demands of the news cycle.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative leadership, with a heavy focus on earned media, PR-led activations, or non-traditional advertising.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates “work the world talked about”—campaigns that broke through via PR, social trends, or cultural moments.

  • Deep understanding of how to leverage Social, Celebrity, and Influencer ecosystems to drive brand discovery.

  • Experience translating marketing strategies, product roadmaps, and the news cycle into clear creative directives.

  • Service diverse categories across the NYT portfolio, from the rigor of News to the fandom of The Athletic and the community-driven spaces of Games and Cooking.

  • Cultivate trusted relationships across the organization and navigate complex stakeholder dynamics.

  • Operational agility to navigate the time sensitive requirements of earned media while maintaining high standards of craft.

job.title: Associate Creative Director, Events
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times creates original, quality journalism in many forms, from the daily paper to The Daily podcast. Our live events play an important role in this mission, connecting readers to the story and to each other. From flagship convenings like DealBook and Climate Forward to immersive gatherings like Hard Fork Live, New York Times events intrigue, inform and inspire in equal measure.

This is a leadership role for an accomplished creative who can translate the value of world-class journalism into powerful design experiences. You will help bring New York Times journalism to life and create compelling environments for a portfolio of public events and experiences. You will lead creative work that defines both individual events and the overall audience experience across our events portfolio. As part of a cross-disciplinary team, you will shape how audiences experience these moments across every touchpoint, from physical stages to digital screens to marketing assets.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters and requires regular in-office attendance three days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the strategic visual development and art direction for our portfolio of public events and experiences, demonstrating expert knowledge of spatial design, environmental graphics, wayfinding, audience journeys, live audience engagement, and meticulous physical execution.
  • Guide the creative lifecycle of each event—from naming and foundational identity to marketing campaigns, live production, and post-event storytelling.
  • Thoughtfully integrate the design of sponsor support into revenue-generating events, balancing business objectives with an audience experience that reflects the values of our journalism.
  • Art direct video interstitials and live screen graphics, working closely with our Senior Writer for Events to merge narrative outlines with visual storytelling, and collaborating with editors and motion designers to create work that defines the event experience.
  • Work across editorial, events, and marketing to secure resources, navigate live-event production challenges, and steward relationships between editorial priorities and advertising objectives.
  • Oversee the thoughtful documentation of our events, working with photo editors to capture high-quality visual assets that extend the life of the experience and support future programming and partnerships.
  • Manage and mentor a design team dedicated to event projects, cultivating an environment of high-quality execution, continuous learning, and diverse perspectives.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Creative Director for Culture, Communications and Live Experience.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in brand identity, spatial and experiential design, environmental graphics, and live-event production.
  • Experience designing for physical environments, including signage systems, audience wayfinding, and large-scale event graphics.
  • A versatile design portfolio showcasing an experience with layout, typography, and experience handling high-profile editorial content and designing around newsmakers.
  • A strong conceptual understanding of motion design and the ability to think in and direct motion, with considerable experience collaborating with external motion design studios or internal teams to execute graphics for event screens, presentations, and digital platforms.
  • Familiarity with video production workflows and experience directing editors, motion designers, and video teams on larger-scale event productions.
  • Proficiency across contemporary design tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite) and presentation software (Google Slides), with a strong understanding of motion workflows and social publishing platforms.
  • B.A., B.S., B.F.A. or M.F.A.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A track record of effective people management, including creating robust development plans, delivering actionable feedback, and fostering an environment of trust and respect.
  • A high bar of accountability and the ability to navigate the demands of live-event production under tight deadlines.
  • A genuine passion for journalism and a deep curiosity about our work and company—we hope you enjoy reading, watching, and listening to it.

Additional Compensation and Benefits

Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description

The New York Times Advertising is hiring an Associate Programmatic Sales Director to join our Sales Team. You will join The Times at a very exciting time, as we tap into the enormous programmatic demand for quality audiences and content from our agency and advertiser partners. Success will require an intensity of effort, demonstrated through targeted outreach, pitch meetings, and securing new PMP deals, in partnership with The Times's vertical sales teams. This is a temp position, beginning mid-October, 2026, covering the Programmatic Sales Director.

 

About the Role

You will grow our programmatic revenue across The New York Times portfolio. Using existing programmatic-buyer relationships is an imperative for success. You will engage with Ad Monetization, Ad Product, and Product Marketing teams to grow our programmatic value proposition and capability awareness in-market. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the VP, Head of Agency Development and Sales Strategy. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Programmatic Sales Strategy: Develop and execute a plan to secure programmatic deals from PMP spenders who are active in the market along with NYTA-direct accounts, in collaboration with the direct sales team.
  • Full-Funnel Accountability involves overseeing client relationships and revenue outcomes. This oversight occurs before and after PMP creation. To meet client commitments and identify growth opportunities, one must work with Account Management, Ad Operations, and Direct Sales.

job.title: Audience Editor, Climate and Science
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

We are looking for an audience editor to join the newsroom Audience team and partner with our Climate and Science desks to help them continue to reach more readers and deepen our engagement with those readers.

This editor will work with the desk to inform coverage, both day-to-day and long-term, suggesting timely stories as well as evergreen topics, with an eye toward framing. They will help maximize distribution through search strategies and social programming, and by pitching internally to the homepage, newsletters and other alerts. And they will track data for the desk, using analytical skills to provide context and recommendations to the editors.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Audience strategy & growth:

    • Partner with senior editors to inform coverage decisions, suggesting timely stories, evergreen topics, and longer-term franchises that resonate with reader interest and important news moments, with a keen eye toward framing and formats.

    • Identify coverage and format opportunities that will attract new readers, particularly those who may not currently view The New York Times as a regular news source.

    • Maximize content distribution through sophisticated search strategies, strategic social programming, and by coordinating publication with the homepage, newsletters, and notifications.

    • Identify trending topics and competitive trends, along with coverage and format opportunities that will drive growth and competitive performance with a deep understanding of the off-platform landscape, trends and what's driving conversation.

  • Data analysis & reporting:

    • Interpret data and audience signals to strategically shape how we present stories both on and off our platforms.

    • Deliver actionable daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

    • Contribute to regular audience performance updates, including but not limited to morning audience notes, monthly masthead presentations, and quarterly and annual audience reports to company leadership.

    • Partner with the newsroom audience analytics team on deep and actionable analysis.

  • Social media & engagement:

    • Write compelling social copy, analyze our presence and strategy on existing platforms, and evaluate opportunities for potentially launching new accounts on social platforms.

    • Work with journalists on best social media practices, including framing pieces for specific audiences and effectively using the Reporter Reply commenting feature.

  • Cross-functional collaboration:

    • Liaise with the main search, social, community, home, notifications, and newsletter teams on breaking news and enterprise, coordinating overlapping coverage with Well and other relevant desks.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • You will report to a Senior Audience Editor.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in digital journalism, with a demonstrated track record in audience development.

  • Proven skill at bridging specialties, including reporting, editing, product, analytics, design, and user research.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive work independently and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience communicating and collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders at all levels.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep knowledge of news competitors.

  • In-depth knowledge of the search landscape, with the ability to spot trends and identify misinformation.

  • Solid understanding of all mainstream and emerging social channels, with a willingness to continuously learn about new platforms.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with knowledge of Times style or the ability to absorb and apply it quickly.

  • The ability to write in an engaging, smart tone that feels native to other platforms while remaining consistent with the values of The Times.

  • A highly strategic and analytical mind; comfortable with data, A/B testing, and iterating to find what resonates with various audiences.

job.title: Audience Editor, NYT Wirecutter
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

Wirecutter is seeking an editor to lead programming and personalization for our ecommerce initiatives, with a particular emphasis on the Wirecutter Store. You will be the editorial lead for how we talk about the Store — crafting language, frameworks, and campaigns that invite readers in, explain what the Store is, and bring them back during major editorial moments throughout the year.

As audience editor for ecommerce, programming, and personalization, you will focus on three core areas: messaging, copy, and alignment with stakeholders around big editorial moments; audience strategy, lifecycle flows, and personalization rooted in our standards; and editorial programming and email support that tightly links our journalism to new platforms.

As an audience editor, you will report to Wirecutter's deputy director of newsletters and programming, and collaborate closely with colleagues across newsletters and programming, audience at large, Wirecutter's newsroom, as well as our commerce, marketing, product, and analytics teams.

You will drive the editorial voice of Store-related messaging, build and maintain a unified promo calendar, and design tests and experiments to deepen engagement while valuing Wirecutter's standards for independence and trust.

You'll bring thoughtful editorial judgment, comfort working with data, and a sense of how lifecycle messaging, personalization, and on-site experiences can work together to serve readers.

This role has the potential to be remote, though New York City–based applicants are preferred.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive the voice and editorial quality of Wirecutter Store-related messaging across channels: Write and line-edit copy for newsletters, lifecycle flows, push, SMS, on-site promos, and Wirecutter Store entry points with deep editorial rigor and collaboration across partner teams.
  • Support the editorial quality of product detail pages (PDPs) on the Wirecutter Store:
  • Create messaging frameworks for major Store moments (launches, tentpoles, seasonal pushes) so readers understand what the Store is and why they should trust it.
  • Partner with marketing to ensure users are engaged at every touchpoint in the lifecycle, from acquisition campaigns to transactional emails and targeted promos.
  • Create and maintain a Store messaging style guide that aligns with Wirecutter's voice and company-wide Store goals, including guidelines for CTAs, subject lines, and promotional framing.
  • Contribute to overall Wirecutter newsletters and programming responsibilities — especially during major moments where it connects to the Store (i.e. gifting season; deal events).
  • Work closely with product and data to understand how we are engaging readers across surfaces, and design editorial experiments to better reach and engage with them based on behaviors — particularly in inboxes
  • Continuously test and optimize messaging (subject lines, CTAs, timing, sequencing) to improve engagement while staying rooted in our standards and reporting.
  • Maintain a unified Store messaging and promo calendar that's integrated with Wirecutter's broader editorial, promotional, and major deal events strategy, rather than running on a separate track.
  • Work closely with edit leadership and in collaboration with cross-functional teams like marketing and product to design reader journeys that connect journalism to the Store to follow-ups in a way that feels personal, useful, and closely connected to overall editorial reader journeys.
  • Perform related work as assigned.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Deputy Director, Newsletters and Programming, NYT Wirecutter.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in a newsroom, audience, or editorial marketing role with substantial experience in writing, editing, or programming for digital audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience with email newsletters, lifecycle or CRM programs, or other audience-led messaging channels; familiarity with ecommerce or product-focused journalism.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, line-editing skills, and a strong sense of how to translate rigorous reporting into clear, compelling, and trustworthy copy.
  • Proven ability to use analytics, A/B testing, and audience insights to inform messaging decisions and iterate on subject lines, CTAs, timing, and personalization.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with product, marketing, commerce, data, and creative partners, and an ability to advocate for reader-first, journalism-informed decisions.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills, including experience maintaining calendars, managing complex campaigns, and keeping multiple stakeholders aligned.
  • A deep interest in Wirecutter's mission and a commitment to upholding our standards for independence, rigor, and service journalism in all Store-related communications.

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.

This role will lead the rollout and growth of both our YouTube-first video shows and audio shows, ensuring they are published and packaged effectively while monitoring how they perform over time. Strategic work includes: analyzing performance data, highlighting wins and areas for improvement, and surfacing competitive insights that inform future packaging and rollout. We’re looking for someone eager to execute and report on performance, with a strong understanding of YouTube and other social video platforms.

You have experience developing video rollout strategies across platforms and assessing their success, with a strong understanding of all mainstream social video platforms—particularly YouTube and TikTok. We are looking for someone with a proven track record of driving video engagement and reach, and who is eager to refine and expand our distribution strategies to maximize the reach and impact of Times video shows.

job.title: Business Correspondent, Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is looking for a talented, experienced and versatile correspondent to join the tech pod on the Business desk to cover Elon Musk's artificial intelligence work. Musk, a founder of OpenAI, has long been invested in the technology and its implications. He is making A.I. central to SpaceX and Tesla, his two main companies, and is competing with other Silicon Valley titans in dealmaking, geopolitics, national security, and financing of the technology.

We are looking for an energetic, determined and collegial journalist who thrives when competing on the most compelling and important storylines. job.title: Business Editor
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The state of the global economy. The emergence of artificial intelligence. The rapidly changing media and entertainment ecosystems. The New York Times’s business desk is on the forefront of some of the biggest issues of our times, serving a general interest audience but also closely watched by many of the influential powerbrokers we cover.

We are seeking a dynamic journalist to lead our business desk — both to uphold its strong foundation and to lead its evolution in a relentlessly shifting news and media environment.

The successful candidate ought to have a strong news metabolism and a record of motivating reporters to break consequential stories and produce competitive coverage, including explanatory, analytical and investigative journalism. You are steeped in business coverage and have an innovative vision for making our report even more essential, from the conception of beats to the use of new storytelling forms. You are an experienced manager who can oversee and coordinate the work of large teams of journalists, while collaborating effectively with departments across a large newsroom. 

You will oversee a report expressed across multiple formats: text, video, photo, interactive graphics, and more. And you are attuned to maintaining a healthy culture that fosters teamwork, high morale and professional development for a large global staff. 

This position is based in our New York City headquarters. It is a full-time role that includes regular attendance in the office each week. It reports to Carolyn Ryan, managing editor

Responsibilities

  • Lead the Business report of The New York Times, including driving competitive news coverage, generating scoops and ambitious enterprise, incorporating visual and other forms into the report, and setting desk goals and overseeing performance
  • Develop and uphold a strong and cohesive workplace culture
  • Collaborate with colleagues on desks across the newsroom
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience as an editor 
  • 5+ years in a significant leadership or managerial role within a major media organization
  • Experience assigning stories and directing coverage
  • Track record of producing varied storyforms 
  • Strong news judgment
  • Demonstrated exceptional editing skills, with the ability to sharpen complex critiques, elevate prose, and guide writers toward their best work under tight deadlines.
  • Experience successfully navigating complex, matrixed organizational structures.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience managing large teams of reporters and editors 
  • An eagerness to coach and support colleagues
  • A collaborative, diplomatic leadership style
