job.title: Brand & Sync Partnerships Director
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a Sync Partnerships Director to join UnitedMasters!

What You'll Do

  • Identify, qualify, and close new customer accounts  to achieve and exceed sales targets
  • Develop account plans to increase adoption and grow key accounts.
  • Build and maintain relationships with decision-makers and client champions in key accounts.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies tailored to key accounts.
  • Manage pipeline to keep forecasts and deals status effectively communicated across the organization.
  • Shape complex deals and negotiate contracts to closure, working closely with legal teams
  • Create a meaningful presence for the company in related industry events.
  • Partner with UnitedMasters’ Music, Product, and Marketing teams to analyze market trends, deepen understanding of customer needs, refine unique selling propositions and continually improve messaging.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and competitive landscape

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proven ability to set goals and work cross-functionally to establish a strong market presence and revenue.
  • You have a track record in contributing to culture, process and cross-functional collaboration to enable business success.
  • Ability to travel and host events to nurture and deepen client relationships

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience and extensive relationships selling campaign-based and/or program-based programs to Creative / Content / Marketing departments. 
  • Proven network of contacts across Creative / Content / Marketing landscapes in Advertising, Sports, Digital Publishing, or Media within the US with a proven track record closing deals.
  • Passionate about all genres of music and constantly evaluating new trends in the ever-changing music landscape
  • Distinct point of view on where the industry is heading and ability to inform how UnitedMasters can leverage its position in culture and independent music distribution to build sustainable competitive advantages in sync.
  • An empathetic problem solver who is closely attuned to our company’s values and those of the independent artists we serve.
  • You are an entrepreneur at heart: You are driven and self-directed. You are confident and energized about building through new stages of growth.                                                                          

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Music Industry, or a related field.
  • Mastery of CRM software, such as Hubspot or Salesforce
  • Deep experience in selling Music to Creative Teams with a track record of success

About UnitedMasters, Inc. 

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $130k-$160k + Commission + Equity

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. in some cases that may include bonus, stock options, 401k match).

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  

We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Business Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Business Director to join Translation!

Position Summary

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner, deeply invested in understanding your clients’ business challenges and uncovering opportunities to solve them through innovative, culturally attuned creative solutions. You’ll cultivate strong, proactive client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, and drive initiatives that deliver measurable business impact. With Program Management leading operational excellence, you will focus on shaping strategic agendas, fostering growth, and ensuring our work drives tangible results for both the client and agency.

What You’ll Do

Drive Business & Strategic Leadership

  • Act as the day-to-day senior business lead on assigned accounts, serving as a strategic partner who uncovers and addresses core client challenges and opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with mid-to-senior client stakeholders, proactively offering strategic counsel rooted in a deep understanding of their business, category, and competitive dynamics.
  • Partner closely with Program Management to align on priorities and ensure our collective approach delivers on both business objectives and operational rigor.
  • Keep a constant pulse on the health of client relationships and business performance, identifying risks or growth opportunities early and collaborating with agency leadership to proactively address them.

Lead Creative Solutions with Business Impact

  • Collaborate with Strategy, Creative, and other internal teams to ensure our work solves real business problems and capitalizes on cultural opportunities.
  • Champion the development of strategies and creative solutions that are grounded in business insights and tied to clear performance metrics.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends and cultural shifts to bring fresh, informed thinking that drives innovative solutions for clients.
  • Partner with production leads, creative teams and program management to execute creative work that fully brings to life the approved creative concepts within the allocated time and budget
  • Advocate for additional budget and or push the boundaries with clients to create the most compelling executions possible 

Team & Partnership Leadership

  • Guide and inspire cross-discipline partners, fostering a culture of strategic curiosity, accountability, and partnership excellence.
  • Work hand-in-hand with Program Management, who will lead the operational planning, scoping, budgeting, and executional excellence—freeing you to focus on driving the business agenda and strategic growth.
  • Together with Program Management, ensure seamless integration across disciplines, maintaining the highest standards in client service and delivery.

Champion Growth & Client Success

  • Proactively identify opportunities to grow agency partnerships within existing accounts, aligning agency capabilities with the client’s long-term business goals. Responsible for creating and actioning growth plans for assigned clients
  • Play a key role in broader business development efforts, participating in pitches and strategic growth initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Deep understanding of the QSR or restaurant category, with an appreciation for cultural nuances that inform creative strategies.
  • Experience leading multicultural or African American targeted work
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to quickly grasp client industry dynamics and uncover opportunities for impactful creative solutions.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, with the confidence to provide strategic counsel to clients and inspire internal teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading integrated work across multiple channels, with a strong sense for how creative and strategic solutions drive business results.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with the optimism and resilience to tackle challenges and move work forward.
  • Passion for culturally relevant work that delivers against both business objectives and consumer engagement.
  • Proven track record of leading creative initiatives that drove real business change or results for clients

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of experience in an agency or communications-related industry, with a well-rounded understanding of advertising, marketing, media, creative, production, and agency finance.
  • Proven success managing the end-to-end lifecycle of integrated campaigns, engaging with mid-to-senior-level clients, and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on production experience with large-scale, multi-channel initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with QSR brands. Culturally driven brand experience is also a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $115,000 - 135,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Business Supervisor
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Business Supervisor to support an exciting account. This role is hybrid and requires 4 days a week in our Brooklyn office, with 1 day remote. 

Position Summary

The Business Supervisor (BS) is the day-to-day client partnership lead, responsible for managing client communication, translating business needs into actionable direction, and ensuring clarity across internal teams. Serving as the critical connection point between Business Leadership and Program Management, the Business Supervisor helps create exceptional client experiences while enabling efficient delivery.

This role operates with guidance while independently managing day-to-day client relationships and workstreams. Business Supervisors build trusted client partnerships, drive alignment across disciplines, proactively manage expectations, and help ensure every engagement is strategically grounded and executionally set up for success.

What You'll Do

Client Partnership & Communication

  • Own day-to-day client relationships and communication across assigned workstreams.
  • Lead routine client meetings, status calls, working sessions, and follow-up communications.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and thoughtful partnership.
  • Ensure every client interaction is organized, productive, and aligned against business objectives.
  • Gain an understanding of the client’s business and relationship with the AACM along with the Owners + Operators structure. 
  • Ability to pivot, be nimble, multi-task on a daily basis based on the business needs. 

Translation & Alignment

  • Translate client needs, feedback, and business objectives into clear direction for internal teams.
  • Partner closely with Strategy, Communications/Media, Creative, and Business Directors to develop and refine creative briefs.
  • Ensure cross-functional teams understand priorities, expectations, success metrics, and next steps.
  • Create alignment between client goals and agency recommendations throughout the life of a project.

Creative Development Support

  • Prepare clients for presentations and key decision-making moments.
  • Help articulate strategic and creative rationale in a clear, compelling, and client-ready manner.
  • Anticipate client feedback and guide internal teams on effective responses.
  • Support creative development by ensuring work remains aligned to client objectives and approved strategy.
  • Ensure the team is building upon prior learnings and continuously improving upon the work efforts. 

Risk & Expectation Management

  • Proactively identify risks, ambiguities, or changing client needs before they become issues.
  • Manage client expectations through transparent communication and thoughtful problem-solving.
  • Resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating only when appropriate.

job.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters' music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join UnitedMasters!

About This Role

As a Senior TPM at UnitedMasters, you'll manage the overarching portfolio of programs within your workstreams. You’ll have a large scope of responsibility and influence; partnering with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, UX Designers, as well as cross functional stakeholders in Marketing, Legal, Finance, etc. to build products that align with the organization’s goals. You'll understand technical concepts and meaningfully contribute to conversations about technical solutions while being responsible for delivering the roadmap with limited supervision. Key competencies for this role include: influencing and leadership, program planning, driving results, managing ambiguity, and ensuring accountability. This role requires five years of experience as a TPM in a similarly sized company or industry.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the day-to-day program management of multiple work streams across the software development lifecycle, including product strategy, technical design, implementation, experimentation, and go-to-market (GTM)
  • Ensure feature development tracks toward deliverables; proactively identify and resolve blockers, including dependencies on other teams
  • Manage cross-team dependencies across other scrum teams, strategic partners, Design, and QA
  • Drive alignment on commitments across multiple teams (Tech, Marketing, Business Development, QA) to achieve goals
  • Assist teams in getting back on track when deadlines are missed by creating and socializing new plans to ensure alignment across engineering teams and stakeholders
  • Serve as a reliable representative and point of contact for your vertical alongside the PM and EM

job.title: VP, Engineering
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building the world’s most powerful marketplace connecting artists, brands, and fans—empowering over 1.5M independent artists to earn, grow, and own their future. We’ve reinvented music distribution by putting artists first: enabling emerging creators to distribute directly to DSPs while maintaining ownership of their masters and up to 100% of royalties.

Our team is a diverse group of engineers, designers, product thinkers, and storytellers united by a shared mission to help artists succeed on their own terms. We combine deep expertise in technology, music, and culture to build products that unlock opportunity for creators everywhere. With a collaborative, creator-led mindset, we work closely with Translation, our in-house creative agency—to drive innovation at the intersection of culture and tech.

Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Alphabet (Google), Apple, and Disney, we are scaling rapidly across our B2C subscription business and Indie Label B2B platform.

What’s the Role?

UnitedMasters is seeking a Vice President of Engineering to lead and scale an engineering organization across backend, mobile (iOS/Android), web, data, QA, DevOps. This leader will drive the architectural vision, delivery excellence, and technical culture behind our consumer subscription products and our growing B2B indie label business.

A core mandate of this role is leveraging AI to enhance both artist  experience and engineering productivity. You will champion AI-driven personalization, artist tools, recommendations, and automation while also deploying AI-enabled development tooling, test automation, and ML-driven operations to improve engineering velocity and quality.

This is a hands-on, build-it-from-the-ground-up mandate. A top first-year priority is establishing UnitedMasters' “paved path” for agentic software development: defining the agentic-development methodology, making the core architecture and tooling decisions, setting context and documentation standards, standing up the eval and safety framework, coaching engineers through adoption, and demonstrating measurable developer-productivity gains. We're looking for someone who has personally built these capabilities, not sponsored or inherited them from a central platform team.

This role is ideal for a systems-level thinker, an inspiring people leader, and an operator who thrives in a fast-moving, culture-driven environment.

What You’ll Do

Technical Leadership, AI Innovation & Architecture

  • Define the multi-year technical and AI strategy across the UnitedMasters product ecosystem, championing new technologies, especially AI/ML, automation, and mobile innovation, to drive continuous improvement.
  • Build AI-powered customer-facing capabilities: artist insights, content recommendations, automated marketing, distribution optimization, and ML-driven discovery, monetization, and predictive tools.
  • Deliver measurable improvements from AI-enabled engineering, including gains in delivery speed, cycle time, and quality through capabilities such as code generation, automated testing, code review, debugging, and engineering operations automation.
  • Create and scale the paved path for AI-assisted and agentic software development across engineering: define the methodology and repeatable end-to-end workflows, determine how work is decomposed across sub-agents and tools, select and integrate the tooling, establish the supporting development practices and infrastructure, and drive adoption across the engineering organization.
  • Establish the technical foundations for reliable and secure AI agents in UnitedMasters products, including agent architecture, agent memory and state management, context engineering, RAG, tool use, an evaluation framework, human-in-the-loop controls, and defenses against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and other adversarial risks.
  • Drive architectural modernization and scale initiatives across our web applications, mobile apps, and internal tech platforms.
  • Ensure systems are reliable, performant, secure, and built for global scale.

Organizational Leadership & Global Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop an engineering organization, including managers, and senior ICs.
  • Own engineering competencies, performance systems, and technical excellence standards.

Execution, Delivery & Productivity

  • Drive  SDLC practices with strong CI/CD, automated testing, and AI-enabled developer tools.
  • Foster an environment where teams experiment and ship quickly, backed by strong measurement and rapid iteration.
  • Ensure predictable execution and high-quality delivery across all engineering pods.
  • Partner with Product and Design leadership on prioritization, planning, and resource allocation.
  • Own engineering commitments and ensure exceptional communication around timelines, risks, and dependencies.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Revenue, Marketing, and Artist Relations teams.
  • Translate business goals into clear, actionable technical plans.
  • Improve expectations-setting and visibility with executive stakeholders.

Who We’re Looking For

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years engineering experience with 5+ years leading orgs of 25+ engineers, including managers and senior ICs.
  • Proven success as a senior engineering leader at a scaled B2C, marketplace, or subscription-driven technology company.
  • Strong technical background with the ability to dive deep into systems architecture, data modeling, mobile performance, and platform-scale challenges.
    Demonstrated experience deploying AI/ML in both customer-facing features and internal engineering workflows.
  • Track record of improving engineering velocity and developer experience through tooling, process, and automation.
  • Direct, hands-on experience building agentic-development capabilities from the ground up (must-have): methodology, tooling, context standards, and eval/safety frameworks you personally designed and shipped, with measurable developer-productivity gains you drove.
  • Exceptional communication skills and experience partnering with product and executive leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large-scale content distribution, media ingestion pipelines, payments, subscription systems, or rights management.
  • Familiarity with Python/Django, JavaScript/TypeScript, Kubernetes, event-driven architecture, or modern mobile frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of data science, ML infrastructure, and experimentation platforms.
  • Background in creator economy, digital media, or marketplace ecosystems.

Who You Are

  • A people-first leader who inspires teams and takes pride in developing others.
  • A visionary technologist who sees around corners and builds systems that scale with the business.
  • A business-oriented thinker who maps engineering strategy to real outcomes for artists and label partners.
  • A decisive operator who thrives in ambiguity and moves with urgency.
  • A culture-builder who values collaboration, inclusion, and excellence.

Why UnitedMasters?

  • Lead the engineering organization shaping the future of independent music.
  • Build AI-powered products and tools that help artists earn, grow, and be discovered.
  • Drive innovation at the intersection of technology, creativity, and culture.
  • Make a direct impact on millions of creators around the world.

Salary Hiring Range:  $275K - 310K + bonus opportunity 

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. in some cases bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: 3D Motion Specialist
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Fame House, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Fame House powers eCommerce for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration, both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD:

Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent.

At Digital Creative & Experience, we create experiences that connect artists and fans through storytelling, design, content, commerce, and culture. Across artist storefronts, ecommerce experiences, campaigns, content initiatives, and fan engagement platforms, the Design & Direction team is responsible for bringing artist brands to life through compelling and innovative creative experiences.

As digital experiences continue to evolve, motion, animation, and immersive visual storytelling play an increasingly important role in how audiences discover, engage with, and connect to artists and brands. The 3D Motion Specialist helps shape these experiences by transforming creative concepts into dynamic visual content that elevates storytelling, enhances engagement, and pushes creative boundaries.

How You’ll CREATE

The 3D Motion Specialist is responsible for designing and creating high-quality motion graphics, 3D visualizations, animations, and digital content experiences across artist campaigns, e-commerce initiatives, content productions, and branded experiences. Working closely with Creative Directors, Designers, Content Production teams, and Developers, this role translates creative vision into visually compelling motion-based experiences that support artist storytelling, product presentation, fan engagement, and brand expression.

Combining technical expertise with strong creative instincts, the 3D Motion Specialist contributes throughout the creative process, from concept development and visual exploration through final execution and delivery. This role plays a key part in evolving the visual capabilities of the Design & Direction team and exploring new ways to engage audiences through motion and interactive storytelling.

Motion Design & Animation

  • Create high-quality motion graphics and animation assets across digital campaigns, e-commerce experiences, social content, and artist initiatives

  • Develop engaging visual narratives through motion, timing, composition, and storytelling principles

  • Translate creative concepts into compelling animated content and motion systems

  • Create animated assets that support artist storytelling, product launches, and audience engagement initiatives

  • Develop title sequences, transitions, promotional assets, and branded motion content

3D Design & Visualization

  • Create 3D environments, product visualizations, digital assets, and immersive content experiences

  • Develop realistic and stylized renderings that support campaign and brand objectives

  • Produce 3D assets for digital experiences, content production, ecommerce initiatives, and promotional campaigns

  • Explore innovative approaches to dimensional storytelling and digital expression

  • Contribute to the development of future-facing content formats and emerging creative technologies

Creative Development

  • Partner with Creative Directors to explore visual concepts and creative approaches

  • Participate in concept development, brainstorming sessions, and creative workshops

  • Contribute visual ideas, mood boards, references, and prototypes during project development

  • Support the evolution of creative frameworks and visual storytelling standards

  • Collaborate with Design teams to ensure consistency across visual systems and brand experiences

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Designers, Developers, Content Producers, Editors, and Creative Directors throughout project lifecycles

  • Support content production teams through animation, visual effects, and motion-based storytelling solutions

  • Prepare assets for delivery across multiple channels and platforms

  • Ensure motion and 3D deliverables meet technical specifications and performance requirements

  • Collaborate on interactive and emerging digital experiences where motion enhances user engagement

Innovation & Craft Development

  • Stay informed on emerging technologies, motion design trends, visual techniques, and creative tools

  • Explore opportunities to introduce new creative capabilities, workflows, and technologies

  • Contribute to the growth of motion design and 3D capabilities within the Design & Direction team

  • Continuously develop technical skills across motion graphics, animation, rendering, simulation, and interactive content

Bring Your VIBE

  • 3-6 years experience in motion design, animation, 3D design, visual effects, digital design, or related creative disciplines

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in motion graphics, animation, and 3D content creation

  • Advanced proficiency in Cinema 4D, Blender, After Effects, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools

  • Understanding of visual storytelling, composition, typography, design systems, and animation principles

  • Experience working across digital campaigns, branded content, ecommerce, entertainment, music, or agency environments

  • Strong creative problem-solving and conceptual thinking abilities

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously

  • Passion for music, culture, digital experiences, and emerging technologies

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

Success Looks Like

  • Motion and 3D content consistently elevates the quality of creative output across the organization

  • Creative concepts are enhanced through innovative visual storytelling and animation

  • Artists, products, and brands are represented through engaging and memorable digital experiences

  • Motion assets perform effectively across channels and platforms

  • New creative approaches and technologies continue to expand team capabilities

  • Creative teams trust your expertise and seek your input throughout concept development

  • Work helps establish Digital Creative Services as a leader in innovative digital experiences

job.title: Account Lead
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:
Virgin Music is looking for a superstar Account Lead/Manager to join our industry-leading Commercial Marketing team. This role will build go-to-market commercial release plans, identify and execute innovative commercial opportunities, and develop creative release strategies while nurturing key relationships with our commercial accounts, artists, and label partners.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience building, optimizing, and managing YouTube channels on behalf of artists, with a deep understanding of the platform’s underlying mechanics. They are fluent in YouTube’s ecosystem—from content strategy and audience development to monetization and discovery levers—and know how to leverage the full suite of YouTube tools to grow artist presence, engagement, and global reach.

This individual will also possess exceptional relationship management skills, be proactive and results-oriented, and demonstrate strong strategic and analytical thinking. They must thrive in a fast-paced environment and serve as a passionate advocate for Virgin’s artists and label partners.

How you'll CREATE:

Relationship Management:
Develop and maintain strong relationships with DSPs and streaming partners while also serving as a key YouTube platform expert—driving storytelling, content strategy, and audience growth initiatives. Collaborate with playlist/genre leads and platform representatives by utilizing cultural insight, marketing strategy, and data to deliver against targets. Support asset collection, optimize content delivery, and manage pitch administration. Attend regular meetings and maintain in-person relationships with partners.

Partner Account Manager:
Represent Virgin Music Group repertoire as the Account Lead across various commercial accounts, including YouTube as a core strategic platform. Maintain a deep, working knowledge of best practices, tools (e.g., YouTube Studio, Content ID, Official Artist Channels), and opportunities across accounts. Lead release strategies, long-lead planning, and campaigns while pitching and securing opportunities that drive visibility and discovery for artists.

Label Relations:
Work directly with Virgin Music Group labels to identify opportunities across release schedules, including YouTube-first or YouTube-enhanced strategies (premieres, Shorts, live content, catalog optimization). Educate teams on platform best practices and ensure alignment on KPIs, reporting, and performance tracking.

Streaming and Commercial Marketing Strategy:
Create dynamic release plans that integrate YouTube as a central discovery and fan engagement engine, leveraging content formats, release timing, and platform features to maximize impact.

YouTube Channel Strategy & Optimization:
Lead the development and ongoing management of artist YouTube channels, including channel optimization, content programming, metadata strategy, release cadence, audience segmentation, and growth tactics. Utilize YouTube analytics and insights to inform strategy, improve performance, and drive subscriber and viewership growth.

Data Analysis:
Provide daily and in-depth analysis across platforms, with a strong emphasis on YouTube performance metrics (audience retention, CTR, watch time, traffic sources, etc.), translating insights into actionable recommendations.

Label Meetings:
Communicate release performance and strategic recommendations, including YouTube-specific insights and optimization opportunities, while building forward-looking plans.

Digital Marketing Strategy:
Partner with label digital teams to ensure campaigns are innovative and platform-native, with a strong emphasis on video strategy, fan engagement, and discovery through YouTube and emerging formats (e.g., Shorts).

Artist Relations:
Liaise directly with labels, managers, and artists to guide YouTube content strategy, channel growth, and best practices, ensuring seamless execution across campaigns.

Culture Driven Focus:
Stay deeply connected to cultural trends and platform behaviors, particularly video consumption trends and YouTube-native formats, translating them into meaningful opportunities for artists and partners.

Bring your VIBE:

  • Proven experience building and managing YouTube channels for artists or music brands, with a strong understanding of platform mechanics and growth strategies
  • Deep knowledge of YouTube Studio, Content ID, Official Artist Channels, monetization, SEO/metadata, and audience development tactics
  • Exceptional relationship management skills with existing music industry contacts
  • Highly analytical with the ability to interpret data and trends, especially video and audience performance metrics
  • Able to manage large workloads in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
  • Experience developing and executing campaigns and pitching strategic proposals
  • Tech-savvy with a strong understanding of digital platforms, trends, and emerging technologies
  • Creative, innovative, detail-oriented, and resourceful
  • Highly organized with strong prioritization and multitasking skills
  • Proactive, with a ‘can do’ attitude and willingness to attend live events regularly
  • Passionate about music and culture
  • 3+ years’ experience in music industry sales, marketing, or digital strategy, with YouTube/platform experience strongly preferred
  • Project management experience preferred
  • Existing relationships with labels and/or commercial platform partners preferred
  • College degree preferred

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We are currently seeking an Application Security Engineer to join UMG's global Tech Security & Identity organization. Reporting to the Manager, Security Engineering and Vulnerability, this role is responsible for improving the security of internally developed applications and cloud services by partnering closely with engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to integrate security throughout the software development lifecycle.

The Application Security Engineer will serve as a trusted technical advisor, performing application security assessments, supporting secure software development practices, and helping engineering teams identify and address security risks early in the development process. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with collaboration across development and security teams to strengthen UMG's application security posture while enabling innovation.

The ideal candidate has experience in application security, secure software development, cloud-native technologies, and developer enablement, along with strong communication skills and a passion for building secure software.

How you'll CREATE:

  • Perform application security assessments, threat modeling, and secure design reviews for internally developed and third-party applications.

  • Conduct application security testing using static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), API security testing, and manual validation techniques.

  • Review source code and provide secure coding guidance based on OWASP best practices and secure development principles.

  • Partner with software engineering teams to identify security risks and recommend practical remediation strategies throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to integrate application security testing into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery workflows.

  • Provide security architecture guidance for new applications, APIs, cloud-native services, and technology integrations.

  • Support implementation of modern authentication and authorization technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and other identity standards.

  • Evaluate, implement, and maintain application security tools and help improve security testing coverage across the development lifecycle.

  • Develop automation and scripting to improve application security testing, reporting, and engineering workflows.

  • Participate in security reviews for new technologies, cloud services, and third-party applications.

  • Support investigation and remediation of application-layer security incidents and vulnerabilities when required.

  • Create reusable security guidance, reference architectures, and technical documentation to improve secure development practices across engineering teams.

  • Deliver secure coding guidance and developer education to promote security-by-design principles.

  • Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and identity teams to continuously improve enterprise application security capabilities.

Bring your VIBE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in Application Security, Security Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline with a security focus.

  • Experience performing application security assessments, threat modeling, and secure architecture reviews.

  • Strong understanding of secure coding principles and common application vulnerabilities, including the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10.

  • Experience with application security testing technologies including SAST, DAST, SCA, API security testing, and penetration testing methodologies.

  • Experience working with modern application architectures, REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native technologies.

  • Experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows.

  • Experience working within AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform environments.

  • Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization technologies including OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and JWT.

  • Understanding of security frameworks and standards including OWASP, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and ISO 27001.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience implementing Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices within Agile development environments.

  • Experience with application security platforms such as GitHub Advanced Security, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Checkmarx, Veracode, Burp Suite, Semgrep, or similar tools.

  • Experience with container security, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code security.

  • Experience developing automation using Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages.

  • Experience performing security assessments of cloud-native applications and APIs.

  • Professional certifications such as CSSLP, GIAC GWEB, AWS Certified Security Specialty, Security+, CISSP, or equivalent.

  • Experience working within large global enterprise environments.

  • Experience in media, entertainment, or similarly distributed global organizations.

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Fame House, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Fame House powers eCommerce for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration, both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD

Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent.

At Digital Creative & Expereince, exceptional content starts with exceptional execution. Across artist campaigns, e-commerce experiences, product launches, social content, and brand storytelling initiatives, our Content & Experience team creates visual experiences that connect artists, brands, and audiences around the world.

As content production continues to evolve, the importance of technical excellence, workflow consistency, and media integrity has never been greater. The Digital Imaging Technician plays a critical role in ensuring productions operate efficiently, assets are captured and managed correctly, and creative teams can move confidently from production through post-production without compromise.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, production, and creative execution, helping ensure every production is built on a foundation of reliability, quality, and operational excellence.

How You’ll CREATE

The Digital Imaging Technician is responsible for managing technical production workflows, media handling, imaging integrity, and on-set technical operations across Content & Experience productions.

Working closely with Directors of Photography, Producers, Editors, Photographers, Camera Operators, and Post Production teams, this role ensures assets are captured, processed, backed up, organized, and delivered according to established technical standards and production requirements.

Beyond supporting individual productions, the Digital Imaging Technician contributes to the development of scalable production workflows, technology standards, and technical best practices that improve efficiency, consistency, and quality across the organization.

This role combines deep technical expertise with strong operational discipline and problem-solving skills, serving as a trusted technical partner throughout the production lifecycle.

Technical Production Operations

  • Lead technical workflow management across video, photography, and hybrid productions

  • Establish and maintain media management standards throughout production activities

  • Configure and manage camera, monitoring, recording, and data systems

  • Ensure technical consistency across production environments and projects

  • Support Directors of Photography and camera teams with technical setup and troubleshooting

  • Monitor image quality, color accuracy, exposure consistency, and recording integrity throughout productions

  • Ensure production assets meet technical specifications and quality requirements

Media Management & Asset Integrity

  • Manage ingestion, verification, organization, and backup of production assets

  • Maintain secure and reliable media management workflows

  • Ensure all footage, photography, and production assets are correctly archived and documented

  • Establish redundancy and backup procedures that protect asset integrity

  • Coordinate asset handoff processes between production and post-production teams

  • Maintain file naming, metadata, and organizational standards

Workflow Development

  • Develop and improve production-to-post-production workflows

  • Establish technical standards and best practices across content production

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability

  • Support implementation of new production technologies and systems

  • Collaborate with Editors and Post Production teams to optimize delivery workflows

  • Ensure production pipelines support evolving business and creative requirements

Technical Leadership

  • Act as the primary technical resource on production sets and studio environments

  • Troubleshoot equipment, workflow, and technical issues during production

  • Provide guidance on formats, codecs, color workflows, and media management practices

  • Support training and onboarding related to production technology and workflows

  • Partner with Grip & Equipment, Production, and Creative teams to ensure operational readiness

  • Contribute to future planning around production technology investments and capabilities

Bring Your VIBE

  • 4-8 years experience in digital imaging, technical production, post-production workflows, broadcast operations, or related production environments

  • Strong understanding of camera systems, recording formats, codecs, color management, and digital imaging workflows

  • Experience supporting video, photography, ecommerce, campaign, and content productions

  • Knowledge of media management, backup systems, storage solutions, and asset workflows

  • Experience working with post-production teams and editorial pipelines

  • Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving abilities

  • Exceptional attention to detail and process discipline

  • Ability to remain calm and solution-oriented in fast-paced production environments

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Passion for technology, production, innovation, and content creation

Success Looks Like

  • Production assets are consistently secure, organized, and technically accurate

  • Productions operate efficiently with minimal technical disruption

  • Camera and production teams trust technical guidance and workflow support

  • Asset handoffs between production and post-production are seamless

  • Technical standards are maintained across all productions

  • Workflow improvements drive efficiency, consistency, and scalability

  • Content quality is protected through strong technical leadership and operational excellence

job.title: Director, Artist & Label Services
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Famehouse, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in merchandise & D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Famehouse powers merch and D2C for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration—both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of D2C & merchandise for artists, providing a full-service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How We Lead:

Famehouse is seeking an experienced merch Account/Brand Manager to join our team in Los Angeles as a Director, Artist & Label Services, focusing on artists across the Capitol roster.

In this role, you’ll serve as the strategic lead across a portfolio of artists, owning the long-term direction of their merchandise and D2C businesses. You’ll shape merch & D2C strategies that align with the artist’s creative vision to deliver strong commercial results across both merch and music, developing long-term (rolling 12mo+) calendar plans across all revenue channels and guiding the strategy behind every campaign, product launch, and fan experience.

This role requires a strong ability to sell ideas and inspire confidence with artist and label teams, bringing clarity & thoughtful storytelling to every campaign discussion to help artists understand D2C & merch’s impact in building fandom. It requires exceptional taste, deep cultural fluency, and an intuitive understanding of artist brand, aesthetic direction, and creative identity.

Success in this role also requires exceptional collaborative leadership, working closely with many teams and disciplines, both internally and with partners. Candidates must lead with positivity, respect, and a team-first mindset, ensuring strong partnerships across the organization and consistently delivering great outcomes for artists.

How You’ll Create:

  • Serve as the relationship lead for Capitol Music Group and their artists, building trusted relationships with artist managers, label teams, and creative partners.
     
  • Lead holistic, cross-channel merchandise strategy across D2C, tour, retail, and licensing, including for physical music on d2c, exclusives, and fan engagement moments.
     
  • Develop rolling 12-month calendar plans across all channels, including D2C, tour & VIP, retail, and licensing initiatives, working closely with the artist team, label marketing and creative.
     
  • Bring infectious energy, enthusiasm, and storytelling to all pitch, proposal, and planning conversations — inspiring clients to adopt innovative D2C and merch ideas that drive growth.
     
  • Lead development and presentation of artist proposals, calendar plans, and go-to-market initiatives, ensuring buy-in from clients and stakeholders.
     
  • Partner closely with Campaign Managers to ensure all campaigns and initiatives remain on track to achieve artist and label goals, proactively identifying opportunities to optimize performance.
     
  • Lead Artist & Label Business Reviews, presenting insights, growth opportunities, and long-term strategic recommendations.
     
  • Manage artist and label feedback and ensure all executions are aligned with client expectations and artist brand standards, including leading all business and product approvals.
     
  • Serve as a collaborative, trusted partner inside the organization — working closely with a wide range of teams, operating with positivity, respect, and a solutions-focused mindset.
     
  • Maintain strong client satisfaction by ensuring artist teams feel supported, informed, and excited about their partnership with Famehouse.
     

Bring Your Vibe:

  • 8+ years of experience in account management, artist relations, marketing, or eCommerce within music, entertainment, or merchandise.
     
  • Demonstrated success managing artist relationships in fast-paced environments.
     
  • Strong understanding of the label, artist, and merchandise ecosystem, ideally with prior label-side, artist commerce, or D2C experience.
     
  • A passion for the music & culture of Capitol’s roster is a must. Candidates should bring dedication in serving the artist community and delivering exceptional experiences for their fans.
     
  • Strong understanding of D2C commerce, merchandise strategy, and fan engagement.
     
  • Excellent communicator and presenter with the ability to sell ideas and strategies in compelling ways. High degree of comfort communicating with sr. leaders, artist managers, and their teams.
     
  • Strong creative instincts and taste level aligned with artist brands and cultural trends.
     
  • Positive, collaborative leader who works well across many teams and builds trust easily.
     
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple campaigns, clients, and priorities simultaneously.
     
  • Passion for music, fan culture, and building meaningful artist-to-fan experiences.
     
  • Commitment to teamwork and respect for every function is required; must be willing to set personal ego aside for the good of the team and delivering for our artists and partners.

job.title: Director, Catalog Creative
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How We LEAD

The Director, Catalog Visual Creative will spearhead the creative direction, evolution, and execution of visual media supporting Capitol’s iconic catalog and legacy artists. This includes reissues, deluxe/anniversary campaigns, remastered artwork, archival storytelling, long-form content, catalog brand identity systems, and global creative toolkits.

This role requires a global mindset, ensuring that visuals resonate not only within the U.S. but across key international markets. You will collaborate with marketing and digital core teams, as well as relevant departments across the label based on project needs to craft universally compelling creative. As a Director, you will uphold artistic integrity and historical authenticity while shaping forward-thinking creative expressions that scale worldwide.

How You’ll CREATE

Creative Leadership & Global Strategic Vision

  • Drive the overarching creative vision for catalog artists with a strong understanding of global audiences, cultural nuances, and international market dynamics.
  • Develop creative that is rooted in artist legacy but strategically positioned for global relevance across regions and platforms.

High-Level Concept Development

  • Oversee creation of artist project visual assets (ex. music video / press & DSP photos / concept cover art) – lead process of ideation with artist and management team, execution, and trafficking and obtaining approvals internally and externally.
  • Lead concepting of refreshed packaging, campaign assets, deluxe editions, and multi-territory brand systems.
  • Craft visual narratives that communicate legacy and heritage in ways that resonate across continents and generations.
  • Ensure global scalability of creative concepts, including adaptations for non-U.S. markets, localized formats, and regional content strategies.

Stewardship of Archival Assets

  • Oversee creative use of archival materials in ways that respect historical provenance.
  • Collaborate with international teams to rediscover, adapt, and contextualize archival assets for different cultural markets.
  • Maintain best practices for preservation, delivery, metadata, and global accessibility of catalog visual assets.

Cross-Departmental Creative Partnership

  • Partner with Creative Leadership to develop brand bibles and mood boards with international considerations baked into the visual identity system.
  • Build strong working relationships with catalog and core label teams to ensure cohesive execution.
  • Present creative direction confidently to stakeholders, artist representatives, estates, and territory leads.

Talent Direction & Creative Resourcing

  • Identify high-caliber creative partners — photographers, directors, designers, editors, restoration specialists.
  • Champion diverse creative perspectives that reflect the global impact and multicultural audiences of catalog artists.

Production Oversight

  • Oversee production workflows and ensure campaign assets meet regional requirements for formats, platforms, and cultural relevance.
  • Drafting production agreements for art / photo / music video / misc. content.
  • Oversee distribution of approved creative assets internally to respective departments.
  • Approve vendor bids, negotiate contracts, and supervise multi-market deliveries.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple high-volume projects with international timelines, partners, and sensitive estate-driven workflows.
  • Anticipate market-specific needs and adjust priorities to support global releases, rollouts, and milestone moments.
  • Ability to work across time zones, travel when necessary, and maintain strong cross-cultural diplomatic skills.

Bring Your VIBE

  • 7–10+ years of visual creative leadership experience, ideally with global creative exposure or international campaign management.
  • Demonstrated ability to build creative strategies that scale across diverse audiences and respect regional/cultural contexts.
  • Strong ability to communicate creative direction and feedback on assets to/from artist/mgmt. and external creative partners (vice versa).
  • Deep understanding of how global music, design, fashion, art, and cultural trends shape visual storytelling.
  • Experience guiding large cross-functional teams and external vendors.
  • Passion for preserving and reimagining legacy artistry for a worldwide audience.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photo Shop, Illustrator, Premiere, etc.)
  • Ability to edit short and long form content and getting relevant approvals internal/external is preferred.
  • General retouching capability for images for social/digital/print/billboards is preferred.
  • Keep up with design and editorial trends.

job.title: Director, Catalog Digital Marketing Urban
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How We LEAD

We are currently seeking an experienced Director, Catalog Marketing who will drive the long-term product and campaign strategy for multiple artists and projects across the IGA roster, with specific focus on Urban (Hip-Hop/R&B) catalog while maintaining fluency across all genres. This leader will partner closely with the Department Head and all departments within IGA (A&R, Revenue, Creative, Digital, PR, Radio) to build and execute fully integrated, progressive, and culturally fluent marketing strategies that resonate with both legacy audiences and the next generation of fans.

The ideal candidate brings deep understanding of music history, especially Hip-Hop and R&B, paired with a strategic, forward-thinking marketing mind, strong cultural awareness, trend fluency, and the maturity to bridge legacy artistry with modern audience behavior. This person blends creative instinct, data-driven thinking, operational discipline, and cross-functional collaboration—always keeping artist brand integrity, fan experience, and long-term impact at the center.

How You’ll CREATE

Urban + Multi-Genre Catalog Strategy

  • Develop and execute innovative catalog marketing strategies for Urban (Hip-Hop/R&B) artists while applying equal expertise across all genres.
  • Identify opportunities to pull forward catalog moments that resonate with today’s youth—balancing cultural nostalgia with modern relevance.
  • Build long-tail strategies that strengthen artist legacy while tapping into emerging discovery behavior, cultural moments, and platform trends.

Creative Ideation & Cultural Fluency

  • Bring strong creative instincts and a modern marketing mindset—someone who sees possibilities, not limitations.
  • Develop big ideas, tentpole moments, viral concepts, and culturally relevant activations that stretch across platforms and audience groups.
  • Ensure ideas honor the artist’s legacy while making them meaningful and exciting for new generations.

Trend Awareness & Viral Opportunities

  • Stay deeply connected to cultural trends—especially TikTok, social audio moments, memes, and youth-driven behavior.
  • Recognize viral patterns early and develop strategies to enhance, accelerate, or originate viral catalog moments.
  • Bring forward new ideas using remixes, edits, challenges, influencers, and micro-moments that leverage platform algorithms.

Research, Data, and Insights Integration

  • Tap into all research and data sources—internal insights, data analytics, consumer behavior, streaming patterns, social sentiment, and cultural research.
  • Use data to validate opportunities, uncover blind spots, and inform go-forward strategy.
  • Ensure the team utilizes internal tools, processes, and cross-functional expertise to maximize performance and efficiency.

Frontline + Catalog Alignment

  • Understand frontline release cycles and how they influence catalog moments.
  • Work across current genres and frontline teams to ensure that catalog strategy complements and enhances artist development across the roster.
  • Seamlessly bridge catalog and frontline marketing—ensuring holistic, year-round artist narratives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Catalog and Core Label teams including Marketing, A&R, Digital, Creative, International, Commercial, Revenue, and Artist Management to support priority Urban and multi-genre catalog projects.
  • Maintain proactive, clear communication with all stakeholders—deadlines must be met, and alignment must be constant across all moving parts.
  • Serve as a key partner to Artist Management, ensuring that campaigns support artist brand integrity and long-term vision.

Execution, Analysis & Optimization

  • Guide and oversee the creation of all marketing materials and original content for campaigns.
  • Regularly interface with artists and management to ensure alignment on all aspects of release plans and catalog marketing strategy.
  • Analyze streaming, sales, radio, and social performance to adjust strategies in real time.
  • Use audience insights to optimize rollouts, messaging, formats, and content across channels.

Bring Your VIBE

  • 6+ years’ experience as a Marketing Director and/or Product Manager in music
  • Strong experience in Urban (Hip-Hop/R&B) while holding comprehensive knowledge across all genres
  • Deep passion for music history, catalog storytelling, and cultural evolution—whether lived, learned, or actively pursuing
  • Strong ability to define and drive strategy, execution, timelines, and cross-functional coordination
  • Creative thinker with the ability to generate fresh, innovative marketing ideas rooted in culture
  • Strong understanding of DSP behavior and trends (Spotify, Apple, SoundCloud, YouTube)
  • Deep familiarity with social platforms and content trends, especially TikTok
  • Excellent communication, writing, presentation, and cross-functional relationship skills
  • Proficiency with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Nielsen analytics (SoundScan, Mediabase)
  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

job.title: Director, Catalog Production
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How We LEAD: 

The Director, Catalog Production helps bring iconic music to life through dynamic, culturally relevant catalog releases that celebrate artistry and innovation. This role contributes to the creation of exceptional physical and digital products — from collectible vinyl and anniversary box sets to special-edition releases that give timeless music a fresh voice and new energy.

Rooted in collaboration, precision, and creative execution, this position works closely with design, A&R, marketing, and supply chain teams to help ensure products are expertly crafted and seamlessly produced. Every detail — from artwork to delivery — reflects the care and legacy of the music itself.

At its core, this role is about helping craft experiences that fans can hold onto, turning legendary recordings into meaningful, lasting moments.

How You’ll CREATE: 

  • Support the production of catalog releases that inspire fans and collectors — including deluxe box sets, limited vinyl runs, and special anniversary campaigns.

  • Collaborate with A&R, Creative, Marketing, D2C, and International teams to translate creative ideas into tangible, high-quality products.

  • Partner with printers, manufacturers, mastering studios, and the UMG supply chain to ensure accuracy, timing, and quality in all deliverables.

  • Manage key aspects of the production process — including artwork prep, pre-press, mastering, and delivery — while keeping creative intent and execution aligned.

  • Track and coordinate production timelines and milestones across multiple releases, ensuring projects stay on schedule.

  • Explore and recommend new materials, packaging, and production techniques that elevate the fan experience.

  • Assist with digital companion releases, ensuring alignment between physical and digital versions.
