job.title: Globe Sync Agent (Advertising) - New York, New York
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Globe 

Who we are  

Globe is the award-winning creative and partnerships division of Universal Music Group in the UK. We work together with our artists and labels, operating at the intersection of music, film, television, brands and creative partners. 

We specialise in placing music to picture across film, TV, advertising, gaming and streaming alongside crafting standout brand partnerships and original content. Our work sits at the heart of an artist’s marketing strategy, driving cultural relevance, audience reach and long-term impact. 

Our team  

Globe is made up of passionate and knowledgeable experts who thrive on collaboration and creativity. We work closely with artists from the moment they sign, helping shape their journey across all stages of their career. Our team approaches every campaign with pace and precision, moving fast like an F1 pit crew, but with the deep creative care of the engineers behind the scenes. 

We’re building a new sync presence on the ground in the USA, and we’re looking for dynamic self-starters who can identify and unlock opportunities others might miss. We believe in the power of teamwork, cultural fluency, and mutual respect and we’re united by our love of music. 

Our impact  

Globe plays a key role in the long-term success of our artists. We secure impactful placements that elevate an artist’s profile and fanbase, whether it’s a global film franchise, a soundtrack moment in a streaming hit, or a culture-shaping ad campaign. Each sync is a chance to deepen engagement, build brand value, and create timeless connections between music and audience. 

Our work helps shape perception and drive discovery. We create opportunities that align with artist narratives and bring a new level of visibility to Universal Music Group’s UK world-class repertoire. 

The Role  

A day in the life of  

As Sync Agent, Globe USA (Advertising – East Coast), you’ll lead Globe’s advertising-focused sync strategy from New York. Your remit will centre on identifying, developing and executing licensing opportunities that maximise the commercial and creative impact of Universal Music UK’s frontline and catalogue repertoire. 

You’ll work with advertising agencies, music supervisors, brands and creative partners to build long-lasting relationships and drive new and repeat business. Working closely with our UK labels and A&R teams, you’ll curate and deliver music responses that cut through creatively and deliver commercially. 

On any given day you could be: 

  • Pitching music to advertising agencies, brands, and creative studios for upcoming campaigns 

  • Collaborating with A&R to develop custom or tailored musical responses to client briefs 

  • Meeting with key contacts in the advertising industry to deepen relationships and understand trends 

  • Negotiating sync deals, overseeing licensing, clearances and financial tracking 

  • Monitoring campaign performance and sync usage to inform future activity 

  • Attending brand showcases, award shows, and industry events to grow Globe’s US network 

  • Working closely with colleagues in the UK to align sync activity with artist campaigns and priorities 

Your impact in role 

You will play a critical role in helping UK artists break into the US advertising sync market. Your placements will provide meaningful profile and commercial wins for our artists, increase catalogue performance, and expand our footprint in the creative industries. 

By maintaining strong relationships and securing high-value opportunities, you’ll directly support the growth of Universal Music UK’s presence in the US sync space, particularly within the influential advertising and branding sectors. 

This role is ideal for you if 

  • You are deeply connected within the advertising sync and music supervision space 

  • You have a strong understanding of how music, brands and storytelling intersect 

  • You’re confident balancing creative ambition with commercial delivery 

  • You enjoy spotting new opportunities and shaping long-term client relationships 

  • You’re excited by building something new and being part of a fast-moving, collaborative team 

  • You’re adaptable, solutions-focused, and thrive on delivering impactful results 

Key responsibilities  

  • Lead Globe NY’s sync strategy, focused on advertising-driven opportunities 

  • Work to accountable commercial targets and KPIs, aligned with artist and label goals 

  • Cultivate, grow and maintain relationships with brands, agencies and music supervision teams 

  • Respond creatively and commercially to sync briefs, pitching music from our full repertoire 

  • Negotiate, close and execute sync deals including clearance, licensing and payments 

  • Collaborate with UK labels and A&R to develop bespoke creative responses 

  • Deliver artist showcases, client engagement moments and in-market activations 

  • Track sync activity and catalogue performance to provide actionable insights to internal teams 

  • Stay ahead of sync, advertising and content trends to identify new revenue opportunities 

Our ideal candidate  

  • 8+ years’ experience in creative sync, advertising music supervision, or licensing 

  • Extensive network of advertising industry contacts and creative agency partners 

  • Proven success in pitching and closing advertising sync deals 

  • Strong understanding of music copyright, licensing and legal frameworks 

  • Commercially astute with excellent negotiation and communication skills 

  • Organised, strategic and able to manage multiple priorities and client needs 

  • Familiarity with key platforms including Microsoft Office, Salesforce, DISCO and music analytics tools 

  • Based in the New York area with the ability to travel as required 

  • A passion for music across all genres, and an appreciation of UK repertoire, is a plus 

Why join Globe  

  • Be part of a pioneering new sync expansion in the USA 

  • Play a central role in breaking UK artists globally 

  • Represent one of the most exciting catalogues in music, from emerging icons to legendary acts 

  • Work within a collaborative, inclusive and values-driven creative team 

  • Help shape the future of sync in one of the world’s most important media markets 

  • Make a lasting impact on artists, on culture, and on the business 

Reward and Benefits 

  • Be part of an entrepreneurial, global organization that values authenticity, drive, creativity, relationships, and a competitive spirit 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and FSA options, as well as: 

  • 100% coverage for out-patient mental health services 

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year) 

  • A lifetime fertility support allowance of $30,000 to plan participants 

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement 

  • 100% immediately vested 401(k) match on the first 5% of your contribution on eligible compensation 

  • Variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including: 

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees 

  • 3-weeks PTO for non-exempt employees 

  • 2-weeks paid Winter Break 

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day) 

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day) 

  • Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent

job.title: Identity Access Management (IAM) Engineer – Identity Governance and Administration
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Job Summary 

We are currently seeking an Identity & Access Management Engineer with specialization in Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) to join UMG’s global Tech Security & Identity organization. Reporting to the VP, Tech Security & Identity, this is a hands-on engineering role responsible for designing, implementing, and operating enterprise IGA capabilities across a complex, global environment. 

This engineer will play a critical role in governing digital identities, access entitlements, and lifecycle processes for employees, contractors, and non-employee populations. The role emphasizes strong engineering execution, automation, and operational discipline, partnering closely with security, HR, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure access is provisioned appropriately, reviewed regularly, and removed in a timely manner. The ideal candidate brings deep experience with modern IGA platforms, strong understanding of access governance controls, and the ability to operate at scale in a regulated enterprise. 

Job Functions 

Design, engineer, deploy, and operate Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) solutions across the enterprise. 

Implement and manage identity lifecycle processes including joiner, mover, and leaver (JML) workflows for employees and non-employee identities. 

Engineer and maintain access request, approval, and provisioning workflows integrated with HR systems, directories, and enterprise applications. 

Design and operate access governance controls including role models, entitlement catalogs, access certifications, and periodic access reviews. 

Partner with application owners and platform teams to onboard applications into IGA and remediate access governance gaps. 

Develop and maintain automation and integrations for IGA workflows using scripting, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code approaches (e.g., PowerShell, Python). 

Support segregation of duties (SoD) controls, access policy enforcement, and audit readiness activities. 

Troubleshoot and resolve complex identity lifecycle, provisioning, and access-related issues across integrated systems. 

Collaborate with Security, HR, Compliance, and Infrastructure teams to ensure identity governance controls align with security policies and regulatory requirements. 

Maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, and operational runbooks to support scalable and repeatable IGA operations. 

Continuously identify opportunities to improve access governance maturity, reduce manual effort, and enhance user experience through automation and platform enhancements. 

Job Requirements 

Essential Qualifications 

5+ years of hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management or Security Engineering roles, with a strong focus on Identity Governance & Administration. 

Demonstrated experience implementing and operating enterprise IGA platforms (e.g., Saviynt, SailPoint, or equivalent). 

Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, role-based access control (RBAC), and entitlement governance. 

Hands-on experience designing and supporting access certification campaigns and remediation processes. 

Experience integrating IGA solutions with HR systems, Active Directory / Entra ID, and enterprise applications. 

Proficiency in scripting and automation using tools such as PowerShell or Python. 

Experience working in hybrid and cloud environments (Azure and/or AWS) with IAM integrations. 

Ability to independently own complex technical deliverables while collaborating effectively within a global organization. 

Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. 

Desirable Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

Experience with advanced IGA capabilities such as role mining, access analytics, or policy-based provisioning. 

Familiarity with compliance and audit frameworks such as SOX, ISO 27001, NIST, or similar. 

Professional certifications such as Saviynt Certified Professional, SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer, Security+, or CISSP. 

Experience operating IAM or identity governance platforms within a large, global, or highly regulated enterprise environment.

Across artist storefronts, e-commerce experiences, campaigns, content initiatives, and fan engagement platforms, the Design & Direction team is responsible for bringing artist brands to life through innovative and meaningful creative experiences.

Motion plays an increasingly important role in how audiences experience digital content. Whether enhancing artist storytelling, elevating product launches, creating immersive campaign moments, or bringing digital experiences to life, motion has the power to create emotion, drive engagement, and strengthen audience connection.

The Lead Motion Designer is responsible for advancing the motion design capabilities of the organization while ensuring motion remains a meaningful and integrated part of the creative process.

How You’ll CREATE

The Lead Motion Designer is responsible for defining and leading motion design execution across Digital Creative Services. Working at the intersection of design, storytelling, technology, and creative innovation, this role develops motion systems, animation approaches, and visual experiences that elevate artist brands, campaigns, and digital products.

Partnering closely with Creative Directors, Designers, Content Production teams, Developers, and Client stakeholders, the Lead Motion Designer translates creative vision into compelling motion-led experiences while establishing standards, workflows, and best practices that improve consistency and creative quality across the organization.

This role combines hands-on creative execution with creative leadership, serving as both a motion specialist and a trusted creative partner throughout the concept.

Motion Design Leadership

  • Lead motion design execution across campaigns, e-commerce experiences, content initiatives, and digital products

  • Define motion design principles, animation standards, and creative approaches across the organization

  • Establish scalable motion systems that support artist storytelling and brand expression

  • Ensure motion design enhances user experience, engagement, and creative effectiveness

  • Champion the role of motion throughout the creative development process

Creative Development

  • Partner with Creative Directors during concept development and experience design phases

  • Contribute motion-first thinking to creative briefs, presentations, and campaign development

  • Develop storyboards, motion explorations, prototypes, and visual concepts

  • Translate static creative concepts into engaging motion-based experiences

  • Explore innovative approaches to storytelling through animation and movement

Motion & Visual Execution

  • Create high-quality motion graphics, animations, and visual content across multiple channels and platforms

  • Develop content for artist campaigns, ecommerce experiences, social content, product launches, and branded storytelling initiatives

  • Lead the creation of motion assets ranging from micro-interactions and promotional content through to large-scale campaign experiences

  • Utilize 2D, 3D, compositing, visual effects, and emerging technologies where appropriate

  • Ensure all motion deliverables meet the highest creative and technical standards

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Designers, Content Producers, Developers, Editors, and Creative Directors

  • Support Development teams in implementing motion experiences across digital products and platforms

  • Partner with Content Production teams to integrate motion into content ecosystems and storytelling initiatives

  • Ensure motion execution aligns with project objectives, timelines, and technical requirements

  • Act as a motion design subject matter expert across the organization

Innovation & Capability Development

  • Drive the evolution of motion design capabilities within Digital Creative Services

  • Research emerging technologies, tools, platforms, and creative opportunities

  • Explore AI, real-time rendering, interactive motion, 3D, and immersive experience technologies

  • Mentor designers and creatives looking to strengthen motion capabilities

  • Contribute to the development of creative standards, workflows, and best practices

Bring Your VIBE

  • 5-8 years experience in motion design, animation, visual design, digital experiences, or related creative disciplines

  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating motion-led storytelling and creative problem solving

  • Advanced proficiency across After Effects, Cinema 4D, Blender, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and relevant motion tools

  • Strong understanding of animation principles, visual storytelling, design systems, and user experience

  • Experience working across campaigns, ecommerce, content production, digital products, or entertainment environments

  • Ability to move comfortably between strategic thinking and hands-on execution

  • Strong presentation, communication, and collaboration skills

  • Passion for music, culture, design, emerging technology, and creative innovation

Success Looks Like

  • Motion consistently elevates the quality and impact of creative work

  • Motion principles and standards are adopted across the organization

  • Creative concepts are strengthened through thoughtful animation and movement

  • Artists, brands, and campaigns benefit from distinctive and memorable motion experiences

  • Teams seek out motion expertise throughout the creative development process

  • New technologies and techniques continue to evolve the organization's creative capabilities

  • Digital Creative Services is recognized for best-in-class motion-led creative experiences

job.title: Manager, Catalog Creator
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How We LEAD
The Manager, Creator Catalog supports creator, influencer, and content marketing initiatives across Capitol Records’ Pop/Rock and Urban (Hip-Hop & R&B) catalog artists. This role brings iconic eras, anniversaries, archival moments, reissues, and culturally defining stories to life through strategic, authentic creator partnerships.


Working closely with Digital Marketing leadership and cross-functional teams, the Manager ensures creator content reflects each artist’s legacy while driving discovery and engagement among both long-standing fans and new generations. Managing Pop/Rock and Urban catalogs requires an understanding that creator strategies differ by genre—from storytelling style and platform behavior to cultural context and creator communities—while still laddering up to a cohesive catalog vision.


A general global awareness is important, ensuring creator strategies can scale across markets when appropriate without losing cultural authenticity.


How You’ll CREATE


Creator, Influencer & Content Strategy

  • Lead day-to-day execution of creator and influencer marketing across Pop/Rock and Urban catalog campaigns.
  • Identify and source creators whose content aligns organically with each genre—ranging from nostalgia-driven and performance-based storytelling in Pop/Rock to culturally rooted commentary, dance, lifestyle, fashion, education, and production-focused creators in Urban.
  • Apply genre-aware thinking when recommending creators, formats, and platforms—recognizing that Pop/Rock and Urban audiences engage with content differently.
  • Recommend creators for key territories when campaigns require international amplification.
  • Support initiatives tied to anniversaries, classic albums, reissues, remasters, box sets, archival releases, and cultural milestones.

Campaign Development & Execution

  • Manage creator sourcing, outreach, briefings, deliverable tracking, approvals, and ongoing communication.
  • Maintain clear, professional communication between creators, internal teams, artist partners, and estates.
  • Activate creator content around key release moments, platform trends, cultural conversations, and genre-specific cycles.
  • Ensure all creator output aligns with campaign objectives, artist legacy, and broader catalog strategy.

Insights, Data & Optimization

  • Use platform analytics, cultural trends, and genre knowledge to identify creators who feel authentic to each campaign.
  • Track creator performance across platforms and compile insights for internal teams.
  • Identify opportunities to scale high-performing content or optimize underperforming activations.
  • Incorporate cross-market insights when evaluating creator effectiveness and reach.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Catalog and Core label teams across Marketing, Digital, Creative, A&R Research, Production, Revenue, and Commercial to support catalog priorities.
  • Support integration of Capitol Records’ broader creator and content networks across Pop/Rock and Urban initiatives.
  • Ensure creator content reinforces artist brand, campaign narrative, and long-term catalog positioning.
  • Stay aligned with Digital Marketing leadership to ensure execution reflects overall strategy and priorities.

Bring Your VIBE

  • 3+ years of creator or influencer marketing experience within music, digital media, or adjacent cultural spaces
  • Experience working with Pop/Rock and/or Urban (Hip-Hop & R&B) creators strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of creator ecosystems, platform trends, and fan behavior across genres
  • Comfort managing relationships with creators, artist teams, estates, and internal partners
  • Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple catalog campaigns simultaneously
  • Strategic thinker who understands the balance between paid and organic creator programs
  • Passion for music history and interest in how legacy content connects with modern and global audiences

job.title: Manager, Commercial Partnerships
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Based in Nashville, Tennessee and reporting to the Director, Commercial Partnerships, Universal Music Canada, the Manager, Commercial Partnerships will oversee Universal Music Canada’s social strategy across our entire domestic roster, developing and consistently optimizing social plans that amplify key moments within an artist timeline, while also using data to uncover key areas of opportunity for our artists in the social space.

This role is UMC’s expert on social accounts and acts as a champion for our artists globally within the social media space. The role will also serve as a Nashville extension of the Commercial Partnerships team based in Toronto and is expected to act as a local resource for UMC. This includes providing on-the-ground support for domestic artists, attending industry events, and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders.

How You'll CREATE:

  • Lead social media strategy for UMC Canada’s domestic artist roster, overseeing planning, execution, performance analysis, and ongoing optimization across key markets.

  • Manage and optimize artist social accounts, ensuring profiles are accurate, strategically aligned, and effectively support artist development and campaign objectives.

  • Identify and leverage commercial partnership opportunities, collaborating with artists, platforms, and stakeholders to drive promotional, marketing, and business development initiatives.

  • Use data and analytics to uncover audience growth opportunities, measure campaign performance, and provide actionable insights that improve results.

  • Provide social media expertise and strategic guidance to marketing, artist, and management teams, identifying key moments and opportunities within artist campaigns and release cycles.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with social platform partners and global counterparts, sharing best practices, campaign learnings, and emerging digital trends.

  • Support continuous improvement of social processes and capabilities through reporting, knowledge sharing, and ongoing learning across teams.

  • Serve as UMC’s Nashville representative, building and maintaining strong relationships across the local music community, including artists, management, industry stakeholders, and partners.

  • Act as a key liaison between the Nashville and Canadian music communities, facilitating connections and supporting collaboration opportunities for UMC artists and teams.

  • Help coordinate and support artist, partner, corporate, and industry events in Nashville, including showcases, conferences, activations, and networking opportunities that advance UMC Canada’s strategic priorities.

Bring Your VIBE:

  • • 3–5 years of relevant experience

  • • Expertise in social media best practices and optimization

job.description:

Capitol Christian Music Group is seeking a Manager, Data and Analytics to join our growing Data team in artist and business intelligence across the label.
Reporting to the Vice President, Data and Insights, this role will analyze large datasets across streaming and digital platforms, social media, and audience engagement channels to identify trends, measure performance, and uncover opportunities for artist growth. The ideal candidate will translate complex data into clear summaries and actionable recommendations that inform
decisions across business development and artist strategy. The role is ideal for a solutions oriented, intellectually curious self-starter with a passion for music and a drive to continuously evolve data capabilities and impact.


How You’ll CREATE
• Analyze large datasets across music streaming platforms (e.g., Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube), social media, fan engagement, and marketing performance to identify meaningful trends and opportunities.
• Own ongoing reporting, performance analysis, and insight delivery across the label in partnership with data leadership.
• Develop and maintain dashboards and data visualizations to enable teams to track performance and uncover insights.
• Query and manipulate data using SQL, Python, and similar tools to support both recurring reporting and ad-hoc analysis.
• Build customized analyses and reports across revenue, consumption and marketing data.
• Deliver data-driven analyses that inform marketing and digital strategy and support business initiatives.
• Maintain and validate data pipelines to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of analytics outputs.
• Partner cross-functionally with marketing, digital, and commercial teams to answer key business questions through data.
• Monitor trends across streaming, social, and audience engagement platforms to surface emerging signals relevant to artist development and marketing.

• Experience working with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or similar platforms.
• Experience working with large, complex datasets and applying analytical thinking to derive insights.
• Music, media, or entertainment industry experience is a plus but not required.
• Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related analytical field.
• Passion for music and curiosity about how fans discover and engage with artists.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill large datasets into concise, actionable insights.
• Familiarity with streaming, social media, and digital audience data is a plus.
• Ability to build dynamic models and analyses and translate data findings into clear insights and concise summaries.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.

job.title: Manager, eCommerce Marketing
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Famehouse, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Famehouse powers D2C for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration—both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of D2C & merchandise for artists, providing a full-service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more. 
 
How we LEAD: 


Merchandise and commerce are part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent. 


The Manager, Site Marketing turns traffic, campaign demand, product priorities, and artist moments into high-impact storefront strategies that drive conversion, sell-through, fan engagement, and revenue growth. This role owns the non-creative site strategy across merchandising, product placement, promotional planning, campaign destinations, homepage, and collection strategy, PDP optimization, key shopping moments, and alignment with CRM, paid media, and other acquisition channels. 


Core responsibilities of this role include: 

  •  Lead on-site marketing programming across the sites, including promotions, to achieve store revenue and conversion goals. 
  •  Optimize fan journeys from traffic source to product discovery, storytelling, offer, and purchase. 
  • Align cross-channel execution with paid media, email, CRM, social, label, and artist teams. 
  • Merchandise and prioritize products, collections, campaigns, and offers on the storefront to drive engagement, conversion, and revenue. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve site performance through testing, merchandising adjustments, landing page optimization, offer strategy, and improved shopping paths. 
  • Translate artist priorities, label needs, inventory considerations, product performance, and commercial goals into an actionable site plan. 

This role requires a strategic, commercially minded, highly collaborative manager who can balance long-term planning with fast-moving priorities. The ideal candidate understands how fans shop, how campaigns translate across ecommerce storefronts, and how product performance should inform merchandising, promotional, and customer journey decisions. They should be comfortable leading workstreams, making clear recommendations, building alignment across cross-functional partners, and bringing structure, judgment, and momentum to a high-volume environment. 


How you'll CREATE: 
 
Site Marketing Strategy & Commercial Planning 

  • Own site marketing strategy for a portfolio of artist stores, ensuring storefront activity aligns to commercial priorities, artist moments, fan demand, and revenue goals. 
  • Build and manage site marketing calendars that coordinate releases, product drops, promotions, tour moments, seasonal opportunities, CRM pushes, paid media campaigns, and evergreen selling periods. 
  • Prioritize the highest-value opportunities across stores and campaigns, balancing business impact, artist priorities, product performance, traffic drivers, and operational feasibility. 
  • Translate campaign demand, product priorities, and artist moments into clear storefront plans that define what should show up, where it should appear, when it should launch, and how it should support conversion. 
  • Lead planning conversations with cross-functional partners to ensure site strategy is proactive, commercially grounded, and clearly connected to broader marketing and revenue goals. 

 
On-Site Campaigns, Promotions & Merchandising 

  • Lead planning and execution of on-site marketing campaigns that support new releases, product launches, catalog moments, artist exclusives, preorders, restocks, tour activity, limited-edition drops, and seasonal moments. 
  • Own merchandising recommendations across homepages, collections, product pages, campaign destinations, navigation paths, cart moments, and other key storefront placements. 
  • Determine how products, collections, campaigns, and offers are surfaced, sequenced, and prioritized to improve product discovery, fan engagement, conversion, average order value, and sell-through. 
  • Develop promotional strategies across sitewide and artist-specific moments, including offer placement, messaging, landing page strategy, timing, and coordination with CRM, paid media, and other marketing channels. 
  • Use proven ecommerce levers such as discounts, bundles, free shipping, gift-with-purchase, exclusives, presale access, urgency messaging, and limited-time moments to support demand capture and conversion. 
  • Ensure storefront plans reflect artist brand, campaign strategy, customer needs, and commercial opportunity while making it easy for fans to discover and purchase priority products. 

 
Fan Journey & Storefront Optimization  

  • Shape customer journeys from traffic source to product discovery, storytelling, offer, purchase, and repeat engagement. 
  • Develop landing page and campaign destination strategies, including product hierarchy, content flow, collection logic, module placement, CTA strategy, and shopping paths. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve site flow, content clarity, product visibility, merchandising logic, and conversion paths across priority stores and campaigns. 
  • Partner with CRM, paid media, and label marketing teams to ensure traffic-driving efforts connect to the right site destinations, messaging, products, and commercial priorities. 
  • Recommend updates before, during, and after key campaigns based on fan behavior, business performance, and real-time opportunities. 

 
Performance, Insights & Optimization 

  • Monitor store, campaign, product, and customer journey performance to identify opportunities to improve conversion, sell-through, average order value, engagement, and revenue. 
  • Partner with Insights and other Commercial teams to understand product trends, inventory opportunities, pricing sensitivity, conversion behavior, and underperforming SKUs. 
  • Translate performance insights into actionable site marketing recommendations, including merchandising updates, campaign pivots, promotional tests, product recirculation, landing page adjustments, and shopping path improvements. 
  • Develop clear readouts and next-step recommendations that connect site performance to commercial outcomes. 
  • Support testing opportunities across promotional mechanics, merchandising approaches, landing page structures, product sequencing, content placement, and conversion paths. 

 
Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment 

  • Act as a strategic connector across Commercial, CRM, Paid Media, Creative, Product Performance, Analytics, Operations, labels, artist teams, and storefront/site partners. 
  • Ensure campaigns are aligned across site strategy, traffic-driving channels, product priorities, promotional timing, creative needs, messaging, and business goals. 
  • Lead cross-functional planning conversations, bringing clarity to priorities, timelines, dependencies, owners, and next steps. 
  • Proactively surface risks, blockers, tradeoffs, and opportunities, while helping teams move toward practical, commercially sound decisions. 
  • Build trust with partners by communicating clearly, following through consistently, and balancing strategic thinking with operational discipline. 

 
Manager-Level Ownership & Judgement 

  • Bring structure, prioritization, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment with multiple stores, campaigns, stakeholders, and competing priorities. 
  • Make informed recommendations with confidence, using commercial context, customer behavior, product performance, and business goals to guide decisions. 
  • Exercise strong judgment when balancing artist needs, revenue opportunities, customer clarity, operational realities, and timing considerations. 
  • Build alignment with cross-functional partners, using clear rationale, data, and strong relationship-building. 
  • Anticipate needs before they become blockers and help create a more proactive, strategic, and performance-focused site marketing function. 
  • Operate with ownership, accountability, curiosity, and a solutions-oriented mindset, while remaining adaptable as priorities evolve. 

Bring your VIBE: 

  • 5+ years of experience in site/D2C marketing, ecommerce, digital marketing, site merchandising, campaign marketing, promotional strategy, or a related field. 
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce strategy, storefront merchandising, promotional planning, customer journeys, conversion optimization, and performance-driven growth. 
  • Proven ability to translate commercial priorities, campaign goals, product performance, and customer behavior into clear site marketing strategies and actionable plans. 
  • Experience managing multiple campaigns, calendars, launches, priorities, and stakeholders in a fast-moving ecommerce or digital environment. 
  • Comfortable using performance data to identify insights, make recommendations, influence decisions, and optimize campaigns before, during, and after launch. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex inputs into clear briefs, recaps, recommendations, and next steps. 
  • Excellent judgment and prioritization skills, especially when balancing artist needs, revenue opportunities, customer clarity, operational constraints, and competing deadlines. 
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and accountable, with strong follow-through and the ability to keep workstreams moving without constant direction. 
  • Confident leading cross-functional conversations, aligning stakeholders, and creating clarity around priorities, timing, dependencies, and ownership. 
  • Strong relationship-builder who can earn trust across teams, influence without authority, and bring partners along through clear rationale and collaborative problem-solving. 
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to anticipate risks, surface tradeoffs, and recommend practical paths forward. 
  • Curious about fan behavior, artist culture, digital commerce, and how storefronts can deepen the fan-to-artist connection while driving measurable business results. 
  • Strong instincts as an online shopper and a clear point of view on what makes a storefront compelling, easy to shop, and commercially effective. 
  • Balanced leadership style with confidence, humility, adaptability, and a no-ego approach to collaboration. 
  • Familiarity with email/CRM, paid media, social commerce, affiliate, or other acquisition channels. 
  • Experience with site merchandising, CMS tools, landing page strategy, PDP optimization, cart strategy, or frontend QA. 

 
A plus, but not required: 

  • Experience in music, entertainment, fashion, streetwear, consumer products, artist merchandising, or fan commerce. 
  • Experience with Shopify or similar ecommerce platforms. 
  • Understanding of UX principles, consumer behavior, analytics, A/B testing, or conversion rate optimization. 
  • Project management experience or experience leading complex workstreams across multiple teams.

job.title: Manager, Marketing Strategy (Label-Managed Catalog)
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We are seeking a strategic and highly organized Marketing Manager, Recordings, looking after the catalogs of the actively signed/on-roster artists across Island Records.

The role will identify, develop, and execute campaigns across the assigned roster employing modern, dynamic ‘always-on’ approach.  As the central point of contact for projects, the candidate should have knowledge across the spectrum of modern music marketing strategies including Digital Marketing (short form video trends, ad strategy, influencer strategy), Commerce (physical and digital product delivery, DSP landscape), eCommerce (artist and label stores), CRM, audience growth, and more.   The successful candidate has a passionate view of catalog as a living, evolving asset that fuels artist growth, fan engagement, and revenue.

How you’ll CREATE:

Catalog Strategy & Planning

  • Identify opportunities to reframe and reintroduce catalog through storytelling and content.
  • Manage and at times develop marketing plans aligned with current releases, touring, anniversaries, and cultural moments for the actively signed artists across the labels of the Republic Collective.
  • Support catalog as a growth engine for audience expansion and discovery.

Project Management & Execution

  • Own timelines, workflows, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.
  • Coordinate across internal teams and artist mgmt. teams to ensure seamless execution.
  • Benchmark campaign success against spend and consumption.
  • Serve as a central point of contact for projects.

Digital Marketing & Audience Growth

  • Partner with digital marketing teams on Resurgent Track campaigns, DSP strategy, social activations, first party data collection initiatives, advertising, content, and more.
  • Use data insights to inform targeting and optimization.

job.title: Marketing Manager
job.description:
Universal Music Canada is Canada’s leading music company, engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content.  Home to the most comprehensive catalogue of recordings and songs across every musical genre, UMC is committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship in broadening opportunities for our artists on both the domestic and world stages as well as creating new experiences for fans.
 

Universal Music Canada is part of Universal Music Group, the world leader in music-based entertainment.
 

We are searching for creative, innovative, and passionate people to fill a current vacancy on our team. If you love music and are excited about joining this amazing organization, we would love to meet you!

Marketing Manager - Virgin Music Group

The team works four days a week from our award-winning creative campus located in Liberty Village, Toronto, and one day to work virtually.

Reporting to the Sr. Vice President – Head of Marketing North America, the Marketing Manager at Virgin Music Group Canada will be responsible for leading and executing innovative artist marketing campaigns across domestic and international markets. The Marketing Manager will act as the strategic and operational lead for artist projects, overseeing end-to-end campaign development while collaborating with internal departments, label partners, artists, managers, and external agencies. The ideal candidate is a creative, culturally connected, and commercially minded marketer with a strong understanding of the evolving music landscape, fan engagement, and digital marketing.

How You’ll Lead:

  • Lead and execute artist marketing campaigns from strategy development through launch and post-campaign analysis

  • Develop fan-first marketing strategies that drive artist awareness, audience engagement, streaming growth, and commercial success across digital and physical formats

  • Collaborate with artists, managers, label partners, and internal teams to create rollout plans aligned with artist brand positioning and long-term career goals

  • Manage local campaign strategy, timelines, budgets, creative development, and execution

  • Develop and oversee digital marketing initiatives including short-form content, influencer activations, creator partnerships, paid media campaigns, and emerging platform opportunities

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with artists, managers, agencies, promoters, digital platforms, and third-party partners

  • Provide local marketing guidance and strategic support to label partners and distribution clients

  • Collaborate with global and local teams to ensure campaigns are aligned across territories while incorporating market-specific insights

  • Manage local marketing budgets effectively while maximizing return on investment

  • Identify and capitalize on cultural moments, viral trends, and emerging opportunities to maximize fan engagement and visibility.

  • Support DSP pitches, proposals, and business development initiatives for prospective clients and artist partnerships

  • Maintain a strong understanding of evolving music industry trends, digital platforms, audience behaviors, and emerging marketing technologies

  • Other duties and projects as assigned

What You Bring:

  • 4-6 years of marketing experience in the creative industry

  • Strong understanding of the music industry, including artist marketing, label operations, streaming platforms, audience development, and release strategies

  • Deep knowledge of digital marketing, social media, creator marketing, content strategy, and fan engagement best practices

  • Understanding of domestic and international music markets, media landscapes, and commercial opportunities

  • Experience developing and executing successful music marketing campaigns across multiple genres

  • Understanding of global music distribution structures and the independent music ecosystem

  • Experience with cross-promotional marketing, branding partnerships, and experiential campaigns is an asset

  • Working knowledge of paid media, CRM strategies, eCommerce integration, and first-party fan data collection

  • Experience using digital tools, analytics platforms, and marketing technologies to inform campaign decisions

  • Positivity, passion, a competitive edge, and opinions you can stand behind

  • Bold, ambitious, creative thinking; an entrepreneurial style and a growth mindset

  • Excellent communication skills anchored by honesty, approachability, and an open mind

The ideal candidate will have deep hands-on experience with next-generation firewall technologies, a strong focus on security standardization, and the ability to partner closely with Cybersecurity and Infrastructure teams in a global enterprise environment.

job.title: Senior Coordinator, Content Strategy
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Fame House, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Fame House powers eCommerce for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration, both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD:

Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent.

At Digital Creative & Experience, we create experiences that connect artists with fans through storytelling, design, content, commerce, and culture. From artist storefronts and ecommerce experiences to campaigns, content initiatives, and fan engagement programs, the Design & Direction team is responsible for defining the creative vision that brings artist brands to life across every digital touchpoint.

The Creative Direction team establishes the creative frameworks, visual identities, and experience principles that guide how work is conceived, developed, and executed. Working closely with Design, Content Production, Development, Project Management, and Client teams, we ensure every experience balances artistic expression, audience engagement, and business performance.

Role Overview

The Senior Coordinator, Content Strategy is responsible for the planning, governance, and execution of content placement across UMG's eCommerce experiences. Working closely with Creative, Merchandising, Content Production, Development, and Project Management teams, this role owns the creation and oversight of eCommerce placement plans, ensuring every product is accurately represented from planning through launch.

Serving as the central source of truth for product assets and placement requirements, this role is responsible for maintaining the integrity of content across our eCommerce storefronts. Through rigorous quality control, they ensure all products, imagery, copy, and associated assets align with approved placement plans prior to photography and publication, helping deliver a consistent and high-quality customer experience.

The Senior Coordinator plays a critical role in connecting cross-functional teams, maintaining visibility across content readiness, and ensuring assets, documentation, and placement standards remain accurate, organized, and accessible throughout the campaign lifecycle. They proactively identify content gaps, resolve discrepancies, and drive operational consistency to support successful product launches.

This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about eCommerce operations, digital merchandising, and content excellence. They thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy building structure through process, and take pride in ensuring every customer-facing experience is executed with accuracy and consistency.

How You'll CREATE:

eCommerce Content Strategy & Placement

  • Own the creation, maintenance, and execution of eCommerce placement plans across artist and label storefronts.

  • Develop merchandising placement strategies that ensure products, collections, and campaigns are accurately represented across all digital storefronts.

  • Partner with Creative, Merchandising, Client Services, and Production teams to align placement plans with campaign objectives and commercial priorities.

  • Translate campaign requirements into clear content placement documentation that serves as the single source of truth for execution.

  • Continuously review and optimize placement standards to improve consistency, customer experience, and operational efficiency.

Content Quality Control & Asset Governance

  • Lead quality control reviews of all products and associated assets against approved placement plans prior to photography and site publication.

  • Validate that products, imagery, copy, collections, variants, and metadata are complete, accurate, and aligned to merchandising requirements.

  • Identify and resolve content discrepancies before they impact downstream production or customer-facing experiences.

  • Maintain ownership of content accuracy across eCommerce platforms, ensuring consistency across all artist storefronts.

  • Act as the central source of truth for product assets, ensuring all approved creative and content is current, accessible, and properly version controlled.

Content Operations & Coordination

  • Coordinate content readiness across Creative, Production, Merchandising, Development, and Project Management teams.

  • Manage content timelines, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure assets are available ahead of key campaign milestones.

  • Support product launches by ensuring all required assets, approvals, and placement documentation are complete.

  • Maintain content documentation, placement guides, and operational standards across multiple concurrent projects.

  • Proactively identify risks, blockers, or gaps that may impact content readiness or launch timelines.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for content placement and asset management across cross-functional teams.

  • Partner closely with Creative, Merchandising, Content Production, Client Services, and eCommerce Operations to ensure seamless execution.

  • Facilitate communication around content changes, asset updates, and placement requirements throughout campaign lifecycles.

  • Support continuous improvement of content workflows, documentation, and governance processes.

job.description:

  • Familiarity with industry data providers and platforms such as Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music, TikTok, Meta, Luminate, Chartmetric, SoundCloud, Pandora, or similar consumption and audience analytics platforms.
  • Understanding of artist lifecycle analytics, audience development, catalog performance, playlisting, fan engagement, and commercial music performance measurement.

job.title: Senior Manager, Business Affairs Administration
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

As a member of the Business & Legal Affairs team, you'll play a key role in helping bring new music and video releases to market by managing rights clearances and licensing activities across a diverse roster of artists. You'll partner with teams across Business & Legal Affairs, A&R, Marketing, Production, Revenue, Licensing, Artist Management, and external rights holders to ensure releases move forward efficiently while mitigating legal and business risks.

This role is ideal for a highly organized, solutions-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex rights issues, and is passionate about the music industry. The successful candidate will have 3-5 years of music licensing, legal, or business affairs experience and be eager to expand their expertise in artist, sample, synchronization, and content clearances.

How you'll CREATE:

Rights Clearance & Release Support

  • Coordinate and manage music and video clearances by working with third-party labels, publishers, licensors, clearance agencies, artist management, and internal stakeholders to secure all required approvals for commercial releases.
  • Manage the end-to-end clearance process, tracking requests, monitoring timelines, and helping resolve complex rights issues that could impact release schedules.
  • Advise internal teams on clearance requirements, ownership splits, and licensing considerations for samples, side artists, compilations, soundtrack projects, and synchronization opportunities.

Contract Drafting & Administration

  • Draft, review, and administer a variety of music agreements, including Sample Agreements, Side Artist Agreements, Label Waivers (including Profit Split arrangements), and Soundtrack and Synchronization License Agreements.
  • Manage agreement execution, maintain accurate contract records, distribute finalized agreements to appropriate stakeholders, and coordinate supporting documentation for payment processing.

Risk Assessment & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Review music video treatments and final content to identify potential copyright, trademark, publicity, and reputational risks, partnering with Legal executives to resolve issues before release.
  • Collaborate closely with Business & Legal Affairs, A&R, Marketing, Production, Revenue, Licensing, Artist Management, and Legal teams to support artist releases and commercial licensing initiatives.
  • Partner with synchronization and catalog licensing teams to facilitate soundtrack placements and other licensing opportunities.

Process Management

  • Maintain organized tracking systems and documentation to ensure visibility into project status, contractual obligations, and clearance milestones.
  • Recommend and support process improvements that increase operational efficiency and enhance cross-functional collaboration.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 3-5 years of experience in music industry licensing, business affairs, legal administration, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of music copyright, licensing, publishing, and recording agreements.
  • Experience drafting and administering music-related agreements is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and sound judgment when navigating complex rights issues.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively across departments.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining confidentiality.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Familiarity with UMG systems is a plus.
  • Passion for music and the evolving entertainment landscape.

You understand that modern data platforms must not only support reporting, but also enable machine learning, generative AI, and intelligent applications through high-quality, well-governed, semantically consistent enterprise data.

In this role, you will lead teams of data engineers responsible for delivering domain-specific data products, semantic layers, and data marts that serve as trusted, AI-ready sources of truth across the organization, while shaping how data is structured, governed, and exposed to support AI/ML use cases, feature engineering, and semantic consistency across tools and applications.

  • Experience driving data quality, governance, and observability frameworks critical for AI trust and explainability.

We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

The Senior Manager, Global Data and Analytics will report directly into the EVP, Global Data and Analytics, and will support REPUBLIC Collective in implementing analytics strategy across A&R and Marketing by designing and developing innovative, highly adopted data-driven solutions (tools and applications) to solve critical business problems.

How you’ll CREATE:

  • Connect business strategy to research insights and translate them into impeccable design solutions, delivering products with mass adoption and daily engagement across all key areas of REPUBLIC Collective and our artist partners.

  • Serve as an embed for all data-related questions and actions across the label group to generate maximum ROI with minimum

    turnaround time to implementation.

  • Alongside existing engineering teams, iterate on innovative and bespoke product features that solve the most important and

    commercially impactful problems for the business which are easy-to-use, driving mass-adoption amongst marketing and A&R

    teams, and artist management partners.

  • Develop and execute a variety of effective and efficient UX research processes, with the goal of a repeatable, clear,

    benchmarked, and actionable end products.

  • Help identify, maintain, and clean the best data pipelines to help ensure we are mining all available information in service of

    industry leading KPI’s to impact efficiency and effectiveness across A&R and marketing.

  • Build and refine an extensive knowledge of real-time users and their needs across all areas of the business and our label and

    artist partners, resulting in best-practice qualitative and quantitative research techniques that fit the current and future needs of

    the business.

Bring your VIBE:

  • Passion and curiosity for music and the data that is used within the industry, preferably with an-depth knowledge of current music industry trends including key account, consumption pattern shifts, and the impact/variety of social media.

  • Ability to query our databases (using platforms such as BigQuery) accurately and efficiently using Python, SQL and/orJavaScript

  • Advanced level Excel skills, with the ability to develop dynamic models using named ranges / formulaic references

  • Understanding of API usage for importing data for analysis

  • Understanding of TikTok and social media trends

  • Familiarity with statistical concepts and tools, along with the ability to use them effectively in analyses

  • Ability to visualize data within Looker, Alteryx, Tableau, DOMO, or other data visualization platforms.

  • Interest and ability in building, training, deploying, scaling and maintaining deep-learning models

  • Adept in distilling large amounts of data into concise, actionable summaries.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented team player.

  • Ability to present findings in a visually compelling and articulate manner.

  • Self-sufficient with the confidence to independently pursue information.

  • Ability to thrive in fast paced environment, manage multiple tasks at once and work to deadlines

  • 3-5+ years of work experience in data analysis, management consulting, entertainment industry analysis, or similar role. Music Industry preferred but not required.

  • Experience working with analytical tools including, but not limited to Excel, Tableau, BigQuery, Alteryx, etc. BS in Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a similarly quantitative degree

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement

  • 401(k) with 100% immediate vesting on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees

  • 3-weeks PTO for non-exempt employees

  • 2-weeks paid Winter Break

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day)

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day)

  • Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent

job.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Planning and Analysis
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Famehouse, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in merchandise & D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Famehouse powers merch and D2C for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration—both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of D2C & merchandise for artists, providing a full-service solution to grow an artist’s owned business across channels, including strategy, creative, merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD:

Famehouse is looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Planning & Analysis to help us build stronger revenue projections, planning, and business visibility across our D2C and merchandise services for artists & labels.

This role will sit within the Insights team and work closely with account teams, channel leads, finance, merchandise planning, operations, and label partners. The right person will help us better understand where revenue is coming from, where the opportunities are, and how we can make smarter, more proactive decisions across D2C, touring, and retail merchandise.

We’re looking for someone who is highly analytical, strategically oriented, and comfortable turning messy inputs into clear, useful planning tools and recommendations. Ideal candidates bring a strong existing understanding of the nuances of the music industry, and have an ability to balance both art and science in their work.

How You’ll CREATE:

  • Drive revenue planning and analysis across D2C, touring, and retail merchandise channels

  • Partner with account managers, channel and commercial teams to build, pressure-test, and refine artist and campaign projections across the roster

  • Develop practical forecasting models, planning frameworks, and projection methodologies that can scale across the business

  • Work closely with merchandise planning, finance, operations, and label commercial teams to align on assumptions, timelines, reporting, and planning processes

  • Lead recurring executive reporting, compiling business reviews, and performance analysis

  • Identify risks, opportunities, and trends across artists, product categories, campaigns, and sales channels

  • Help shape the roadmap for stronger forecasting tools, reporting infrastructure, and planning workflows

  • Build clear analytical frameworks and reporting solutions that improve forecasting accuracy and commercial visibility

  • Help establish shared best practices for revenue forecasting, commercial planning, and business reviews across teams

Bring your VIBE:

  • 5–8 years of experience in forecasting, commercial analytics, retail planning, ecommerce strategy, business insights, or a similar analytical role

  • Experience in a major music company is strongly preferred

  • Strong analytical and modeling skills, with the ability to work across multiple teams and business functions

  • Experience building forecasting methodologies, planning processes, dashboards, and/or executive reporting

  • Familiarity with ecommerce, merchandise planning, retail analytics, touring, consumer products, or artist/label businesses

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly and simply

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with finance, merchandising, operations, commercial, and account teams

  • Ability to operate in an evolving, fast-moving business where the answer is not always obvious

  • Experience leading business performance reviews, with a strong understanding of P&L drivers and the ability to translate sales performance into strategic recommendations

  • Bonus points for experience building forecasting models and analytical tools, including leveraging modern data and AI capabilities to improve planning, forecasting, and decision-making

  • Familiarity with SQL, BigQuery, LookML, or similar analytical technologies, with the ability to prototype datasets, reporting layers, or forecasting solutions in partnership with technical teams

  • A proactive, curious, and solutions-oriented mindset

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement

  • 401(k) with 100% immediate vesting on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees

  • 3-weeks PTO for non-exempt employees

  • 2-weeks paid Winter Break

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day)

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day)

  • Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent

Check out our full overview of benefits on the Perks Playlist page of the career site.

How we LEAD:

The Senior Manager, ServiceNow Product & Service owns the Product Team’s portfolio of ServiceNow domains and is accountable for stakeholder relationships, prioritisation, and value delivery to internal customers. The role leads demand shaping, roadmap cadence, and outcomes-based reporting across domains (e.g., ITSM/Knowledge, HRSD/custom apps, CMDB, catalogue requests, access workflows, and asset-related capabilities) while ensuring alignment to platform guardrails and release cadence. Working within a globally distributed ServiceNow organisation, the role drives predictable delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement across multiple time zones.

  • Own overall stakeholder relationships, prioritization, and domain roadmaps across the Product Team portfolio

  • Run intake, demand shaping, and roadmap cadence; translate requests into outcomes, epics, and acceptance criteria

  • Drive cross-domain dependency management and alignment with platform guardrails and release windows

  • Own vulnerability management workflow outcomes and reporting with Security and IT partners

  • Own value measurement and reporting (KPIs, adoption, service outcomes) and drive continuous improvement

  • Lead escalation management, communications, and change enablement for Product-delivered capabilities

  • Partner effectively with a global ServiceNow team across multiple time zones (Sydney, Los Angeles, London, India) 

Bring your VIBE:

  • Executive-level stakeholder management; able to influence priorities and outcomes across IT and business units

  • Strong product/service ownership mindset; prioritize based on value, risk, and capacity with disciplined governance

  • Ability to run structured intake, roadmap planning, and delivery cadences to ensure predictable outcomes

  • Strong communication skills; translate technical constraints and trade-offs into business-relevant decisions

  • Ability to operate effectively in a global, multi-timezone team with clear coordination and handoffs

  • Working knowledge of ITSM/ITIL concepts and modern delivery practices (Agile/Lean) with pragmatic application 

  • 8+ years in service management, enterprise platforms, or technology product/service delivery environments

  • 3+ years in a senior role owning roadmaps, prioritization, and stakeholder outcomes for enterprise capabilities

  • Experience managing portfolios across multiple domains/modules with competing priorities and dependencies

  • Experience defining and measuring KPIs and value outcomes (adoption, service performance, delivery predictability)

  • Experience partnering with Security/IT stakeholders on vulnerability process outcomes and reporting

  • Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zonesServiceNow knowledge across key modules and platform concepts (ITSM, Catalog, Knowledge, CMDB/ITOM concepts, integrations)

job.title: Senior Product Manager
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We seek an experienced and driven Sr. Product Manager – Data Products within the Global Data & Analytics Products team. You are passionate about building scalable, high-quality data products that power analytics, machine learning, AI, and intelligent decision-making across UMG. You are equally comfortable discussing customer outcomes with business stakeholders as well as data architecture, pipelines, and semantic models with engineering teams.

You will lead the strategy and execution for data assets that enable trusted, governed datasets for teams across the business. Your work will lay the foundation for advanced ML & AI use cases, experimentation, personalization, automation, and enterprise reporting.

We are looking for a technically minded Product Manager who will partner closely with engineering, analytics, machine learning, governance, and business stakeholders to define products that are trusted, scalable, and AI-ready.

You enjoy working at the intersection of technology, data, and business strategy and are energized by solving complex platform problems and launching AI data products

This role will report to the Sr. Director of Product Management (Data Platform).

How you’ll CREATE:

  • Define product strategy for foundational data capabilities, including curated datasets, semantic models, feature stores, APIs, and data services that enable downstream analytics and AI applications

  • Define, track, and report key data product metrics, including adoption, data quality, latency, completeness, and downstream usage.

  • Define and deliver reusable, scalable, well-documented data assets for analytics, BI, ML, and operational use cases.

  • Partner with data engineering, governance, ML Engineering, and analytics teams to define data models, domain boundaries, data contracts, transformation logic, and data quality standards that enable scalable enterprise products.

  • Translate business requirements into technical product requirements, balancing usability, scalability, governance, and long-term platform vision.

  • Ensure data assets are structured to support experimentation, personalization, predictive analytics, and AI initiatives.

  • Support integrations with new data sources to enhance data completeness and enrichment

  • Remove impediments for engineering teams due to unclear requirements, misaligned priorities, or stakeholder ambiguity.

  • Leverage AI-assisted product management practices to accelerate discovery, documentation, prototyping, and delivery while maintaining strong governance and quality standards.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 5+ years of experience building data-intensive products, with a strong technical foundation in data engineering, analytics, or data architecture. Previous hands-on experience in one of these disciplines is highly desirable.

  • Demonstrated ability to earn credibility with highly technical engineering teams while effectively communicating complex concepts to executive and business stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of modern data architecture, dimensional modeling, semantic layers, data contracts, APIs, and scalable data platform design.

  • Experience partnering closely with data engineering and analytics teams to deliver scalable data solutions.

  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms, orchestration frameworks, data transformation tools, and metadata/governance platforms

  • Strong SQL skills with the ability to independently validate data, investigate issues, and collaborate effectively with engineers during solution design.

  • Experience in defining and measuring data quality and governance standards
