job.title: Senior Vice President, Artist and Label Services (REPUBLIC Collective)
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How We LEAD:

Famehouse is seeking a proven music marketing and merchandise executive to lead Account Management for artists and labels across the REPUBLIC Collective rosters, including Republic Records, Mercury, Island, Def Jam, MCA, Universal, and Uptown Records artists.
 

Based in New York, this leader will own senior artist and label relationships, guide long-term roster planning, and help build world-class merchandise and D2C businesses across eCommerce, tour, retail, and licensing.
 

The SVP will be accountable for delivering both creative and commercial goals while strengthening trust in Famehouse at every touchpoint. This requires a culturally fluent, artist-first leader with deep credibility in music marketing and merchandise, strong executive presence, high taste level, and the ability to inspire confidence across artist teams, label leadership, and internal partners.
 

Success in this role also requires exceptional people leadership: mentoring and motivating a high-performing Account Management team, fostering collaboration and accountability, and setting ego aside in service of the team, the artists we support, and the fans.

How You’ll CREATE:

Artist, Label & Roster Leadership

  • Lead Account Management across REPUBLIC Collective roster artists, overseeing a team of Account Managers in close alignment with wider Famehouse Accounts leadership.

  • Serve as the senior relationship lead for key label stakeholders and priority artist teams, building trusted, long-term partnerships.

  • Own strategic planning across artist rosters, ensuring merchandise and D2C plans are aligned with release cycles, touring, fan moments, and artist brand priorities.

  • Ensure Famehouse delivers exceptional artist, label, and fan experiences across every touchpoint.

Strategy, Growth & Commercial Performance

  • Define and drive the growth of artist merchandise and D2C businesses across eCommerce, tour, retail, and licensing.

  • Guide the development of best-in-class 12-month calendar strategies that balance creative ambition, commercial opportunity, and operational feasibility.

  • Oversee roster performance, ensuring the business is on track to meet or exceed revenue and growth targets without compromising margin.

  • Lead and support Artist & Label Business Reviews at the executive level, providing strategic insights and forward-looking recommendations.

  • Elevate the quality of artist proposals, go-to-market plans, and business storytelling, ensuring the team delivers compelling, high-impact strategies.

  • Champion a culture of energy, enthusiasm, and idea-selling, helping artists and labels feel inspired by Famehouse’s approach to merchandise and D2C.

  • Partner closely with REPUBLIC Collective label leadership, marketing, and creative teams to align on artist priorities and growth opportunities.

Cross-Functional Execution & Operating Standards

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Campaign Management, Commercial Strategy, Product, Creative, Marketing, and Operations to ensure seamless execution.

  • Establish and reinforce best practices, processes, and standards for client management, strategic planning, and cross-functional collaboration.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor, motivate, and develop Account Managers, creating clarity, accountability, and a culture of high performance.

  • Model low-ego, team-first leadership that prioritizes collaboration, trust, and excellence in service of artists, labels, fans, and Famehouse.

  • 12+ years of relevant music industry experience across label marketing, artist merchandise, D2C, brand management, or artist commerce.

  • Proven track record leading senior artist, manager, and/or label relationships with credibility, trust, and strong executive presence.

  • Deep understanding of artist development, release cycles, touring, fan engagement, and how merchandise / D2C strategies support broader artist goals.

  • Experience developing and selling through strategic marketing, merchandise, or commerce plans for high-priority artists or campaigns.

  • Strong commercial instincts, with the ability to balance creative ambition, artist priorities, revenue growth, margin, and operational feasibility.

  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams.

  • High taste level, strong creative judgment, and the ability to elevate artist proposals, positioning, and storytelling.

  • Low-ego, highly collaborative leadership style with a strong client-service mindset.

  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

You will be an essential partner to our development, infrastructure, and security teams, driving a culture of resilience and continuous improvement across the organization.

System Reliability & Performance 

Design, build, and maintain the availability, scalability, and performance of critical services.

Solid understanding of networking, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).

We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

We are currently seeking an experienced Sr. Identity Access Management Architect to lead architectural design, strategic planning, and delivery across the full Identity & Access Management landscape. The Sr. Identity Access Management Architect will play a critical role in shaping UMG’s global identity ecosystem across areas such as Access Management, IGA, PAM, Directory Services, and PKI.

This hands-on role will drive scalable and secure identity solutions, leading complex integrations across on-premises and multi-cloud environments. The successful candidate will possess deep technical expertise, a strategic mindset, and a strong ability to influence cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.

Job Functions:

  • Architect and design enterprise-wide IAM solutions aligned with business goals, security policies, and compliance requirements.

  • Provide leadership and oversight for strategic IAM functions including PAM, IGA, SSO, MFA, Federation, PKI, Directory Services, and Secrets Management.

  • Define technical direction for IAM tools and develop overall strategic framework for implementation across the company with an emphasis on standard configurations.

  • Lead architecture planning and lifecycle designs for all personas including employees, partners, customers, and non-human identities.

  • Establish the target-state identity architecture and effectively communicate and guide engineers to implementing that vision.

  • Develop secure and scalable authentication, authorization, and account provisioning workflows.

  • Partner with engineering teams to integrate identity services into applications and infrastructure using APIs and automation pipelines.

  • Evaluate complex business requirements and effectively guide cross-functional teams to implement secure identity frameworks.

  • Create and maintain architectural documentation, standards, and design patterns for IAM services.

  • Contribute to solution development and code when needed, and review designs to ensure compliance with architecture and security standards.

  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to communicate strategy, resolve roadblocks, and champion IAM modernization initiatives.

Job Requirements:

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in IAM or Security Architecture roles, with demonstrated success in designing enterprise-scale IAM platforms

  • Strong expertise with IAM protocols (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos, FIDO) and modern cloud identity models

  • Extensive hands-on experience with products like CyberArk, PingOne, Ping Davinci, EntraID, Saviynt, HashiCorp Vault, Digicert, Onfido, and Active Directory

  • Expert-level understanding of Authentication, Authorization, Directory Services, PKI, MFA, Federation, and PAM

  • Experience designing secure APIs and automating operational functions

  • Proven ability to lead architectural governance and collaborate across security, infrastructure, application, and compliance teams

  • Track record of implementing secure, scalable identity solutions in multi-cloud and hybrid environments

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization

  • Experience working in Agile environments with cross-functional engineering teams

Desirable:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator, or TOGAF

  • Background in risk-based authentication, adaptive access, and identity analytics

  • Experience in media, entertainment, or global enterprises

  • Experience in cloud application development and maintenance

  • Strong understanding of cloud security, container security, and zero trust architecture

  • Experience deploying passwordless technology in a hybrid environment

  • Knowledge of IAM-related compliance frameworks such as SOX, GDPR, NIST, ISO 27001

job.title: Stylist
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Fame House, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Fame House powers eCommerce for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration, both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD

Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent.

At Digital Creative& Experience, we create content that connects artists with fans across every touchpoint of the digital experience. From artist stores and ecommerce experiences to campaigns, social content, product launches, and brand storytelling initiatives, our Content Production team is responsible for bringing creative concepts to life through compelling visual experiences.

The Stylist plays a critical role in shaping how products, artists, and brands are represented through content. Working closely with Creative Directors, Producers, Photographers, Video Teams, and Content Production, this role helps transform creative vision into tangible visual execution that elevates storytelling, strengthens brand identity, and enhances the overall quality of content.

How You’ll CREATE

The Stylist is responsible for developing and executing styling solutions across photography, video, e-commerce, campaign, and branded content productions. This role ensures products, talent, props, and visual elements are presented in a way that supports creative objectives, reflects artist and brand identity, and delivers a consistent visual standard across all content.

Working closely with creative and production teams, the Stylist contributes throughout the production lifecycle, from concept development and pre-production planning through on-set execution and final asset delivery. Combining strong aesthetic judgment with exceptional organization and attention to detail, this role helps create engaging visual experiences that connect with audiences and support business objectives.

  • Develop styling approaches that align with creative direction, artist identity, and campaign objectives

  • Partner with Creative Directors and Producers during concept development and pre-production planning

  • Source, organize, and prepare wardrobe, props, accessories, and styling elements for productions

  • Style talent, products, and environments across photography and video shoots

  • Ensure styling execution supports brand standards, creative treatments, and storytelling objectives

  • Collaborate with photographers, video operators, content producers, and production teams during shoots

  • Manage styling continuity across multiple assets, channels, and deliverables

  • Prepare shoot decks, reference materials, mood boards, and styling recommendations

  • Coordinate with external vendors, stylists, wardrobe providers, and production partners when required

  • Manage styling inventory, organization, and asset tracking

  • Support product preparation and presentation for ecommerce and merchandising content

  • Identify opportunities to elevate visual quality and improve content effectiveness

  • Stay informed on fashion, music, cultural, and visual trends that influence artist and consumer behavior

  • Ensure all styling elements are prepared, maintained, and executed to the highest standard

Bring Your VIBE

  • 3-5 years experience in styling, fashion, content production, ecommerce, editorial, entertainment, or creative agency environments

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating styling work across photography, video, ecommerce, or campaign content

  • Deep understanding of visual storytelling, styling principles, and brand expression

  • Experience working with products, talent, artists, and creative teams

  • Strong organizational and project management skills

  • Ability to manage multiple productions and deadlines simultaneously

  • Exceptional attention to detail and visual consistency

  • Strong understanding of current fashion, music, cultural, and consumer trends

  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across creative and production teams

  • Passion for music, culture, fashion, and content creation

Success Looks Like

  • Styling consistently elevates the quality and effectiveness of content

  • Artist, brand, and campaign identities are represented accurately and authentically

  • Productions run efficiently with styling elements fully prepared and organized

  • Products and talent are presented to the highest visual standard

  • Creative teams trust styling recommendations and expertise

  • Content delivers a cohesive visual experience across channels and touchpoints

job.title: Vice President, Enterprise Data Governance and Strategy
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How You’ll Lead:

The Vice President, Data Governance & Strategy is a senior executive leader responsible for defining and operationalizing a comprehensive enterprise data governance and data strategy across UMG. This role ensures that critical data assets—spanning music rights, royalties, digital consumption, fan engagement, e-commerce and merchandise (online and on-tour), physical products, and artist development—are accurate, trusted, compliant, and strategically leveraged.

Operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology, privacy, and partnerships, the VP champions a data-driven culture and enables scalable, compliant data usage that fuels monetization, fan growth, and innovation in a rapidly evolving global music ecosystem.

How You’ll Create:

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and drive the enterprise data strategy to support business growth, monetization of music assets, and fan engagement.

  • Identify and assess new fan data sources and partnership opportunities aligned with the enterprise data strategy, accounting for label and regional differences.

  • Align data initiatives with music industry trends, business priorities, and evolving digital platforms, including streaming, social platforms, AI-enabled services, and emerging distribution models.

  • Partner with C-level executives and senior leaders across Legal, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, HR, and Technology to integrate data insights into strategic and operational decision-making.

  • Serve as a trusted executive advisor on data value, risk, and opportunity across the organization.

Data Governance

  • Develop and implement a robust, scalable data governance framework covering:

    • Fan, CRM, and e-commerce data

    • Digital consumption and DSP reporting

    • Artist, repertoire, and product metadata

    • Financial, royalty, and rights data

  • Establish clear data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, and accountability models across business units and regions.

  • Standardize data definitions and identifiers (e.g., ISRC, ISWC, IPI) to ensure consistency, transparency, and auditability across systems and partners.

  • Ensure compliance with global music rights regulations, licensing requirements, and data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), in close partnership with Legal, Privacy, and Security teams.

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Work cross-functionally with legal, operations, analytics, product, and technology teams to operationalize governance standards through platforms, processes, and workflows.

  • Promote data literacy, stewardship, and accountability across departments and business units.

  • Lead organizational change to position data as a managed enterprise asset, enabling trusted insights and scalable innovation.

Technology, Innovation & Future-Readiness

  • Evaluate, select, and deploy enterprise data governance and cataloging technologies supporting discovery, classification, lineage, quality monitoring, and access controls.

  • Drive automation and scalability in data ingestion, normalization, and reconciliation from digital platforms such as Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, TikTok, and emerging channels.

AI Readiness, Responsible AI & Privacy by Design

  • Facilitate in establishing AI-ready data foundations, ensuring data used for advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI is accurate, well-governed, traceable, and ethically sourced.

  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Technology teams to define and operationalize AI governance frameworks, including controls for data usage, consent, provenance, bias mitigation, explainability, and auditability.

  • Embed privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default principles into AI-enabled initiatives involving fan, artist, and partner data, ensuring compliance with global privacy regulations and contractual obligations.

  • Play an active role in defining policies and guardrails for the responsible use of generative AI across the music lifecycle, including metadata enrichment, rights identification, royalty processing, fan engagement, marketing optimization, and internal productivity tools.

  • Assess and mitigate risks related to AI-driven data sharing, automated decision-making, synthetic data, and data leakage, while enabling innovation that supports monetization, efficiency, and trust.

  • Stay informed on emerging technologies such as AI/ML, blockchain, smart contracts, NFTs, and next-generation rights management, and evaluate their implications for music data governance, licensing, and revenue models.

Bring your VIBE:

Experience & Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Data Science, Music Business, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data governance, data strategy, information management, or digital rights management—preferably within music, media, or entertainment.

  • Deep understanding of music rights, publishing, royalties, and global distribution models.

  • Strong familiarity with industry standards and ecosystems, including DDEX, ISRC, ISWC, IPI, and global licensing organizations.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance, catalog, and rights/royalty platforms (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, SynchTank, Vistex, Revelator or similar).

Leadership & Influence

  • Proven ability to operate at the executive level, influencing across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Track record of driving enterprise-wide data transformation and cultural change.

  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and stakeholder-management skills.

Key Competencies

  • Visionary leadership at the intersection of data, music, and innovation

  • Strong grasp of digital music consumption, fan data, and data monetization models

  • Compliance-minded, detail-oriented, with a pragmatic business lens

  • Ability to align diverse teams and priorities in a complex, global organization

job.title: Vice President, Planning and Forecasting (COE Lead)
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We are currently seeking an accomplished Vice President, Planning and Forecasting to drive transformation of UMG’s enterprise forecasting capabilities. The Vice President, Planning and Forecasting will lead the design, build, and operation of a new Center of Excellence (COE) for Forecasting and Planning. This role will be instrumental in transforming enterprise forecasting capabilities across Universal Music Group’s global organization, introducing modern, driver-based planning frameworks and enabling scalable, data-driven decision-making.

This leader will partner closely with Finance, Strategy, and Business Unit leaders to standardize planning processes, enhance forecast accuracy, and embed advanced tools and methodologies across the organization, including AI/ML-enabled forecasting tools.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in financial planning, forecasting methodologies, and driver-based modeling, along with hands-on experience implementing and governing enterprise planning tools such as Anaplan, Onestream, Pigment or custom builds. Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including comfort with AI/ML forecasting approaches, are essential, as is the ability to translate complex modeling concepts into practical tools and to drive their adoption across the business.

How you’ll CREATE:

  • Driver-based forecasting: Develop and maintain driver-based forecast models for revenue lines and cost categories, linking operational drivers to outcomes

  • AI/ML-enabled use cases: Shape centralized forecasting use cases to support profit centers and senior leadership, reducing manual bottom-up effort and improving forecast accuracy

  • Scenario modeling & forecasting improvement: Own and evolve scenario modeling tools; continuously improve forecasting methodologies and approaches (e.g., leveraging ML models, next-gen tooling) to enhance accuracy

  • Planning tool, data & logic governance: Govern PBF tools, planning data and logic across profit and cost centers; drive consistency in how forecasting data is captured and tagged

  • Tool training & adoption: Develop training materials, train divisional FP&A teams on tool usage, and drive consistent adoption

  • Continuous tool improvement: Fields enhancement requests from users, maintain and prioritize tool backlog, and partner with CDAO to develop new capabilities

  • Cross Functional Partnership: Collaborate with Corp Controllership on shared data foundation between actuals and forecasts to avoid duplication and ensure reconcilability. Partner with CIO and CDAO on PBF tool modernization and platform implementation to power an AI-enabled forecasting and reporting infrastructure. Collaborate Senior Vice President - Strategic Finance & Planning Work to transform the Planning and Forecasting cadence and processes. Work with BI & Analytics COE to align planning logic and driver definitions

  • Team leadership: Build, Lead and mentor a high-performing Global Forecasting COE

Bring your VIBE:

  • 12–15+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or strategic planning

  • Deep expertise in financial planning, forecasting methodologies, and driver-based modeling

  • Experience implementing and governing enterprise planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, OneStream, custom builds)

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including comfort with AI/ML forecasting approaches

  • Translate complex modeling concepts into practical tools

  • Experience driving tool adoption

  • This role is office-based

job.description:

We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. Fame House, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Fame House powers eCommerce for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration, both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more.

How we LEAD:

Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent. Digital Creative & Experience creates content that connects artists with fans across every touchpoint of the digital experience. Working across artist stores, ecommerce experiences, product launches, campaigns, social content, and brand storytelling initiatives, our Content Production team is responsible for bringing creative concepts to life through high-quality visual content that drives engagement and supports commercial performance. The Video Operator / Shooter plays a critical role in capturing compelling video content across a wide variety of productions, partnering closely with Producers, Creative Directors, Photographers, Editors, and Content teams to ensure every asset meets the highest creative and technical standards.

The Video Operator / Shooter is responsible for capturing high-quality video content across studio, location, e-commerce, campaign, and social productions. Combining strong technical expertise with a creative eye, this role ensures footage is captured efficiently, consistently, and in alignment with creative direction and production requirements. Working closely with the Content Production team, this role supports all stages of production execution, from equipment preparation and on-set operations through to media management and handoff into post-production workflows. The Video Operator / Shooter serves as a key contributor to the visual storytelling process, helping transform creative concepts into engaging content that connects artists, brands, and fans.

  • Operate cinema, mirrorless, and production camera systems to meet creative and technical requirements

  • Execute creative direction provided by Content Creative Directors and Production leads

  • Collaborate with Producers to ensure efficient shoot execution and schedule adherence

  • Support lighting setup and camera positioning to achieve desired visual outcomes

  • Work alongside photographers and content teams to support integrated content capture

  • Ensure technical accuracy including focus, exposure, framing, color consistency, and media management

  • Manage camera, lens, monitoring, and support equipment during productions

  • Maintain equipment readiness, organization, and inventory standards

  • Assist with pre-production planning, technical preparation, and shoot logistics

  • Support multi-camera, live, and fast-turnaround production environments when required

  • Organize and prepare footage for post-production workflows and asset delivery
  • Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency and content quality
  • Maintain a strong understanding of emerging production technologies, tools, and industry best practices

Bring Your VIBE

  • 3-5 years experience operating cameras within content production, ecommerce, music, entertainment, agency, or brand environments

  • Strong understanding of camera systems, lenses, lighting, audio capture, and production workflows

  • Experience capturing content across multiple formats including campaign, social, product, lifestyle, and branded content

  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced production environments while maintaining attention to detail

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Comfortable working across multiple projects and priorities simultaneously

  • Understanding of post-production workflows and asset management processes

  • Passion for visual storytelling, music, culture, and digital content

  • Ability to solve problems quickly and remain calm under pressure

  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute wherever needed to achieve the best creative outcome

  • Consistently capturing technically excellent footage

  • Supporting efficient and productive shoot environments

  • Delivering assets that meet creative and production standards

  • Contributing to seamless collaboration across production and creative teams

  • Maintaining readiness and reliability across all production activities Helping elevate the overall quality and effectiveness of content produced by the team

The Urban One story began simply with a dream and one radio station. Forty years, 13 markets, and 70+ stations later, we are a media empire, spanning multiple media platforms.   • Professional demeanor, excellent verbal and written communication, and customer service skills

job.title: R1 Receptionist
job.description:
Radio One is seeking a professional, friendly, and highly organized Receptionist to serve as the first point of contact for employees, clients, vendors, artists, community partners, and visitors. The Receptionist will provide exceptional front-desk service while supporting the day-to-day administrative needs of the office.

The ideal candidate is personable, dependable, polished, and comfortable working in a fast-paced entertainment and media environment.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Greet and welcome all visitors, clients, talent, vendors, and guests in a professional and courteous manner.
  • Answer, screen, and direct incoming telephone calls.
  • Manage the reception area and maintain a professional appearance.
  • Receive and distribute mail, packages, deliveries, and other correspondence.
  • Maintain visitor logs and follow company security and building access procedures.
  • Notify employees when guests arrive and assist with meeting-room coordination.
  • Respond to general inquiries and direct visitors or callers to the appropriate department.
  • Provide administrative support to station management and various departments as needed.
  • Assist with scheduling meetings, coordinating conference rooms, and maintaining calendars when requested.
  • Maintain office supplies and notify appropriate staff when supplies need to be reordered.
  • Assist with copying, scanning, filing, printing, and other basic office functions.
  • Support promotions, marketing, events, and station activities as needed.
  • Assist with artist, client, sponsor, and community partner arrivals during station events and activations.
  • Maintain confidentiality regarding company, employee, client, talent, and business information.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1–2 years of receptionist, administrative, customer service, or related experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Professional and welcoming demeanor.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Comfortable interacting with people at all levels of an organization.
  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office, email, calendars, and other office technology.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism and composure in a busy media/entertainment environment.
  • Must be dependable, punctual, and able to work independently.

A little bit about our team:

WMX, Warner Music Group's culture-driving merchandise, creative content, and artist services division, is a global full-service team that offers creative direction, production services, and support for WMG licensed artists and labels. As the Retail Art Director, you will step into a brand-new, highly strategic role designed to grow and develop our retail business strategy as a whole. You will act as the vital creative bridge on our team, working directly with our Creative Directors to align on artistic vision, while collaborating hand-in-hand with our Retail Sales team to build bespoke presentations for global retail partners. Your work will directly impact how our entire artist roster breaks into major retail spaces, transforming creative concepts into massive commercial realities.

Your role:

As Art Director at WMX, you’ll bring our artists’ visual worlds to life across music, fashion, and culture. You’ll focus directly on developing visual concepts, leading art direction for merch collections, and collaborating closely with both in-house talent and freelance creators. This role is fast-paced, hands-on, and deeply plugged into culture. You’ll be turning artist identities into compelling, fan-obsessed merchandise and visual assets across our roster.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Develop Visual & Art Direction: Create the visual language and offer creative mentorship for merch collections and campaigns. Confirm every concept reflects the artist's identity and resonates with their fanbase.

  • Lead the visual invention and curation of merchandise lines for artists represented by our company. Progress collections from initial aesthetic moodboards to fully realized visual concepts.

  • Guide In-House & Freelance Designers: Source, brief, and direct internal designers, outside studios, and specialized freelancers (illustrators, typographers, graphic designers). Provide clear feedback to elevate output and ensure visual consistency across all assets.

  • Partner with Artists & Management: Work directly with artists, managers, and internal brand teams to understand aesthetic goals and translate them into cohesive visual designs.

  • Ensure Visual Quality & Brand Consistency: Review and refine all art deliverables to ensure high aesthetic standards, on-brief execution, and visual harmony across product lineups.

  • Collaborate with Production & Operations: Partner with production teams to manage asset handover, review tech packs, and refine designs to align with physical production capabilities without compromising creative vision.

  • Stay Ahead of Visual & Fashion Trends: Maintain a deep awareness of emerging fashion, music, design, and subculture trends, continually infusing fresh visual ideas into our artist collections.

About you:

  • You have 4-6+ years of experience in art direction, graphic design, or brand design, preferably within retail, fashion, or corporate pitch-deck creation.

  • You have a proven track record of trend forecasting and a deep understanding of commercial retail landscapes and consumer behavior.

  • You have expert-level layout and presentation skills, with a portfolio that proves you can turn complex strategies into clean, beautiful, and compelling visual stories.

  • You enjoy acting as a bridge between highly conceptual creative ideas and business-driven commercial targets.

  • You are passionate about emerging fashion, design, and music culture, and you instinctively know how to translate those movements into retail-ready product ideas.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • You have expert knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and key presentation platforms like Keynote or PowerPoint.

  • You have a deep passion for fashion and product design

  • You have experience designing mockups for apparel, retail packaging, or point-of-sale displays.

  • You have a passion for emerging creative tools, trends, and technologies (AI, AR, motion, etc.) and how they can elevate storytelling

At Warner Music Group, our Strategic Finance team serves as the analytical engine that drives both our high-level business strategy and day-to-day operations. By extracting actionable intelligence from core financial data, the team partners seamlessly across Warner Music’s Central Functions, Recorded Music, and Music Publishing to uncover deep business insights. Ultimately, Strategic Finance sits at the forefront of the company, mapping the financial dynamics and emerging trends that are actively shaping the future of the global music industry.

Your role:

As the Data Scientist for Strategic Finance, you will act as the crucial link between our financial strategists and the Technology department. A key part of your mission is collaborating closely with the technology engineers and data scientists who are building our state-of-the-art predictive forecasting platform, ensuring the tool perfectly aligns with business needs. Alongside this, you will deploy modern AI solutions to automate complex financial workflows and transform ambiguous, disparate data into standardized, cohesive datasets—moving the department away from fragile legacy spreadsheets and toward a highly automated, self-service data ecosystem.

    • Oversee and manage our global community management framework and safely navigate real-time social crisis mitigation to protect the brand and our songwriters.

  • Execute Data-Driven Reporting: 

    • Maintain a robust analytics framework. You will pull platform metrics, run competitive benchmarking, and deliver performance reports against our global benchmarks to convert numbers into practical creative strategies.

  • Support Executives, Creators & Partners:

    • Directly partner with senior leadership, A&R teams, and our creators to visualize strategic goals. You will build custom presentation decks and visual materials from scratch, maintaining a highly polished, professional, and composed presence when collaborating with C-level executives and high-profile creatives.

  • Branding/writing: 

    • Help develop brand voice. You will draft compelling and detailed copy across all touchpoints, including SEO-optimized blog posts for WCM’s website, roster signing announcements, and highly nuanced social captions.

  • Is a natural on social media, intimately keeping up with current music, digital, and cultural trends.

  • Is exceptional at writing, editing, and proofing copy to suit the distinct nuances of different channels.

  • Is adept at using the full Adobe Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva, and CapCut.

  • Can develop long-form and complex PowerPoint and Keynote presentations from scratch, including infographics, charts, and iconography.

  • Is data-driven, comfortable capturing and analyzing social metrics, tracking insights, and translating numbers into actionable creative strategies.

  • Is proficient in guidelines across print, web, SEO, and native platform analytics (including platforms such as Google Analytics, Sprout Social, or Later.com).

  • Can thrive as an individual contributor and can roll up their sleeves, as well as manage or direct external teams.

  • Can think creatively, critique meaningfully, and take direction.

  • Can gracefully manage a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

A little bit about our team:

The WMG Global Commercial Services team maximizes WMG revenue and market share, leading through best practices, platform expertise and forward thinking solutions that support our recorded music strategy.

The content protection team is a group of global specialists who leverage technology, intellectual property law, and collaborative relationships with industry partners and third-party vendors to ensure music fans across the globe can experience and access WMG’s content the way our artists intend. We provide support to our label and territory partners with content protection, rights management, and optimization to ensure maximum revenue opportunities at our commercial digital partners.

  

Your role:

We are looking for someone who is eager to interact with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to protect WMG’s content and who is motivated to help our artists maintain control over their release plans.  This person is a leader and will help shape a world-class content protection team.  

Here you’ll get to:

  • Work with a distributed team of internal collaborators and third-party partners to monitor and protect all forms of WMG's intellectual property. This includes audio, physical products, merchandise, and virtual properties.  

  • Identify unauthorized uploads and pre-release leaks of WMG-controlled content on streaming services, social media platforms, and video-sharing sites across the Internet. Manage the implementation of notice and takedown protocols according to US Copyright laws and other legal frameworks.

  • Liaise with WMG’s labels, global affiliate companies, and corporate departments to manage priority releases, maintain content protection guidelines, and stay current on platform policy frameworks and developments

  • Develop and maintain internal SOP's, protocols for handling blocking issues, and workflow documentation for the detection, triage, and takedown of AI generated deepfakes and voice clones exploiting artist names, images, and likenesses

  • Build and oversee the internal tool set and tracking systems, including logs, dashboards, and intake forms used to monitor AI activity, ensuring consistent documentation of sources, evidence, and resolution of outcomes across the team

  • Track emerging AI content-generation platforms and tools being used to produce unauthorized content, flagging new abuse vectors to experienced colleagues  

  • Stay informed of new and emerging content protection, tools and vendor solutions entering the market, and coordinate the evaluation of their potential fit for the team's monitoring, detection, and takedown workflows

About you:

  • Effectively manage and prioritize multiple projects at one time 

  • Demonstrate proficiency with internet research and discovery tools  

  • Stay organized, on task, and self-motivated  

  • Encourage and motivate other team members  

  • Navigate music platforms, mobile app stores, and online marketplaces 

  • Think on your feet and work independently 

  • Provide periodic coverage for our global content protection inbox, including on a flexible/non- traditional work week as needed.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Prior management experience 

  • Experience with database management and Google Analytics 

  • Familiarity with HTML, SQL, Python, and/or Java 

  • An understanding of generative Artificial Intelligence tools, technologies, and methodologies

  • Comfort with Google Enterprise products (Sheets, Docs, Slides, and Forms) and Microsoft Office Services (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point) 

  • 3-4 years of experience in the Music industry or a related field, such as Film, TV, or Digital Media 

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills 

  • Outstanding presentation skills  

  • A readiness to engage with senior team members around the globe 

  • Fluency in English and a second language, such as Spanish or Mandarin

  • College Degree preferred

Your Role:

The Manager, Deal Structuring & Valuation will be a key contributor to the Deals Office team, supporting the financial analysis, modeling, and structuring of strategic deals across recorded music and music publishing. This role is crucial in ensuring that deal proposals are financially sound, align with our strategic objectives, and contribute to long-term growth and shareholder value. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, a keen eye for detail, and a foundational understanding of the music and entertainment industry.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare comprehensive financial models and valuation analyses (e.g., DCF, IRR, payback period) for potential deals. Present and explain valuation range and basis for catalog acquisitions

  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to inform deal assumptions and valuation benchmarks.

  • Prepare detailed presentations and reports for operators and deal committee reviews, summarizing financial projections and key deal terms

  • Support Reporting team and Radar system to ensure company wide adoption, data integrity and completeness

  • Support development of financial models with use of AI and wide automated deal modelling

  • Support post investment reviews and analysis, prepare summary of findings and portfolio analysis 

  • Maintain deal tracker, ensure data consistency and develop automated dashboards for regular reporting

Required Competencies/Skills:

  • 3-5 years of experience in finance, investment banking, corporate development, or a related analytical role, preferably within the music, entertainment, or media industries.

  • Demonstrated experience in financial modeling, valuation techniques, and data analysis.

  • Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements.

  • Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI).

  • High attention to detail and accuracy in data handling and reporting.

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly.

  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  •  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA or CFA a plus.

Your role:

●       Maintain release schedules and ensure all operational deliverables are met on time.

●       Work with the Sr. Director, Global Traffic to Analyze, maintain and negotiate freight rates for Retail shipments and local couriers

●       Approve invoices and provide accounting info for freight and Distribution Accruals

●       Provide returns forecast for Accounting

●       Track and report on sales trends.

The Global Classics Marketing team focuses on growing audience reach, increasing brand awareness, and achieving commercial success for a varied roster of frontline artists and their releases. Based worldwide, the label consists of teams specializing in A&R, Finance, Operations, Commerce, and Legal Affairs. Additionally, shared service teams cover Tech, Digital, Sync, Licensing, Audience, and Business Intelligence.

Your role:

Your primary focus as Marketing Manager is the development and execution of high-level global campaigns for a dedicated roster of classical artists. Acting as the main marketing point-of-contact, you’ll bridge the gap between our artists, their collaborators, and colleagues worldwide. The role also involves coordinating local marketing for priority releases—both frontline and catalog—while managing campaign budgets and key supplier relationships.

A little bit about our team:

The Global Commercial Services team advances WMG revenue and market share, leading through platform expertise and forward thinking solutions that support our recorded music strategy. Our team provides day to day support for many of our top strategic UGC partners and liaises with territories and labels around the world. This position will play a key role in shaping the processes, policies and overall success of the team. In addition to the support role our team manages UGC claiming for monetization and this role will be a key figure in maximizing that business.

Your role:

This role is central to optimizing our core UGC platforms, with a specific focus in ownership conflicts and WMG’s YouTube issues queue, which consists of potential and disputed claims, reference overlaps, and ownership transfers. You will assist with proactive conflict and claiming exercises at key digital platforms like SoundExchange, TikTok, and Meta. You will also assist with key revenue and rights optimization projects including video availability and video recapture. In this role, you will be directly contributing to the department’s annual revenue impact target via revenue optimization efforts.

Here you’ll get to:

  • You will work directly with team leadership to deliver on annual goals and achievements and revenue optimization targets.

  • You will oversee Revenue Optimization’s conflicting ownership processes with labels and partners for YouTube, TikTok, Meta, SoundCloud, SoundExchange and other platform.

  • You will directly lead WMG’s YouTube CMS issues queues to ensure timely resolution.

  • You will support video rights optimization initiatives, including handling video availability for single-song and long-form content across all platforms.

  • You will identify and complete proactive claiming opportunities at SoundExchange, neighboring rights platforms, and DSPs to drive incremental revenue.

  • You will partner with the YouTube Account Management and Dedicated Support teams on a cross-functional task force to action unclaimed videos, ad enablement, and more

  • You will develop and manage regular communication and reporting to leadership for this work.

About you:

  • You have 3+ years of experience in digital account management or rights management.

  • You have expertise in rights review and managing complex digital ownership conflicts.

  • You have an analytical approach with the ability to translate large datasets into actionable business strategies.

  • You have exceptional communication and storytelling skills, bridging data insights with creative teams.

  • You are a self-starter with strong organizational skills and the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

  • You have the desire to solve problems, sometimes on strict timelines.

  • You are proficient in Google productivity tools (e.g., Gmail, Sheets, Docs, etc.).

  • You think analytically, making decisions based on logic, experience and reason.


 

We’d love it if you also had:

  • You have a YouTube Music Rights certification.

  • You have familiarity with Meta Rights Manager, SoundCloud Deck, or ByteDance MediaMatch.

  • You have technical proficiency in Python or SQL for data analysis.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Corporate Finance, the Senior Analyst will play a hands-on role in the management of centrally managed Corporate functions and Recorded Music functional areas.

  • Compile and analyze Corporate spend information used in senior-management, Board and external reporting materials.

  • Maintain strong follow-up on outstanding items, results and forecast assumptions across multiple collaborators.

Job Title: Senior Coordinator, Artist Insights & Strategy

A little bit about our team:

The Global Catalog Growth & Insights team uses data & insights to help define and shape the strategy for growing audiences across all of WMG's Off-Roster Catalog. We work with Artist Brand Managers, Artists themselves, and their management teams to communicate opportunities to increase engagement among their current fans and highlight ways to reach new potential fans.

Your role:

Based in NYC and reporting to the London-based Director, Artist Insights & Strategy, the Senior Coordinator, Artist Insights & Strategy will play a key supporting role in the collection and analysis of research data to uncover insights that help define the strategic direction of our rich Global Catalog and extend the legacy and success of our most iconic artists. 

You will be deeply immersed in cultural trends and the digital landscape, and help drive high-impact, research-driven projects from conception to completion, translating cultural, audience, and consumption data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations. 

Here you’ll get to:

  • Support the Director, Artist Insights & Strategy and internal Artist Brand Managers by conducting research deep dives and audience analysis to guide long-term artist strategies. 

  • Monitor internet culture, social media trends, subcultures, and fan behaviors to identify cultural shifts and strategic opportunities.

  • Translate internet culture findings and audience insights into pitch-ready concepts, content ideas, and partnerships to reintroduce classic works to new generations. 

  • Assist with collection and visualization of audience data, leveraging AI-powered tools and modern research workflows.

  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into engaging, narrative-led material that clearly communicates audience insights and growth opportunities.

  • Organize and update internal research databases and third-party reports libraries to keep insights easily accessible for global teams.

  • Maintain team project trackers and coordinate task timelines across the US and UK teams.

About you:

  • You live and breathe internet culture and are genuinely passionate about music, artist legacies and the power of storytelling to drive discovery and fandom across generations.

  • Sharp cultural and strategic analysis: a knack for translating complex cultural & audience data (quant & qual) into clear, tangible recommendations, using compelling narratives. 

  • A curious mindset and an appetite to understand why audiences love what they love, how fan communities operate, and where music culture is moving next.

  • Strong organizational skills and a proven ability to prioritize effectively and manage competing demands.

  • A collaborative mindset and a proven ability to work seamlessly across cross-functional internal teams.

  • Strong communication skills with experience interacting with a diverse range of internal & external stakeholders. 

  • 2-3 years of experience in a coordinator, research support, or admin role within music, entertainment, or digital media.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Familiarity with analytics or audience data tools, such as Chartmetric, co:brand, and Luminate.

  • Experience in working with brands, building strategies for growing reach & long-term engagement.  

  • Music industry experience. 

  • Background in marketing to understand levers and their impacts in different scenarios.

Job Title: Senior Director, Order To Cash (OTC)

A little bit about our team:

Warner Music’s Nashville Shared Services Center (SSC)  is the home to the financial and administrative functions that provide critical support and best-in-class services to our US, Canadian, and Latin American Recorded Music and Publishing businesses. The Nashville Center embodies the innovative and creative spirit that stems from the company’s deep history in nurturing entrepreneurial thinking and artist-focused innovation, enabling our employees to develop a wide range of skills through cross-function collaboration and development opportunities.

Your role:

If you are an Amazing Order-to-Cash (OTC) Leader who wants to create a vision and roadmap to build a world-class OTC team within our regional center, then keep reading!  

Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead end-to-end Order to Cash process and execution across multiple business models, platforms, and regions, including North & South America. 

  • Ensure Billing, collections, revenue recognition, credit, customer master data, and cash application activities are completed accurately, timely, and in alignment with business objectives.

  • Oversee processes supported by SAP, Salesforce, Vistex, and other billing and reporting platforms.

  • Manage day-to-day cash flow continuity, including misdirected or unknown payments and due to / due from reconciliation for all customer agreements

  • Define and monitor Order to Cash performance metrics, including aging, unapplied cash levels, billing accuracy, collection effectiveness, and customer satisfaction

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all things OTC for Mergers/Acquisitions

  • Work closely with the Business Development team as new deals/agreements are made to achieve systematic revenue processing within the scope of the agreements

  • Manage a customer portfolio that generates more than $ 4 billion in revenue annually 

  • Liaise with the team managing Revenue Recognition to ensure billing is executed per individual customer agreements

  • Build and strengthen the capabilities of the OTC team by identifying, developing, and overseeing talent within the function 

  • Position yourself as a relied-on point of contact between all internal functional groups, including, but not limited to, Corporate Finance, Label Finance, Internal Audit, and Shared Services

  • Leverage system automation, AI-based reconciliation tools, and streamlined workflows to improve operational performance

  • Serve as a point of escalation and final approval for the OTC process 

  • Lead the team in the performance of day-to-day activities within OTC 

  • Oversee OTC  leaders (both on and offshore) to ensure disputes are repaid or escalated timely. 

​Partner with:

  • RTR team on the OTC month-end close-related activities, including cash/accounts receivable reconciliations 

  • PTP team to determine ways to improve WMG’s working capital

  • GPO in identifying continuous process improvement opportunities 

  • WMG teams like Risk Management, Treasury, and Legal when pursuing or initiating new OTC portals and/or wallets (including BitPay) 

About you:

  • 10+ years of experience in Order to Cash, Revenue Operations, or a similar field including oversight of credit & collections.

  • 5+ years of people leadership experience for Order to Cash delivery

  • Excellent communication, influencing skills and team member management, leading team in a remote first working environment supported by team based offshore for more transactional activities

  • Extremely collaborative team player

  • Ability to value-stream map each part of the OTC processes specific to Finance – including billing, credit, collections, cash applications, and industry specific revenue streams.  Assist with upstream and downstream process mapping to ensure seamless hand-offs with the entire organization

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field 

  • Experience leading collaborative discussions and working with a diverse team of stakeholders to achieve a common goal 

  • Executive-level communication skills 

  • Working knowledge of US GAAP, SOX compliance, and audit procedures

  • Experience driving continuous improvement and challenging normal operations

  • Experience with process design (TQM, Six Sigma, LEAN, Agile, or similar process measurement and analysis techniques)

  • Experience ensuring policy and process compliance with applicable laws and data policies

  • Experience in desktop applications, financial ERP software, process flow tools, and/or statistical analysis for process improvement 

  • Extensive experience as a user of a large and complex ERP system

  • Basic understanding of IT project management methodology (Agile or SDLC)

  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize projects and work under pressure to meet deadlines

We’d love it if you also had:

  • CPA, MBA, or equivalent preferred 

  • Music or Entertainment Industry experience preferred

  • Deep knowledge of SAP and S/4HANA preferred

  • Working experience for OTC activities in LATAM

A little bit about our team:

The People Team sits at the heart of Warner Music Group and is focused on attracting, retaining and developing exceptional people. As part of the People team, our dynamic and diverse Talent Acquisition team is responsible for finding and hiring the best talent for the business, and partnering with our business leaders on their talent attraction strategies.

Your role:

At WMG, you will immerse yourself in a vibrant, creative environment, turning your passion for connecting people and music into a rewarding career.

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, you will drive our end-to-end talent acquisition strategy, identifying and engaging high-caliber, diverse talent across the business. Acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, you will work with executive collaborators and hiring managers. You will craft proactive sourcing strategies and carry them out to meet business needs now and in the future. Beyond managing complex searches, you will lead strategic TA initiatives, champion our employer brand, and oversee key talent programs and projects. This is a high-impact role requiring strategic foresight, strong business insight, and a consultative approach.   

Here you’ll get to:

- Own the full lifecycle recruitment for assigned roles, delivering an outstanding candidate experience from initial briefing to negotiation and onboarding.   Although the role is west-coast based, you will recruit for positions in other locations and time zones, as well.

- Serve as a strategic talent advisor to business leaders, using labor market insights, industry trends, and data to build hiring strategies and influence talent decisions.

- Design and execute innovative sourcing strategies to build robust, diverse talent pipelines for immediate hires and long-term organizational growth.

- Lead key talent acquisition projects aimed at enhancing candidate experience, optimizing recruitment processes, and embedding best practices across the organization.

- Manage agency partner relationships, evaluating vendor performance and ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and SLAs.

- Represent the Warner Music organization as an employer brand ambassador at industry panels, networking events, and campus programs.

- Partner seamlessly with the broader People team (People Partners, Total Rewards, etc.) to deliver cohesive, business-aligned talent solutions.

- Drive recruitment initiatives, establishing strategic partnerships and talent channels to continually diversify our pipeline.

- Mentor and guide hiring managers on interview guidelines, candidate assessment, and competitive market dynamics.
 

About you:

- 5-7 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally combining agency and in-house environments, with a proven track record of filling complex and senior-level positions.

- Proven talent strategist with expert-level knowledge of proactive sourcing methods (LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, niche networks, and competitive intelligence).

- Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using modern ATS platforms (Workday preferred) and sourcing technologies.

- Consultative approach with the confidence and executive presence to challenge, advise, and influence collaborators at all levels.

- Strong business insight, with the ability to quickly grasp industry dynamics and translate strategic objectives into effective talent strategies.

- Demonstrated project management capability, with experience leading TA initiatives, process improvements, or early-career programs.

- Ability to be flexible and nimble in an ever-evolving business environment.

- Data-informed approach, comfortable applying recruitment metrics to evaluate pipeline health and sourcing efficiency.

- Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, capable of fostering collaboration across global and cross-functional teams.

- Outstanding organizational skills and process driven orientation.

Job Title: Sr. Analyst, Financial

A little bit about our team:

Warner Music Group's Global Business Services (GBS) is home to the finance operations, legal, and administrative functions that provide critical support and best-in-class services to our global Finance labels and affiliates. Each regional center embodies the collaboration and creative spirit that stems from the company’s deep history in cultivating entrepreneurial thinking and artist-focused innovation, enabling our employees to develop a wide range of skills through cross-function collaboration and development opportunities. Based out of Nashville, our US Participations team is fully remote and committed to supporting all U.S. record labels, and artist & label services divisions.


We’re excited to hear from impactful finance and audit professionals who are ready to apply their elite analytical skills to a specialized, high-stakes environment. We are looking for "detective-minded" analysts with a passion for music, who thrive on uncovering the "why" behind the numbers and who possess the commercial acumen to translate complex legal logic into precise financial outputs.

Why this could be your next big break:

You are a highly autonomous finance professional who takes immense pride in ownership and accountability. You don't just process data; you interrogate it. You thrive in environments where you are expected to be a subject matter expert, serving as a trusted point of contact for both partners across the company, and your peers.

This role is perfect for someone coming from a rigorous Audit, Royalty, or Financial Reporting background who is ready to move into a fast-paced, dynamic industry. You’ll be given the space to work independently, but you’ll do so through a lens of deep collaboration—mentoring analysts and acting as a link between financial accounting, royalty operations and our business. If you enjoy the challenge of high-volume data, complex financial calculations, and the satisfaction of delivering accurate insights under tight deadlines, this is your next step.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the preparation, analysis and review  of complex participation profit-share and distribution financial statements. You will ensure every output aligns with both unique contractual obligations and rigorous accounting standards.
