job.title: Managing Editor
job.description:
The Role

We’re looking for an Editorial Manager to run the day-to-day of thegrio.com; someone who spends real time in the copy and also owns the systems around publishing it.

This is a player-coach job. On any given day, you’ll line-edit a breaking politics story, decide which pitches to greenlight, rebuild tomorrow’s publishing schedule around a news break, check what’s performing in the analytics, and reset the plan accordingly. You are the person who ensures the site publishes the right stories at the right time in theGrio’s voice and plans next month’s content strategy.

You are comfortable with AI-based production tools, but remain clear-eyed about their limits. We use them to move faster on the mechanical parts of the job, and we do not use them as a substitute for reporting, judgment, or a human byline. Every published word goes through a human editor. That editor is often you.

What You’ll Do

Daily editorial management

  • Own the daily publishing operation for thegrio.com.

  • Run the daily and monthly news meeting and set priorities across news, politics, entertainment, lifestyle and business.

  • Serve as the editorial point of contact for staff writers, contributors and freelancers.

  • Make the call on breaking news: what we chase, what we aggregate, what we skip, and how fast we move.

  • Hold the line on accuracy, sourcing, fairness and corrections; escalate legal or sensitivity questions early.

Editing

  • Line-edit and structurally edit across formats like short news hits, features, essays, explainers and video-adjacent copy.

  • Edit for theGrio’s voice: culturally fluent, direct, and written for our audience rather than about them.

  • Write and rewrite headlines, decks, and inform social copy that hold up both in search and in front of a human.

  • Copy-edit to house style, maintain and update the style guide, and enforce it consistently.

  • Coach writers with specific, actionable feedback to help them become stronger writers next time, not just a fixed draft.

Story development and greenlighting

  • Evaluate incoming pitches and greenlight the ones with the clearest audience case; quickly kill or reshape the rest with a clear reason.

  • Generate original story ideas from the news cycle, cultural moments, search and social demand, and audience data.

  • Commission and manage freelance assignments.

  • Build the mix deliberately: breaking coverage, service, and evergreen content, originals worth the investment, and franchise/tentpole coverage.

Editorial calendar and planning

  • Own the editorial calendar end to end; daily, weekly and long-lead.

  • Plan tentpole and moment-driven coverage (elections, awards season, Black History Month, HBCU homecomings, cultural anniversaries, major sports and music moments) far enough ahead to do them well.

  • Maintain a healthy pipeline so the site is never running on same-day scramble alone.

  • Coordinate with social, newsletter, audience development and commerce teams so a story lands everywhere it should.

Audience, analytics and performance

  • Live in the analytics daily — Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and our real-time tool, Chartbeat to turn what you see into traffic and interest-producing articles.

  • Track the metrics that matter for the business: pageviews, engaged time, returning readers, newsletter conversion, and revenue-relevant page performance.

  • Understand where traffic actually comes from (search, Google Discover, social, direct, newsletter, syndication) and how each is trending.

  • Use search and trend data (Search Console, Google Trends, social listening) to inform assignments before publication, not just to grade them after.

  • Run a weekly performance read for editorial leadership: what worked, what didn’t, what we’re changing next week.

  • Test and iterate to make a measurable difference using headlines, images, publish timing, formats, and document what you learn so the whole team gets better.

AI-enabled production

  • Use AI tools fluently in the production workflow: research and background synthesis, transcription, headline and SEO variant generation, summaries and bullets, alt text, tagging and metadata, style checks, and first-pass structural feedback.

  • Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows for editorial with prompts, templates and checks the team can use and be able to train writers and editors on them.

  • Apply clear guardrails, consistent with newsroom practice at outlets such as the BBC, Reuters and The Guardian: nothing AI-assisted publishes without human review and approval; AI output is verified before it’s trusted; AI does not generate reporting, quotes, or sourcing.

  • Help shape and enforce theGrio’s AI usage and disclosure standards and keep them current as tools change.

  • Track new tools and make the case for the ones that would meaningfully improve speed or quality.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Chief Content Officer and editorial leadership on coverage strategy and priorities.

  • Partner with social, newsletter, ad sales and commerce on cross-functional initiatives.

  • Represent editorial standards in conversations about sponsored, branded and partner content.

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years in digital editorial, with at least 1–2 years assigning and editing other people’s work.

  • Demonstrated excellence as an editor. You can quickly restructure a messy draft, line-edit for clarity and rhythm, and copy-edit clean.

  • Deep, current fluency in Black culture, politics and media, and a real understanding of theGrio’s audience.

  • Fluency with WordPress and digital publishing workflow tools such as Monday.com and Slack.

  • Working command of SEO fundamentals and audience analytics. You can read GA4 or Chartbeat and say what to do differently tomorrow.

  • Hands-on comfort with AI production tools and sound judgment about when not to use them.

  • Sound news judgment under deadline pressure, and the composure to make fast calls and own them.

  • Strong embody organizational discipline. You can hold a calendar, a freelance budget and six moving stories at once.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; the ability to give direct feedback kindly and effectively.

Preferred

  • Experience at a national digital news or culture brand.

  • Experience managing freelance networks and contributor budgets.

  • Familiarity with social media production and distribution as well as video workflows.

  • Experience building or documenting editorial process like style guides, standards, AI policy, workflow docs.

  • Background in one or more of theGrio’s core verticals: politics, entertainment, business, lifestyle, sports.

  • Passion for Black media and culture; deep understanding of theGrio’s mission and role of Black media in American history.

Compensation and Benefits

Salary range: $85,000-$100,000 commensurate with experience.

Benefits include [medical, dental and vision coverage; 401(k); paid time off and holidays; parental leave]. This is a remote, U.S.-based role; occasional travel for team gatherings and coverage may be required in New York City and D.C.

job.title: Platform Engineer - Backend & CMS Integration
job.description:
About Local Now

Local Now is a free, ad-supported streaming service delivering local news, weather, sports, and lifestyle programming to viewers across virtually every connected device. As part of Allen Media Group, we operate at meaningful scale across mobile, smart TVs, streaming sticks, set-top boxes, and the web. We are now investing in a ground-up rebuild of our streaming platform with a privacy-first architecture, modern shared-code strategy, and the engineering rigor needed to grow sustainably.

We build for audiences who expect frictionless playback on any device, and for advertisers who depend on us to deliver reliable, high-quality monetization. The work is tangible: every improvement we make is felt by millions of viewers.

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to own backend services and content-management integration for the Local Now streaming platform. This role sits at the intersection of three things that matter most to us: the integration with our third-party content management system, the backend platform services that power every client app, and the privacy-and-data architecture that ensures we are good stewards of user information across every surface.

You will work alongside an experienced backend team (a director-level architect, a senior architect-engineer, and a senior engineer) to extend our platform services and harden CMS integration. The CMS integration in particular is load-bearing: every piece of content that reaches a viewer flows through it.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and operate backend services that abstract our content management system and serve content to client apps across many device platforms.

  • Define and evolve API contracts for cross-platform client consumption, including content metadata, playback manifests, ad-decision endpoints, and personalization signals.

  • Partner with the CMS vendor and internal stakeholders to integrate, troubleshoot, and extend content workflows end-to-end.

  • Implement privacy-first patterns server-side: consent propagation, data minimization, DSAR plumbing, and PII handling at the platform layer.

  • Instrument the platform for observability and operational analytics — error rates, latency, content-availability, and ad-decisioning performance.

  • Work with frontend, platform, and ad-tech engineers to ensure the backend evolves in step with what clients and monetization actually need.

  • Contribute to architecture review, code review, and the broader engineering bar of the team.


What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of backend engineering experience building production services at scale.

  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core, along with Go, Kotlin, Python, TypeScript/Node, or similar, and the discipline to write services that are maintainable years from now.

  • Experience integrating with third-party SaaS platforms — particularly those that own a critical part of the user-facing experience (CMS, identity, billing, ad-serving).

  • Solid grasp of API design, distributed-systems patterns, caching, queueing, and the operational realities of running services in production.

  • Deep experience with ad tech ecosystems, including server-side ad insertion (SSAI) with MediaTailor, beaconing, and integrating Ad SDKs such as The Trade Desk (UID2) and SpringServe.

  • Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including IaC patterns and secure-by-default service deployment.

  • Awareness of privacy, security, and compliance considerations as engineering concerns, not legal afterthoughts.

  • Excellent collaboration skills; comfortable working with vendors, frontend teams, and product partners simultaneously.

  • Extensive experience with SQL, including writing stored procedures, and designing scalable analytics table structures.

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating with a media-industry CMS (Quickplay, Brightcove, Vimeo OTT, MediaKind, or similar).

  • Streaming or media-tech background — playback manifests, ad-stitching/SSAI, DRM, content packaging.

  • Familiarity with privacy/consent technology (Fides, OneTrust, Ethyca, or similar) and DSAR engineering workflows.

  • Experience using AI coding assistants effectively to ship more in less time without sacrificing quality.

job.title: Weather Product Engineer
job.description:
Weather Product Engineer

About Us

Join the team at The Weather Channel, the most trusted weather and news brand in the world. We are dedicated to providing the most accurate, life-saving information to millions of people. At our core, we are a technology-driven organization that thrives on innovation, blending advanced meteorology with world-class engineering to tell the story of our planet.


Summary

This is a unique opportunity for an innovative developer to stand at the cutting edge of weather technology. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about meteorology and driven by the challenge of transforming complex data into best-in-class weather messaging tools. In this role, you will be a key architect of the future, utilizing every tool in your arsenal to develop first-class weather products consumed by a diverse, global audience across multiple media platforms.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Architect and engineer high-performance, ultra-reliable data pipelines that seamlessly integrate diverse weather datasets into immersive visualization products.  

  • Drive the next generation of weather automation by leveraging advanced programming and scripting to build smarter, faster product workflows.

  • Harvest and synthesize weather data from a vast array of global resources, transforming raw information into actionable formats for our core weather visualization systems.

  • Own the product lifecycle from initial spark to on-air triumph, leading high-impact projects that define our technical roadmap.

  • Establish the standard for technical excellence by producing comprehensive documentation for data management and product releases.

  • Utilize GIS technology to weave complex databases with georeferenced spatial data, creating rich, contextual weather stories.

  • Build a revolutionary graphical toolset that empowers our team with first-to-market, enhanced storytelling capabilities.

  • Push the boundaries of software performance through rigorous operational testing and feedback loops for new releases.

  • Collaborate as a technical expert to troubleshoot and optimize weather graphic production systems.


QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS

  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Computer Science, or equivalent expertise.

  • Strong foundation in modern product development processes and methodologies.

  • Proficiency in key development languages including Python, JavaScript, HTML, XML, and VBA.

  • Direct experience leveraging cutting-edge AI models (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) to accelerate product innovation.

  • 5+ years of proven success in developing consumer-facing products.

  • Unwavering commitment to organizational cyber security protocols and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • Advanced knowledge of professional weather visualization systems (e.g., WSI TruVu Max) is a distinct advantage.

  • Strategic thinker with a holistic approach to complex project management and problem-solving.

  • Exhibits creative problem solving skills and unique resourcefulness in order to complete tasks

  • Quickly learns and applies new technologies

  • Customer focused, innovative, and self-motivated

The position sits at the intersection of facilities operations, smart building technology, maintenance planning, asset management, and systems administration. Reporting & Operational Analytics

  • Experience supporting facilities operations, maintenance planning, asset management, or building systems environments
  • Familiarity with preventative maintenance programs and work order management
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams

job.title: Director, App Security
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Director, Application Security Engineering to strengthen our cybersecurity posture and partner directly with teams building software across web, mobile, data, and AI-enabled workflows. This role will embed security into delivery practices, improve how we prevent and remediate risk, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This Director will work across software engineering, platform, DevOps, architecture, QA, infrastructure, compliance, and security teams to mature secure SDLC (i.e., SSDLC) practices, expand developer-friendly guardrails, and improve application and agent security. They should be comfortable moving between code review, tooling configuration, threat modeling, vulnerability management, automation, security enablement, and emerging AI security considerations.  This is a hybrid role (3 days/week in-office). Preference given to candidates near a TKO office, including NYC, Stamford, Orlando, Austin, or Las Vegas.

The Role and What You’ll Do

The Director, Application Security Engineering will:

  • Own and evolve application security practices across the SSDLC, emphasizing scalable, developer-aligned, shift-left controls
  • Operate and improve SAST, SCA, secret scanning, code scanning, repository protections, and related controls across repositories and CI/CD pipelines
  • Develop secure development enablement for citizen developers, vibe coding, and AI-assisted development, including practical guidance for tooling, code assurance, identity, observability, and enterprise standards
  • Review application and code-level vulnerabilities, validate findings, reduce noise, and drive risk-based remediation plans
  • Conduct threat modeling and security design reviews for new systems, major changes, integrations, APIs, and high-risk workflows
  • Advise teams on secure coding, authentication and authorization, session management, secrets handling, logging, encryption, dependency hygiene, and data protection
  • Improve security guardrails for build pipelines, containers, APIs, third-party components, and deployment practices across modern and legacy environments
  • Mature risk-based vulnerability management across intake, validation, prioritization, remediation guidance, exception handling, and reporting
  • Support secure adoption of AI-assisted development and agentic systems by assessing trust boundaries, data exposure paths, prompt and tool-invocation risks, and misuse scenarios
  • Develop pragmatic standards, playbooks, reference architectures, documentation, and office-hour support that improve consistency without slowing teams down unnecessarily
  • Track recurring weaknesses, recommend structural fixes, and help leadership understand where engineering investment will reduce risk most effectively
  • Use AI productively and responsibly to accelerate analysis, triage, documentation, coding support, and security review while maintaining strong human judgment

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in application security, product security, DevSecOps, and security engineering or a closely related software security role
  • Proven experience working directly with engineering teams in fast-moving delivery environments
  • Hands-on experience configuring, tuning, and operationalizing SAST, SCA, and related tooling such as SonarQube, Dependabot, GitHub, GitHub Advanced Security, or comparable platforms
  • Ability to interpret and reason about code, identify meaningful risk, and provide specific, implementable remediation guidance to engineers
  • Practical experience with SSDLC and shift-left practices, including automated code review support, threat modeling, security design review, and vulnerability management
  • Strong understanding of application and API security, including common software weaknesses, authN/authZ, secrets handling, dependency risk, injection, deserialization, and data protection
  • Experience integrating reliable, scalable, and minimally disruptive security controls into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud and modern software delivery patterns, including containers, IaC, and Git-based workflows
  • Strong judgment in vulnerability triage, balancing severity, exploitability, business impact, and engineering realities
  • Ability to write clear guidance, standards, and technical documentation for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Bias toward automation, simplification, and scalable solutions over manual heroics
  • Broad DevSecOps mindset across code, pipelines, dependencies, platforms, deployment, and operations
  • Experience using AI tools responsibly to improve engineering and security outcomes

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience securing AI agents, LLM-enabled applications, copilots, or agentic workflows in production or near-production environments
  • Experience with DAST, API security testing, penetration testing coordination, red-team support, or adversarial testing of application and AI systems
  • Experience with policy-as-code, IaC scanning, container/image security, software supply-chain security, SBOMs, provenance, attestation, and secrets management
  • Familiarity with cloud security across AWS and/or GCP and the application-layer implications of cloud-native architectures
  • Experience in regulated, audit-sensitive, or event-critical environments where evidence, controls, and operational rigor matter
  • Experience building metrics, dashboards, or reporting that show AppSec posture and remediation progress
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing secure engineering culture without direct people management responsibility

What Good Looks Like in This Role

  • Engineering teams get faster, clearer, and more actionable security guidance as well as assistance with implementation and mechanics for a "teach a person to fish" approach
  • Security tooling produces more trustworthy signals and leads to better adoption, not just more alerts
  • Teams catch and remediate issues earlier in design and development rather than late in release cycles
  • Application and agent-security risks are surfaced in practical terms with concrete mitigation paths
  • Standards, playbooks, and tooling make secure delivery easier and more consistent
  • Security becomes more embedded in day-to-day engineering execution and technical operations, and less dependent on last-minute security scrambles and efforts,

Per local requirements and in the interest of transparency, the hourly rate shown below reflects the prevalent current hiring range for this position. Hiring pay rates are based on a number of factors, including location and may vary depending on job-related qualifications, knowledge, skills and experience. The company strives to provide locally competitive rewards packages, which include base rate along with, as applicable, short- and long-term incentives, growth and developmental opportunities, and robust benefits, such as health care, retirement, vacation and other paid time off, and additional offerings.

Hiring Rate Minimum:

$142,500 annually(minimum will not fall below the applicable State/local minimum salary thresholds)

Hiring Rate Maximum:

$190,000 annually

You’ll work across a wide range of short-form content, from behind-the-scenes doc style promotions and hype reels to branded storytelling and original shoots.

If you love film, television, and music—and bring that sensibility into your work—you'll feel right at home here.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Craft short-form video content for WWE’s digital, social, and broadcast platforms.
  • Edit in Avid Media Composer within Interplay environments, adhering to established project workflows.
  • Bring a bespoke, intentional style to each edit—tailoring tone, pacing, and sound design to the story being told.
  • Collaborate closely with producers, directors, and graphic artists from concept through delivery.
  • Work with music supervisors and creative leads to source and sync stock music libraries that enhances emotional resonance.
  • Maintain high standards for visual storytelling, sound, and finish quality.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines while staying creatively inspired.

Qualifications:

  • 3–5 years of professional editing, or AE experience in TV, film, or digital media.
  • Proficient in Avid Media Composer and comfortable in Interplay environments.
  • Strong editorial sensibility with a track record of distinct, stylistic work—must provide a demo reel or portfolio.
  • Deep understanding of post-production workflows, asset management, and file-based media.
  • A love of music and its role in storytelling; skilled at pairing visuals and sound for maximum impact.
  • Comfortable taking feedback and working collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Passion for editing is essential—experience in sports is not required.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in documentary, narrative television, or music-driven content.
  • Knowledge of color correction, sound mixing, and motion graphics is a plus (but not required).
  • Fan of WWE or open to learning about the brand’s storytelling ethos.

Please attach a portfolio or work samples with your application.

job.title: Space Planner & Facilities Systems Specialist
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Location: Stamford, CT – WWE Headquarters (Onsite)
Department: Facilities
Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

WWE is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Space Planner to support the day-to-day planning, coordination, and optimization of our state-of-the-art corporate headquarters environment in Stamford, CT. This is an opportunity to support one of the most unique and technologically advanced corporate headquarters environments in Connecticut. This role offers exposure to modern workplace operations, facilities systems, and smart building technologies within a highly visible and collaborative environment.

This role will focus primarily on space planning, workplace coordination, AutoCAD-based floor plan management, and facilities operations support, while also assisting with CMMS administration, asset tracking, maintenance coordination, and reporting initiatives.

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys working at the intersection of workplace operations, facilities technology, and cross-functional coordination. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with space planning, facilities systems, CAD, or workplace operations experience who is interested in growing into broader smart building and

Key Responsibilities

Space Planning & Workplace Coordination

  • Maintain and update facility floor plans, seating layouts, and workplace documentation using AutoCAD or similar design software
  • Support office moves, adds, changes, and departmental space planning initiatives within our OfficeSpace software
  • Coordinate workspace allocations and assist with optimizing office utilization
  • Partner with Facilities, HR, IT, and department leaders to support workplace planning needs
  • Maintain accurate records of occupancy, workspace assignments, and facility layouts

Facilities Systems & CMMS Support

  • Support administration and ongoing maintenance of the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)
  • Assist with asset tracking, preventive maintenance scheduling, and work order coordination
  • Help maintain facilities data, inventory records, vendor information, and maintenance documentation
  • Generate reports and analytics related to facilities operations, asset management, and service performance
  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and internal teams to ensure timely completion of maintenance activities

Operational Support

  • Assist with facilities projects, workplace improvements, and operational initiatives
  • Support inventory management and procurement coordination for facilities-related materials and supplies
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency within workplace and facilities systems
  • Participate in workplace planning and facilities operational meetings as needed

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in space planning, facilities coordination, workplace operations, CAD drafting, facilities systems, or related environments
  • Experience in OfficeSpace or similar workplace management softwares/tools
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD or similar space planning/design software required
  • Experience supporting facilities operations, workplace planning, or office environments preferred
  • Exposure to CMMS, IWMS, CAFM, or other facilities management platforms is a plus
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication and cross-functional coordination abilities
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel
  • Experience with data reporting, asset tracking, or facilities analytics is a plus

job.title: Writer/Producer
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Writer/Producer

WWE develops and produces 52 weeks of original programming for two of the longest running weekly episodic television shows: Monday Night Raw and Friday Night SmackDown. Both Raw and SmackDown combine action, drama, reality, comedy and adventure! The goal of the Creative team is to provide compelling stories portrayed by the world's most charismatic, diverse, larger-than-life characters on or off television!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop clearly defined, yet emotionally sophisticated, characters for a diverse group of WWE Talent.

  • Script descriptive, thought-provoking, captivating, and creative storylines for RAW, SmackDown, and select WWE programming streaming on ESPN.

  • Collaborate with a team of writers to build compelling stories that capture a global audience fitting multiple demographics.

  • Provide punch-up for specific scripted segments as well as review the totality of entire episodes for continuity and flow.

  • Incorporate consumer insights and social media to deliver impactful storylines that are consistent with the WWE brand and each Talent's skills and history.

  • Weekly travel to our shows (RAW or SmackDown) & rotating travel to PLEs (Premium Live Events).

  • Attend and contribute in creative writing team meetings every week at our Stamford, CT HQ.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of writing for TV or Film

  • Producing and Directing experience a plus

  • Professional TV or Film staff experience preferred

  • Experience in Live TV production a plus

  • Previous experience working with On-Screen Talent, Creative Writers, and Producers

  • Understanding of WWE's audience (demographic and psychographic) preferred

  • BA/BS in Film, TV, Drama, Media Studies, Communications or similar field of study or validated experience in lieu of a degree preferred
